sys_update_xml.payload: custom open that cashflow's AI case. c.cfNavInput = (c.data && c.data.cfIndex) || 1; c.cfGo = function (n) { var total = (c.data && c.data.cfTotal) || 0; if (total < 1) { return; } n = parseInt(n, 10); if (isNaN(n)) { n = c.data.cfIndex; } if (n < 1) { n = 1; } if (n > total) { n = total; } if (n === c.data.cfIndex) { c.cfNavInput = c.data.cfIndex; return; } var target = c.data.cfList[n - 1]; if (target) { $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_ai_extraction&cf=' + target; } }; c.cfKey = function (ev) { if (ev.key === 'Enter') { c.cfGo(c.cfNavInput); return; } if (['-', '+', 'e', 'E', '.'].indexOf(ev.key) !== -1) { ev.preventDefault(); } }; // Enter edit mode — fields become editable. c.edit = function () { c.editing = true; }; // A field changed — light up Save and refresh the (cached) feedback rows + re-highlight the body. c.markDirty = function () { c.dirty = true; c.data.saved = false; rebuildFeedback(); rebuildBodyHtml(); }; // ---- Feedback Loop (ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDER — no backend / not wired) ---------------------------- // Snapshot the AI-extracted values at load; when the analyst changes any field, surface a row // {Field | AI Value | Actual Value | Reason}. Reason is an editable text box, kept in the client only. // Nothing here is persisted or sent anywhere — it demonstrates the human-in-the-loop feedback that a // real learning loop would harvest (the AI-value ↔ analyst-value pairs ARE captured in the audit trail, // so this can become real later). Per-cashflow: cfGo does a full page nav, so the baseline resets. c._fbFields = [ { k: 'counterparty', lbl: 'Counterparty' }, { k: 'value_date', lbl: 'Value Date' }, { k: 'amount', lbl: 'Amount' }, { k: 'currency', lbl: 'Currency' }, { k: 'direction', lbl: 'Direction' }, { k: 'nomuraEntity', lbl: 'Nomura Entity' }, { k: 'product', lbl: 'Product' }, { k: 'reference', lbl: 'Trade Reference' }, { k: 'tradeDate', lbl: 'Trade Date' }, { k: 'ssiBank', lbl: 'SSI Bank / BIC' }, { k: 'ssiAccount', lbl: 'SSI Account' }, { k: 'ssiBeneficiary', lbl: 'SSI Beneficiary / BIC' }, { k: 'ssiIntermediary', lbl: 'SSI Intermediary' } ]; c._fbBaseline = {}; for (var _fi = 0; _fi < c._fbFields.length; _fi++) { var _fk = c._fbFields[_fi].k; c._fbBaseline[_fk] = '' + ((c.data && c.data[_fk] != null) ? c.data[_fk] : ''); } c.fbReason = {}; // client-only, per-field free text c.feedbackRowsList = []; // CACHED — bound by ng-repeat/ng-if. Never bind ng-repeat to a function: // it would allocate a new array each digest and never stabilise ($rootScope:infdig). function rebuildFeedback() { var out = []; for (var i = 0; i < c._fbFields.length; i++) { var f = c._fbFields[i]; var cur = '' + ((c.data && c.data[f.k] != null) ? c.data[f.k] : ''); var base = c._fbBaseline[f.k] || ''; if (cur !== base) { out.push({ key: f.k, label: f.lbl, ai: base || '—', actual: cur || '—' }); } } c.feedbackRowsList = out; } rebuildFeedback(); // ---- Source highlighting (DEV feature): color-code THIS cashflow's values inside the mail body ------- // Only for BODY-ONLY mails (no attachments). Builds trusted HTML that wraps each extracted field value // where it appears in the body, colour-coded by field type — so the analyst sees exactly where each value // came from. Reactive: recomputed on load and on every edit. Multi-cashflow mails navigate per cashflow // (cfGo = full reload), so this always reflects the cashflow currently shown. var _sce = null; try { _sce = $injector.get('$sce'); } catch (e) { _sce = null; } // -- Email-body highlighting from the AI's source provenance (c.data.sources) -- // The model returns, per cashflow, the verbatim ROW source + the exact snippet it read each field value // from. We locate the row source (exact per-cashflow scoping - no string-guessing), then each field's // snippet within it, and build the legend from exactly the fields present. Counterparty is never here. c.HL_LEGEND = []; var _GROUP_CLS = { amount: 'cf-hl-amount', date: 'cf-hl-date', ccy: 'cf-hl-ccy', dir: 'cf-hl-dir', ref: 'cf-hl-ref', other: 'cf-hl-ssi' }; var _CUSTOM_PALETTE = ['cf-hl-c1', 'cf-hl-c2', 'cf-hl-c3', 'cf-hl-c4', 'cf-hl-c5', 'cf-hl-c6']; function _esc(s) { return ('' + s).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>'); } // Colour class for a field: fixed per group; custom fields get a distinct palette colour per key. function _clsFor(f, customMap) { if (f.group === 'custom') { if (!customMap.hasOwnProperty(f.key)) { customMap[f.key] = _CUSTOM_PALETTE[customMap.__n++ % _CUSTOM_PALETTE.length]; } return customMap[f.key]; } return _GROUP_CLS[f.group] || 'cf-hl-ssi'; } // Exact (then whitespace-tolerant) locate of `needle` in `body` within [lo, hi). Returns [start,end] or null. function _locate(body, needle, lo, hi) { var n = '' + needle; if (!n) { return null; } var idx = body.indexOf(n, lo); if (idx !== -1 && idx + n.length <= hi) { return [idx, idx + n.length]; } var pat = n.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&').replace(/\s+/g, '\\s+'); // model may reflow whitespace try { var re = new RegExp(pat, 'g'); re.lastIndex = lo; var m = re.exec(body); if (m && m.index >= lo && m.index + m[0].length <= hi) { return [m.index, m.index + m[0].length]; } } catch (e) { /* bad pattern -> no match */ } return null; } function _titleAttr(s) { return _esc(s).replace(/"/g, '"'); } // Build the highlighted body from the AI source provenance. Returns '' when there is nothing to show. function _buildBodyHtmlFromSources(body, sources) { body = '' + body; var fields = (sources && sources.fields) || []; c.HL_LEGEND = []; if (!fields.length) { return ''; } var customMap = { __n: 0 }; // active region = the row's verbatim source (exact per-cashflow scoping); whole body if not found. var lo = 0, hi = body.length, scoped = false; var rowsrc = ('' + ((sources && sources.rowsrc) || '')).trim(); if (rowsrc) { var rr = _locate(body, rowsrc, 0, body.length); if (rr) { lo = rr[0]; hi = rr[1]; scoped = true; } } var legend = [], ranges = [], i; for (i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) { var f = fields[i], cls = _clsFor(f, customMap); legend.push({ cls: cls, label: f.label }); var snip = ('' + (f.snippet || '')).trim(); if (!snip) { continue; } var r = _locate(body, snip, lo, hi); if (r) { ranges.push({ start: r[0], end: r[1], cls: cls, label: f.label }); } } c.HL_LEGEND = legend; // resolve overlaps (earliest start, then longest) ranges.sort(function (a, b) { return a.start - b.start || (b.end - b.start) - (a.end - a.start); }); var picked = [], lastEnd = -1, k; for (k = 0; k < ranges.length; k++) { if (ranges[k].start >= lastEnd) { picked.push(ranges[k]); lastEnd = ranges[k].end; } } // assemble: leading text | (text + field spans) | trailing text var html = _esc(body.slice(0, lo)), pos = lo, p; if (scoped) { html += ''; } for (p = 0; p < picked.length; p++) { var rg = picked[p]; html += _esc(body.slice(pos, rg.start)); html += '' + _esc(body.slice(rg.start, rg.end)) + ''; pos = rg.end; } html += _esc(body.slice(pos, hi)); if (scoped) { html += ''; } return html + _esc(body.slice(hi)); } c.bodyHl = false; // true -> render the highlighted body; false -> plain body c.bodyHtml = null; c.hlCount = 0; function rebuildBodyHtml() { c.bodyHl = false; c.bodyHtml = null; c.hlCount = 0; c.HL_LEGEND = []; if (!_sce || !c.data || !c.data.mail) { return; } var att = ('' + (c.data.mail.attachment || '')).trim(); var body = '' + (c.data.mail.body || ''); if (att || !body || body.length > 20000) { return; } // ONLY body-only mails (no attachment), sane size var html = _buildBodyHtmlFromSources(body, c.data.sources); if (!html) { return; } // no AI source provenance yet (re-sync to populate) -> plain body, no legend c.hlCount = (html.match(/class="cf-hl /g) || []).length; c.bodyHtml = _sce.trustAsHtml(html); c.bodyHl = true; } rebuildBodyHtml(); // Auto-scroll the body so the active cashflow block is at the top (so at cashflow 45/50 you don't scroll). // Runs once after render; cfGo navigates (full reload), so each cashflow view auto-scrolls to its block. var _timeout = null; try { _timeout = $injector.get('$timeout'); } catch (e) { _timeout = null; } function scrollToActive() { try { if (!$element || !$element[0]) { return; } var cont = $element[0].querySelector('.nom-mailbody-hl'); if (!cont) { return; } var act = cont.querySelector('.cf-hl-active'); if (!act) { return; } var cr = cont.getBoundingClientRect(), ar = act.getBoundingClientRect(); cont.scrollTop += (ar.top - cr.top) - 6; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } } if (_timeout) { _timeout(scrollToActive, 80); } // Save edited AI fields (only when there are unsaved changes). Stays IN edit mode so the analyst can // then Confirm (or keep editing) — only Confirm leaves edit mode. `dirty` is cleared synchronously // (within this click's digest) so the Save button disables immediately. c.saveError = ''; c.save = function () { if (!c.dirty) { return; } c.dirty = false; c.saveError = ''; c.data.action = 'save'; c.server.update().then( function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; rebuildFeedback(); }, function () { c.dirty = true; c.data.saved = false; c.saveError = 'Save failed — please try again.'; c.data.action = ''; } ); }; // Confirm the AI extracted fields. Leave edit mode so the card returns to the clean read-only view // (plain fields, no action bar, Re-confirm available). <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function controller($window, $timeout, $interval) {
    var c = this;

    // Board pagination survives the cashflow round-trip (opening a cashflow is a FULL page nav that resets
    // Angular state): c.open saves the current page + page-size to sessionStorage, and the restore block
    // (below the pager helpers) reads it on load so we return to the same page instead of page 1. Keyed by
    // wizard id so each board remembers its own page (order-independent — survives ?wiz=/?id= param order).
    c._pageKey = 'nfotcBoardPage:' + ((c.data && c.data.wizId) || 'default');   // server-recovered wiz id — stable even when the URL drops ?wiz= on the way back from a case screen

    // International-format an amount for DISPLAY only (thousands separators). Leaves the raw value + the
    // numeric sort field untouched; preserves any trailing currency text and a leading sign.
    c.fmtAmt = function (v) {
        var s = ('' + (v == null ? '' : v)).trim();
        if (!s) { return ''; }
        var m = s.match(/^(-?)(\d[\d,]*)(\.\d+)?(.*)$/);
        if (!m) { return s; }
        return m[1] + m[2].replace(/,/g, '').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',') + (m[3] || '') + (m[4] || '');
    };
    // Board-level access guard: the server sets data.redirect when the current user isn't permitted to
    // view this wizard's board (not assigned, and not a manager/admin). Navigate back to the landing page.
    if (c.data && c.data.redirect) { $window.location.href = c.data.redirect; return; }
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () { $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm'); };

    c.synced = !!(c.data && c.data.synced);
    c.syncing = false;

    // ---- live async progress state ----
    // CSG scans the whole mailbox and routes its own mails; OTC runs its settlement pipeline. Stage copy
    // differs so the loading card matches what's actually happening.
    var STAGES = (c.data && c.data.isCsg)
        ? ['Scanning the shared mailbox…', 'Routing CSG entity-data (NLUX) mails…', 'Extracting RDM ids…', 'Resolving entities in the EVE directory…']
        : ['Ingesting mails from the mailbox…', 'Classifying the in-scope mails…', 'Deriving counterparties from EVE…', 'Extracting settlement fields with AI…'];
    c.syncProgress = 0;      // real % = done / target
    c.syncDone = 0;
    c.syncTarget = 0;
    c.syncMatched = 0;       // mails routed to THIS wizard (of the whole mailbox scanned)
    c.syncElapsed = 0;
    c.syncMsg = '';
    c._tick = null;          // 1s elapsed/stage ticker
    c._poll = null;          // status poller
    c.elapsedFmt = function () { var m = Math.floor(c.syncElapsed / 60), s = c.syncElapsed % 60; return m + ':' + ('0' + s).slice(-2); };

    function startTicker() {
        var i = 0; c.syncElapsed = 0; c.syncMsg = STAGES[0];
        c._tick = $interval(function () { c.syncElapsed += 1; if (c.syncElapsed % 3 === 0) { i = (i + 1) % STAGES.length; c.syncMsg = STAGES[i]; } }, 1000);
    }
    function stopTicker() { if (c._tick) { $interval.cancel(c._tick); c._tick = null; } }
    function stopPoll() { if (c._poll) { $interval.cancel(c._poll); c._poll = null; } }

    // Access can be REVOKED while the board is already open (manager deletes the work-driver or unassigns
    // the analyst). The server re-runs the access guard on EVERY request and sets data.redirect; check it
    // after every round-trip so an in-page refresh / Sync / poll bounces the analyst out immediately — not
    // only on the initial page load.
    function checkRedirect() {
        if (c.data && c.data.redirect) {
            stopPoll(); stopTicker(); c.syncing = false;
            $window.location.href = c.data.redirect;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // Read the REAL progress the server returns and drive the bar/count.
    function applyProgress() {
        var p = (c.data && c.data.progress) || {};
        c.syncDone = (p.done || 0) + (p.errored || 0);
        c.syncTarget = p.target || 0;
        c.syncMatched = p.matched || 0;
        c.syncProgress = c.syncTarget > 0 ? Math.max(4, Math.round(c.syncDone / c.syncTarget * 100)) : (c.syncDone ? 100 : 8);
        return p;
    }
    function finishSync() {
        stopPoll(); stopTicker();
        c.syncProgress = 100;
        $timeout(function () { c.syncing = false; c.data.action = ''; c.synced = !!c.data.synced; sortRows(); }, 500);
    }

    function sortRows() {
        if (c.data.rows && c.data.rows.length) {
            c.data.rows.sort(function (a, b) { return ('' + (a.mailId || '')).localeCompare('' + (b.mailId || '')); });
        }
    }
    sortRows();

    // Sync now: fire the Workflow-Studio subflow per mail in the BACKGROUND (non-blocking), then poll real
    // progress every ~2.5s — the bar + "X of N" reflect actual completions, and rows stream in live.
    var _lastDone = -1, _noChange = 0, _polls = 0;
    function poll() {
        c.data.action = 'sync_status';
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            if (checkRedirect()) { return; }
            c.data.action = ''; _polls += 1;
            var p = applyProgress();
            sortRows();
            if (p.complete || (p.running || 0) <= 0) { finishSync(); return; }
            if (c.syncDone === _lastDone) { _noChange += 1; } else { _noChange = 0; _lastDone = c.syncDone; }
            if (_polls > 120 || _noChange > 16) { finishSync(); }   // safety: reveal what we have if it stalls
        });
    }
    c.sync = function () {
        if (c.syncing) { return; }
        c.syncing = true; _lastDone = -1; _noChange = 0; _polls = 0;
        c.syncProgress = 6; c.syncDone = 0; c.syncTarget = 0;
        startTicker();
        c.data.action = 'sync';
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            if (checkRedirect()) { return; }
            c.data.action = '';
            var p = applyProgress(); sortRows();
            if (!p.complete && (p.running || 0) > 0) { c._poll = $interval(poll, 2500); }
            else { finishSync(); }
        });
    };
    c.resync = function () {
        c.data.action = 'reset_sync';
        c.server.update().then(function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; c.synced = false; c.data.rows = []; });
    };

    // ---- filters + sort (same behaviour as the OTC Settlements dashboard) ----
    c.sortKey = 'mailId'; c.sortAsc = true;
    c.q = ''; c.cpFilter = ''; c.matchFilter = '';
    // Outlook Tagging is a MULTI-SELECT (toggle buttons): c.wfSel holds the chosen tags; empty = show all.
    c.wfTags = ['Awaiting Confirmation', 'Awaiting Review', 'Resolved — Matched', 'Resolved — Unmatched'];
    c.wfSel = {};
    c.toggleWf = function (t) { if (c.wfSel[t]) { delete c.wfSel[t]; } else { c.wfSel[t] = true; } c.onFilterChange(); };
    c.wfActive = function () { for (var k in c.wfSel) { if (c.wfSel.hasOwnProperty(k)) { return true; } } return false; };
    c.clearWf = function () { c.wfSel = {}; c.onFilterChange(); };
    c.rowFilter = function (row) {
        var q = ('' + (c.q || '')).toLowerCase().trim();
        if (q) {
            // Global search across every visible column — mail id, counterparty, amount (raw + formatted),
            // currency, direction, value date, classification, match status and outlook tagging. Every typed
            // word must appear somewhere in the row (AND match).
            var hay = [
                row.mailId, row.cfLabel, row.counterparty, row.amount, c.fmtAmt(row.amount),
                row.currency, row.direction, row.value_date_disp, row.value_date,
                (row.tagging && row.tagging.label), row.matchLabel, row.workflowLabel, row.reference
            ].join(' ').toLowerCase();
            var terms = q.split(/\s+/);
            for (var ti = 0; ti < terms.length; ti++) { if (terms[ti] && hay.indexOf(terms[ti]) === -1) { return false; } }
        }
        if (c.cpFilter && row.counterparty !== c.cpFilter) { return false; }
        if (c.matchFilter && row.matchStatus !== c.matchFilter) { return false; }
        if (c.wfActive() && !c.wfSel[row.workflowLabel]) { return false; }   // multi-select: keep rows whose tag is selected
        return true;
    };
    c.open = function (href) {
        if (!href) { return; }
        // Remember which board page this cashflow was opened from, so returning lands back here.
        try { $window.sessionStorage.setItem(c._pageKey, JSON.stringify({ page: c.page, pageSize: c.pageSize })); } catch (e) { /* sessionStorage unavailable (private mode) */ }
        $window.location.href = href;
    };

    // ---- CSG entity-break board filters + detail panel ----
    c.csgQ = ''; c.csgStatusFilter = '';
    c.csgDetail = null;
    c.openCsg = function (row) { c.csgDetail = row; if ($window.scrollTo) { $window.scrollTo(0, 0); } };
    c.closeCsg = function () { c.csgDetail = null; };
    c.csgRowFilter = function (row) {
        var q = ('' + (c.csgQ || '')).toLowerCase();
        if (q && ('' + (row.rdm || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1 &&
                 ('' + (row.entity || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1 &&
                 ('' + (row.fullName || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1) { return false; }
        if (c.csgStatusFilter && row.status !== c.csgStatusFilter) { return false; }
        return true;
    };
    c.sortVal = function (row, key) {
        if (key === 'amount') { return row.amountNum; }
        if (key === 'elapsed') { return row.elapsedMin; }
        if (key === 'tagging') { return row.tagging.label; }
        if (key === 'match') { return row.matchLabel; }
        return row[key];
    };
    c.arrow = function (key) { if (c.sortKey !== key) { return '⇅'; } return c.sortAsc ? '▲' : '▼'; };
    c.sort = function (key) {
        if (c.sortKey === key) { c.sortAsc = !c.sortAsc; } else { c.sortKey = key; c.sortAsc = true; }
        var asc = c.sortAsc;
        c.data.rows.sort(function (a, b) {
            var xa = c.sortVal(a, key), xb = c.sortVal(b, key), r;
            if (typeof xa === 'number' && typeof xb === 'number') { r = xa - xb; }
            else { r = ('' + xa).localeCompare('' + xb); }
            return asc ? r : -r;
        });
    };

    // ---- pagination (shared by the OTC cashflow board + the CSG entity-break board) ----
    // Client-side only: the rows are already loaded, so this slices the CURRENT filtered set. The user
    // picks how many rows per page from a standard set; "All" shows everything. Available to managers and
    // analysts alike (the read-only mode only hides ACTIONS, not the paging controls).
    c.pageSizes = [10, 25, 50, 100];
    c.pageSize = 25;                 // sensible default
    c.page = 1;
    c.ALL = 1000000;                 // limitTo cap used for the "All" option
    c._ps = function () { return c.pageSize === 'All' ? c.ALL : c.pageSize; };
    c.pageOffset = function () { return (c.page - 1) * (c.pageSize === 'All' ? 0 : c.pageSize); };
    c.pageLimit = function () { return c._ps(); };
    c.pageCount = function (total) { return Math.max(1, Math.ceil((total || 0) / c._ps())); };
    c.prevPage = function () { if (c.page > 1) { c.page -= 1; } };
    c.nextPage = function (total) { if (c.page < c.pageCount(total)) { c.page += 1; } };
    c.lastPage = function (total) { c.page = c.pageCount(total); };
    c.rangeStart = function (total) { return total ? (c.pageOffset() + 1) : 0; };
    c.rangeEnd = function (total) { return Math.min(c.pageOffset() + c._ps(), total || 0); };
    // Reset to page 1 whenever the row set changes shape (search / filter / page-size) so we never land on
    // a now-empty page. Sorting keeps the count, so it does NOT reset the page.
    c.onPageSize = function () { c.page = 1; };
    c.onFilterChange = function () { c.page = 1; };

    // Restore the page/size saved when a cashflow was opened from this board (c.open), so a "← Dashboard"
    // return lands on the same page. Clamp to the current row count so we never overshoot a shorter list.
    (function () {
        try {
            var saved = JSON.parse($window.sessionStorage.getItem(c._pageKey) || 'null');
            if (!saved) { return; }
            if (saved.pageSize === 'All' || c.pageSizes.indexOf(saved.pageSize) !== -1) { c.pageSize = saved.pageSize; }
            var n = parseInt(saved.page, 10);
            if (n > 0) {
                c.page = n;   // restore even if rows haven't rendered yet (board is sync-gated) — never force page 1 prematurely
                var rc = (c.data && c.data.rows) ? c.data.rows.length : 0;
                if (rc > 0 && c.pageSize !== 'All') {
                    var maxPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rc / c.pageSize));   // clamp DOWN only when the count is actually known
                    if (c.page > maxPage) { c.page = maxPage; }
                }
            }
        } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    })();
}
]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* Published-wizard dashboard — clone of the OTC Settlements dashboard CSS + Sync-now states. */
.nom-app * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.nom-app { font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; background: #eef1f5; color: #20242c; min-height: 100vh; }
.nom-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; background: #fff; padding: 6px 26px; border-bottom: 3px solid #C8102E; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06); position: relative; z-index: 30; }
.nom-logo { height: 48px; width: auto; }
.nom-user { margin-left: auto; position: relative; }
.nom-role { font-size: 13px; color: #5b6270; }
.nom-avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #C8102E; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.nom-user-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 8px 4px 6px; border-radius: 9px; transition: background .12s; }
.nom-user-btn:hover { background: #f3f4f7; }
.nom-caret { color: #98a2b3; font-size: 10px; transition: transform .15s; }
.nom-caret.open { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.nom-backdrop { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 900; background: transparent; }
.nom-menu { position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 8px); z-index: 1000; width: 222px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(20,30,60,.18); overflow: hidden; }
.nom-menu-hd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f2f5; }
.nom-avatar.sm { width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 12px; }
.nom-menu-id .nm-name { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.nom-menu-id .nm-sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: #8a909a; margin-top: 1px; }
.nom-menu-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #fff; border: none; text-align: left; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #C0392B; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
.nom-menu-item:hover { background: #fdf2f2; }
.nom-menu-item .nm-ico { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; }

.nom-body { display: flex; align-items: stretch; min-height: calc(100vh - 62px); }
.tag-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 24px 30px; }
.tag-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.tag-head h1 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wz-home { margin-left: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #C8102E; background: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 18px; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid #f0c8ce; }
.wz-home:hover { background: #fdeef0; text-decoration: none; }
.sync-btn { background: #C8102E; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 18px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(200,16,46,.3); font-family: inherit; }
.sync-btn:hover { background: #a50d26; }
.sync-btn.big { padding: 13px 26px; font-size: 15px; margin-top: 22px; }
.sync-btn.ghost { background: #fff; color: #6B46C1; border: 1px solid #d9cef5; box-shadow: none; margin-right: 8px; }
.sync-btn.ghost:hover { background: #f5f1fd; }

/* Sync states */
.sync-empty { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05); padding: 70px 40px; text-align: center; }
.sync-empty-ico { width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f1edfb; color: #6B46C1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 30px; margin: 0 auto 18px; }
.sync-empty-t { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; }
.sync-empty-s { font-size: 13.5px; color: #6b7280; margin: 8px auto 0; max-width: 480px; line-height: 1.6; }
.sync-loading { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05); padding: 56px 40px; }
.sync-load-card { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; }
.sync-load-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; text-align: center; }
.sync-load-sub { font-size: 13px; color: #6b7280; text-align: center; margin: 8px 0 26px; line-height: 1.5; }
.sync-count { text-align: center; font-size: 14px; color: #475065; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.sync-count-num { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; color: #6B46C1; vertical-align: -3px; }
.sync-count-of { color: #98a0ac; }
.sync-bar { height: 9px; background: #eef0f4; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
.sync-bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6B46C1, #9a6ff0); background-size: 200% 100%; transition: width .9s ease; animation: sync-shimmer 1.6s linear infinite; }
@keyframes sync-shimmer { to { background-position: -200% 0; } }
.sync-load-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 12px; }
.sync-load-msg { font-size: 13px; color: #475065; }

.sync-note { background: #e6f4ea; border: 1px solid #cdeeda; color: #1E7E45; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 16px; }

.sync-warn { background: #fdf1e3; border: 1px solid #f2d9b8; color: #8a6516; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }

/* dashboard table (identical to OTC Settlements) */
.stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.stat { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 16px 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(20,30,60,.05); }

.search { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(20,30,60,.05); }

.s-field { padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid #d7dbe2; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; color: #1a1a2e; background: #fff; min-width: 180px; }

.tag-btn { padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid #d7dbe2; border-radius: 20px; background: #fff; color: #374151; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s ease, border-color .12s ease, color .12s ease; }

/* Per-mail resolution highlight: a resolved cashflow = light green; its still-unresolved siblings

/* --- mail pipeline funnel (Processed -> Relevant -> Extracted) --- */
.funnel { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(20,30,60,.05); padding: 14px 20px 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; }

@media (max-width: 720px) { .fn-arrow { min-width: 100%; flex-direction: row; padding: 2px 0; } .fn-chev { transform: rotate(90deg); } }

/* --- pagination footer (shared by the OTC + CSG boards) --- */
.pager { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 18px; border-top: 1px solid #eef0f4; background: #fbfbfd; }

.pager-size select:focus { outline: none; border-color: #C8102E; }

.pager-nav button:hover:not([disabled]) { border-color: #C8102E; color: #C8102E; }
.pager-nav button[disabled] { color: #b4b9c2; cursor: default; background: #f4f5f7; }
.pager-page { font-size: 12.5px; color: #1a1a2e; font-weight: 600; padding: 0 8px; }
.tg { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px; }
.tg-conf { background: #fdf1e3; color: #B7791F; }
.tg-rev { background: #e7f0fb; color: #1F5FA8; }
.tg-pre { background: #eef0f6; color: #3F5170; }
.tg-settle { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1E7E45; }
.tg-post { background: #f1edfb; color: #6B46C1; }
.tg-ok { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1E7E45; }
.tg-warn { background: #fdf1e3; color: #B7791F; }
.tg-bad { background: #fbe9e7; color: #C0392B; }
.tg-pend { background: #eef0f4; color: #6b7280; }
.tg-prog { background: #e7f0fb; color: #1F5FA8; }

/* ── CSG mail detail (visual only) ── */
.csg-link { color: #C8102E; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(200,16,46,.4); }
.tbl tbody tr:hover .csg-link { border-bottom-color: #C8102E; }

.csg-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(20,26,44,.5); z-index: 40; }
.csg-modal { position: fixed; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: min(960px, 94vw); max-height: 90vh; background: #fff; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(15,22,45,.35); z-index: 41; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
.csg-modal-hd { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f4; }
.csg-modal-ttl { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.csg-modal-file { font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; }
.csg-close { border: none; background: #f1f2f5; color: #6b7280; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
.csg-close:hover { background: #e4e6ea; color: #1a1a2e; }
.csg-modal-bd { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 1fr; gap: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.csg-mail { padding: 20px 22px; overflow-y: auto; border-right: 1px solid #eef0f4; }
.csg-fields { padding: 20px 22px; overflow-y: auto; background: #fbfbfd; }
.csg-sec-h { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #98a0ac; margin-bottom: 14px; }

.csg-hdr-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 6px 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.csg-hk { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #98a0ac; padding-top: 1px; }
.csg-hv { font-size: 12.5px; color: #2a2f39; word-break: break-word; }
.csg-subj { font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.csg-body { background: #f7f8fa; border: 1px solid #eef0f4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: #3a3f4a; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; max-height: 46vh; overflow-y: auto; }

.csg-fld { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.csg-fld-k { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #6b7280; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.csg-fld-v { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.csg-fld-v.mono { font-family: Consolas, monospace; }
.csg-fld-div { height: 1px; background: #eaecf1; margin: 4px 0 16px; }

.csg-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .01em; padding: 2px 8px 2px 6px; border-radius: 20px; text-transform: none; }
.csg-tag svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }
.csg-tag.eve { background: #e7f0fb; color: #1F5FA8; }
.csg-tag.ai { background: #f1edfb; color: #6B46C1; }

@media (max-width: 720px) { .csg-modal-bd { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .csg-mail { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f4; } }
</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>true</has_preview><id>nfotcbsm-wiz-dashboard</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
}]]></link><name>OTC Wizard Dashboard</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Published-wizard dashboard (Service Portal) — the block that appears on the work-driver landing once
 * a wizard is published. It IS the OTC Settlements Dashboard (delegates to TaggingDashboard.dataAi()),
 * but starts EMPTY: nothing shows until the analyst clicks "Sync now", which pulls the mailbox-drop
 * mails (already AI-extracted by the pipeline) into the board. The sync state is held per session so a
 * reload keeps the synced view. Rows link to the same Compare & Match + writeback case screen.
 */
(function () {
    data.logo = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().LOGO;
    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();
    data.homeUrl = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers';

    var wizId = $sp.getParameter('wiz') || (input && input.wizId) || '';
    // Recover the wizard from session when navigation dropped the ?wiz= param (e.g. coming back from a
    // case screen). The wiz-dashboard is ALWAYS per-wizard; without a wizId, TaggingDashboard.dataAi()
    // falls back to the GLOBAL view (every relevant mail, incl. CSG) — that is the bug being fixed here.
    if (!wizId) { wizId = '' + (gs.getSession().getClientData('nfotc_wiz_current') || ''); }
    if (wizId) { gs.getSession().putClientData('nfotc_wiz_current', wizId); }
    data.wizId = wizId;

    // ── BOARD-LEVEL ACCESS GUARD (centralised: x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard) ──
    // The wiz board is per-wizard by definition — never render it (or the dataAi global fallback) without a
    // wizId; bounce to the landing page for EVERYONE (incl. admin). Otherwise managers/admins pass and an
    // analyst may open a board ONLY for a wizard assigned to them (a hand-typed ?wiz= URL is thus blocked).
    data.redirect = '';
    if (!wizId || !new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().canViewWizard(wizId)) { data.redirect = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers'; }
    if (data.redirect) {
        // Not permitted — return safe empty defaults so the template doesn't error during the redirect
        // flash, then stop building the board. The client navigates away on data.redirect.
        data.wizName = ''; data.isCsg = false; data.synced = false; data.progress = null; data.readOnly = true;
        data.stats = []; data.rows = []; data.counterparties = []; data.csgRows = []; data.csgStats = [];
        return;
    }

    // READ-ONLY mode — a manager/admin viewing a board they don't own as the assigned analyst, or an explicit
    // manager view opened from the dashboard (?ro=1). Read-only strips every state-changing control
    // (FR-UI-022: managers can't confirm/override/write-back). Only the assigned analyst may act.
    var _roParam = ('' + ($sp.getParameter('ro') || '')) === '1';
    data.readOnly = _roParam || !new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().isAssignedAnalyst(wizId);

    data.wizName = 'OTC Settlements';
    // CSG mode: when this wizard is a CSG entity-data wizard (work-driver / name carries "csg"), the board
    // renders an ENTITY-BREAK view (EVE lookup by RDM id) instead of the OTC cashflow view. Detection is
    // string-based and off-path for OTC, so the OTC Settlements board is entirely unaffected.
    data.isCsg = false;
    var wizIdRules = '';
    if (wizId) {
        var wg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (wg.get(wizId)) {
            data.wizName = wg.getValue('name') || 'OTC Settlements';
            // CSG detection is robust to the taxonomy: new wizards carry it as the "CSG" Service (OPS Client
            // Services -> Client Entity Data -> CSG); legacy ones carried "csg" in the work-driver/name/sub-bu.
            var sig = ((wg.getValue('service') || '') + ' ' + (wg.getValue('work_driver') || '') + ' ' + (wg.getValue('name') || '') + ' ' + (wg.getValue('sub_bu') || '')).toLowerCase();
            data.isCsg = sig.indexOf('csg') !== -1;
            wizIdRules = wg.getValue('id_rules') || '';
        }
    }

    var flagKey = 'wizsync_' + (wizId || 'default');
    data.syncInfo = null;
    if (input && input.action === 'sync' && wizId && !data.readOnly) {
        // "Sync now" RUNS THE WORKFLOW STUDIO FLOW — ASYNC. For each relevant mail it invokes the callable
        // subflow "OTC Settlement - Intake (Subflow)" in the BACKGROUND via sn_fd.FlowAPI (fire-and-forget),
        // so the request returns immediately and the mails process in parallel off the request thread.
        // Real progress is polled via 'sync_status'. Mails land at "Awaiting Confirmation" (HITL).
        var wgc = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        var activity = wgc.get(wizId) ? (wgc.getValue('activity') || '') : '';
        if (activity !== 'Compare & Match') {
            data.syncInfo = { queued: 0, unsupported: true, activity: activity };
        } else {
            var queued = 0, failed = 0, diag = '';
            // The ingest flow is upload-only now, so mails have NO classification yet — the SUBFLOW
            // classifies (and skips extraction for irrelevant). Run it on every mail this wizard hasn't
            // processed. Skip ones already extracted, or already processed (incl. classified-irrelevant).
            var rg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            rg.orderBy('sys_created_on');
            rg.query();
            var wex = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.WizardExtractor();
            while (rg.next()) {
                var eid = rg.getUniqueValue();
                if (rg.getValue('wiz_extracted') === wizId) { continue; }   // already EXTRACTED by this wizard (real success) — don't redo
                // OWNERSHIP GATE — the fix for cross-wizard sync. Only process mails that match THIS wizard's
                // Email-Identification rules; ingest-on-demand makes routing work on the first sync too.
                // Mails belonging to another wizard (or noise) are skipped entirely — never stamped, never
                // run — so clicking Sync on one board never touches the other board's mails.
                var route = wex.routeForWizard(wizId, eid);
                if (!route || route.classification !== 'relevant') { continue; }
                // NOTE: do NOT skip merely because composed_state==='done' — 'done' is set even when extraction
                // returned no rows, so a failed / empty mail MUST be retried on the next Sync (not skipped forever).
                var egr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
                if (!egr.get(eid)) { continue; }
                egr.setValue('composed_run', wizId); egr.setValue('composed_state', 'running'); egr.update();
                try {
                    // Reference input needs a GlideRecord. inBackground() = queue + return immediately.
                    // CSG runs through its OWN (dummy, demo-only) subflow; OTC through the real intake one.
                    var _subflow = data.isCsg ? 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm.csg_intake_subflow' : 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm.otc_intake_subflow';
                    sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner()
                        .subflow(_subflow)
                        .inBackground()
                        .withInputs({ email_record: egr })
                        .run();
                    queued++;
                } catch (efx) {
                    failed++; if (!diag) { diag = '' + efx; }
                    egr.setValue('composed_state', 'error'); egr.update();   // don't leave it stuck "running"
                }
            }
            data.syncInfo = { activity: activity, async: true, queued: queued, failed: failed, diag: diag };
        }
        gs.getSession().putClientData(flagKey, '1');
    }
    if (input && input.action === 'reset_sync' && !data.readOnly) { gs.getSession().clearClientData(flagKey); }
    var sessionFlag = ('' + (gs.getSession().getClientData(flagKey) || '')) === '1';

    // Live async progress for THIS wizard (polled by 'sync_status'; also computed on 'sync' + normal load).
    // A mail is DONE if it extracted (wiz_extracted===wizId) or its subflow finished (composed_state 'done');
    // RUNNING while its subflow is in flight; ERRORED if it failed to queue. Complete when running hits 0.
    data.progress = null;
    if (wizId) {
        var pDone = 0, pRunning = 0, pErr = 0, pMatched = 0;
        var pg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        pg.addQuery('composed_run', wizId);
        pg.query();
        while (pg.next()) {
            pMatched++;
            var wx = pg.getValue('wiz_extracted'), cs = pg.getValue('composed_state');
            if (wx === wizId || cs === 'done') { pDone++; }
            else if (cs === 'error') { pErr++; }
            else if (cs === 'running') { pRunning++; }
            else { pDone++; }
        }
        if (data.isCsg) {
            // CSG SCANS THE WHOLE SHARED MAILBOX, then processes only its matches. Report the FULL scan:
            // every mail is evaluated against the wizard's rules; the ones it doesn't own are dismissed
            // instantly (counted done), and its matched mails extract in the background. So the bar reads
            // "N of <whole mailbox>", not "5 of 5".
            var tg = new GlideAggregate('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            tg.addAggregate('COUNT');
            tg.query();
            var scanTotal = tg.next() ? parseInt(tg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : pMatched;
            var dismissed = Math.max(0, scanTotal - pMatched);   // scanned & not this wizard's -> done
            data.progress = { done: dismissed + pDone + pErr, running: pRunning, errored: pErr, target: scanTotal, matched: pMatched, complete: (pRunning === 0) };
        } else {
            data.progress = { done: pDone, running: pRunning, errored: pErr, target: pDone + pRunning + pErr, matched: pMatched, complete: (pRunning === 0) };
        }
    }

    // ── CSG ENTITY-BREAK BOARD ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Hardcoded EVE lookup for the POC (no AI, no extraction): pull the RDM id off each routed CSG mail
    // and resolve the entity record. Status is the headline column. This whole branch is CSG-only; the
    // OTC path below is never touched.
    if (data.isCsg) {
        // Hardcoded EVE directory (mirrors CSG_EVE_Reference.xlsx). Keyed by RDM id carried in the mail.
        var EVE = {
            '364469': { entity: 'ENT1', role: 'ISS,NLE,OBLG,TRAR,TROBO', shortName: 'ENT1', longName: 'Entity1', fullName: 'Entity1', country: 'GB', status: 'OPEN' },
            '372815': { entity: 'ENT2', role: 'ISS,NLE,OBLG,TRAR',       shortName: 'ENT2', longName: 'Entity2', fullName: 'Entity2', country: 'US', status: 'CLOSED' },
            '388104': { entity: 'ENT3', role: 'NLE,OBLG,TROBO',          shortName: 'ENT3', longName: 'Entity3', fullName: 'Entity3', country: 'SG', status: 'OPEN' },
            '395620': { entity: 'ENT4', role: 'ISS,NLE,OBLG,TRAR,TROBO', shortName: 'ENT4', longName: 'Entity4', fullName: 'Entity4', country: 'DE', status: 'CLOSED' },
            '402337': { entity: 'ENT5', role: 'ISS,NLE,OBLG,TROBO',      shortName: 'ENT5', longName: 'Entity5', fullName: 'Entity5', country: 'HK', status: 'OPEN' }
        };
        // The CSG mails are the ones carrying this wizard's identifier keyword in the subject (NLUX by
        // default) — robust to the shared classification field flip-flopping between wizards.
        var kw = 'NLUX';
        try { var lbls = JSON.parse(wizIdRules || '[]'); if (lbls[0] && lbls[0].subject) { kw = '' + lbls[0].subject; } } catch (eKw) { /* default */ }

        data.csgRows = [];
        var csgOpen = 0, csgClosed = 0, csgUnmatched = 0, csgProcessed = 0;
        var cg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        cg.addQuery('mail_subject', 'CONTAINS', kw);
        cg.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        cg.query();
        while (cg.next()) {
            // "This wizard synced these mails" marker — set only by THIS board's Sync loop. OTC's Sync
            // ingests (parses) the CSG mails to route/exclude them, but the ownership gate never stamps
            // composed_run on them, so it can't make the CSG board look synced.
            if (cg.getValue('composed_run') === wizId) { csgProcessed++; }
            var subj = cg.getValue('mail_subject') || '';
            var body = cg.getValue('mail_body') || '';
            // RDM id: trailing number in the subject, else ORG_RDM_ID in the body, else any 5–7 digit run.
            var m = subj.match(/(\d{5,7})\s*$/) ||
                    body.match(/ORG[_ ]?RDM[_ ]?ID\D{0,20}(\d{5,7})/i) ||
                    subj.match(/(\d{5,7})/);
            var rdm = m ? m[1] : '';
            var e = EVE[rdm] || null;
            if (e && e.status === 'OPEN') { csgOpen++; }
            else if (e && e.status === 'CLOSED') { csgClosed++; }
            else { csgUnmatched++; }
            data.csgRows.push({
                mailId: cg.getValue('name'),
                rdm: rdm || '-',
                entity: e ? e.entity : '-',
                role: e ? e.role : '-',
                shortName: e ? e.shortName : '-',
                longName: e ? e.longName : '-',
                fullName: e ? e.fullName : '-',
                country: e ? e.country : '-',
                status: e ? e.status : 'NOT FOUND',
                matched: !!e,
                // display-only mail context for the detail panel (does not affect routing/EVE lookup)
                subject: subj,
                from: cg.getValue('mail_from') || '',
                to: cg.getValue('mail_to') || '',
                cc: cg.getValue('mail_cc') || '',
                body: body
            });
        }
        data.csgStats = [
            { label: 'Entity Breaks', num: data.csgRows.length, numCls: 'n-blue' },
            { label: 'Open', num: csgOpen, numCls: 'n-green' },
            { label: 'Closed', num: csgClosed, numCls: 'n-amber' },
            { label: 'Unresolved', num: csgUnmatched, numCls: (csgUnmatched ? 'n-red' : '') }
        ];
        // Synced ONLY when CSG's own Sync has run: a CSG mail carries composed_run === wizId (persists),
        // OR a sync is in flight, OR the session flag is set (immediate post-click). Merely having NLUX
        // mails in the table (e.g. ingested by OTC's Sync) does NOT count — so the CSG board stays on the
        // "Nothing run yet" empty state until the user clicks Sync on THIS board.
        var csgInFlight = !!(data.progress && data.progress.running > 0);
        data.synced = (csgProcessed > 0) || csgInFlight || sessionFlag;
        // OTC arrays stay empty in CSG mode.
        data.stats = []; data.rows = []; data.counterparties = [];
        return;
    }

    // PERSISTENCE: the board is "synced" if this wizard already has extracted mails in the DB (so it
    // survives leaving and returning to the page), OR a sync is currently in flight, OR the session flag
    // is set (immediate post-click). No longer session-only — a reload/navigation keeps the results.
    var d = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.TaggingDashboard().dataAi(wizId, data.readOnly);
    var hasRows = !!(d && d.rows && d.rows.length);
    var inFlight = !!(data.progress && data.progress.running > 0);
    data.synced = hasRows || inFlight || sessionFlag;
    data.funnel = null;
    if (data.synced) {
        // scope the board to only the mails THIS wizard has extracted with its own field prompts
        data.stats = d.stats;
        data.rows = d.rows;
        data.counterparties = d.counterparties;

        // ── Mail pipeline funnel: Processed → Relevant → Extracted. Makes the mail flow transparent so
        // nothing feels "lost" — every scanned mail is accounted for, and the drop-off at each stage is
        // explicit. All cheap COUNT aggregates on the email table.
        //   Processed = the whole shared mailbox this wizard's Sync scanned/evaluated.
        //   Relevant  = mails this driver CLAIMED via its Email-Identification rules (composed_run = wizId,
        //               or already extracted by it) — i.e. relevant + owned.
        //   Extracted = mails that produced ≥1 cashflow (wiz_extracted = wizId).
        function _count(gr) { gr.addAggregate('COUNT'); gr.query(); return gr.next() ? (parseInt(gr.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0) : 0; }
        var _fp = new GlideAggregate('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        var _processed = _count(_fp);
        var _fr = new GlideAggregate('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        _fr.addQuery('composed_run', wizId).addOrCondition('wiz_extracted', wizId);   // relevant + owned (⊇ extracted)
        var _relevant = _count(_fr);
        var _fe = new GlideAggregate('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        _fe.addQuery('wiz_extracted', wizId);
        var _extracted = _count(_fe);
        data.funnel = {
            processed: _processed,
            relevant: _relevant,
            extracted: _extracted,
            filtered: Math.max(0, _processed - _relevant),   // scanned but not this driver's / not relevant
            pending: Math.max(0, _relevant - _extracted)     // claimed but not yet extracted (failed / in-flight → retried next Sync)
        };
    } else {
        data.stats = [];
        data.rows = [];
        data.counterparties = [];
    }
})();
]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>a457327eb58e49f7953f2e1837ce0eda</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>OTC Wizard Dashboard</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_a457327eb58e49f7953f2e1837ce0eda</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:24</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="nom-app">
  <header class="nom-top">
    <img class="nom-logo" ng-src="{{c.data.logo}}" alt="Nomura"/>
    <div class="nom-user">
      <div class="nom-user-btn" ng-click="c.userMenu = !c.userMenu">
        <span class="nom-role">{{c.data.role}}</span>
        <div class="nom-avatar">US</div>
        <span class="nom-caret" ng-class="{open: c.userMenu}">▾</span>
      </div>
      <div class="nom-backdrop" ng-if="c.userMenu" ng-click="c.userMenu = false"></div>
      <div class="nom-menu" ng-if="c.userMenu">
        <div class="nom-menu-hd">
          <div class="nom-avatar sm">US</div>
          <div class="nom-menu-id"><div class="nm-name">Analyst</div><div class="nm-sub">{{c.data.wizName}}</div></div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="nom-menu-item" ng-click="c.signOut()"><span class="nm-ico">⏻</span> Sign out</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="nom-body">
    <main class="tag-main">
    <div class="tag-head">
      <h1>{{c.data.wizName}}</h1>
      <a class="wz-home" ng-href="{{c.data.homeUrl}}">← Home</a>
      <span ng-if="c.data.readOnly" style="margin-left:12px;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:#fdecef;color:#C8102E;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;" title="You are viewing this analyst's board as a manager — actions are disabled (FR-UI-022).">👁 Read-only — Manager view</span>
      <button class="sync-btn" ng-if="c.synced && !c.syncing && !c.data.readOnly" ng-click="c.sync()" title="Run this wizard's workflow (Workflow Studio) on the mailbox">↻ Sync now</button>
    </div>

    <!-- syncing: loading animation -->
    <div class="sync-loading" ng-if="c.syncing">
      <div class="sync-load-card">
        <div class="sync-load-title">Running the workflow</div>
        <div class="sync-load-sub" ng-if="!c.data.isCsg">Mails are processing through Workflow Studio in the background — Ingest → Classify → Derive counterparty (EVE) → Extract fields. You can keep working; results stream in below.</div>
        <div class="sync-load-sub" ng-if="c.data.isCsg">Scanning the whole shared mailbox and routing the CSG entity-data mails — Ingest → Identify (NLUX) → Extract RDM id → Resolve in EVE. You can keep working; results stream in below.</div>
        <div class="sync-count">
          <span class="sync-count-num">{{c.syncDone}}</span> <span class="sync-count-of">of {{c.syncTarget}}</span> mails {{c.data.isCsg ? 'scanned' : 'processed'}}<span class="sync-count-of" ng-if="c.data.isCsg && c.syncMatched"> · {{c.syncMatched}} matched</span>
        </div>
        <div class="sync-bar"><div class="sync-bar-fill" ng-style="{width: c.syncProgress + '%'}"></div></div>
        <div class="sync-load-row">
          <span class="sync-load-msg">{{c.syncMsg}}</span>
          <span class="sync-load-time">{{c.elapsedFmt()}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- not synced: empty state with a big Sync now -->
    <div class="sync-empty" ng-if="!c.synced && !c.syncing">
      <div class="sync-empty-ico">⇩</div>
      <div class="sync-empty-t">Nothing run yet</div>
      <div class="sync-empty-s">Click <strong>Sync now</strong> to run this wizard on the mailbox — it classifies and extracts each mail with the config from the onboarding wizard, then stops at <strong>Awaiting Confirmation</strong> for your review.</div>
      <button class="sync-btn big" ng-click="c.sync()">↻ Sync now</button>
    </div>

    <!-- synced: the OTC Settlements dashboard -->
    <div ng-if="c.synced && !c.syncing">
      <div class="sync-note flow" ng-if="c.data.syncInfo && c.data.syncInfo.processed">
        ✓ Extracted <strong>{{c.data.syncInfo.processed}}</strong> mail(s) (<strong>{{c.data.syncInfo.cashflows}}</strong> cashflows) with this wizard’s field prompts — now at <strong>Awaiting Confirmation</strong>. Confirm a cashflow to run Compare & Match.
        <span ng-if="c.data.syncInfo.remaining"> <strong>{{c.data.syncInfo.remaining}}</strong> mail(s) remaining — click <strong>Sync now</strong> again for the next batch.</span>
      </div>
      <div class="sync-note" ng-if="c.data.syncInfo && c.data.syncInfo.status === 'ok' && !c.data.syncInfo.processed && !c.data.syncInfo.remaining && !c.data.syncInfo.failed">
        ✓ All mails are already up to date for this wizard.
      </div>
      <div class="sync-warn" ng-if="!c.data.isCsg && c.data.syncInfo && c.data.syncInfo.failed && !c.data.syncInfo.processed">
        ⚠ The workflow ran but extraction returned nothing for <strong>{{c.data.syncInfo.failed}}</strong> mail(s).<span ng-if="c.data.syncInfo.diag"> Error: {{c.data.syncInfo.diag}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="sync-warn" ng-if="c.data.syncInfo && c.data.syncInfo.status === 'no_fields'">
        ⚠ This wizard has no extraction fields configured. Edit its Field Extraction step, then Sync again.
      </div>
      <div class="sync-warn" ng-if="c.data.syncInfo && c.data.syncInfo.unsupported">
        ⚠ No workflow exists yet for the activity <strong>{{c.data.syncInfo.activity || '(none)'}}</strong>. Only <strong>Compare & Match</strong> is built today.
      </div>
      <!-- ══ CSG entity-break board (EVE lookup by RDM id) ══ -->
      <div ng-if="c.data.isCsg">
        <div class="sync-note flow">
          ✓ Routed <strong>{{c.data.csgRows.length}}</strong> CSG entity-data mail(s) from the shared mailbox. Each RDM id is resolved against the EVE directory below — <strong>Status</strong> drives the next action.
        </div>
        <div class="stats">
          <div class="stat" ng-repeat="s in c.data.csgStats track by $index">
            <div class="stat-num" ng-class="s.numCls">{{s.num}}</div>
            <div class="stat-lbl">{{s.label}}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="search">
          <span class="search-lbl">Search using:</span>
          <input class="s-field" ng-model="c.csgQ" ng-change="c.onFilterChange()" placeholder="Search RDM id / entity..."/>
          <select class="s-field" ng-model="c.csgStatusFilter" ng-change="c.onFilterChange()">
            <option value="">Status - All</option>
            <option value="OPEN">Open</option>
            <option value="CLOSED">Closed</option>
            <option value="NOT FOUND">Unresolved</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-h">Entity data — EVE directory</div>
          <table class="tbl">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th class="ns">Mail Id</th>
                <th class="ns">RDM ID</th>
                <th class="ns">Entity</th>
                <th class="ns">Role</th>
                <th class="ns">Short Name</th>
                <th class="ns">Long Name</th>
                <th class="ns">Full Name</th>
                <th class="ns">Country</th>
                <th class="ns">Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr ng-repeat="r in (csgFiltered = (c.data.csgRows | filter:c.csgRowFilter)) | limitTo:c.pageLimit():c.pageOffset() track by $index" ng-click="c.openCsg(r)" style="cursor:pointer">
                <td class="mono"><a class="csg-link">{{r.mailId || '-'}}</a></td>
                <td class="mono">{{r.rdm}}</td>
                <td>{{r.entity}}</td>
                <td>{{r.role}}</td>
                <td>{{r.shortName}}</td>
                <td>{{r.longName}}</td>
                <td>{{r.fullName}}</td>
                <td>{{r.country}}</td>
                <td>
                  <span class="tg" ng-class="{'tg-ok': r.status === 'OPEN', 'tg-warn': r.status === 'CLOSED', 'tg-bad': r.status !== 'OPEN' && r.status !== 'CLOSED'}">{{r.status}}</span>
                </td>
              </tr>
              <tr ng-if="!c.data.csgRows.length">
                <td colspan="9" class="empty">No CSG entity-data mails found. Drop some on the mailbox, then Sync now.</td>
              </tr>
              <tr ng-if="c.data.csgRows.length && !csgFiltered.length">
                <td colspan="9" class="empty">No rows match your search / filter.</td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
          <div class="pager" ng-if="csgFiltered.length">
            <div class="pager-size">
              <span>Rows per page:</span>
              <select ng-model="c.pageSize" ng-change="c.onPageSize()">
                <option ng-repeat="n in c.pageSizes" ng-value="n">{{n}}</option>
                <option ng-value="'All'">All</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="pager-info">Showing {{c.rangeStart(csgFiltered.length)}}–{{c.rangeEnd(csgFiltered.length)}} of {{csgFiltered.length}}</div>
            <div class="pager-nav">
              <button type="button" ng-click="c.page=1" ng-disabled="c.page<=1">« First</button>
              <button type="button" ng-click="c.prevPage()" ng-disabled="c.page<=1">‹ Prev</button>
              <span class="pager-page">Page {{c.page}} of {{c.pageCount(csgFiltered.length)}}</span>
              <button type="button" ng-click="c.nextPage(csgFiltered.length)" ng-disabled="c.page>=c.pageCount(csgFiltered.length)">Next ›</button>
              <button type="button" ng-click="c.lastPage(csgFiltered.length)" ng-disabled="c.page>=c.pageCount(csgFiltered.length)">Last »</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- CSG mail detail: the mail + the AI-extracted RDM id + the EVE-derived fields -->
        <div class="csg-overlay" ng-if="c.csgDetail" ng-click="c.closeCsg()"></div>
        <div class="csg-modal" ng-if="c.csgDetail">
          <div class="csg-modal-hd">
            <div class="csg-modal-ttl">
              <span class="csg-modal-file">{{c.csgDetail.mailId}}</span>
              <span class="tg" ng-class="{'tg-ok': c.csgDetail.status === 'OPEN', 'tg-warn': c.csgDetail.status === 'CLOSED', 'tg-bad': c.csgDetail.status !== 'OPEN' && c.csgDetail.status !== 'CLOSED'}">{{c.csgDetail.status}}</span>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="csg-close" ng-click="c.closeCsg()">×</button>
          </div>
          <div class="csg-modal-bd">
            <!-- LEFT: the email -->
            <div class="csg-mail">
              <div class="csg-sec-h">Email</div>
              <div class="csg-hdr-grid">
                <div class="csg-hk">From</div><div class="csg-hv">{{c.csgDetail.from || '-'}}</div>
                <div class="csg-hk">To</div><div class="csg-hv">{{c.csgDetail.to || '-'}}</div>
                <div class="csg-hk" ng-if="c.csgDetail.cc">Cc</div><div class="csg-hv" ng-if="c.csgDetail.cc">{{c.csgDetail.cc}}</div>
                <div class="csg-hk">Subject</div><div class="csg-hv csg-subj">{{c.csgDetail.subject || '-'}}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="csg-body">{{c.csgDetail.body || '(no body captured)'}}</div>
            </div>

            <!-- RIGHT: extraction + resolution -->
            <div class="csg-fields">
              <div class="csg-sec-h">Extraction & resolution</div>

              <div class="csg-fld">
                <div class="csg-fld-k">RDM ID
                  <span class="csg-tag ai" title="Extracted from the email by AI">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M12 3l1.9 4.6L18.5 9.5 13.9 11.4 12 16l-1.9-4.6L5.5 9.5 10.1 7.6 12 3z" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="18.5" cy="17.5" r="1.6" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
                    AI extracted
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div class="csg-fld-v mono">{{c.csgDetail.rdm}}</div>
              </div>

              <div class="csg-fld-div"></div>

              <div class="csg-fld" ng-repeat="f in [
                  {k:'Entity', v:c.csgDetail.entity},
                  {k:'Role', v:c.csgDetail.role},
                  {k:'Short Name', v:c.csgDetail.shortName},
                  {k:'Long Name', v:c.csgDetail.longName},
                  {k:'Full Name', v:c.csgDetail.fullName},
                  {k:'Country', v:c.csgDetail.country}] track by $index">
                <div class="csg-fld-k">{{f.k}}
                  <span class="csg-tag eve" title="Resolved from the EVE directory by RDM id">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><ellipse cx="12" cy="5.5" rx="7" ry="2.6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M5 5.5v6c0 1.4 3.1 2.6 7 2.6s7-1.2 7-2.6v-6M5 11.5v6c0 1.4 3.1 2.6 7 2.6s7-1.2 7-2.6v-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>
                    Derived from EVE
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div class="csg-fld-v">{{f.v}}</div>
              </div>

              <div class="csg-fld">
                <div class="csg-fld-k">Status
                  <span class="csg-tag eve" title="Resolved from the EVE directory by RDM id">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><ellipse cx="12" cy="5.5" rx="7" ry="2.6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M5 5.5v6c0 1.4 3.1 2.6 7 2.6s7-1.2 7-2.6v-6M5 11.5v6c0 1.4 3.1 2.6 7 2.6s7-1.2 7-2.6v-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>
                    Derived from EVE
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div class="csg-fld-v">
                  <span class="tg" ng-class="{'tg-ok': c.csgDetail.status === 'OPEN', 'tg-warn': c.csgDetail.status === 'CLOSED', 'tg-bad': c.csgDetail.status !== 'OPEN' && c.csgDetail.status !== 'CLOSED'}">{{c.csgDetail.status}}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ══ OTC Settlements board (unchanged) ══ -->
      <div ng-if="!c.data.isCsg">

      <!-- Mail pipeline funnel — Processed → Relevant → Extracted, so no mail feels lost -->
      <div class="funnel" ng-if="c.data.funnel">
        <div class="fn-head">Email pipeline</div>
        <div class="fn-flow">
          <div class="fn-stage fn-proc">
            <div class="fn-num">{{c.data.funnel.processed}}</div>
            <div class="fn-lbl">Scanned</div>
            <div class="fn-cap">mails scanned</div>
          </div>
          <div class="fn-arrow">
            <span class="fn-chev">→</span>
            <span class="fn-delta" ng-if="c.data.funnel.filtered > 0">−{{c.data.funnel.filtered}} filtered</span>
          </div>
          <div class="fn-stage fn-rel">
            <div class="fn-num">{{c.data.funnel.relevant}}</div>
            <div class="fn-lbl">Identified</div>
            <div class="fn-cap">claimed by this driver</div>
          </div>
          <div class="fn-arrow">
            <span class="fn-chev">→</span>
            <span class="fn-delta fn-delta-warn" ng-if="c.data.funnel.pending > 0">{{c.data.funnel.pending}} pending ↻</span>
          </div>
          <div class="fn-stage fn-ext">
            <div class="fn-num">{{c.data.funnel.extracted}}</div>
            <div class="fn-lbl">Extracted</div>
            <div class="fn-cap">into cashflows</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="fn-note" ng-if="c.data.funnel.pending > 0">{{c.data.funnel.pending}} claimed mail(s) not yet extracted — retried automatically on the next Sync, never dropped.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="stats">
        <div class="stat" ng-repeat="s in c.data.stats track by $index">
          <div class="stat-num" ng-class="s.numCls">{{s.num}}</div>
          <div class="stat-lbl">{{s.label}}</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="search">
        <span class="search-lbl">Search:</span>
        <input class="s-search" type="text" ng-model="c.q" ng-change="c.onFilterChange()" placeholder="Search anything — mail id, counterparty, amount, currency, direction, value date, classification, match status, tagging…">
        <span class="search-lbl">Filter by:</span>
        <select class="s-field" ng-model="c.cpFilter" ng-change="c.onFilterChange()">
          <option value="">Counterparty - All</option>
          <option ng-repeat="cp in c.data.counterparties track by $index" value="{{cp}}">{{cp}}</option>
        </select>
        <select class="s-field" ng-model="c.matchFilter" ng-change="c.onFilterChange()">
          <option value="">Compare and Match Status - All</option>
          <option value="pending">Pending Confirmation</option>
          <option value="matched">Matched</option>
          <option value="mismatch">Mismatch</option>
          <option value="no_match">Allege</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="s-btns">
        <span class="s-btns-lbl">Outlook Tagging:</span>
        <button type="button" class="tag-btn" ng-repeat="t in c.wfTags track by $index" ng-class="{on: c.wfSel[t]}" ng-click="c.toggleWf(t)">{{t}}</button>
        <button type="button" class="tag-btn tag-clear" ng-if="c.wfActive()" ng-click="c.clearWf()">× Clear</button>
      </div>

      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-h">Activity table</div>
        <table class="tbl">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th ng-click="c.sort('mailId')">Mail Id <span class="sort-ind" ng-class="{active: c.sortKey === 'mailId'}">{{c.arrow('mailId')}}</span></th>
              <th class="ns">Cashflow</th>
              <th ng-click="c.sort('counterparty')">Counterparty (EVE) <span class="sort-ind" ng-class="{active: c.sortKey === 'counterparty'}">{{c.arrow('counterparty')}}</span></th>
              <th ng-click="c.sort('amount')">Amount <span class="sort-ind" ng-class="{active: c.sortKey === 'amount'}">{{c.arrow('amount')}}</span></th>
              <th class="ns">Currency</th>
              <th ng-click="c.sort('direction')">Direction <span class="sort-ind" ng-class="{active: c.sortKey === 'direction'}">{{c.arrow('direction')}}</span></th>
              <th ng-click="c.sort('value_date')">VD (YYYY-MM-DD) <span class="sort-ind" ng-class="{active: c.sortKey === 'value_date'}">{{c.arrow('value_date')}}</span></th>
              <th ng-click="c.sort('tagging')">Classification <span class="sort-ind" ng-class="{active: c.sortKey === 'tagging'}">{{c.arrow('tagging')}}</span></th>
              <th ng-click="c.sort('elapsed')">Time Elapsed <span class="sort-ind" ng-class="{active: c.sortKey === 'elapsed'}">{{c.arrow('elapsed')}}</span></th>
              <th ng-click="c.sort('match')">Compare and Match Status <span class="sort-ind" ng-class="{active: c.sortKey === 'match'}">{{c.arrow('match')}}</span></th>
              <th class="ns">Outlook Tagging</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr ng-repeat="r in (filteredRows = (c.data.rows | filter:c.rowFilter)) | limitTo:c.pageLimit():c.pageOffset() track by $index" ng-click="c.open(r.href)" style="cursor:pointer" ng-class="{'nom-hl-green': r.rowHl === 'green', 'nom-hl-pink': r.rowHl === 'pink'}">
              <td class="mono">{{r.mailId || '-'}}</td>
              <td class="mono">{{r.cfLabel}}<span ng-if="r.cfSub" class="cf-sub"> {{r.cfSub}}</span></td>
              <td>{{r.counterparty || '-'}}</td>
              <td>{{c.fmtAmt(r.amount) || '-'}}</td>
              <td>{{r.currency || '-'}}</td>
              <td>{{r.direction || '-'}}</td>
              <td>{{r.value_date_disp || '-'}}</td>
              <td>
                <span ng-if="r.tagging.cls !== 'dash'" class="tg" ng-class="r.tagging.cls">{{r.tagging.label}}</span>
                <span ng-if="r.tagging.cls === 'dash'" class="dash">-</span>
              </td>
              <td><span ng-class="{dash: r.elapsedText === '-'}">{{r.elapsedText}}</span></td>
              <td><span class="tg" ng-class="r.matchCls">{{r.matchLabel}}</span></td>
              <td><span class="tg" ng-class="r.workflowCls">{{r.workflowLabel}}</span></td>
            </tr>
            <tr ng-if="!c.data.rows.length">
              <td colspan="11" class="empty">No relevant emails found. Drop some on the mailbox, then Sync now.</td>
            </tr>
            <tr ng-if="c.data.rows.length && !filteredRows.length">
              <td colspan="11" class="empty">No rows match your search / filter.</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
        <div class="pager" ng-if="filteredRows.length">
          <div class="pager-size">
            <span>Rows per page:</span>
            <select ng-model="c.pageSize" ng-change="c.onPageSize()">
              <option ng-repeat="n in c.pageSizes" ng-value="n">{{n}}</option>
              <option ng-value="'All'">All</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="pager-info">Showing {{c.rangeStart(filteredRows.length)}}–{{c.rangeEnd(filteredRows.length)}} of {{filteredRows.length}}</div>
          <div class="pager-nav">
            <button type="button" ng-click="c.page=1" ng-disabled="c.page<=1">« First</button>
            <button type="button" ng-click="c.prevPage()" ng-disabled="c.page<=1">‹ Prev</button>
            <span class="pager-page">Page {{c.page}} of {{c.pageCount(filteredRows.length)}}</span>
            <button type="button" ng-click="c.nextPage(filteredRows.length)" ng-disabled="c.page>=c.pageCount(filteredRows.length)">Next ›</button>
            <button type="button" ng-click="c.lastPage(filteredRows.length)" ng-disabled="c.page>=c.pageCount(filteredRows.length)">Last »</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    </main>
  </div>
</div>
]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
