<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[function controller($window) {
    var c = this;
    // Access guard — the server sets data.redirect for non-managers; bounce before building anything.
    if (c.data && c.data.redirect) { $window.location.href = c.data.redirect; return; }
    var cat = (c.data && c.data.cat) || {};

    // Header user menu.
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () { $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm'); };

    function clone(o) { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o || {})); }

    // ---- build the working model from the server's initial model ----
    c.model = clone(c.data.initModel);
    c.model.targets = c.model.targets && c.model.targets.length ? c.model.targets : [{ system: '', map: {} }];

    // Field rows are the added fields (each: name + type + AI prompt + example + value + match config).
    c.model.fields = c.model.fields || [];

    // Per-driver Compare & Match tolerances (step 5). Number inputs need numeric values; a blank (null) field
    // means "inherit the system default". Normalise whatever was loaded from config_overrides to number|null.
    c.model.tolerances = c.model.tolerances || {};
    (function normTol() {
        var t = c.model.tolerances;
        for (var k in t) { if (t.hasOwnProperty(k)) { var n = parseFloat(t[k]); t[k] = isNaN(n) ? null : n; } }
    })();
    c.resetTol = function (mk) { c.model.tolerances[mk] = null; };

    // CSG mode = the "CSG" Service (new taxonomy: OPS Client Services -> Client Entity Data -> CSG). Legacy
    // wizards carried "CSG" in the Sub-BU/Work-Driver instead, so keep detecting that too. The OTC driver
    // sits under OTC Settlements, so this never affects OTC. Drives the CSG step preview, the RDM-ID
    // mandatory field, and the CSG-specific Target-Mapping / Write-back copy.
    c.isCsg = function () {
        if (('' + (c.model.service || '')).toUpperCase() === 'CSG') { return true; }
        var sig = (('' + (c.model.subBu || '')) + ' ' + ('' + (c.model.workDriver || ''))).toUpperCase();
        return sig.indexOf('CSG') !== -1;
    };

    // MANDATORY fields — always present, locked. OTC (Compare & Match) needs the four economic keys;
    // CSG needs only the RDM id (which keys the EVE lookup). Seeded from the field catalog.
    var OTC_MANDATORY = ['Value Date', 'Amount', 'Currency', 'Direction'];
    var CSG_MANDATORY = ['RDM ID'];
    var ALL_MANDATORY = OTC_MANDATORY.concat(CSG_MANDATORY);
    function currentMandatory() { return c.isCsg() ? CSG_MANDATORY : OTC_MANDATORY; }
    function _catField(name) {
        var fc = cat.fieldCatalog || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < fc.length; i++) { if (fc[i].name === name) { return fc[i]; } }
        return null;
    }
    // Every field row carries exactly 3 example VALUE slots for the Field Extraction editor.
    function ensureExamples(row) {
        if (!row) { return; }
        var ex = row.examples || [], out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            var v = ex[i];
            if (v && typeof v === 'object') { v = v.value || ''; }  // migrate old {input,value} -> value
            out.push(v == null ? '' : ('' + v));
        }
        row.examples = out;
    }
    function ensureMandatoryFields() {
        var MAND = currentMandatory();
        var existing = c.model.fields || [], byName = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < existing.length; i++) { if (existing[i].name) { byName[existing[i].name] = existing[i]; } }
        var mand = [];
        for (var m = 0; m < MAND.length; m++) {
            var nm = MAND[m], row = byName[nm];
            var fc = _catField(nm);
            if (row) {
                row.mandatory = true; row.mapExclude = false;
                // seed the master prompt + examples from the catalog if this draft predates them
                if (fc && !row.examples) { row.examples = (fc.examples || []).slice(); }
                if (fc && !row.prompt) { row.prompt = fc.prompt; }
            } else if (fc) {
                row = { name: fc.name, type: fc.type || 'string', prompt: fc.prompt, example: fc.example || '', value: fc.value || '', custom: false, mapExclude: false, mandatory: true, examples: (fc.examples || []).slice() };
            }
            if (row) { mand.push(row); }
        }
        // Keep custom / optional fields, but drop the OTHER mode's mandatory fields so switching
        // OTC <-> CSG cleanly swaps the locked set (RDM ID <-> Value Date/Amount/Currency/Direction).
        var rest = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < existing.length; j++) { if (ALL_MANDATORY.indexOf(existing[j].name) === -1) { rest.push(existing[j]); } }
        c.model.fields = mand.concat(rest);   // mandatory first, in fixed order
        for (var e = 0; e < c.model.fields.length; e++) { ensureExamples(c.model.fields[e]); }
    }
    ensureMandatoryFields();
    c.ensureMandatoryFields = ensureMandatoryFields;
    c.ensureExamples = ensureExamples;

    // ---- email identification rules (labels) ----
    function emptyLabel() { return { name: '', context: '', keywords: '', senders: '', subject: '', exclusions: '', excludeReplies: true, excludeNoise: true }; }
    c.model.labels = c.model.labels || [];
    if (!c.model.labels.length) { c.model.labels.push(emptyLabel()); } // one empty label so the fields show
    c.addLabel = function () { c.model.labels.push(emptyLabel()); };
    c.removeLabel = function (idx) { c.model.labels.splice(idx, 1); };

    // ---- Outlook tagging + analyst writeback (defaulted server-side; guard for older drafts) ----
    if (!c.model.tagging || !c.model.tagging.length) {
        c.model.tagging = [
            { stage: 'Default', tag: '' }, { stage: 'Extraction Confirmed', tag: '' },
            { stage: 'Review Confirmed', tag: '' }, { stage: 'Resolved', tag: '' }, { stage: 'Escalated', tag: '' }
        ];
    }
    // ---- Write-back: one action per Compare & Match outcome (Matched / Mismatch / No Match), chosen
    // from a fixed set of actions and UNFILLED by default. Normalise whatever was loaded to these 3 rows.
    var WB_SCENARIOS = ['Matched', 'Mismatch', 'No Match'];
    var WB_ACTIONS = (cat.writebackActions) || ['Send to NEWS', 'Reply to Counterparty', 'Reply to Middle Office'];
    function ensureWriteback() {
        var existing = c.model.writeback || [], byScen = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < existing.length; i++) {
            var s = ('' + (existing[i].scenario || '')).toLowerCase();
            var key = (s.indexOf('mismatch') > -1) ? 'Mismatch' : (s.indexOf('no') > -1 ? 'No Match' : (s.indexOf('match') > -1 ? 'Matched' : ''));
            if (!key) { continue; }
            // Support both shapes: new {actions:[...]} and legacy {action:'...'} — keep only valid, de-duped.
            var acts = existing[i].actions;
            if (!(acts instanceof Array)) { acts = existing[i].action ? [existing[i].action] : []; }
            var clean = [];
            for (var a = 0; a < acts.length; a++) { if (WB_ACTIONS.indexOf(acts[a]) > -1 && clean.indexOf(acts[a]) === -1) { clean.push(acts[a]); } }
            byScen[key] = clean;
        }
        var out = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < WB_SCENARIOS.length; j++) {
            out.push({ scenario: WB_SCENARIOS[j], actions: byScen[WB_SCENARIOS[j]] || [], _add: '' });
        }
        c.model.writeback = out;
    }
    ensureWriteback();
    // Manager adds/removes multiple actions per outcome, from the fixed WB_ACTIONS set (no duplicates).
    c.wbAddAction = function (w, a) {
        if (!w || !a || WB_ACTIONS.indexOf(a) === -1) { return; }
        w.actions = w.actions || [];
        if (w.actions.indexOf(a) === -1) { w.actions.push(a); }
    };
    c.wbRemoveAction = function (w, i) { if (w && w.actions && i >= 0 && i < w.actions.length) { w.actions.splice(i, 1); } };
    c.wbAvailable = function (w) {
        var out = [], have = (w && w.actions) || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < WB_ACTIONS.length; i++) { if (have.indexOf(WB_ACTIONS[i]) === -1) { out.push(WB_ACTIONS[i]); } }
        return out;
    };
    c.wbLabel = function (s) {
        return ({ 'Matched': 'All fields match', 'Mismatch': 'Mismatch — some fields differ', 'No Match': 'No match — no booking found' })[s] || s;
    };
    if (!c.model.ingestionType) { c.model.ingestionType = 'Mail'; }

    // ---- Define cascade: BU -> Sub-BU -> Service -> Work Driver (taxonomy-driven) ----
    // Activity is not a user choice — it is always "Compare & Match" (the one built pipeline), stamped when
    // a work driver is picked. The tree leaf is the array of work drivers for a (BU, Sub-BU, Service).
    var TAX = cat.taxonomy || {};
    c.busList = function () { return Object.keys(TAX); };
    c.subBusFor = function () { return (c.model.bu && TAX[c.model.bu]) ? Object.keys(TAX[c.model.bu]) : []; };
    c.servicesFor = function () { var b = c.model.bu, s = c.model.subBu; return (b && s && TAX[b] && TAX[b][s]) ? Object.keys(TAX[b][s]) : []; };
    c.workDriversFor = function () { var b = c.model.bu, s = c.model.subBu, sv = c.model.service; return (b && s && sv && TAX[b] && TAX[b][s] && TAX[b][s][sv]) ? TAX[b][s][sv] : []; };
    c.onBu = function () { c.model.subBu = ''; c.model.service = ''; c.model.workDriver = ''; c.model.activity = ''; };
    c.onSubBu = function () { c.model.service = ''; c.model.workDriver = ''; c.model.activity = ''; };
    // Service (labelled "Work driver" in the UI) now decides OTC<->CSG. Re-seed the mandatory fields and
    // reset the (mode-specific) target system on change so a stale system/field from the other mode can't linger.
    c.onService = function () { c.model.workDriver = ''; c.model.activity = ''; ensureMandatoryFields(); c.model.targets = [{ system: '', map: {} }]; };
    c.onWorkDriver = function () { c.model.activity = ''; ensureMandatoryFields(); };
    // Skill (c.model.activity) is now a USER choice — Compare & Match / Reconcile / Validation — no longer
    // auto-stamped. Only Compare & Match is wired; the other two reveal their own (dummy) step sequence.
    c.activityOptions = function () { return cat.activityOptions || ['Compare & Match', 'Reconcile', 'Validation']; };
    c.onActivity = function () { };

    // ---- nested stepper: 4 top steps; step 2 "Input Configuration" walks 6 sub-pages ----
    c.steps = [
        { n: 1, label: 'Define' },
        { n: 2, label: 'Input Configuration' },
        { n: 3, label: 'Review' },
        { n: 4, label: 'Publish' }
    ];
    c.subs = [
        { n: 1, label: 'Ingestion' },
        { n: 2, label: 'Email Identification' },
        { n: 3, label: 'Field Extraction' },
        { n: 4, label: 'Target Mapping' },
        { n: 5, label: 'Compare & Match' },
        { n: 6, label: 'Write-back' }
    ];
    // CSG has no Compare & Match / Write-back — drop them from the sub-nav and cap navigation at Target Mapping (4).
    c.visibleSubs = function () { return c.isCsg() ? c.subs.slice(0, 4) : c.subs; };
    c.lastSub = function () { return c.isCsg() ? 4 : 6; };
    c.step = c.data.startStep || 1;
    if (c.step < 1) { c.step = 1; }
    if (c.step > 4) { c.step = 4; }
    c.sub = 1;
    c.isLastStep = function () { return c.step === 4; };
    c.goSub = function (n) { if (c.step === 2 && n >= 1 && n <= c.lastSub()) { c.sub = n; window0(); } };
    c.next = function () {
        if (c.step === 2 && c.sub < c.lastSub()) { c.sub++; window0(); return; }
        if (c.step < 4) { c.step++; if (c.step === 2) { c.sub = 1; } window0(); silentSaveDraft(); }
    };
    c.back = function () {
        if (c.step === 2 && c.sub > 1) { c.sub--; window0(); return; }
        if (c.step > 1) { c.step--; if (c.step === 2) { c.sub = c.lastSub(); } window0(); }
    };
    function window0() { if ($window.scrollTo) { $window.scrollTo(0, 0); } }

    // ---- catalogs exposed to the template ----
    c.cat = cat;
    // Target systems + columns are mode-specific: CSG resolves against EVE / Target 1 / Target 2, OTC
    // against the settlement systems. RDM ID maps to the target's identifier column (e.g. EVE's "rdm id").
    c.targetSystems = function () { return c.isCsg() ? (cat.targetSystemsCsg || []) : (cat.targetSystems || []); };
    c.targetFieldsFor = function (system) {
        var src = c.isCsg() ? (cat.targetFieldsCsg || {}) : (cat.targetFields || {});
        return src[system] || [];
    };
    // The pre-coded step sequence for the chosen Skill (activity). CSG uses its own entity-data sequence
    // (extract RDM id -> resolve in EVE); otherwise the sequence is looked up by the chosen Skill —
    // Compare & Match (wired) / Reconcile / Validation (dummy demo sequences).
    c.activitySteps = function () {
        if (c.isCsg()) { return cat.stepTemplatesCsg || []; }
        if (!c.model.workDriver || !c.model.activity) { return []; }
        return ((cat.stepTemplates || {})[c.model.activity]) || [];
    };
    c.hasActivitySteps = function () { return c.activitySteps().length > 0; };
    // Field picker options, filtered by mode: CSG shows only RDM ID (+ Custom); OTC hides RDM ID.
    c.pickableCatalog = function () {
        var fc = cat.fieldCatalog || [], out = [], csg = c.isCsg();
        for (var i = 0; i < fc.length; i++) {
            var isRdm = fc[i].name === 'RDM ID';
            if (csg && !isRdm) { continue; }
            if (!csg && isRdm) { continue; }
            out.push(fc[i]);
        }
        return out;
    };

    // ---- field rows ----
    c.selectedFields = function () {
        var out = [], f = c.model.fields || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) { if (f[i].name) { out.push(f[i]); } }
        return out;
    };
    c.selectedCount = function () { return c.selectedFields().length; };
    // Fields that participate in compare/match + target mapping vs. extract-only fields (e.g. SSI).
    c.mapFields = function () { var o = [], f = c.selectedFields(); for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) { if (!f[i].mapExclude) { o.push(f[i]); } } return o; };
    c.excludedFields = function () { var o = [], f = c.selectedFields(); for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) { if (f[i].mapExclude) { o.push(f[i]); } } return o; };
    c.excludeFromMap = function (f) { if (f && f.mandatory) { return; } f.mapExclude = true; };
    c.includeInMap = function (f) { f.mapExclude = false; };
    c.fieldByName = function (name) {
        var fc = cat.fieldCatalog || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < fc.length; i++) { if (fc[i].name === name) { return fc[i]; } }
        return null;
    };
    // Fields already added, so the dropdown can hide duplicates.
    c.isFieldTaken = function (name, row) {
        var f = c.model.fields || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) { if (f[i] !== row && f[i].name === name) { return true; } }
        return false;
    };
    c.addFieldRow = function () { var r = { name: '', type: 'string', prompt: '', example: '', value: '', custom: false, mapExclude: false }; ensureExamples(r); c.model.fields.push(r); };
    c.removeFieldRow = function (idx) { if (c.model.fields[idx] && c.model.fields[idx].mandatory) { return; } c.model.fields.splice(idx, 1); };
    // Picking a preconfigured field autofills its type / AI prompt / example / value (all still editable).
    // Picking "Custom field" turns the row into a blank, user-defined field (own name + own prompt).
    c.onFieldPick = function (row) {
        if (row.name === '__custom__') {
            row.custom = true; row.name = ''; row.type = 'string'; row.prompt = ''; row.example = ''; row.value = '';
            row.matchMode = 'exact'; row.fuzzyPct = 85; row.tolerance = 0; row.examples = [];
            ensureExamples(row);
            return;
        }
        var cf = c.fieldByName(row.name);
        if (cf) {
            row.type = cf.type || 'string'; row.prompt = cf.prompt; row.value = cf.value; row.custom = false;
            row.examples = (cf.examples || []).slice();
            ensureExamples(row);
            // SSI fields are extract-only by default (settlement instructions, not economic match keys).
            row.mapExclude = /ssi/i.test(row.name);
        }
    };
    // Switch a custom row back to the preconfigured dropdown.
    c.revertField = function (row) { row.custom = false; row.name = ''; };
    // Changing a field's type (Target Mapping) resets an incompatible match mode back to Exact.
    c.onFieldType = function (f) {
        if (f.type === 'float' && f.matchMode === 'fuzzy') { f.matchMode = 'exact'; }
        if (f.type !== 'float' && f.matchMode === 'tolerance') { f.matchMode = 'exact'; }
    };

    // ---- Test extraction (Now Assist) ----
    c.showTest = false;
    c.testRow = null;
    c.testInput = '';
    c.testOutput = '';
    c.testBusy = false;
    c.openTest = function (row) {
        c.testRow = row;
        c.testInput = row.example || '';
        c.testOutput = '';
        c.showTest = true;
    };
    c.closeTest = function () { c.showTest = false; c.testRow = null; };
    c.runTest = function () {
        if (!c.testRow) { return; }
        c.testBusy = true;
        c.testOutput = '';
        c.data.action = 'test';
        c.data.testField = c.testRow.name;
        c.data.testPrompt = c.testRow.prompt;
        c.data.testExample = c.testRow.example;
        c.data.testValue = c.testRow.value;
        c.data.testInput = c.testInput;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.testBusy = false;
            // Tidy the model output: trim each line, drop blanks (a multi-trade input yields
            // several values in single-value mode — show them cleanly, one per line).
            var lines = ('' + (c.data.testOutput || '')).split(/\r?\n/), tidy = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { var l = lines[i].replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ').trim(); if (l) { tidy.push(l); } }
            c.testOutput = tidy.join('\n') || '(no output)';
            c.data.action = '';
        });
    };

    // ---- prompt enhancer (custom fields): send the manager's draft to the Now Assist skill and
    // replace the field's AI Prompt with the improved instruction it returns. Examples stay as-is.
    c.enhanceRow = null;
    c.enhBusy = '';           // non-row enhances (description / a label's context); '' = idle
    c.descEnhMsg = '';
    c.enhancePrompt = function (row) {
        if (!row || c.enhanceRow || c.enhBusy) { return; }
        var draft = ('' + (row.prompt || '')).trim();
        if (!draft) { row._enhanceMsg = 'Write a short prompt first, then enhance it.'; return; }
        c.enhanceRow = row; row._enhanceMsg = '';
        c.data.action = 'enhance_prompt';
        c.data.enhanceDraft = draft;
        c.data.enhanceField = row.name || 'this field';
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.data.action = '';
            var st = '' + (c.data.enhanceStatus || ''), txt = '' + (c.data.enhanceText || '');
            if (st === 'ok' && txt) { row.prompt = txt; row._enhanceMsg = '✨ Enhanced'; }
            else { row._enhanceMsg = 'Could not enhance (' + (st || 'no response') + ') — the skill may need activating in Now Assist Admin.'; }
            c.data.enhanceStatus = ''; c.data.enhanceText = '';
            c.enhanceRow = null;
        });
    };

    // ---- prompt enhancer, other free-text fields: Description (Define) + each label's Context (Email
    // Identification). Same skill/action, a `mode` steers Chinou; on success it REPLACES the field text.
    function _enhance(token, mode, field, draft, msgSet, apply) {
        if (c.enhanceRow || c.enhBusy) { return; }
        draft = ('' + (draft || '')).trim();
        if (!draft) { msgSet('Write something first, then enhance it.'); return; }
        c.enhBusy = token; msgSet('');
        c.data.action = 'enhance_prompt';
        c.data.enhanceDraft = draft;
        c.data.enhanceField = field;
        c.data.enhanceMode = mode;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.data.action = '';
            var st = '' + (c.data.enhanceStatus || ''), txt = '' + (c.data.enhanceText || '');
            if (st === 'ok' && txt) { apply(txt); msgSet('✨ Enhanced'); }
            else { msgSet('Could not enhance (' + (st || 'no response') + ') — the skill may need activating in Now Assist Admin.'); }
            c.data.enhanceStatus = ''; c.data.enhanceText = ''; c.data.enhanceMode = '';
            c.enhBusy = '';
        });
    }
    c.enhanceDescription = function () {
        _enhance('desc', 'description', 'work-driver description', c.model.description,
            function (m) { c.descEnhMsg = m; }, function (t) { c.model.description = t; });
    };
    c.enhanceContext = function (lab) {
        if (!lab) { return; }
        _enhance(lab, 'classification', 'email classification context', lab.context,
            function (m) { lab._enhMsg = m; }, function (t) { lab.context = t; });
    };

    // ---- targets & mapping ----
    c.addTarget = function () { if (c.model.targets.length >= 1) { return; } c.model.targets.push({ system: '', map: {} }); };
    c.removeTarget = function (idx) { if (c.model.targets.length > 1) { c.model.targets.splice(idx, 1); } };

    // Naive auto-map: match each selected input field to the closest target column by normalised name.
    function norm(s) { return ('' + (s || '')).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); }
    c.autoMap = function (t) {
        var tf = c.targetFieldsFor(t.system);
        var sel = c.selectedFields();
        for (var i = 0; i < sel.length; i++) {
            var fn = sel[i].name, best = '';
            var nf = norm(fn);
            for (var j = 0; j < tf.length; j++) {
                var nt = norm(tf[j]);
                if (nt === nf || nt.indexOf(nf) > -1 || nf.indexOf(nt) > -1) { best = tf[j]; break; }
            }
            // token overlap fallback (e.g. "Trade Reference" -> "trade_ref")
            if (!best) {
                var toks = fn.toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z0-9]+/);
                for (var k = 0; k < tf.length; k++) {
                    var lt = tf[k].toLowerCase();
                    for (var x = 0; x < toks.length; x++) { if (toks[x] && toks[x].length > 2 && lt.indexOf(toks[x].substr(0, 4)) > -1) { best = tf[k]; break; } }
                    if (best) { break; }
                }
            }
            if (best && !t.map[fn]) { t.map[fn] = best; }
        }
    };
    c.onTargetSystem = function (t) { t.map = {}; c.autoMap(t); };

    // ---- Run: REAL record-mode extraction (every trade -> one row, all fields, via Now Assist) ----
    c.runInput = '';
    c.runRows = null;   // null = not run yet; [] = ran, no rows
    c.runKeys = [];
    c.runStatus = '';
    c.runStatusText = '';
    c.runBusy = false;
    c.runExtract = function () {
        if (!c.runInput || !c.selectedCount()) { return; }
        c.runBusy = true;
        c.runRows = null;
        c.data.action = 'run_extract';
        c.data.runFields = c.selectedFields();
        c.data.runInput = c.runInput;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.runBusy = false;
            c.runKeys = c.data.runKeys || [];
            c.runRows = c.data.runRows || [];
            c.runStatus = c.data.runStatus || '';
            c.runStatusText = (c.runStatus === 'ok') ? 'No rows found' : ('No result — status: ' + c.runStatus);
            c.data.action = '';
        });
    };

    // ---- validation for Next ----
    c.canNext = function () {
        // Define: needs name + full taxonomy (BU -> Sub-BU -> Service -> Work driver), AND the resulting
        // pipeline must have a pre-coded step set. Activity is fixed to "Compare & Match".
        if (c.step === 1) { return !!(c.model.name && c.model.subBu && c.model.service && c.model.workDriver && c.model.activity) && c.hasActivitySteps(); }
        // Input Configuration: only the Ingestion sub-page gates — a Mail source needs a mailbox.
        if (c.step === 2 && c.sub === 1) { return c.model.ingestionType !== 'Mail' || !!c.model.mailbox; }
        return true;
    };

    // ---- persist ----
    c.busy = false;
    function persist(action) {
        c.busy = true;
        c.data.action = action;
        c.data.model = c.model;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_list';
        });
    }
    // Silent background draft-save: creates the draft as soon as the manager advances past Define, and
    // keeps model.id so later saves (and Publish) update the SAME record — never a duplicate. No navigation.
    function silentSaveDraft() {
        if (!(c.model && c.model.name) || c.model.status === 'published') { return; }
        c.busy = true;
        c.data.action = 'save_draft';
        c.data.model = c.model;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.busy = false;
            c.data.action = '';
            if (c.data.savedId) { c.model.id = c.data.savedId; if (!c.model.status) { c.model.status = 'draft'; } }
        });
    }

    c.saveDraft = function () { persist('save_draft'); };
    c.publish = function () { persist('publish'); };
    c.clearAll = function () {
        if (!$window.confirm('Clear all selections and start blank?')) { return; }
        $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_builder';
    };
    // Leaving an incomplete wizard auto-saves it as a DRAFT (so nothing is lost) — unless it is already
    // published (editing a live workflow) or nothing meaningful has been entered yet.
    c.exit = function () {
        var m = c.model || {};
        // NB: activity is auto-set to "Compare & Match", so it is NOT a signal of real progress — checking
        // it would auto-save a junk draft for an untouched new wizard. Use the fields the user actually picks.
        var started = !!(m.name || m.subBu || m.service || m.workDriver || (m.fields && m.fields.length));
        if (started && m.status !== 'published') { persist('save_draft'); return; }
        $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_list';
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/wizard-builder.client.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>1a7733c27c51491591faa69618160db4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/wizard-builder.client.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_1a7733c27c51491591faa69618160db4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * OTC AI Case Screen — Service Portal widget SERVER script.
 * Full replica of the OTC analyst screen (Extracted -> Compare & Match -> Decide next action, with
 * analyst-feedback writeback), but every extracted value comes from the AI fields (ai_*), the match
 * runs via CompareMatch.buildDataAi, and all analyst-feedback state is stored on the PARALLEL ai_*
 * workflow fields (ai_confirmed / ai_analyst_outcome / ai_review_confirmed / ai_resolution) so the AI
 * path is completely independent of the OTC path. AI extraction logic itself is untouched.
 */
(function () {
    // ── ACCESS GUARD (centralised: x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard) ──
    // A non-manager/admin analyst may open a case ONLY while they still have at least one PUBLISHED
    // work-driver assigned. Re-evaluated on every request, so once the manager deletes the work-driver or
    // unassigns the analyst, the next load/refresh bounces them to the landing page (client navigates away).
    data.redirect = '';
    if (!new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().canViewAny()) { data.redirect = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers'; }
    if (data.redirect) { data.empty = true; return; }

    // READ-ONLY (FR-UI-022): only the ASSIGNED analyst of the cashflow's work-driver may act (confirm /
    // override / write-back). A manager/admin — or anyone arriving from a read-only board (?ro=1) — views it
    // read-only: every state-changing action is gated server-side below, and the buttons are hidden in the UI.
    var _ag = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard();
    data.role = _ag.roleLabel();
    function _canActCf(cfSysId) { if (!cfSysId) { return false; } var _g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); return _g.get('' + cfSysId) ? _ag.canActOnCashflow(_g) : false; }
    var _roParam = ('' + ($sp.getParameter('ro') || (input && input.ro) || '')) === '1';
    // $sp.getParameter is only reliable on the initial GET; on a server.update() POST the URL params are
    // gone, so fall back to the persisted client value (data.cfParam / data.ro) — otherwise readOnly would
    // flip to true after every Save/Confirm and hide all controls. Same fallback used at line ~295.
    var _cfForRo = $sp.getParameter('cf') || (input && input.cfParam) || '';
    data.readOnly = _roParam || !_canActCf(_cfForRo);
    data.ro = _roParam ? '1' : '';   // persist so the fallback above survives a server.update() POST

    var ex = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.EmlFieldExtractor();
    function setIf(gr, col, v) { if (v !== null && v !== undefined) { gr.setValue(col, '' + v); } }
    function vdDisp(v) { var m = ('' + (v || '')).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/); return m ? (m[3] + '-' + m[2] + '-' + m[1]) : ('' + (v || '')); }
    function vdIso(v) { v = '' + (v || ''); if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) { return v; } var m = v.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{4})$/); return m ? (m[3] + '-' + ('0' + m[1]).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + m[2]).slice(-2)) : v; }
    function fmtReceived(raw) {
        raw = '' + (raw || '');
        var m = raw.match(/(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]{3})[A-Za-z]*\s+(\d{4})\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?/);
        if (!m) { return raw; }
        var mo = { jan: '01', feb: '02', mar: '03', apr: '04', may: '05', jun: '06', jul: '07', aug: '08', sep: '09', oct: '10', nov: '11', dec: '12' }[m[2].toLowerCase()] || '01';
        return ('0' + m[1]).slice(-2) + '-' + mo + '-' + m[3] + ' ' + ('0' + m[4]).slice(-2) + ':' + m[5] + ':' + (m[6] || '00');
    }
    function extractEmail(s) {
        s = '' + (s || '');
        var m = s.match(/<([^>]+)>/); if (m) { return m[1].trim(); }
        m = s.match(/[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.\w+/); return m ? m[0] : '';
    }
    function fmtAmt(v) {
        var n = parseFloat(('' + (v || '')).replace(/,/g, ''));
        if (isNaN(n)) { return '' + (v || '-'); }
        var p = n.toFixed(2).split('.');
        p[0] = p[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
        return p.join('.');
    }
    // Never-negative amount + direction double-flip rule — delegated to the SHARED AmountDirection Script
    // Include so the case screen and the board (TaggingDashboard) agree. Fixes the old inline divergences:
    // free-text directions ("COU RECEIVE") are now normalised before flipping, and an empty direction no
    // longer becomes a '-' sentinel. The AI's raw negative is accepted on extraction ("let it be"); this
    // only governs display + what we persist on an analyst action.
    var _adir = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AmountDirection();
    function flipDir(d) { return _adir.flip(d); }
    function amtIsNeg(a) { return _adir.isNeg(a); }
    function amtAbs(a) { return _adir.absAmt(a); }
    function dispDir(amt, dir) { return _adir.dispDir(amt, dir); }
    function drow(label, val) { return '  ' + (label + '                    ').slice(0, 18) + ('' + (val === '' || val == null ? '-' : val)); }
    function detailBlock(ref, ccy, amt, dir, vd) {
        return drow('Trade reference', ref) + '\n' + drow('Currency', ccy) + '\n' +
            drow('Amount', fmtAmt(amt)) + '\n' + drow('Direction', dir) + '\n' + drow('Value date', vd);
    }

    // Step 3 draft — DRIVEN by the write-back action the manager configured for this outcome in the
    // onboarding wizard (Send to NEWS / Reply to Counterparty / Reply to Middle Office). Falls back to a
    // Middle Office referral when nothing is configured. The analyst still resolves with the Resolved
    // buttons; the write-back "send" is the configured side action.
    function buildDraft(action) {
        var ref = data.reference || '(no reference)';
        var ccy = data.currency || '', amt = data.amount || '', vd = data.value_date || '';
        var cp = data.counterparty || 'Counterparty';
        var subj = ref + ' (' + ccy + ', value ' + vd + ')';
        var bk = (data.cmp && data.cmp.booking) ? data.cmp.booking : null;
        var diffs = (data.cmp && data.cmp.banner) ? data.cmp.banner.diffs.concat(data.cmp.banner.miss).join(', ') : '';
        var cpBlk = detailBlock(ref, ccy, amt, data.direction, vd);
        var bkBlk = bk ? detailBlock(bk.bank_trade_ref || bk.reference || '-', bk.currency || ccy, bk.amount, bk.direction || data.direction, bk.value_date || vd) : '  (no matching booking found in our systems)';
        var lead = diffs
            ? ('The counterparty confirmation and our booking differ on the field(s): ' + diffs + '.')
            : (bk ? 'The counterparty confirmation and our booking agree on every field.'
                  : 'No matching booking was found in our systems for the cash flow below.');
        var tail = '\n\nCounterparty: ' + cp + '\nSource email: ' + data.ref + '\n\nCounterparty submitted:\n' + cpBlk + '\n\nBooked by the bank:\n' + bkBlk + '\n\nRegards,\nSettlements';

        // `action` (passed in) is ONE of the manager-configured write-back actions for this outcome
        // (Send to NEWS / Reply to Counterparty / Reply to Middle Office). May be '' when none configured.
        action = '' + (action || '');
        var senderEmail = gr.getValue('mail_from') || (cp + ' Settlements');

        // Default: Middle Office referral (no config, or a Middle Office action).
        // channel: 'email' = an actual message to a person (To/Subject/Body draft). 'system' = a
        // system write-back with NO mail intimation (just a status line) — used for NEWS.
        var d = {
            action: action, channel: 'email', title: 'Refer to Middle Office', to: 'middleoffice@abc.com',
            subject: 'Referral: Trade confirmation — ' + subj, body: lead + tail,
            sendLabel: 'Send to Middle Office', sentLabel: 'Sent to Middle Office'
        };
        if (/news/i.test(action)) {
            // NEWS is a SYSTEM write-back (the booking system), not an email — no mail intimation.
            d.channel = 'system'; d.title = 'Write-back to NEWS'; d.to = ''; d.subject = '';
            d.body = (bk && !diffs)
                ? 'Counterparty confirmation and our booking agree on every field. The confirmed settlement will be written back to NEWS — no email is sent.'
                : 'The confirmed settlement will be written back to NEWS — no email is sent.';
            d.sendLabel = 'Send to NEWS'; d.sentLabel = 'Sent to NEWS';
        } else if (/counterparty/i.test(action)) {
            d.title = 'Reply to Counterparty'; d.to = senderEmail; d.subject = 'Re: Trade confirmation — ' + subj;
            d.body = 'Hi ' + cp + ',\n\n' + lead + tail;
            d.sendLabel = 'Reply to Counterparty'; d.sentLabel = 'Reply sent to counterparty';
        } else if (/middle office/i.test(action)) {
            d.title = /reply/i.test(action) ? 'Reply to Middle Office' : 'Refer to Middle Office';
            d.sendLabel = /reply/i.test(action) ? 'Reply to Middle Office' : 'Send to Middle Office';
            d.sentLabel = /reply/i.test(action) ? 'Reply sent to Middle Office' : 'Sent to Middle Office';
        }
        // Embed the ORIGINAL inbound email underneath the reply — a real reply quotes the source message.
        // Applies to any EMAIL channel (Counterparty / Middle Office); the NEWS system write-back has no
        // email, so it is skipped. Reply on top, quoted original below (standard email reply format).
        if (d.channel === 'email') {
            var m = data.mail || {};
            if (m.body || m.subject) {
                d.body += '\n\n----------------- Original Message -----------------\n' +
                          'From:    ' + (m.from || '') + '\n' +
                          'To:      ' + (m.to || '') + '\n' +
                          (m.received ? ('Sent:    ' + m.received + '\n') : '') +
                          'Subject: ' + (m.subject || '') + '\n' +
                          '----------------------------------------------------\n\n' +
                          (m.body || '');
            }
        }
        return d;
    }

    // ---- Audit trail: append-only capture of analyst actions + AI inferences (BRD §Audit, FSD §15) ----
    var AUD = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AuditTrail();
    function auditCf(cfGr, eventType, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        var emId = cfGr.getValue('email'), mailId = '', cp = '';
        var em = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        if (em.get(emId)) { mailId = em.getValue('name'); cp = em.getValue('counterparty_name'); }
        opts.entityType = 'cashflow';
        opts.entityId = cfGr.getUniqueValue();
        opts.emailId = emId;
        opts.cashflowId = cfGr.getUniqueValue();
        opts.mailId = mailId;
        opts.counterparty = cp;
        AUD.log(eventType, opts);
    }

    // Save action: persist the edited AI fields back onto the cashflow (ai_* only — never the OTC fields).
    if (input && input.action === 'save' && input.cfSysId && _canActCf(input.cfSysId)) {
        if (input.cfSysId) {
            var cfg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
            if (cfg.get(input.cfSysId)) {
                // Counterparty is DERIVED (not AI) and read-only, so it is never written here. Compare
                // each incoming value to the stored one first, so a corrected field is audited as an
                // override (original AI value vs analyst-corrected value) per FSD override-transparency.
                var fmap = [
                    ['ai_nomura_entity', 'Nomura Entity', input.nomuraEntity],
                    ['ai_reference', 'Trade Reference', input.reference],
                    ['ai_product', 'Product', input.product],
                    ['ai_currency', 'Currency', input.currency],
                    ['ai_trade_date', 'Trade Date', vdIso(input.tradeDate)],
                    ['ai_value_date', 'Value Date', vdIso(input.value_date)],
                    ['ai_ssi_bank', 'SSI Bank / BIC', input.ssiBank],
                    ['ai_ssi_account', 'SSI Account', input.ssiAccount],
                    ['ai_ssi_beneficiary', 'SSI Beneficiary / BIC', input.ssiBeneficiary],
                    ['ai_ssi_intermediary', 'SSI Intermediary', input.ssiIntermediary]
                ];
                var overrides = [];
                for (var fi = 0; fi < fmap.length; fi++) {
                    var col = fmap[fi][0], lbl = fmap[fi][1], nv = fmap[fi][2];
                    if (nv === undefined || nv === null) { continue; }
                    var ov = cfg.getValue(col) || '';
                    if (('' + nv) !== ('' + ov)) { overrides.push({ label: lbl, before: ov, after: '' + nv }); }
                    setIf(cfg, col, nv);
                }
                // Amount + Direction are handled as a PAIR against the DISPLAYED (normalized) values the
                // analyst saw: the card shows |amount| + the double-flipped direction when the stored amount
                // is negative. Persist the normalized pair (never negative, net direction) so it stays stable
                // on re-open; audit only when the analyst genuinely changed what they saw.
                var _stAmtRaw = cfg.getValue('ai_amount'), _stDirRaw = cfg.getValue('ai_direction');
                var _stAmtDisp = amtAbs(_stAmtRaw), _stDirDisp = dispDir(_stAmtRaw, _stDirRaw);
                if (input.amount !== undefined && input.amount !== null) {
                    var _newAmt = amtAbs(input.amount);
                    // Compare against, and audit, the value the analyst actually SAW (the displayed/normalized
                    // one) — not the raw stored value — so we never log a spurious "X -> X" override.
                    if (('' + _newAmt) !== ('' + _stAmtDisp)) { overrides.push({ label: 'Amount', before: _stAmtDisp, after: _newAmt }); }
                    cfg.setValue('ai_amount', '' + _newAmt);
                }
                if (input.direction !== undefined && input.direction !== null) {
                    if (('' + input.direction) !== ('' + _stDirDisp)) { overrides.push({ label: 'Direction', before: _stDirDisp, after: '' + input.direction }); }
                    cfg.setValue('ai_direction', '' + input.direction);
                }
                cfg.update();
                for (var oi = 0; oi < overrides.length; oi++) {
                    var ovr = overrides[oi];
                    auditCf(cfg, 'extraction.overridden', {
                        summary: 'Analyst corrected ' + ovr.label,
                        fieldName: ovr.label, aiValue: ovr.before, analystValue: ovr.after
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        // Counterparty is email-level (derived from the sender directory) and is the value the matcher
        // reads. Allow the analyst to OVERRIDE it here. AUTHORIZATION: resolve the email from the (already
        // access-checked) cashflow — NEVER from a client-supplied email id — so an analyst can't overwrite
        // another wizard's email counterparty by posting a foreign `id`.
        if (input.counterparty !== undefined && input.counterparty !== null && input.cfSysId) {
            var acg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
            if (acg.get(input.cfSysId)) {
                var ecp = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
                if (ecp.get(acg.getValue('email'))) {
                    var oldCp = ecp.getValue('counterparty_name') || '';
                    if (('' + input.counterparty) !== ('' + oldCp)) {
                        ecp.setValue('counterparty_name', '' + input.counterparty);
                        ecp.update();
                        auditCf(acg, 'extraction.overridden', {
                            summary: 'Analyst corrected Counterparty',
                            fieldName: 'Counterparty', aiValue: oldCp, analystValue: '' + input.counterparty
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        data.saved = true;
    }

    // Confirm THIS cashflow's AI extraction (independent of OTC).
    if (input && input.action === 'confirm' && input.cfSysId && _canActCf(input.cfSysId)) {
        var ccg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (ccg.get(input.cfSysId)) {
            // Normalize the pair on confirm so the matched cashflow is never negative (|amount| + net
            // direction) — matches what the analyst confirmed on screen. AUDIT the normalisation (raw ->
            // normalised) so the record mutation is traceable, not silent (the raw AI value is also on the
            // original cashflow.extracted event).
            var _cAmt = ccg.getValue('ai_amount'), _cDir = ccg.getValue('ai_direction');
            if (amtIsNeg(_cAmt)) {
                var _nAmt = amtAbs(_cAmt), _nDir = dispDir(_cAmt, _cDir);
                ccg.setValue('ai_amount', _nAmt);
                ccg.setValue('ai_direction', _nDir);
                auditCf(ccg, 'extraction.normalized', {
                    summary: 'Normalized negative AI amount to bank convention (|amount| + net direction)',
                    aiValue: _cAmt + ' / ' + _cDir, analystValue: _nAmt + ' / ' + _nDir
                });
            }
            ccg.setValue('ai_confirmed', 'true'); ccg.update();
            auditCf(ccg, 'extraction.confirmed', {
                summary: 'Analyst confirmed the extracted fields',
                ai: { amount: ccg.getValue('ai_amount'), currency: ccg.getValue('ai_currency'), value_date: ccg.getValue('ai_value_date'), direction: ccg.getValue('ai_direction') }
            });
        }
    }

    // Analyst outcome writeback (HITL) — ai_* workflow fields only.
    if (input && input.action === 'outcome' && input.cfSysId && input.outcomeChoice && _canActCf(input.cfSysId)) {
        var og = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (og.get(input.cfSysId)) { og.setValue('ai_analyst_outcome', input.outcomeChoice); og.setValue('ai_review_confirmed', ''); og.setValue('ai_resolution', ''); og.setValue('ai_mo_sent', ''); og.update(); }
    }
    if (input && input.action === 'reset_outcome' && input.cfSysId && _canActCf(input.cfSysId)) {
        var rg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (rg.get(input.cfSysId)) { rg.setValue('ai_analyst_outcome', ''); rg.setValue('ai_review_confirmed', ''); rg.setValue('ai_resolution', ''); rg.setValue('ai_mo_sent', ''); rg.update(); }
    }
    if (input && input.action === 'confirm_review' && input.cfSysId) {
        var cvg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (cvg.get(input.cfSysId)) {
            if (input.outcomeChoice) { cvg.setValue('ai_analyst_outcome', input.outcomeChoice); }
            cvg.setValue('ai_review_confirmed', 'true');
            cvg.update();
            auditCf(cvg, 'match.confirmed', { summary: 'Analyst confirmed the match outcome: ' + (cvg.getValue('ai_analyst_outcome') || ''), analystValue: cvg.getValue('ai_analyst_outcome') });
        }
    }
    // Analyst SELECTS which candidate booking to compare against — the selection (not the matcher's
    // best) drives the outcome. Matched if the chosen booking agrees on every field, else Mismatch.
    if (input && input.action === 'select_candidate' && input.cfSysId && input.candKey) {
        var scg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (scg.get(input.cfSysId)) {
            var cmpSel = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().buildDataAi(input.cfSysId, '', input.candKey);
            var selOutcome = (cmpSel && cmpSel.systemOutcome === 'matched') ? 'matched' : 'mismatch';
            scg.setValue('ai_selected_booking', input.candKey);
            scg.setValue('ai_analyst_outcome', selOutcome);
            scg.setValue('ai_review_confirmed', ''); scg.setValue('ai_resolution', ''); scg.setValue('ai_mo_sent', '');
            scg.update();
            var topRef = '', selConf = '';
            var cl = (cmpSel && cmpSel.candidatesList) || [];
            for (var ci = 0; ci < cl.length; ci++) { if (cl[ci].best) { topRef = cl[ci].bankRef; } if (cl[ci].key === input.candKey) { selConf = cl[ci].confidence; } }
            auditCf(scg, 'match.selected', {
                summary: 'Selected booking ' + input.candKey + ' at ' + (cmpSel ? cmpSel.tierLabel : '') + ' — ' + selOutcome,
                aiValue: topRef, analystValue: input.candKey,
                ai: { tier: cmpSel ? cmpSel.tier : 0, tierLabel: cmpSel ? cmpSel.tierLabel : '', candidate: input.candKey, confidence: selConf, outcome: selOutcome, diffs: cmpSel ? cmpSel.diffCount : 0, candidates: cl.length }
            });
        }
    }
    // Analyst declares that none of the candidates match -> no-match path.
    if (input && input.action === 'mark_no_match' && input.cfSysId) {
        var nmg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (nmg.get(input.cfSysId)) {
            nmg.setValue('ai_selected_booking', 'none');
            nmg.setValue('ai_analyst_outcome', 'no_match');
            nmg.setValue('ai_review_confirmed', ''); nmg.setValue('ai_resolution', ''); nmg.setValue('ai_mo_sent', '');
            nmg.update();
            auditCf(nmg, 'match.no_match', { summary: 'Analyst marked the cashflow as no match', analystValue: 'no_match' });
        }
    }
    // Step 3 resolution — the analyst picks one; this is what the dashboard Workflow Status shows.
    if (input && input.action === 'resolve_matched' && input.cfSysId) {
        var rm = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (rm.get(input.cfSysId)) { rm.setValue('ai_resolution', 'resolved_matched'); rm.update(); auditCf(rm, 'writeback', { summary: 'Resolved — Matched (sent to NEWS)', analystValue: 'resolved_matched' }); }
    }
    if (input && input.action === 'resolve_unmatched' && input.cfSysId) {
        var ru = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (ru.get(input.cfSysId)) { ru.setValue('ai_resolution', 'resolved_unmatched'); ru.update(); auditCf(ru, 'writeback', { summary: 'Resolved — Unmatched', analystValue: 'resolved_unmatched' }); }
    }
    // Optional side action — records a local "sent" marker only; deliberately does NOT touch
    // ai_resolution, so the dashboard Workflow Status is unaffected by sending to Middle Office.
    if (input && input.action === 'send_mo' && input.cfSysId) {
        var sd = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        var wbLabel = '' + (input.sendLabel || 'Send to Middle Office');
        if (sd.get(input.cfSysId)) { sd.setValue('ai_mo_sent', 'true'); sd.update(); auditCf(sd, 'writeback.mo', { summary: 'Write-back: ' + wbLabel, analystValue: wbLabel }); }
    }

    // Which record to show: ?cf -> parent email; ?eml -> email; else latest relevant.
    var cfParam = $sp.getParameter('cf') || (input && input.cfParam) || '';
    var emlParam = $sp.getParameter('eml') || (input && input.emlParam) || '';
    var emailFromCf = '';
    if (cfParam) { var cfr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); if (cfr.get(cfParam)) { emailFromCf = cfr.getValue('email'); } }
    var wantId = (input && input.id) || emailFromCf || emlParam || '';
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    var found = wantId ? gr.get(wantId) : false;
    if (!found) {
        var q = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        q.addQuery('classification', 'relevant');
        q.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); q.setLimit(1); q.query();
        if (q.next()) { gr = q; } else { data.empty = true; return; }
    }

    data.empty = false;
    data.id = gr.getUniqueValue();
    data.ref = ('' + (gr.getValue('name') || '')).replace(/\.eml$/i, '') || '(no id)';

    // Resolve the clicked cashflow (or the email's first) and read the AI-extracted fields.
    var cfRec = null;
    if (cfParam) { var cfg2 = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); if (cfg2.get(cfParam) && cfg2.getValue('email') === gr.getUniqueValue()) { cfRec = cfg2; } }
    if (!cfRec) { var f1 = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); f1.addQuery('email', gr.getUniqueValue()); f1.orderBy('flow_index'); f1.setLimit(1); f1.query(); if (f1.next()) { cfRec = f1; } }
    data.cfSysId = cfRec ? cfRec.getUniqueValue() : '';
    // AI source-snippet provenance for THIS cashflow — drives the exact email-body highlighting + the
    // dynamic legend on the case screen (no client-side string-guessing). null when not yet re-extracted.
    data.sources = null;
    try { data.sources = JSON.parse((cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_sources') : '') || 'null'); } catch (eSrc) { data.sources = null; }
    data.analystOutcome = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('ai_analyst_outcome') || '') : '';
    data.reviewConfirmed = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('ai_review_confirmed') === 'true') : false;
    // Counterparty is DERIVED from the sender via the counterparty directory (email-level), same as OTC.
    data.counterparty = gr.getValue('counterparty_name');
    data.reference = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_reference') : gr.getValue('ai_reference');
    data.currency = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_currency') : gr.getValue('ai_currency');
    // Never surface a negative amount: show |amount|, and double-flip the direction when it was negative.
    var _rawAmt = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_amount') : gr.getValue('ai_amount');
    var _rawDir = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_direction') : gr.getValue('ai_direction');
    data.amount = amtAbs(_rawAmt);
    data.direction = dispDir(_rawAmt, _rawDir);
    data.value_date = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_value_date') : gr.getValue('ai_value_date');   // ISO YYYY-MM-DD
    // The remaining BRD/FSD fields (AI-extracted, per cashflow).
    data.nomuraEntity = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_nomura_entity') : '';
    data.product = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_product') : '';
    data.tradeDate = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_trade_date') : '';   // ISO YYYY-MM-DD
    data.ssiBank = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_ssi_bank') : '';
    data.ssiAccount = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_ssi_account') : '';
    data.ssiBeneficiary = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_ssi_beneficiary') : '';
    data.ssiIntermediary = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('ai_ssi_intermediary') : '';
    data.confirmed = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('ai_confirmed') === 'true') : false;

    // Which fields to DISPLAY = the owning wizard's configured fields (the 4 mandatory + counterparty are
    // always shown; optional fields the wizard did NOT configure are hidden). Default = show all (for
    // cashflows not produced by a wizard).
    data.show = { counterparty: true, value_date: true, amount: true, currency: true, direction: true, reference: true, nomuraEntity: true, product: true, tradeDate: true, ssiBank: true, ssiAccount: true, ssiBeneficiary: true, ssiIntermediary: true };
    var showWiz = gr.getValue('wiz_extracted') || '';
    if (showWiz) {
        var wgShow = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (wgShow.get(showWiz)) {
            var fldsShow = [];
            try { fldsShow = JSON.parse(wgShow.getValue('input_fields') || '[]'); } catch (eShow) { fldsShow = []; }
            if (fldsShow.length) {
                var FKEY = { 'value date': 'value_date', 'amount': 'amount', 'currency': 'currency', 'direction': 'direction', 'trade reference': 'reference', 'nomura entity': 'nomuraEntity', 'product': 'product', 'trade date': 'tradeDate', 'ssi bank / bic': 'ssiBank', 'ssi account': 'ssiAccount', 'ssi beneficiary / bic': 'ssiBeneficiary', 'ssi intermediary': 'ssiIntermediary' };
                var show = { counterparty: true, value_date: true, amount: true, currency: true, direction: true };
                for (var si = 0; si < fldsShow.length; si++) { var sk = FKEY[('' + (fldsShow[si].name || '')).toLowerCase()]; if (sk) { show[sk] = true; } }
                data.show = show;
            }
        }
    }

    // Write-back actions configured in the owning wizard (per Compare & Match outcome) — surfaced so the
    // analyst sees what the workflow does for this cashflow's outcome (Matched / Mismatch / No Match).
    data.wb = { matched: [], mismatch: [], no_match: [] };
    if (showWiz) {
        var wgWb = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (wgWb.get(showWiz)) {
            var wbCfg = [];
            try { wbCfg = JSON.parse(wgWb.getValue('writeback') || '[]'); } catch (eWb) { wbCfg = []; }
            for (var wi = 0; wi < wbCfg.length; wi++) {
                var scen = ('' + (wbCfg[wi].scenario || '')).toLowerCase();
                var wkey = (scen.indexOf('mismatch') > -1) ? 'mismatch' : (scen.indexOf('no') > -1 ? 'no_match' : (scen.indexOf('match') > -1 ? 'matched' : ''));
                if (wkey) { data.wb[wkey] = (wbCfg[wi].actions instanceof Array) ? wbCfg[wi].actions : (wbCfg[wi].action ? [wbCfg[wi].action] : []); }
            }
        }
    }
    data.cfParam = cfParam;
    data.emlParam = emlParam;

    // Cashflow navigator (multi-trade mails).
    data.cfList = [];
    var lcf = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
    lcf.addQuery('email', gr.getUniqueValue());
    lcf.orderBy('flow_index');
    lcf.query();
    while (lcf.next()) { data.cfList.push(lcf.getUniqueValue()); }
    data.cfTotal = data.cfList.length;
    data.cfIndex = 0;
    for (var ni = 0; ni < data.cfList.length; ni++) { if (data.cfList[ni] === data.cfSysId) { data.cfIndex = ni + 1; break; } }

    // Mail contents from the raw .eml.
    data.mail = { to: '', from: '', cc: '', subject: '', body: '', attachment: '', received: '' };
    data.emlAttId = '';
    var attNames = [];
    var ag = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
    ag.addQuery('table_name', 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    ag.addQuery('table_sys_id', gr.getUniqueValue());
    ag.orderBy('sys_created_on');
    ag.query();
    while (ag.next()) {
        var ctype = ag.getValue('content_type') || '';
        var fname = ag.getValue('file_name') || '';
        if (!data.emlAttId && (ctype === 'message/rfc822' || /\.eml$/i.test(fname))) {
            data.emlAttId = ag.getUniqueValue();
        } else {
            attNames.push(fname);
        }
    }
    if (data.emlAttId) {
        var m = ex.mailContents(data.emlAttId) || {};
        data.mail.to = m.to || ''; data.mail.from = m.from || ''; data.mail.cc = m.cc || '';
        data.mail.subject = m.subject || ''; data.mail.body = m.body || '';
        data.mail.received = fmtReceived(m.date);
    } else {
        // No raw .eml (e.g. seeded demo data) — fall back to the stored mail_* fields on the email.
        data.mail.to = gr.getValue('mail_to') || '';
        data.mail.from = gr.getValue('mail_from') || '';
        data.mail.subject = gr.getValue('mail_subject') || '';
        data.mail.body = gr.getValue('mail_body') || '';
    }
    data.mail.attachment = attNames.join(', ');

    // ---- Extraction confidence (grounding + validation per field) ----
    // Ground against the full text the AI read (body + parsed spreadsheet grid), rebuilt cheaply
    // (no AI call). Falls back to the body if the .eml can't be re-parsed.
    var confContent = data.mail.body || '';
    try {
        if (data.emlAttId) {
            var dxc = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.DemoExtractor().run(data.emlAttId, gr.getUniqueValue(), false);
            if (dxc && dxc.aiContent) { confContent = dxc.aiContent; }
        }
    } catch (ecc) { /* fall back to body */ }
    data.conf = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.ExtractionConfidence().score({
        counterparty: data.counterparty, nomuraEntity: data.nomuraEntity, product: data.product,
        reference: data.reference, tradeDate: data.tradeDate, valueDate: data.value_date,
        amount: data.amount, currency: data.currency, direction: data.direction,
        ssiBank: data.ssiBank, ssiAccount: data.ssiAccount, ssiBeneficiary: data.ssiBeneficiary, ssiIntermediary: data.ssiIntermediary
    }, confContent);

    // Back link → the SCOPED wizard board this case belongs to (NOT the global ai_dashboard, which lists
    // EVERY work-driver's mails, incl. CSG). Owning wizard = the mail's wiz_extracted / wiz_assigned; fall
    // back to the session's current board, then the landing page. This is what made "come back" show CSG.
    var _ownWiz = gr.getValue('wiz_extracted') || gr.getValue('wiz_assigned') || ('' + (gs.getSession().getClientData('nfotc_wiz_current') || ''));
    data.dashUrl = _ownWiz ? ('/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_nfotc_wiz_dash&wiz=' + _ownWiz) : '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers';

    // Step 2 (Compare & Match) — only after the analyst confirms the AI extraction. Uses the AI values.
    data.selectedRef = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('ai_selected_booking') || '') : '';
    data.cmp = null;
    if (data.confirmed) {
        var cm = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch();
        data.cmp = data.cfSysId ? cm.buildDataAi(data.cfSysId, '', data.selectedRef) : cm.buildDataAi('', gr.getUniqueValue(), data.selectedRef);
    }
    data.effectiveOutcome = data.analystOutcome || (data.cmp ? data.cmp.systemOutcome : '');
    data.resolution = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('ai_resolution') || '') : '';
    data.moSent = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('ai_mo_sent') === 'true') : false;
    // One draft PER manager-configured write-back action for this outcome (the analyst picks which to send).
    // If none configured, fall back to a single default draft (Middle Office referral, as before).
    data.drafts = [];
    if (data.confirmed && data.cmp && data.effectiveOutcome) {
        var _wbActs = (data.wb && data.wb[data.effectiveOutcome]) ? data.wb[data.effectiveOutcome] : [];
        if (_wbActs && _wbActs.length) { for (var _dfi = 0; _dfi < _wbActs.length; _dfi++) { data.drafts.push(buildDraft(_wbActs[_dfi])); } }
        else { data.drafts.push(buildDraft('')); }
    }
    data.draft = data.drafts.length ? data.drafts[0] : null;

    data.logo = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().LOGO;
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/ai-extraction.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>24d9ebe28af34a7a992845b553107648</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/ai-extraction.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_24d9ebe28af34a7a992845b553107648</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * DemoExtractor — one-shot email extraction for the business "Demo" page.
 *
 * Given a raw .eml already stored as a sys_attachment on a throwaway email record, it runs the SAME
 * pipeline the live OTC AI Settlements flow uses — EmlFieldExtractor (body) + XlsxCashflowExtractor
 * (spreadsheet), merged — and, when asked, the "Extract Settlement Fields" Now Assist skill
 * (AiFieldExtractor). It NEVER writes cashflow rows; everything is returned in-memory for display, so
 * the demo shows the unstructured-email -> structured-fields journey without touching the dashboards.
 *
 * Direction convention mirrors the live path: the email states the counterparty's POV; the AI 13-field
 * view is stored/shown from the bank POV (Pay <-> Receive flipped).
 */
var DemoExtractor = Class.create();
DemoExtractor.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    _flipDir: function (d) {
        var s = ('' + (d || '')).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (s === 'pay' || s === 'p' || s === 'pays') { return 'Receive'; }
        if (s === 'receive' || s === 'r' || s === 'rec' || s === 'receives') { return 'Pay'; }
        return d || '';
    },
    _refKey: function (s) { return ('' + (s || '')).toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ''); },

    /**
     * @param {string} attSysId    sys_id of the raw .eml sys_attachment
     * @param {string} emailSysId  sys_id of the (throwaway) parent x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email record
     * @param {boolean} withAi     also run the Now Assist extraction + align per cashflow
     */
    run: function (attSysId, emailSysId, withAi) {
        var out = {
            counterparty: '', mail: { to: '', from: '', cc: '', subject: '', body: '', date: '', attachment: '' },
            flows: [], cashflows: [], aiContent: '', aiStatus: '', aiFlowCount: 0
        };
        if (!attSysId) { return out; }
        var self = this;
        var ex = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.EmlFieldExtractor();

        // 1. deterministic body extraction + counterparty derived from the sender
        var r = ex.extractAll(attSysId, 'relevant');
        out.counterparty = r.counterparty_name || '';
        var bodyFlows = (r.flows && r.flows.length) ? r.flows.slice() : [];

        // 2. spreadsheet extraction (multi-tab), merged with the body flows (dedupe by reference)
        var attachmentText = '', attFlows = [];
        try {
            var xr = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.XlsxCashflowExtractor().extract(attSysId, emailSysId);
            if (xr && xr.flow_count) { attFlows = xr.flows; attachmentText = xr.sheet_text || ''; }
        } catch (e) { gs.warn('[DemoExtractor] xlsx: ' + e); }

        var merged = [], seen = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < bodyFlows.length; i++) { merged.push(bodyFlows[i]); var kb = self._refKey(bodyFlows[i].reference); if (kb) { seen[kb] = true; } }
        for (var j = 0; j < attFlows.length; j++) { var ka = self._refKey(attFlows[j].reference); if (ka && seen[ka]) { continue; } merged.push(attFlows[j]); if (ka) { seen[ka] = true; } }

        // 3. mail contents (headers + body) — as-shown to the analyst
        var m = ex.mailContents(attSysId) || {};
        out.mail.to = m.to || ''; out.mail.from = m.from || ''; out.mail.cc = m.cc || '';
        out.mail.subject = m.subject || ''; out.mail.body = m.body || ''; out.mail.date = m.date || '';

        // deterministic preview (direction shown AS STATED in the email — pre-AI, pre-flip)
        for (var p = 0; p < merged.length; p++) {
            var f = merged[p];
            out.flows.push({ reference: f.reference || '', currency: f.currency || '', amount: f.amount || '', direction: f.direction || '', value_date: f.value_date || '' });
        }

        // 4. the exact content that will be fed to the AI (body + parsed spreadsheet grid)
        var content = 'From: ' + (m.from || '') + '\nSubject: ' + (m.subject || '') + '\n\n';
        var segs = [];
        if (m.body) { segs.push(m.body); }
        if (attachmentText) {
            segs.push('The counterparty is the firm that SENT this email (the From address/domain above), ' +
                'NOT any "Counterparty Legal Name" column (which names the recipient bank). Additional ' +
                'settlement cashflows from the attached spreadsheet:\n' + attachmentText);
        }
        content += segs.join('\n\n');
        out.aiContent = content;

        if (withAi) {
            var ai = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AiFieldExtractor().extract(content);
            var aiFlows = ai.flows || [];
            out.aiStatus = ai.status || '';
            out.aiFlowCount = ai.flow_count || 0;
            var aiByRef = {};
            for (var q = 0; q < aiFlows.length; q++) { var qk = self._refKey(aiFlows[q].reference); if (qk && !(qk in aiByRef)) { aiByRef[qk] = aiFlows[q]; } }
            for (var c = 0; c < merged.length; c++) {
                var fm = merged[c];
                var af = aiByRef[self._refKey(fm.reference)] || aiFlows[c] || {};
                out.cashflows.push({
                    counterparty: out.counterparty,

                    ssiBeneficiary: af.ssi_beneficiary || '',

Idempotent: only if not already parsed. if (attId && !g.getValue('mail_body')) { try { var m = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.EmlFieldExtractor().mailContents(attId) || {}; g.setValue('mail_to', m.to || ''); g.setValue('mail_from', m.from || ''); g.setValue('mail_cc', m.cc || ''); g.setValue('mail_subject', m.subject || ''); g.setValue('mail_body', m.body || ''); } catch (e) { gs.warn('[cap-ingest] parse ' + e); } } if (!g.getValue('source')) { g.setValue('source', 'Composed Intake'); } g.update(); outputs.mail_id = g.getValue('name'); outputs.status = 'ingested'; })(inputs, outputs); 71aa7f6647032200b4fad7527c9a719bemail_record1be0362235444fc29aa33f2d7c5cde7aakshit.mahajan2026-09-03 11:56:354da3c20273aa4128b13c9fd8103b11170akshit.mahajan2026-09-03 11:56:35var__m_sys_hub_step_ext_input_1be0362235444fc29aa33f2d7c5cde7a

Idempotent: only if not already parsed. if (attId && !g.getValue('mail_body')) { try { var m = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.EmlFieldExtractor().mailContents(attId) || {}; g.setValue('mail_to', m.to || ''); g.setValue('mail_from', m.from || ''); g.setValue('mail_cc', m.cc || ''); g.setValue('mail_subject', m.subject || ''); g.setValue('mail_body', m.body || ''); } catch (e) { gs.warn('[cap-ingest] parse ' + e); } } if (!g.getValue('source')) { g.setValue('source', 'Composed Intake'); } g.update(); outputs.mail_id = g.getValue('name'); outputs.status = 'ingested'; })(inputs, outputs); 71aa7f6647032200b4fad7527c9a719bemail_record8680d0ea8343c710fe5233b8beaad3ddakshit.mahajan2026-09-03 11:57:42da8014ea8343c710fe5233b8beaad31a0akshit.mahajan2026-09-03 11:57:42var__m_sys_hub_step_ext_input_8680d0ea8343c710fe5233b8beaad3dd

if (!first) { first = ag.getUniqueValue(); } if (/\.eml$/.test(fn) || ag.getValue('content_type') === 'message/rfc822') { attId = ag.getUniqueValue(); break; } } if (!attId) { attId = first; } if (attId) { try { var sc = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.EmlSenderClassifier().classifyAttachment(attId); if (sc && sc.sender) { g.setValue('sender', sc.sender); g.update(); } } catch (e1) { /* ignore */ } } } // classification = the owning wizard's Email Identification rules (structural + deterministic + AI context) var classification = 'relevant'; try { var r = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.WizardExtractor().identify(wizId, emailId); if (r && r.classification) { classification = r.classification; } } catch (e2) { /* keep relevant */ } var g2 = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
