<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function controller($window) {
    var c = this;

    // Header user menu + sign out.
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () {
        $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm');
    };

    // Filters.
    c.q = '';
    c.wdFilter = '';
    c.actFilter = '';
    c.setWd = function (v) { c.wdFilter = v; };
    c.setAct = function (v) { c.actFilter = v; };
    c.rowFilter = function (card) {
        var q = ('' + (c.q || '')).toLowerCase();
        if (q && ('' + card.name).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1) { return false; }
        if (c.wdFilter && card.workDriver !== c.wdFilter) { return false; }
        if (c.actFilter && card.activity !== c.actFilter) { return false; }
        return true;
    };

    // Create modal.
    c.showModal = false;
    c.copyId = '';
    c.openModal = function () { c.showModal = true; c.copyId = ''; };
    c.closeModal = function () { c.showModal = false; };
    c.createNew = function () { $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_builder'; };
    c.copyEdit = function () {
        if (!c.copyId) { return; }
        $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_builder&copy=' + c.copyId;
    };

    // Card actions.
    c.open = function (id) { $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_builder&edit=' + id; };
    c.publishDraft = function (id) { $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_builder&edit=' + id + '&step=5'; };

    // Assign to real people.
    c.showAssign = false;
    c.assignWiz = null;
    c.assignSel = {};
    c.assignQ = '';
    c.openAssign = function (w) {
        c.assignWiz = w;
        c.assignSel = {};
        var ids = w.assignedIds || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) { c.assignSel[ids[i]] = true; }
        c.assignQ = '';
        c.showAssign = true;
    };
    c.closeAssign = function () { c.showAssign = false; c.assignWiz = null; };
    c.assignCount = function () { var n = 0; for (var k in c.assignSel) { if (c.assignSel[k]) { n++; } } return n; };
    c.userFilter = function (u) {
        var q = ('' + (c.assignQ || '')).toLowerCase();
        if (!q) { return true; }
        return ('' + u.name).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) > -1 || ('' + u.email).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) > -1;
    };
    c.saveAssign = function () {
        var ids = [];
        for (var k in c.assignSel) { if (c.assignSel[k]) { ids.push(k); } }
        c.data.action = 'assign';
        c.data.wizardId = c.assignWiz.id;
        c.data.userIds = ids.join(',');
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.data.action = ''; c.data.wizardId = ''; c.data.userIds = '';
            c.closeAssign();
        });
    };

    c.remove = function (id, name) {
        if (!$window.confirm('Delete "' + name + '"? This cannot be undone.')) { return; }
        c.data.action = 'delete';
        c.data.wizardId = id;
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; c.data.wizardId = ''; });
    };

    // ---- Settings (gear on a card): edit the wizard record's config fields inline ----
    var scat = (c.data && c.data.cat) || {};
    var STAX = scat.taxonomy || {};
    c.showSettings = false;
    c.settingsWiz = null;
    c.settings = null;
    c.savingSettings = false;
    c.openSettings = function (w) {
        c.settingsWiz = w;
        c.settings = {
            description: w.description || '', bu: w.bu || '', subBu: w.subBu || '', service: w.service || '',
            activity: w.activity || 'Compare & Match', workDriver: w.workDriver || '',
            mailbox: w.mailbox || '', inputFormat: w.inputFormat || 'Email',
            ingestionType: w.ingestionType || 'Mail', frequency: w.frequency || 'Real-time',
            target: w.target || '', version: w.version || 'v1'
        };
        c.showSettings = true;
    };
    c.closeSettings = function () { c.showSettings = false; c.settingsWiz = null; c.settings = null; };
    // cascade: BU -> Sub-BU -> Service -> Work Driver (Activity is fixed to "Compare & Match")
    c.sBusList = function () { return Object.keys(STAX); };
    c.sSubBusFor = function () { var s = c.settings; return (s && s.bu && STAX[s.bu]) ? Object.keys(STAX[s.bu]) : []; };
    c.sServicesFor = function () { var s = c.settings; return (s && s.bu && s.subBu && STAX[s.bu] && STAX[s.bu][s.subBu]) ? Object.keys(STAX[s.bu][s.subBu]) : []; };
    c.sWorkDriversFor = function () { var s = c.settings; return (s && s.bu && s.subBu && s.service && STAX[s.bu] && STAX[s.bu][s.subBu] && STAX[s.bu][s.subBu][s.service]) ? STAX[s.bu][s.subBu][s.service] : []; };
    c.sOnBu = function () { c.settings.subBu = ''; c.settings.service = ''; c.settings.workDriver = ''; c.settings.activity = 'Compare & Match'; };
    c.sOnSubBu = function () { c.settings.service = ''; c.settings.workDriver = ''; c.settings.activity = 'Compare & Match'; };
    c.sOnService = function () { c.settings.workDriver = ''; c.settings.activity = 'Compare & Match'; };
    c.sOnWorkDriver = function () { c.settings.activity = 'Compare & Match'; };
    c.saveSettings = function () {
        if (c.savingSettings || !c.settingsWiz) { return; }
        c.savingSettings = true;
        c.data.action = 'save_config';
        c.data.wizardId = c.settingsWiz.id;
        c.data.cfg = JSON.stringify(c.settings);
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.savingSettings = false;
            c.data.action = ''; c.data.wizardId = ''; c.data.cfg = '';
            c.closeSettings();
        });
    };
}
]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* Work Driver Onboarding Wizard — list page */
.nom-app * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.nom-app { font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; background: #eef1f5; color: #20242c; min-height: 100vh; }

/* header (shared with the console) */
.nom-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; background: #fff; padding: 6px 26px; border-bottom: 3px solid #C8102E; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06); position: relative; z-index: 30; }
.nom-logo { height: 48px; width: auto; }
.nom-user { margin-left: auto; position: relative; }
.nom-role { font-size: 13px; color: #5b6270; }
.nom-avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #C8102E; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.nom-user-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 8px 4px 6px; border-radius: 9px; transition: background .12s; }
.nom-user-btn:hover { background: #f3f4f7; }
.nom-caret { color: #98a2b3; font-size: 10px; transition: transform .15s; }
.nom-caret.open { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.nom-backdrop { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 900; background: transparent; }
.nom-menu { position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 8px); z-index: 1000; width: 222px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(20,30,60,.18); overflow: hidden; }
.nom-menu-hd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f2f5; }
.nom-avatar.sm { width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 12px; }
.nom-menu-id .nm-name { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.nom-menu-id .nm-sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: #8a909a; margin-top: 1px; }
.nom-menu-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #fff; border: none; text-align: left; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #C0392B; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
.nom-menu-item:hover { background: #fdf2f2; }
.nom-menu-item .nm-ico { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; }

/* console shell (persistent left sidebar) */
.md-body { display: flex; align-items: stretch; min-height: calc(100vh - 57px); }
.md-side { width: 220px; flex: none; background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid #e6e9ef; padding: 18px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.md-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #3a4150; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; }
.md-nav-item:hover { background: #f3f4f7; text-decoration: none; color: #3a4150; }
.md-nav-item.active { background: #fdeef0; color: #C8102E; }
.md-ni-ico { font-size: 13px; width: 16px; text-align: center; }

/* layout */
.wz-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 34px 40px 60px; }
.wz-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.wz-title { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a2e; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.wz-title-ico { color: #1F5FA8; font-size: 22px; }
.wz-sub { font-size: 14px; color: #6b7280; margin-top: 6px; }
.wz-new { margin-left: auto; background: #C8102E; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 9px; padding: 12px 20px; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(200,16,46,.3); font-family: inherit; }
.wz-new:hover { background: #a50d26; }
.wz-plus { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; }

/* search + filters */
.wz-search { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; padding: 4px 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(20,30,60,.05); }
.wz-search-ico { color: #98a2b3; font-size: 14px; }
.wz-search-in { border: none; outline: none; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 0; width: 100%; background: transparent; color: #1a1a2e; font-family: inherit; }
.wz-filters { margin-bottom: 26px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.wz-filter-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.wz-filter-lbl { font-size: 12.5px; color: #6b7280; width: 84px; }
.wz-chip { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dfe3ea; border-radius: 18px; padding: 5px 14px; font-size: 12.5px; color: #475065; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
.wz-chip:hover { border-color: #c3c9d4; }
.wz-chip.on { background: #e7f0fb; border-color: #b8d3f2; color: #1F5FA8; font-weight: 600; }

/* section headers */
.wz-section-h { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; margin: 8px 0 14px; }
.wz-sec-ico { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 12px; }
.wz-sec-ico.ok { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1E7E45; }
.wz-sec-ico.draft { background: #fdf1e3; color: #B7791F; }
.wz-count { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1px 9px; }
.wz-count.ok { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1E7E45; }
.wz-count.draft { background: #fdf1e3; color: #B7791F; }

/* cards */
.wz-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 30px; max-width: 980px; }
.wz-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05); }
.wz-card-top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; }
.wz-card-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; flex: 1; }
.wz-ver { font-size: 11px; color: #6b7280; border: 1px solid #e0e3ea; border-radius: 12px; padding: 2px 9px; white-space: nowrap; }
.wz-card-meta { font-size: 12.5px; color: #6B46C1; margin-top: 8px; }
.wz-card-flow { font-size: 12.5px; color: #475065; margin-top: 8px; }
.wz-mono { font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; background: #f3f4f7; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; }
.wz-arrow { color: #98a2b3; }
.wz-card-assigned { font-size: 12.5px; color: #6b7280; margin-top: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.wz-people { font-size: 12px; }
.wz-card-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; }
.wz-run { background: #C8102E; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: inherit; }
.wz-run:hover { background: #a50d26; }
.wz-run.muted { background: #eab7bd; cursor: pointer; }
.wz-play { font-size: 11px; }
.wz-icobtn { background: #f3f4f7; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 8px; width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 14px; color: #5b6270; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: inherit; }
.wz-icobtn:hover { background: #e9ebf0; }
.wz-del { margin-left: auto; }
.wz-del:hover { background: #fdf2f2; color: #C0392B; }
.wz-empty { grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; color: #6b7280; padding: 30px; background: #fff; border: 1px dashed #dfe3ea; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; }

/* password gate */
.wz-gate-wrap { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 80px 24px; }
.wz-gate { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(20,30,60,.08); padding: 34px 34px 30px; width: 400px; max-width: 92vw; text-align: center; }
.wz-gate-ico { font-size: 34px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.wz-gate-t { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wz-gate-sub { font-size: 13.5px; color: #6b7280; margin: 6px 0 22px; }
.wz-gate-in { width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #d7dbe2; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: #1a1a2e; background: #f8f9fb; font-family: inherit; }
.wz-gate-in:focus { outline: none; border-color: #C8102E; background: #fff; }
.wz-gate-in.err { border-color: #C0392B; background: #fff; }
.wz-gate-err { color: #C0392B; font-size: 12.5px; margin-top: 8px; text-align: left; }
.wz-gate-btn { width: 100%; margin-top: 16px; background: #C8102E; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(200,16,46,.3); font-family: inherit; }
.wz-gate-btn:hover { background: #a50d26; }
.wz-gate-btn[disabled] { background: #eab7bd; cursor: default; box-shadow: none; }
.wz-gate-back { display: inline-block; margin-top: 18px; font-size: 12.5px; color: #6b7280; text-decoration: none; }
.wz-gate-back:hover { color: #C8102E; text-decoration: none; }

/* create modal */
.wz-modal-wrap { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 1100; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.wz-modal-back { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(20,25,40,.45); }
.wz-modal { position: relative; z-index: 2; width: 460px; max-width: 92vw; background: #eef1f5; border-radius: 14px; padding: 26px 26px 24px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(20,30,60,.35); }
.wz-modal-x { position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 16px; background: none; border: none; font-size: 16px; color: #8a909a; cursor: pointer; }
.wz-modal-h { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wz-modal-sub { font-size: 13.5px; color: #6b7280; margin: 6px 0 20px; }
.wz-opt { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; margin-bottom: 16px; font-family: inherit; }
.wz-opt:hover { border-color: #b8d3f2; }
.wz-opt-ico { font-size: 20px; color: #1F5FA8; }
.wz-opt-txt { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.wz-opt-t { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wz-opt-d { font-size: 12.5px; color: #6b7280; }
.wz-opt-block { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px; }
.wz-opt-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 3px; }
.wz-modal-sel { width: 100%; margin: 14px 0 12px; padding: 12px 12px; border: 2px solid #C8102E; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #1a1a2e; background: #fff; font-family: inherit; }
.wz-copy-btn { width: 100%; background: #eab7bd; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: inherit; }
.wz-copy-btn.ready { background: #C8102E; }
.wz-copy-btn.ready:hover { background: #a50d26; }
.wz-copy-btn:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }

/* settings (config) modal */
.wz-set-modal { width: 620px; }
.wz-set-body { max-height: 62vh; overflow-y: auto; margin-bottom: 16px; padding-right: 4px; }
.wz-set-lbl { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #4a5160; margin: 12px 0 5px; letter-spacing: .01em; }
.wz-set-in { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #d7dbe2; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #1a1a2e; background: #fff; font-family: inherit; box-sizing: border-box; }
.wz-set-in:focus { outline: none; border-color: #C8102E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(200,16,46,.12); }
.wz-set-in:disabled { background: #f1f2f5; color: #98a0ac; cursor: not-allowed; }
textarea.wz-set-in { resize: vertical; }
.wz-set-row2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; }

/* assign modal */
.wz-assign-search { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #d7dbe2; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #1a1a2e; font-family: inherit; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.wz-assign-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: #C8102E; }
.wz-assign-list { max-height: 320px; overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid #eef0f4; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.wz-assign-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f4f5f8; cursor: pointer; margin: 0; }
.wz-assign-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.wz-assign-row:hover { background: #f8f9fb; }
.wz-assign-row input[type="checkbox"] { width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: #C8102E; cursor: pointer; }
.wz-assign-id { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.wz-assign-name { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wz-assign-email { font-size: 11.5px; color: #8a909a; }
.wz-assign-empty { text-align: center; color: #8a909a; padding: 22px; font-size: 13px; }
</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>true</has_preview><id>nfotcbsm-wizard-list</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
}]]></link><name>OTC Wizard List</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Work Driver Onboarding Wizard — LIST page (server).
 * Lists configured wizards split into Published / Drafts, with filter option lists and the
 * "copy an existing wizard" source list for the create modal. Delete happens here too.
 *
 * Access is gated by ROLE on the landing page (manager/admin only), so there is no separate
 * password gate on this page.
 */
(function () {
    function hasExplicitRole(roleName) {
        try {
            var roles = gs.getUser().getRoles();
            if (!roles) { return false; }
            for (var i = 0; i < roles.length; i++) { if (('' + roles[i]) === roleName) { return true; } }
        } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
        return false;
    }
    var cm = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch();
    data.logo = cm.LOGO;
    data.name = cm.titleCase(gs.getUserDisplayName() || 'Analyst');
    data.isAdmin = gs.hasRole('admin');

    // Option catalogs for the per-card Settings panel (edit the wizard record's config fields inline).
    data.cat = {
        taxonomy: cm.taxonomy(),
        inputFormats: ['Email', 'PDF', 'Excel'],
        ingestionTypes: ['Mail', 'API', 'File Drop', 'Manual'],
        frequencies: ['Real-time', 'Hourly', 'Daily'],
        targetSystems: ['System 1', 'System 2', 'PCM']
    };
    data.isManager = hasExplicitRole('x_nose_nfotc_bsm.manager');
    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();
    var wlp = ('' + data.name).trim().split(/\s+/);
    data.initials = ((wlp[0] || 'U').charAt(0) + (wlp.length > 1 ? wlp[wlp.length - 1].charAt(0) : '')).toUpperCase();

    // Delete a wizard (trash icon on a card).
    if (input && input.action === 'delete' && input.wizardId) {
        var dg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (dg.get(input.wizardId)) { dg.deleteRecord(); }
    }

    // Settings (gear icon on a card): edit the wizard record's configuration fields inline and write them
    // straight back to x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard — the same fields shown on the native record form.
    if (input && input.action === 'save_config' && input.wizardId && input.cfg) {
        var cfgIn = {};
        try { cfgIn = JSON.parse(input.cfg); } catch (ec) { cfgIn = {}; }
        var cg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (cg.get(input.wizardId)) {
            var FMAP = {
                description: 'description', bu: 'bu', subBu: 'sub_bu', service: 'service', activity: 'activity',
                workDriver: 'work_driver', mailbox: 'mailbox', inputFormat: 'input_format',
                ingestionType: 'ingestion_type', frequency: 'frequency', target: 'target_system', version: 'version'
            };
            for (var mk in FMAP) {
                if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cfgIn, mk)) { cg.setValue(FMAP[mk], '' + (cfgIn[mk] == null ? '' : cfgIn[mk])); }
            }
            cg.update();
            data.configSaved = input.wizardId;
            // (Wizard configuration is intentionally NOT written to the cashflow audit trail.)
        }
    }

    // Assign a published workflow to real people: store the list on the wizard AND grant them the
    // analyst role (best-effort) so they can actually run it.
    if (input && input.action === 'assign' && input.wizardId) {
        var wg2 = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (wg2.get(input.wizardId)) {
            var ids = ('' + (input.userIds || '')).split(',');
            var analystRoleId = '';
            var rr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_role');
            if (rr.get('name', 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm.analyst')) { analystRoleId = rr.getUniqueValue(); }
            var list = [];
            for (var ai = 0; ai < ids.length; ai++) {
                var uid = ids[ai];
                if (!uid) { continue; }
                var ug2 = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
                if (!ug2.get(uid)) { continue; }
                list.push({ id: uid, name: ug2.getValue('name') });
                if (analystRoleId) {
                    try {
                        var chk = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
                        chk.addQuery('user', uid);
                        chk.addQuery('role', analystRoleId);
                        chk.query();
                        if (!chk.hasNext()) {
                            var ins = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
                            ins.initialize();
                            ins.setValue('user', uid);
                            ins.setValue('role', analystRoleId);
                            ins.insert();
                        }
                    } catch (e) { /* role grant best-effort (may be restricted) */ }
                }
            }
            wg2.setValue('assigned_users', JSON.stringify(list));
            wg2.setValue('assigned_count', list.length);
            wg2.update();
        }
    }

    // Assignable people (real, active users with an email), for the Assign modal.
    data.users = [];
    var ug = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
    ug.addActiveQuery();
    ug.addNotNullQuery('email');
    ug.addQuery('email', 'NOT LIKE', 'example.com');   // query-level exclude of OOB demo users (…@example.com)
    ug.addQuery('email', 'NOT LIKE', 'email.com');     // …and the …@email.com demo users
    ug.orderBy('name');
    ug.setLimit(2000);                                 // high cap so real analysts past 'R' are actually fetched (not truncated by demo users)
    ug.query();
    while (ug.next()) {
        var unm = ug.getValue('name');
        if (!unm) { continue; }
        var uem = ug.getValue('email') || '';
        var lem = uem.toLowerCase();
        if (lem.indexOf('example.com') !== -1 || lem.indexOf('email.com') !== -1) { continue; }   // JS backup: always drop demo domains even if the query operator doesn't
        data.users.push({ id: ug.getUniqueValue(), name: unm, email: uem });
    }

    function fieldCount(json) {
        try { var a = JSON.parse(json || '[]'); return a.length; } catch (e) { return 0; }
    }
    function assignedList(json) {
        try { return JSON.parse(json || '[]'); } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    data.published = [];
    data.drafts = [];
    data.allWizards = [];
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
    gr.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
    gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) {
        var cardActivity = gr.getValue('activity') || 'Compare & Match';
        var cardWd = gr.getValue('work_driver') || '';
        var rtc = cm.resolveTaxonomy(gr.getValue('bu') || '', gr.getValue('sub_bu') || '', gr.getValue('service') || '', cardWd);
        var card = {
            id: gr.getUniqueValue(),
            name: gr.getValue('name') || 'Untitled wizard',
            description: gr.getValue('description') || '',
            bu: rtc.bu, subBu: rtc.subBu, service: rtc.service,
            workDriver: cardWd,
            activity: cardActivity,
            inputFormat: gr.getValue('input_format') || 'Email',
            ingestionType: gr.getValue('ingestion_type') || 'Mail',
            frequency: gr.getValue('frequency') || 'Real-time',
            source: gr.getValue('mailbox') || '',
            mailbox: gr.getValue('mailbox') || '',
            target: gr.getValue('target_system') || '',
            version: gr.getValue('version') || 'v1',
            fieldCount: fieldCount(gr.getValue('input_fields')),
            status: gr.getValue('status') || 'draft'
        };
        var au = assignedList(gr.getValue('assigned_users'));
        card.assigned = au.length;
        card.assignedIds = au.map(function (u) { return u.id; });
        data.allWizards.push({ id: card.id, name: card.name });
        if (card.status === 'published') { data.published.push(card); } else { data.drafts.push(card); }
    }

    // Filter option lists (chips).
    data.workDrivers = ['Non Pari-ff Prematching', 'OTC Settlements', 'Position Management / Depot Transfer'];
    data.activities = ['Compare & Match', 'Reconcile', 'Validate'];
})();
]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>6b1059fe245c4e0a8150f84d981a2cc6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>OTC Wizard List</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_6b1059fe245c4e0a8150f84d981a2cc6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:24</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="nom-app">
  <header class="nom-top">
    <img class="nom-logo" ng-src="{{c.data.logo}}" alt="Nomura"/>
    <div class="nom-user">
      <div class="nom-user-btn" ng-click="c.userMenu = !c.userMenu">
        <span class="nom-role">{{c.data.role}}</span>
        <div class="nom-avatar">{{c.data.initials}}</div>
        <span class="nom-caret" ng-class="{open: c.userMenu}">▾</span>
      </div>
      <div class="nom-backdrop" ng-if="c.userMenu" ng-click="c.userMenu = false"></div>
      <div class="nom-menu" ng-if="c.userMenu">
        <div class="nom-menu-hd">
          <div class="nom-avatar sm">{{c.data.initials}}</div>
          <div class="nom-menu-id"><div class="nm-name">{{c.data.name}}</div><div class="nm-sub">{{c.data.role}}</div></div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="nom-menu-item" ng-click="c.signOut()"><span class="nm-ico">⏻</span> Sign out</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="md-body">
    <aside class="md-side">
      <a class="md-nav-item" ng-href="/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_manager_dashboard"><span class="md-ni-ico">■</span> Dashboard</a>
      <a class="md-nav-item active" ng-href="/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_list"><span class="md-ni-ico">✦</span> Onboarding Wizard</a>
      <a class="md-nav-item" ng-href="/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_nfotc_audit"><span class="md-ni-ico">☰</span> Audit Trail</a>
    </aside>
    <main class="wz-main">
    <div class="wz-head">
      <div>
        <h1 class="wz-title">Onboarding Wizard</h1>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="wz-new" ng-click="c.openModal()"><span class="wz-plus">+</span> New wizard</button>
    </div>

    <div class="wz-search">
      <input class="wz-search-in" ng-model="c.q" placeholder="Search wizards..."/>
    </div>

    <!-- Published -->
    <div class="wz-section-h">
      <span class="wz-sec-ico ok">✓</span> Published
      <span class="wz-count ok">{{(c.data.published | filter:c.rowFilter).length}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="wz-grid">
      <div class="wz-card" ng-repeat="w in c.data.published | filter:c.rowFilter track by w.id">
        <div class="wz-card-top">
          <div class="wz-card-name">{{w.name}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="wz-card-meta">{{w.workDriver}} <span ng-if="w.activity">· {{w.activity}}</span></div>
        <div class="wz-card-flow"><span class="wz-mono">{{w.inputFormat || 'Input'}}</span> <span ng-if="w.source">· {{w.source}}</span> <span class="wz-arrow">→</span> {{w.target || 'System'}}</div>
        <div class="wz-card-assigned"><span class="wz-people">👥</span> Assigned to {{w.assigned}} people</div>
        <div class="wz-card-actions">
          <button type="button" class="wz-icobtn" title="Settings" ng-click="c.openSettings(w)">⚙</button>
          <button type="button" class="wz-icobtn" title="Edit" ng-click="c.open(w.id)">✎</button>
          <button type="button" class="wz-icobtn" title="Assign to people" ng-click="c.openAssign(w)">👥</button>
          <button type="button" class="wz-icobtn wz-del" title="Delete" ng-click="c.remove(w.id, w.name)">🗑</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Drafts -->
    <div class="wz-section-h">
      <span class="wz-sec-ico draft">✎</span> Drafts
      <span class="wz-count draft">{{(c.data.drafts | filter:c.rowFilter).length}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="wz-grid">
      <div class="wz-card" ng-repeat="w in c.data.drafts | filter:c.rowFilter track by w.id">
        <div class="wz-card-top">
          <div class="wz-card-name">{{w.name}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="wz-card-meta">{{w.workDriver}} <span ng-if="w.activity">· {{w.activity}}</span></div>
        <div class="wz-card-flow"><span class="wz-mono">{{w.inputFormat || 'Input'}}</span> <span ng-if="w.source">· {{w.source}}</span> <span class="wz-arrow">→</span> {{w.target || 'System'}}</div>
        <div class="wz-card-actions">
          <button type="button" class="wz-icobtn" title="Settings" ng-click="c.openSettings(w)">⚙</button>
          <button type="button" class="wz-icobtn" title="Edit" ng-click="c.open(w.id)">✎</button>
          <button type="button" class="wz-icobtn" title="Publish" ng-click="c.publishDraft(w.id)">↑</button>
          <button type="button" class="wz-icobtn wz-del" title="Delete" ng-click="c.remove(w.id, w.name)">🗑</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- Create modal -->
  <div class="wz-modal-wrap" ng-if="c.showModal">
    <div class="wz-modal-back" ng-click="c.closeModal()"></div>
    <div class="wz-modal">
      <button type="button" class="wz-modal-x" ng-click="c.closeModal()">✕</button>
      <h2 class="wz-modal-h">Create a wizard</h2>
      <div class="wz-modal-sub">Start from scratch, or copy an existing wizard as a template.</div>
      <button type="button" class="wz-opt" ng-click="c.createNew()">
        <span class="wz-opt-txt"><span class="wz-opt-t">Create new</span><span class="wz-opt-d">Start a fresh wizard from a blank template.</span></span>
      </button>
      <div class="wz-opt-block">
        <div class="wz-opt-head"><span class="wz-opt-t">Copy and edit existing</span></div>
        <div class="wz-opt-d">Clone another wizard's setup, then edit it.</div>
        <select class="wz-modal-sel" ng-model="c.copyId">
          <option value="">Choose a wizard to copy...</option>
          <option ng-repeat="w in c.data.allWizards track by w.id" value="{{w.id}}">{{w.name}}</option>
        </select>
        <button type="button" class="wz-copy-btn" ng-class="{ready: c.copyId}" ng-click="c.copyEdit()">Copy & edit</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Assign modal -->
  <div class="wz-modal-wrap" ng-if="c.showAssign">
    <div class="wz-modal-back" ng-click="c.closeAssign()"></div>
    <div class="wz-modal">
      <button type="button" class="wz-modal-x" ng-click="c.closeAssign()">✕</button>
      <h2 class="wz-modal-h">Assign analysts</h2>
      <div class="wz-modal-sub">Choose the people who will run <strong>{{c.assignWiz.name}}</strong>. They are granted access to run this workflow.</div>
      <input class="wz-assign-search" ng-model="c.assignQ" placeholder="Search people by name or email..."/>
      <div class="wz-assign-list">
        <label class="wz-assign-row" ng-repeat="u in c.data.users | filter:c.userFilter track by u.id">
          <input type="checkbox" ng-model="c.assignSel[u.id]"/>
          <span class="wz-assign-id">
            <span class="wz-assign-name">{{u.name}}</span>
            <span class="wz-assign-email">{{u.email}}</span>
          </span>
        </label>
        <div class="wz-assign-empty" ng-if="!(c.data.users | filter:c.userFilter).length">No matching people.</div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="wz-copy-btn ready" ng-click="c.saveAssign()">Assign {{c.assignCount()}} {{c.assignCount() === 1 ? 'person' : 'people'}}</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Settings modal: edit the wizard record's config fields inline -->
  <div class="wz-modal-wrap" ng-if="c.showSettings">
    <div class="wz-modal-back" ng-click="c.closeSettings()"></div>
    <div class="wz-modal wz-set-modal">
      <button type="button" class="wz-modal-x" ng-click="c.closeSettings()">✕</button>
      <h2 class="wz-modal-h">⚙ Configure — {{c.settingsWiz.name}}</h2>
      <div class="wz-modal-sub">Edit this workflow’s configuration. Saving writes straight to the ServiceNow wizard record. Fields, mapping, write-back and people are set in the full builder / assign dialog.</div>

      <div class="wz-set-body">
        <label class="wz-set-lbl">Description</label>
        <textarea class="wz-set-in" rows="2" ng-model="c.settings.description"></textarea>

        <div class="wz-set-row2">
          <div>
            <label class="wz-set-lbl">BU</label>
            <select class="wz-set-in" ng-model="c.settings.bu" ng-change="c.sOnBu()"><option value="">Choose</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.sBusList() track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="wz-set-lbl">Sub BU</label>
            <select class="wz-set-in" ng-model="c.settings.subBu" ng-change="c.sOnSubBu()" ng-disabled="!c.settings.bu"><option value="">{{c.settings.bu ? 'Choose' : 'Select a BU first'}}</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.sSubBusFor() track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="wz-set-row2">
          <div>
            <label class="wz-set-lbl">Service</label>
            <select class="wz-set-in" ng-model="c.settings.service" ng-change="c.sOnService()" ng-disabled="!c.settings.subBu"><option value="">{{c.settings.subBu ? 'Choose' : 'Select a Sub BU first'}}</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.sServicesFor() track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="wz-set-lbl">Work driver</label>
            <select class="wz-set-in" ng-model="c.settings.workDriver" ng-change="c.sOnWorkDriver()" ng-disabled="!c.settings.service"><option value="">{{c.settings.service ? 'Choose' : 'Select a Service first'}}</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.sWorkDriversFor() track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="wz-set-row2">
          <div>
            <label class="wz-set-lbl">Activity</label>
            <input class="wz-set-in" ng-model="c.settings.activity" readonly style="background:#f4f5f7;color:#4b5563;"/>
          </div>
          <div></div>
        </div>

        <div class="wz-set-row2">
          <div>
            <label class="wz-set-lbl">Mailbox</label>
            <input class="wz-set-in" ng-model="c.settings.mailbox"/>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="wz-set-lbl">Target system</label>

        <div class="wz-set-row2">

          <div>

        <div class="wz-set-row2">

</div>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[/**
 * OTC console login — custom branded sign-in for the /nfotcbsm Service Portal.
 * Authenticates through the same endpoint the OOTB Service Portal login widget uses
 * (view_form.login), so it is a real, working login (not a mock). On success it
 * redirects straight to the dashboard (/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_analystdashboard).
 */
function controller($scope, $http, $window, spUtil) {
    var c = this;
    c.username = '';
    c.password = '';
    c.message = '';
    c.busy = false;

    var HOME = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers';

    // SSO short-circuit: if the platform already authenticated this visitor (e.g. SSO on
    // bsmdev), skip the branded sign-in form and go straight to the landing. The server
    // (login.server.js) sets c.data.authed for a real, non-guest session.
    if (c.data && c.data.authed) {
        $window.location = c.data.redirect || HOME;
        return;
    }

    c.login = function (username, password) {
        if (!username || !password) {
            c.message = 'Please enter your username and password.';
            return;
        }
        c.busy = true;
        c.message = '';

        var url = spUtil.getURL({ sysparm_type: 'view_form.login' });
        var body = {
            sysparm_type: 'login',
            'ni.nolog.user_password': true,
            remember_me: true,
            user_name: username,
            user_password: password,
            get_redirect_url: true,
            is_direct_redirect: true,
            sysparm_goto_url: HOME,
            cert_login: false
        };
        var enc = Object.keys(body).map(function (k) {
            return encodeURIComponent(k) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(body[k]);
        }).join('&');

        $http({
            method: 'post',
            url: url,
            data: enc,
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
        }).then(function (res) {
            c.busy = false;
            var d = res.data || {};
            if (d.status === 'success') {
                $window.location = d.redirect_url || HOME;
            } else if (d.status === 'mfa_code_required') {
                $window.location = '/validate_multifactor_auth_code.do';
            } else {
                c.message = d.message || 'Invalid username or password.';
                c.password = '';
            }
        }, function () {
            c.busy = false;
            c.message = 'Sign-in failed. Please try again.';
        });
    };
}
]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* ===== Nomura POC login (logo header · centered sign-in · red footer) ===== */
.nlp {
  --red: #C8102E; --red-d: #9B0000; --ink: #1d2939; --muted: #667085;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden;
  font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", -apple-system, sans-serif; color: var(--ink);
  background: #f1f3f6;
}
.nlp * { box-sizing: border-box; }

/* ---------- header ---------- */
.nlp-header { position: relative; overflow: hidden; height: 66px; display: flex; align-items: center;
  padding: 0 40px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #C8102E 0%, #b3001f 100%); }
.nlp-skew { position: absolute; top: -20px; height: 200%; transform: skewX(-20deg); pointer-events: none; }
.nlp-skew.s1 { right: 90px; width: 130px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
.nlp-skew.s2 { right: -30px; width: 150px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.10); }
.nlp-logo { position: relative; z-index: 2; width: 188px; height: 34px;
  background-image: url("data:image/png;base64,"); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: left center; background-size: contain;
  filter: brightness(0) invert(1); }

/* ---------- body / centered card ---------- */
.nlp-body { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 56px 20px; position: relative; }
.nlp-body::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 60%, rgba(200,16,46,.04) 60%, rgba(200,16,46,.04) 64%, transparent 64%); }
.nlp-intro { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 24px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.nlp-h1 { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0 0 6px; color: var(--ink); }
.nlp-h1::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 46px; height: 3px; background: var(--red); margin: 12px auto 0; border-radius: 2px; }
.nlp-sub { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 12px; }

/* ---------- sign-in card ---------- */
.lg-card { width: 100%; max-width: 420px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #eef0f3; border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 34px 34px 30px; box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(16,24,40,.12); position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.lg-tabs { border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f3; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.lg-tab { display: inline-block; padding-bottom: 12px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--red); position: relative; }
.lg-tab.on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 3px; background: var(--red); border-radius: 2px; }
.lg-lbl { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #344054; margin: 16px 0 7px; }
.lg-inp { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #d0d5dd; border-radius: 9px; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 14px; color: #1d2939; transition: border-color .12s, box-shadow .12s; }
.lg-inp::placeholder { color: #98a2b3; }
.lg-inp:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--red); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(200,16,46,.12); }
.lg-err { margin-top: 14px; background: #fdecec; border: 1px solid #f6c9c9; color: #b42318; font-size: 12.5px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; }
.lg-btn { width: 100%; margin-top: 22px; background: var(--red); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 13px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s; }
.lg-btn:hover { background: var(--red-d); }
.lg-btn:disabled { opacity: .75; cursor: default; }

/* ---------- "or" divider + SSO button ---------- */
.lg-or { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin: 18px 0 4px; color: #98a2b3; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.lg-or::before, .lg-or::after { content: ""; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: #e7eaef; }
.lg-btn-sso { width: 100%; margin-top: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); border: 1.5px solid #d7dbe2; border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; transition: border-color .12s, background .12s; }
.lg-btn-sso:hover { border-color: var(--red); background: #fdf5f6; }
.lg-btn-sso .sso-mark { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--red); color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

/* ---------- red footer bar ---------- */
.nlp-copy { background: #C8102E; color: #fff; text-align: center; padding: 13px; }
.nlp-copy-text { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .04em; font-weight: 600; }

@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .nlp-header { padding: 0 20px; }
}
</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description>Branded Nomura sign-in for the Names and Forms OTC console.</description><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>nfotcbsm-login</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
}]]></link><name>OTC Console Login</name><option_schema/><public>true</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * SSO-aware gate for the OTC console login widget (BSM handover build).
 *
 * The BSM instance (nomurabsmdev) authenticates users via SSO at the instance layer, so by the
 * time this Service Portal home/login page renders, a real user is already signed in. In that
 * case we skip the custom sign-in form entirely and forward straight to the landing. Only a
 * genuinely unauthenticated ("guest") visitor is shown the branded sign-in form, as a fallback.
 *
 * This keeps the app portable with no code change between environments:
 *   SSO instance (bsmdev)      -> user already authenticated -> form skipped, straight to landing
 *   non-SSO instance / logged-out -> guest session          -> branded sign-in form is shown
 */
(function () {
    data.redirect = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers';
    data.authed = false;

    // In Service Portal an unauthenticated visitor runs as the built-in "guest" user.
    var userName = gs.getUser().getUserName();
    var isGuest = !userName || userName === 'guest';

    if (gs.isLoggedIn() && !isGuest) {
        data.authed = true; // real (SSO / platform) user -> skip the sign-in form
    }
})();
]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>6ed69f3714d54b4295d4d2306ad5c908</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>OTC Console Login</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_6ed69f3714d54b4295d4d2306ad5c908</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:24</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<!-- SSO short-circuit: an already-authenticated (SSO) visitor never sees the form. -->
<div class="nlp nlp-redirect" ng-if="c.data.authed">
  <div class="nlp-logo" role="img" aria-label="Nomura"></div>
  <p class="nlp-sub">Signing you in…</p>
</div>

<div class="nlp" ng-if="!c.data.authed">

  <!-- ================= Nomura header (logo only) ================= -->
  <header class="nlp-header">
    <div class="nlp-skew s1"></div>
    <div class="nlp-skew s2"></div>
    <div class="nlp-logo" role="img" aria-label="Nomura"></div>
  </header>

  <!-- ================= centered sign-in ================= -->
  <main class="nlp-body">
    <div class="nlp-intro">
      <h1 class="nlp-h1">Names and Forms</h1>
      <p class="nlp-sub">Sign in to the Console</p>
    </div>

    <form class="lg-card" ng-submit="c.login(c.username, c.password)">
      <div class="lg-tabs"><span class="lg-tab on">Login</span></div>

      <label class="lg-lbl">Username</label>
      <input class="lg-inp" type="text" ng-model="c.username" placeholder="Enter your username" autocomplete="username" autofocus>

      <label class="lg-lbl">Password</label>
      <input class="lg-inp" type="password" ng-model="c.password" placeholder="Enter your password" autocomplete="current-password">

      <div class="lg-err" ng-if="c.message">{{c.message}}</div>

      <button type="submit" class="lg-btn" ng-disabled="c.busy">
        <span ng-if="!c.busy">Sign In</span>
        <span ng-if="c.busy">Signing in…</span>
      </button>

      <div class="lg-or">or</div>

      <!-- Placeholder SSO button — intentionally does nothing (no handler, type=button). -->
      <button type="button" class="lg-btn-sso">
        Log in with SSO
      </button>
    </form>
  </main>

  <!-- ================= red footer bar ================= -->
  <div class="nlp-copy">
    <span class="nlp-copy-text">Nomura Global Operations · Names & Forms</span>
  </div>

</div>
]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_101772e7428c46df80e3f9e8f1e8eff4
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AmountDirection</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Never-negative amount + direction double-flip helpers (shared by case screen and board).</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AmountDirection</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * AmountDirection — the ONE source of truth for the "never show / store a negative amount" presentation
 * rule. A negative AI-extracted amount is itself a direction inversion, so we display (and, on an analyst
 * action, persist) |amount| with the direction normalised and flipped once more. Previously this rule was
 * re-implemented inline in ai-extraction.server.js and TaggingDashboard.server.js and had diverged
 * (free-text directions weren't flipped; an empty direction produced a '-' sentinel). Centralised here so
 * both the board and the case screen agree.
 */
var AmountDirection = Class.create();
AmountDirection.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    _num: function (a) { return parseFloat(('' + (a == null ? '' : a)).replace(/[, ]/g, '')); },

    /** Is the amount negative? */
    isNeg: function (a) { var n = this._num(a); return !isNaN(n) && n < 0; },

    /** Display amount: |n| when negative; otherwise the ORIGINAL string (preserve formatting, no re-parse). */
    absAmt: function (a) {
        var s = '' + (a == null ? '' : a);
        var n = this._num(s);
        return (!isNaN(n) && n < 0) ? ('' + Math.abs(n)) : s;
    },

    /** Normalise a free-text direction ("COU RECEIVE", "RECV", "PMT", ...) to Pay / Receive. Unknown/blank
     *  values are returned trimmed, never a placeholder. */
    normDir: function (raw) {
        var s = ('' + (raw || '')).toLowerCase();
        if (/rec|rcv/.test(s)) { return 'Receive'; }
        if (/pay|pmt/.test(s)) { return 'Pay'; }
        return ('' + (raw || '')).trim();
    },

    /** Flip a Pay/Receive. Anything else is returned unchanged (NOT a '-' sentinel). */
    flip: function (d) {
        var s = ('' + (d || '')).trim().toLowerCase();
        return s === 'pay' ? 'Receive' : (s === 'receive' ? 'Pay' : ('' + (d || '')));
    },

    /** Display/normalised direction for a given (amount, direction): normalise, then flip once more when the
     *  amount is negative (the double-flip). Empty stays empty. */
    dispDir: function (amt, dir) {
        var nd = this.normDir(dir);
        return this.isNeg(amt) ? this.flip(nd) : nd;
    },

    type: 'AmountDirection'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>101772e7428c46df80e3f9e8f1e8eff4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AmountDirection</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_101772e7428c46df80e3f9e8f1e8eff4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:43</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm.Intake</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Create an NFOTC Work Item from any source (createWorkItem/populate, with source_ref dedup). The single intake seam for email/PDF/API/Outlook.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>Intake</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Intake — the ONE reusable front door that turns any source into an NFOTC Work Item
 * (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_work_item). Creating a Work Item is what kicks off the reference pipeline flow (which
 * triggers on Work Item created), so this is the seam every channel shares: the Create Work Item flow
 * action, the inbound-email action, a future Outlook/Graph poll flow, or a manual/API call all land here.
 *
 * Source-agnostic on purpose: the pipeline downstream never cares whether the item came from Outlook, a
 * PDF drop, or an API — only Intake changes when a new channel is added. ADDITIVE — OTC/CSG untouched.
 */
var Intake = Class.create();
Intake.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    T: 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm_work_item',

    /** Set the canonical source fields on a Work Item GlideRecord (does NOT insert — the caller owns that). */
    populate: function (gr, sourceType, sourceRef, rawContent, workDriver) {
        gr.setValue('source_type', '' + (sourceType || ''));
        gr.setValue('source_ref', '' + (sourceRef || ''));
        gr.setValue('raw_content', ('' + (rawContent || '')).substring(0, 8000));
        if (workDriver) { gr.setValue('work_driver', '' + workDriver); }
        if (!gr.getValue('wi_status')) { gr.setValue('wi_status', 'new'); }
        if (!gr.getValue('wi_number')) { gr.setValue('wi_number', this._number()); }
        return gr;
    },

    /**
     * Create a Work Item from a source. Deduplicates on source_ref (a stable per-item id, e.g. an email
     * message-id) so the same item is never ingested twice. Returns the sys_id of the new (or existing)
     * Work Item.
     */
    createWorkItem: function (sourceType, sourceRef, rawContent, workDriver) {
        if (sourceRef) {
            var dup = new GlideRecord(this.T);
            dup.addQuery('source_ref', '' + sourceRef);
            dup.setLimit(1); dup.query();
            if (dup.next()) { return dup.getUniqueValue(); }
        }
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.T);
        gr.initialize();
        this.populate(gr, sourceType, sourceRef, rawContent, workDriver);
        return gr.insert();
    },

    _number: function () { return 'WI-' + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue(); },

    type: 'Intake',
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>96f64361525645b694eca81e75e0b3bd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Intake</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_96f64361525645b694eca81e75e0b3bd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:43</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm.NfotcConfig</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Two-tier configuration reader: per-driver wizard override -> system default (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config) -> caller fallback. Makes matcher/classifier tolerances editable data, not code.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>NfotcConfig</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * NfotcConfig — the single reader over the two-tier configuration store (FSD §17).
 *
 *   per-driver override  (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard.config_overrides JSON)   -- if set for this wizard
 *   else system default  (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config row, by `key`)
 *   else the caller's hardcoded fallback                                -- so nothing ever breaks
 *
 * EVERY Script Include and Flow asks this reader instead of hardcoding a constant, so tuning the
 * matcher/classifier is a data edit (Config admin page or the wizard) — no code change, no re-deploy.
 * That is the "config storage + editability" the platform review asked for.
 *
 * Usage:  var cfg = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.NfotcConfig();
 *         var vdTol = cfg.getNumber('match.vd_tol_days', wizId, 2);
 */
var NfotcConfig = Class.create();
NfotcConfig.prototype = {
    initialize: function () { this._cache = null; },

    // --- system defaults, cached per instance -------------------------------------------------
    _sys: function () {
        if (this._cache) { return this._cache; }
        var m = {};
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config');
        g.query();
        while (g.next()) { m[g.getValue('key')] = g.getValue('value'); }
        this._cache = m;
        return m;
    },

    // --- per-driver override off the wizard record --------------------------------------------
    _wizOverride: function (key, wizId) {
        if (!wizId) { return null; }
        var w = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (!w.get(wizId)) { return null; }
        var raw = w.getValue('config_overrides');
        if (!raw) { return null; }
        try {
            var o = JSON.parse(raw);
            return (o && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o, key)) ? ('' + o[key]) : null;
        } catch (e) { return null; }
    },

    _raw: function (key, wizId) {
        var ov = this._wizOverride(key, wizId);
        if (ov !== null && ov !== '') { return ov; }
        var v = this._sys()[key];
        return (v === undefined) ? null : v;
    },

    // --- typed getters (2nd arg is the wizard sys_id or '' for system-only) --------------------
    getNumber: function (key, wizId, def) {
        var v = this._raw(key, wizId);
        if (v === null || v === '') { return def; }
        var n = parseFloat(v);
        return isNaN(n) ? def : n;
    },
    getString: function (key, wizId, def) {
        var v = this._raw(key, wizId);
        return (v === null) ? (def === undefined ? '' : def) : v;
    },
    getBool: function (key, wizId, def) {
        var v = this._raw(key, wizId);
        if (v === null) { return def; }
        return /^(1|true|yes|y)$/i.test('' + v);
    },

    // --- admin surface: list + edit ------------------------------------------------------------
    all: function () {
        var out = [];
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config');
        g.orderBy('config_group');
        g.orderBy('key');
        g.query();
        while (g.next()) {
            out.push({
                sysId: g.getUniqueValue(),
                key: g.getValue('key'),
                label: g.getValue('label'),
                value: g.getValue('value'),
                type: g.getValue('type'),
                group: g.getValue('config_group'),
                description: g.getValue('description')
            });
        }
        return out;
    },
    set: function (sysId, value) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config');
        if (g.get(sysId)) { g.setValue('value', '' + value); g.update(); return true; }
        return false;
    },

    // --- per-wizard surface: list effective config + edit the override -------------------------
    // Returns the config rows with the EFFECTIVE value for this wizard (its override if set, else the
    // system default) plus the system default and an `overridden` flag. `groupFilter` optional.
    forWizard: function (wizId, groupFilter) {
        var overrides = {};
        if (wizId) {
            var w = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
            if (w.get(wizId)) {
                try { overrides = JSON.parse(w.getValue('config_overrides') || '{}') || {}; } catch (e) { overrides = {}; }
            }
        }
        var out = [];
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config');
        if (groupFilter) { g.addQuery('config_group', groupFilter); }
        g.orderBy('config_group');
        g.orderBy('key');
        g.query();
        while (g.next()) {
            var key = g.getValue('key');
            var sysVal = g.getValue('value');
            var hasOv = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(overrides, key) && ('' + overrides[key]) !== '';
            out.push({
                sysId: g.getUniqueValue(), key: key, label: g.getValue('label'),
                systemValue: sysVal, value: hasOv ? ('' + overrides[key]) : sysVal, overridden: hasOv,
                type: g.getValue('type'), group: g.getValue('config_group'), description: g.getValue('description')
            });
        }
        return out;
    },
    // Write a per-wizard override into x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard.config_overrides (the field visible on the
    // native wizard record). An empty value CLEARS the override, reverting to the system default.
    setOverride: function (wizId, key, value) {
        if (!wizId || !key) { return false; }
        var w = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (!w.get(wizId)) { return false; }
        var o = {};
        try { o = JSON.parse(w.getValue('config_overrides') || '{}') || {}; } catch (e) { o = {}; }
        var sv = ('' + (value === undefined || value === null ? '' : value)).trim();
        if (sv === '') { delete o[key]; } else { o[key] = sv; }
        w.setValue('config_overrides', JSON.stringify(o));
        w.update();
        return true;
    },

    type: 'NfotcConfig'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>15aaff3dcdf44a68bc2a6a55356dbb17</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>NfotcConfig</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_15aaff3dcdf44a68bc2a6a55356dbb17</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:43</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_e6e687d525ff43c9814b97979058ff6d
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm.ExtractionConfidence</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Per-field extraction confidence from grounding (value found in the source text) + validation (well-formed), with a stated reason per field. AI-only friendly (no second extractor).</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ExtractionConfidence</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * ExtractionConfidence — a per-field confidence for AI-extracted settlement fields, computed by
 * checks on the OUTPUT (not by a second extractor), so it survives when the deterministic path is
 * removed and the flow is AI-only.
 *
 * Two explainable signals per field:
 *   1. GROUNDING — does the extracted value actually appear in the source text the AI read?
 *      (type-aware: amounts matched on the digit string, dates across common formats, etc.).
 *      Not-grounded flags likely hallucination or heavy reformatting.
 *   2. VALIDATION — is the value well-formed for its type? (date parses, amount numeric,
 *      currency an ISO code, account has digits, direction is Pay/Receive).
 *
 * grounded+valid -> High; one of them -> Medium; neither -> Low. Counterparty is DERIVED (PCM
 * directory), not AI, so it is reported separately as 'derived'. Confidence is expressed as a plain
 * High / Medium / Low level (no percentage) — deterministic and fully auditable, every level has a reason.
 */
var ExtractionConfidence = Class.create();
ExtractionConfidence.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    // Machine level -> display word. Kept short so it fits a badge; the reason string carries the detail.
    LABELS: { hi: 'High', mid: 'Medium', lo: 'Low', derived: 'Derived', absent: '—' },
    // The four economic keys that a settlement can't be trusted without — they drive the OVERALL level.
    MANDATORY: ['valueDate', 'amount', 'currency', 'direction'],
    _rank: { lo: 0, mid: 1, hi: 2 },

    // fields: {counterparty, nomuraEntity, product, reference, tradeDate, valueDate, amount, currency,
    //          direction, ssiBank, ssiAccount, ssiBeneficiary, ssiIntermediary}
    // content: the text the AI read (email body + any parsed spreadsheet grid)
    score: function (fields, content) {
        var text = '' + (content || '');
        var ctx = { text: text, lc: text.toLowerCase(), noSep: text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''), noComma: text.replace(/,/g, '') };
        var self = this, out = {}, low = 0, n = 0;

        function put(key, type, value) {
            var r = self._field(type, value, ctx);
            out[key] = r;
            if (r.level !== 'absent' && r.level !== 'derived') { n++; if (r.level === 'lo') { low++; } }
        }

        out.counterparty = { level: 'derived', label: this.LABELS.derived, reason: 'Derived from the sender via the Eve directory — not AI-extracted.' };
        put('valueDate', 'date', fields.valueDate);
        put('amount', 'amount', fields.amount);
        put('currency', 'currency', fields.currency);
        put('direction', 'direction', fields.direction);
        put('nomuraEntity', 'text', fields.nomuraEntity);
        put('product', 'text', fields.product);
        put('reference', 'ref', fields.reference);
        put('tradeDate', 'date', fields.tradeDate);
        put('ssiBank', 'text', fields.ssiBank);
        put('ssiAccount', 'account', fields.ssiAccount);
        put('ssiBeneficiary', 'text', fields.ssiBeneficiary);
        put('ssiIntermediary', 'text', fields.ssiIntermediary);

        // OVERALL = weakest-link across the four economic keys (a cashflow is only as trustworthy as its
        // worst key). Secondary/SSI fields have their own per-field level but don't move the headline.
        var worst = 'hi', missing = false;
        for (var i = 0; i < this.MANDATORY.length; i++) {
            var lv = (out[this.MANDATORY[i]] || {}).level;
            if (lv === 'absent' || !lv) { missing = true; continue; }
            if (this._rank[lv] < this._rank[worst]) { worst = lv; }
        }
        var oLevel, oReason;
        if (missing || worst === 'lo') { oLevel = 'lo'; oReason = 'An economic key is missing or could not be verified against the source — please review.'; }
        else if (worst === 'mid') { oLevel = 'mid'; oReason = 'The economic keys are present, but at least one needs a glance (reformatted or unusual format).'; }
        else { oLevel = 'hi'; oReason = 'All four economic keys are grounded in the source and well-formed.'; }
        out.overall = { level: oLevel, label: this.LABELS[oLevel], reason: oReason, low: low, count: n };
        return out;
    },

    _field: function (type, value, ctx) {
        var v = ('' + (value == null ? '' : value)).trim();
        if (!v) { return { level: 'absent', label: this.LABELS.absent, reason: 'Not present in this cashflow.' }; }
        var grounded = this._grounded(type, v, ctx);
        var valid = this._valid(type, v);
        var level, reason;
        if (grounded && valid) { level = 'hi'; reason = 'Found in the source text and well-formed.'; }
        else if (grounded && !valid) { level = 'mid'; reason = 'Found in the source, but the format looks unusual — worth a glance.'; }
        else if (!grounded && valid) { level = 'mid'; reason = 'Well-formed, but not found verbatim in the source (may be reformatted by the AI).'; }
        else { level = 'lo'; reason = 'Not found in the source and the format looks off — please review.'; }
        return { level: level, label: this.LABELS[level], reason: reason, grounded: grounded, valid: valid };
    },

    _grounded: function (type, v, ctx) {
        var vl = v.toLowerCase();
        if (type === 'amount') {
            var num = v.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '');
            if (num && ctx.noComma.indexOf(num) !== -1) { return true; }
            var intp = num.split('.')[0];
            return !!(intp && intp.length >= 4 && ctx.noComma.replace(/\./g, '').indexOf(intp) !== -1);
        }
        if (type === 'currency') { return ctx.lc.indexOf(vl) !== -1; }
        if (type === 'date') { return this._dateGrounded(v, ctx.lc); }
        if (type === 'direction') { return /\b(pay|receive|buy|sell|payment)\b/i.test(ctx.text); }
        if (type === 'account') { var d = vl.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); return !!(d && d.length >= 4 && ctx.noSep.indexOf(d) !== -1); }
        // ref / free text
        var tok = vl.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
        if (!tok) { return false; }
        if (tok.length <= 3) { return ctx.lc.indexOf(vl) !== -1; }
        return ctx.noSep.indexOf(tok) !== -1;
    },

    _dateGrounded: function (v, lc) {
        var m = v.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
        if (!m) { return lc.indexOf(v.toLowerCase()) !== -1; }
        var y = m[1], mo = m[2], d = m[3];
        var mon = ['jan', 'feb', 'mar', 'apr', 'may', 'jun', 'jul', 'aug', 'sep', 'oct', 'nov', 'dec'][parseInt(mo, 10) - 1];
        var dNo = '' + parseInt(d, 10);
        var cands = [
            y + '-' + mo + '-' + d, d + '-' + mo + '-' + y, d + '/' + mo + '/' + y, mo + '/' + d + '/' + y, y + '/' + mo + '/' + d,
            d + '-' + mon + '-' + y, d + ' ' + mon + ' ' + y, dNo + ' ' + mon, mon + ' ' + dNo, mon + '-' + dNo
        ];
        for (var i = 0; i < cands.length; i++) { if (lc.indexOf(cands[i].toLowerCase()) !== -1) { return true; } }
        return false;
    },

    _valid: function (type, v) {
        if (type === 'amount') { return !isNaN(parseFloat(('' + v).replace(/[, ]/g, ''))); }
        if (type === 'currency') { return /^[A-Za-z]{3}$/.test(v.trim()); }
        if (type === 'date') { return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(v); }
        if (type === 'direction') { return /^(pay|receive)$/i.test(v.trim()); }
        if (type === 'account') { return /[0-9]/.test(v); }
        return v.length > 0;
    },

    type: 'ExtractionConfidence'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>e6e687d525ff43c9814b97979058ff6d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ExtractionConfidence</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_e6e687d525ff43c9814b97979058ff6d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:44</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
