sys_update_xml.name: sp_widget_272098e98d38468bbf58b5aaf351b1a3
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function controller($window) {
    var c = this;
    // Access guard — the server sets data.redirect for non-managers; bounce before building anything.
    if (c.data && c.data.redirect) { $window.location.href = c.data.redirect; return; }
    var cat = (c.data && c.data.cat) || {};

    // Header user menu.
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () { $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm'); };

    function clone(o) { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o || {})); }

    // ---- build the working model from the server's initial model ----
    c.model = clone(c.data.initModel);
    c.model.targets = c.model.targets && c.model.targets.length ? c.model.targets : [{ system: '', map: {} }];

    // Field rows are the added fields (each: name + type + AI prompt + example + value + match config).
    c.model.fields = c.model.fields || [];

    // Per-driver Compare & Match tolerances (step 5). Number inputs need numeric values; a blank (null) field
    // means "inherit the system default". Normalise whatever was loaded from config_overrides to number|null.
    c.model.tolerances = c.model.tolerances || {};
    (function normTol() {
        var t = c.model.tolerances;
        for (var k in t) { if (t.hasOwnProperty(k)) { var n = parseFloat(t[k]); t[k] = isNaN(n) ? null : n; } }
    })();
    c.resetTol = function (mk) { c.model.tolerances[mk] = null; };

    // CSG mode = the "CSG" Service (new taxonomy: OPS Client Services -> Client Entity Data -> CSG). Legacy
    // wizards carried "CSG" in the Sub-BU/Work-Driver instead, so keep detecting that too. The OTC driver
    // sits under OTC Settlements, so this never affects OTC. Drives the CSG step preview, the RDM-ID
    // mandatory field, and the CSG-specific Target-Mapping / Write-back copy.
    c.isCsg = function () {
        if (('' + (c.model.service || '')).toUpperCase() === 'CSG') { return true; }
        var sig = (('' + (c.model.subBu || '')) + ' ' + ('' + (c.model.workDriver || ''))).toUpperCase();
        return sig.indexOf('CSG') !== -1;
    };

    // MANDATORY fields — always present, locked. OTC (Compare & Match) needs the four economic keys;
    // CSG needs only the RDM id (which keys the EVE lookup). Seeded from the field catalog.
    var OTC_MANDATORY = ['Value Date', 'Amount', 'Currency', 'Direction'];
    var CSG_MANDATORY = ['RDM ID'];
    var ALL_MANDATORY = OTC_MANDATORY.concat(CSG_MANDATORY);
    function currentMandatory() { return c.isCsg() ? CSG_MANDATORY : OTC_MANDATORY; }
    function _catField(name) {
        var fc = cat.fieldCatalog || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < fc.length; i++) { if (fc[i].name === name) { return fc[i]; } }
        return null;
    }
    // Every field row carries exactly 3 example VALUE slots for the Field Extraction editor.
    function ensureExamples(row) {
        if (!row) { return; }
        var ex = row.examples || [], out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            var v = ex[i];
            if (v && typeof v === 'object') { v = v.value || ''; }  // migrate old {input,value} -> value
            out.push(v == null ? '' : ('' + v));
        }
        row.examples = out;
    }
    function ensureMandatoryFields() {
        var MAND = currentMandatory();
        var existing = c.model.fields || [], byName = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < existing.length; i++) { if (existing[i].name) { byName[existing[i].name] = existing[i]; } }
        var mand = [];
        for (var m = 0; m < MAND.length; m++) {
            var nm = MAND[m], row = byName[nm];
            var fc = _catField(nm);
            if (row) {
                row.mandatory = true; row.mapExclude = false;
                // seed the master prompt + examples from the catalog if this draft predates them
                if (fc && !row.examples) { row.examples = (fc.examples || []).slice(); }
                if (fc && !row.prompt) { row.prompt = fc.prompt; }
            } else if (fc) {
                row = { name: fc.name, type: fc.type || 'string', prompt: fc.prompt, example: fc.example || '', value: fc.value || '', custom: false, mapExclude: false, mandatory: true, examples: (fc.examples || []).slice() };
            }
            if (row) { mand.push(row); }
        }
        // Keep custom / optional fields, but drop the OTHER mode's mandatory fields so switching
        // OTC <-> CSG cleanly swaps the locked set (RDM ID <-> Value Date/Amount/Currency/Direction).
        var rest = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < existing.length; j++) { if (ALL_MANDATORY.indexOf(existing[j].name) === -1) { rest.push(existing[j]); } }
        c.model.fields = mand.concat(rest);   // mandatory first, in fixed order
        for (var e = 0; e < c.model.fields.length; e++) { ensureExamples(c.model.fields[e]); }
    }
    ensureMandatoryFields();
    c.ensureMandatoryFields = ensureMandatoryFields;
    c.ensureExamples = ensureExamples;

    // ---- email identification rules (labels) ----
    function emptyLabel() { return { name: '', context: '', keywords: '', senders: '', subject: '', exclusions: '', excludeReplies: true, excludeNoise: true }; }
    c.model.labels = c.model.labels || [];
    if (!c.model.labels.length) { c.model.labels.push(emptyLabel()); } // one empty label so the fields show
    c.addLabel = function () { c.model.labels.push(emptyLabel()); };
    c.removeLabel = function (idx) { c.model.labels.splice(idx, 1); };

    // ---- Outlook tagging + analyst writeback (defaulted server-side; guard for older drafts) ----
    if (!c.model.tagging || !c.model.tagging.length) {
        c.model.tagging = [
            { stage: 'Default', tag: '' }, { stage: 'Extraction Confirmed', tag: '' },
            { stage: 'Review Confirmed', tag: '' }, { stage: 'Resolved', tag: '' }, { stage: 'Escalated', tag: '' }
        ];
    }
    // ---- Write-back: one action per Compare & Match outcome (Matched / Mismatch / No Match), chosen
    // from a fixed set of actions and UNFILLED by default. Normalise whatever was loaded to these 3 rows.
    var WB_SCENARIOS = ['Matched', 'Mismatch', 'No Match'];
    var WB_ACTIONS = (cat.writebackActions) || ['Send to NEWS', 'Reply to Counterparty', 'Reply to Middle Office'];
    function ensureWriteback() {
        var existing = c.model.writeback || [], byScen = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < existing.length; i++) {
            var s = ('' + (existing[i].scenario || '')).toLowerCase();
            var key = (s.indexOf('mismatch') > -1) ? 'Mismatch' : (s.indexOf('no') > -1 ? 'No Match' : (s.indexOf('match') > -1 ? 'Matched' : ''));
            if (!key) { continue; }
            // Support both shapes: new {actions:[...]} and legacy {action:'...'} — keep only valid, de-duped.
            var acts = existing[i].actions;
            if (!(acts instanceof Array)) { acts = existing[i].action ? [existing[i].action] : []; }
            var clean = [];
            for (var a = 0; a < acts.length; a++) { if (WB_ACTIONS.indexOf(acts[a]) > -1 && clean.indexOf(acts[a]) === -1) { clean.push(acts[a]); } }
            byScen[key] = clean;
        }
        var out = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < WB_SCENARIOS.length; j++) {
            out.push({ scenario: WB_SCENARIOS[j], actions: byScen[WB_SCENARIOS[j]] || [], _add: '' });
        }
        c.model.writeback = out;
    }
    ensureWriteback();
    // Manager adds/removes multiple actions per outcome, from the fixed WB_ACTIONS set (no duplicates).
    c.wbAddAction = function (w, a) {
        if (!w || !a || WB_ACTIONS.indexOf(a) === -1) { return; }
        w.actions = w.actions || [];
        if (w.actions.indexOf(a) === -1) { w.actions.push(a); }
    };
    c.wbRemoveAction = function (w, i) { if (w && w.actions && i >= 0 && i < w.actions.length) { w.actions.splice(i, 1); } };
    c.wbAvailable = function (w) {
        var out = [], have = (w && w.actions) || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < WB_ACTIONS.length; i++) { if (have.indexOf(WB_ACTIONS[i]) === -1) { out.push(WB_ACTIONS[i]); } }
        return out;
    };
    c.wbLabel = function (s) {
        return ({ 'Matched': 'All fields match', 'Mismatch': 'Mismatch — some fields differ', 'No Match': 'No match — no booking found' })[s] || s;
    };
    if (!c.model.ingestionType) { c.model.ingestionType = 'Mail'; }

    // ---- Define cascade: BU -> Sub-BU -> Service -> Work Driver (taxonomy-driven) ----
    // Activity is not a user choice — it is always "Compare & Match" (the one built pipeline), stamped when
    // a work driver is picked. The tree leaf is the array of work drivers for a (BU, Sub-BU, Service).
    var TAX = cat.taxonomy || {};
    c.busList = function () { return Object.keys(TAX); };
    c.subBusFor = function () { return (c.model.bu && TAX[c.model.bu]) ? Object.keys(TAX[c.model.bu]) : []; };
    c.servicesFor = function () { var b = c.model.bu, s = c.model.subBu; return (b && s && TAX[b] && TAX[b][s]) ? Object.keys(TAX[b][s]) : []; };
    c.workDriversFor = function () { var b = c.model.bu, s = c.model.subBu, sv = c.model.service; return (b && s && sv && TAX[b] && TAX[b][s] && TAX[b][s][sv]) ? TAX[b][s][sv] : []; };
    c.onBu = function () { c.model.subBu = ''; c.model.service = ''; c.model.workDriver = ''; c.model.activity = ''; };
    c.onSubBu = function () { c.model.service = ''; c.model.workDriver = ''; c.model.activity = ''; };
    // Service (labelled "Work driver" in the UI) now decides OTC<->CSG. Re-seed the mandatory fields and
    // reset the (mode-specific) target system on change so a stale system/field from the other mode can't linger.
    c.onService = function () { c.model.workDriver = ''; c.model.activity = ''; ensureMandatoryFields(); c.model.targets = [{ system: '', map: {} }]; };
    c.onWorkDriver = function () { c.model.activity = ''; ensureMandatoryFields(); };
    // Skill (c.model.activity) is now a USER choice — Compare & Match / Reconcile / Validation — no longer
    // auto-stamped. Only Compare & Match is wired; the other two reveal their own (dummy) step sequence.
    c.activityOptions = function () { return cat.activityOptions || ['Compare & Match', 'Reconcile', 'Validation']; };
    c.onActivity = function () { };

    // ---- nested stepper: 4 top steps; step 2 "Input Configuration" walks 6 sub-pages ----
    c.steps = [
        { n: 1, label: 'Define' },
        { n: 2, label: 'Input Configuration' },
        { n: 3, label: 'Review' },
        { n: 4, label: 'Publish' }
    ];
    c.subs = [
        { n: 1, label: 'Ingestion' },
        { n: 2, label: 'Email Identification' },
        { n: 3, label: 'Field Extraction' },
        { n: 4, label: 'Target Mapping' },
        { n: 5, label: 'Compare & Match' },
        { n: 6, label: 'Write-back' }
    ];
    // CSG has no Compare & Match / Write-back — drop them from the sub-nav and cap navigation at Target Mapping (4).
    c.visibleSubs = function () { return c.isCsg() ? c.subs.slice(0, 4) : c.subs; };
    c.lastSub = function () { return c.isCsg() ? 4 : 6; };
    c.step = c.data.startStep || 1;
    if (c.step < 1) { c.step = 1; }
    if (c.step > 4) { c.step = 4; }
    c.sub = 1;
    c.isLastStep = function () { return c.step === 4; };
    c.goSub = function (n) { if (c.step === 2 && n >= 1 && n <= c.lastSub()) { c.sub = n; window0(); } };
    c.next = function () {
        if (c.step === 2 && c.sub < c.lastSub()) { c.sub++; window0(); return; }
        if (c.step < 4) { c.step++; if (c.step === 2) { c.sub = 1; } window0(); silentSaveDraft(); }
    };
    c.back = function () {
        if (c.step === 2 && c.sub > 1) { c.sub--; window0(); return; }
        if (c.step > 1) { c.step--; if (c.step === 2) { c.sub = c.lastSub(); } window0(); }
    };
    function window0() { if ($window.scrollTo) { $window.scrollTo(0, 0); } }

    // ---- catalogs exposed to the template ----
    c.cat = cat;
    // Target systems + columns are mode-specific: CSG resolves against EVE / Target 1 / Target 2, OTC
    // against the settlement systems. RDM ID maps to the target's identifier column (e.g. EVE's "rdm id").
    c.targetSystems = function () { return c.isCsg() ? (cat.targetSystemsCsg || []) : (cat.targetSystems || []); };
    c.targetFieldsFor = function (system) {
        var src = c.isCsg() ? (cat.targetFieldsCsg || {}) : (cat.targetFields || {});
        return src[system] || [];
    };
    // The pre-coded step sequence for the chosen Skill (activity). CSG uses its own entity-data sequence
    // (extract RDM id -> resolve in EVE); otherwise the sequence is looked up by the chosen Skill —
    // Compare & Match (wired) / Reconcile / Validation (dummy demo sequences).
    c.activitySteps = function () {
        if (c.isCsg()) { return cat.stepTemplatesCsg || []; }
        if (!c.model.workDriver || !c.model.activity) { return []; }
        return ((cat.stepTemplates || {})[c.model.activity]) || [];
    };
    c.hasActivitySteps = function () { return c.activitySteps().length > 0; };
    // Field picker options, filtered by mode: CSG shows only RDM ID (+ Custom); OTC hides RDM ID.
    c.pickableCatalog = function () {
        var fc = cat.fieldCatalog || [], out = [], csg = c.isCsg();
        for (var i = 0; i < fc.length; i++) {
            var isRdm = fc[i].name === 'RDM ID';
            if (csg && !isRdm) { continue; }
            if (!csg && isRdm) { continue; }
            out.push(fc[i]);
        }
        return out;
    };

    // ---- field rows ----
    c.selectedFields = function () {
        var out = [], f = c.model.fields || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) { if (f[i].name) { out.push(f[i]); } }
        return out;
    };
    c.selectedCount = function () { return c.selectedFields().length; };
    // Fields that participate in compare/match + target mapping vs. extract-only fields (e.g. SSI).
    c.mapFields = function () { var o = [], f = c.selectedFields(); for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) { if (!f[i].mapExclude) { o.push(f[i]); } } return o; };
    c.excludedFields = function () { var o = [], f = c.selectedFields(); for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) { if (f[i].mapExclude) { o.push(f[i]); } } return o; };
    c.excludeFromMap = function (f) { if (f && f.mandatory) { return; } f.mapExclude = true; };
    c.includeInMap = function (f) { f.mapExclude = false; };
    c.fieldByName = function (name) {
        var fc = cat.fieldCatalog || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < fc.length; i++) { if (fc[i].name === name) { return fc[i]; } }
        return null;
    };
    // Fields already added, so the dropdown can hide duplicates.
    c.isFieldTaken = function (name, row) {
        var f = c.model.fields || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) { if (f[i] !== row && f[i].name === name) { return true; } }
        return false;
    };
    c.addFieldRow = function () { var r = { name: '', type: 'string', prompt: '', example: '', value: '', custom: false, mapExclude: false }; ensureExamples(r); c.model.fields.push(r); };
    c.removeFieldRow = function (idx) { if (c.model.fields[idx] && c.model.fields[idx].mandatory) { return; } c.model.fields.splice(idx, 1); };
    // Picking a preconfigured field autofills its type / AI prompt / example / value (all still editable).
    // Picking "Custom field" turns the row into a blank, user-defined field (own name + own prompt).
    c.onFieldPick = function (row) {
        if (row.name === '__custom__') {
            row.custom = true; row.name = ''; row.type = 'string'; row.prompt = ''; row.example = ''; row.value = '';
            row.matchMode = 'exact'; row.fuzzyPct = 85; row.tolerance = 0; row.examples = [];
            ensureExamples(row);
            return;
        }
        var cf = c.fieldByName(row.name);
        if (cf) {
            row.type = cf.type || 'string'; row.prompt = cf.prompt; row.value = cf.value; row.custom = false;
            row.examples = (cf.examples || []).slice();
            ensureExamples(row);
            // SSI fields are extract-only by default (settlement instructions, not economic match keys).
            row.mapExclude = /ssi/i.test(row.name);

    };
    // Switch a custom row back to the preconfigured dropdown.
    c.revertField = function (row) { row.custom = false; row.name = ''; };
    // Changing a field's type (Target Mapping) resets an incompatible match mode back to Exact.
    c.onFieldType = function (f) {
        if (f.type === 'float' && f.matchMode === 'fuzzy') { f.matchMode = 'exact'; }
        if (f.type !== 'float' && f.matchMode === 'tolerance') { f.matchMode = 'exact'; }
    };

    // ---- Test extraction (Now Assist) ----
    c.showTest = false;
    c.testRow = null;
    c.testInput = '';
    c.testOutput = '';
    c.testBusy = false;
    c.openTest = function (row) {
        c.testRow = row;
        c.testInput = row.example || '';
        c.testOutput = '';
        c.showTest = true;
    };
    c.closeTest = function () { c.showTest = false; c.testRow = null; };
    c.runTest = function () {
        if (!c.testRow) { return; }
        c.testBusy = true;
        c.testOutput = '';
        c.data.action = 'test';
        c.data.testField = c.testRow.name;
        c.data.testPrompt = c.testRow.prompt;
        c.data.testExample = c.testRow.example;
        c.data.testValue = c.testRow.value;
        c.data.testInput = c.testInput;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.testBusy = false;

            var lines = ('' + (c.data.testOutput || '')).split(/\r?\n/), tidy = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { var l = lines[i].replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ').trim(); if (l) { tidy.push(l); } }

        });
    };

    // ---- prompt enhancer (custom fields): send the manager's draft to the Now Assist skill and
    // replace the field's AI Prompt with the improved instruction it returns. Examples stay as-is.
    c.enhanceRow = null;
    c.enhBusy = '';           // non-row enhances (description / a label's context); '' = idle
    c.descEnhMsg = '';
    c.enhancePrompt = function (row) {
        if (!row || c.enhanceRow || c.enhBusy) { return; }
        var draft = ('' + (row.prompt || '')).trim();
        if (!draft) { row._enhanceMsg = 'Write a short prompt first, then enhance it.'; return; }
        c.enhanceRow = row; row._enhanceMsg = '';
        c.data.action = 'enhance_prompt';
        c.data.enhanceDraft = draft;
        c.data.enhanceField = row.name || 'this field';
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.data.action = '';
            var st = '' + (c.data.enhanceStatus || ''), txt = '' + (c.data.enhanceText || '');
            if (st === 'ok' && txt) { row.prompt = txt; row._enhanceMsg = '✨ Enhanced'; }
            else { row._enhanceMsg = 'Could not enhance (' + (st || 'no response') + ') — the skill may need activating in Now Assist Admin.'; }
            c.data.enhanceStatus = ''; c.data.enhanceText = '';
            c.enhanceRow = null;
        });
    };

    // ---- prompt enhancer, other free-text fields: Description (Define) + each label's Context (Email
    // Identification). Same skill/action, a `mode` steers Chinou; on success it REPLACES the field text.
    function _enhance(token, mode, field, draft, msgSet, apply) {
        if (c.enhanceRow || c.enhBusy) { return; }
        draft = ('' + (draft || '')).trim();
        if (!draft) { msgSet('Write something first, then enhance it.'); return; }
        c.enhBusy = token; msgSet('');
        c.data.action = 'enhance_prompt';
        c.data.enhanceDraft = draft;
        c.data.enhanceField = field;
        c.data.enhanceMode = mode;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.data.action = '';
            var st = '' + (c.data.enhanceStatus || ''), txt = '' + (c.data.enhanceText || '');
            if (st === 'ok' && txt) { apply(txt); msgSet('✨ Enhanced'); }
            else { msgSet('Could not enhance (' + (st || 'no response') + ') — the skill may need activating in Now Assist Admin.'); }
            c.data.enhanceStatus = ''; c.data.enhanceText = ''; c.data.enhanceMode = '';
            c.enhBusy = '';
        });
    }
    c.enhanceDescription = function () {
        _enhance('desc', 'description', 'work-driver description', c.model.description,
            function (m) { c.descEnhMsg = m; }, function (t) { c.model.description = t; });
    };
    c.enhanceContext = function (lab) {
        if (!lab) { return; }
        _enhance(lab, 'classification', 'email classification context', lab.context,
            function (m) { lab._enhMsg = m; }, function (t) { lab.context = t; });
    };

    // ---- targets & mapping ----
    c.addTarget = function () { if (c.model.targets.length >= 1) { return; } c.model.targets.push({ system: '', map: {} }); };
    c.removeTarget = function (idx) { if (c.model.targets.length > 1) { c.model.targets.splice(idx, 1); } };

    // Naive auto-map: match each selected input field to the closest target column by normalised name.
    function norm(s) { return ('' + (s || '')).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); }
    c.autoMap = function (t) {
        var tf = c.targetFieldsFor(t.system);
        var sel = c.selectedFields();
        for (var i = 0; i < sel.length; i++) {
            var fn = sel[i].name, best = '';
            var nf = norm(fn);
            for (var j = 0; j < tf.length; j++) {

                if (nt === nf || nt.indexOf(nf) > -1 || nf.indexOf(nt) > -1) { best = tf[j]; break; }
            }
            // token overlap fallback (e.g. "Trade Reference" -> "trade_ref")
            if (!best) {
                var toks = fn.toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z0-9]+/);

    c.runStatus = '';
    c.runStatusText = '';
    c.runBusy = false;
    c.runExtract = function () {
        if (!c.runInput || !c.selectedCount()) { return; }
        c.runBusy = true;
        c.runRows = null;
        c.data.action = 'run_extract';
        c.data.runFields = c.selectedFields();
        c.data.runInput = c.runInput;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.runBusy = false;
            c.runKeys = c.data.runKeys || [];
            c.runRows = c.data.runRows || [];
            c.runStatus = c.data.runStatus || '';

        });
    };

    c.canNext = function () {
        // Define: needs name + full taxonomy (BU -> Sub-BU -> Service -> Work driver), AND the resulting
        // pipeline must have a pre-coded step set. Activity is fixed to "Compare & Match".
        if (c.step === 1) { return !!(c.model.name && c.model.subBu && c.model.service && c.model.workDriver && c.model.activity) && c.hasActivitySteps(); }
        // Input Configuration: only the Ingestion sub-page gates — a Mail source needs a mailbox.

    // ---- persist ----
    c.busy = false;

        c.data.action = action;
        c.data.model = c.model;

            $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_list';
        });
    }
    // Silent background draft-save: creates the draft as soon as the manager advances past Define, and
    // keeps model.id so later saves (and Publish) update the SAME record — never a duplicate. No navigation.

        if (!(c.model && c.model.name) || c.model.status === 'published') { return; }
        c.busy = true;
        c.data.action = 'save_draft';
        c.data.model = c.model;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.busy = false;
            c.data.action = '';

    c.clearAll = function () {
        if (!$window.confirm('Clear all selections and start blank?')) { return; }
        $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_builder';
    };
    // Leaving an incomplete wizard auto-saves it as a DRAFT (so nothing is lost) — unless it is already
    // published (editing a live workflow) or nothing meaningful has been entered yet.
    c.exit = function () {
        var m = c.model || {};
        // NB: activity is auto-set to "Compare & Match", so it is NOT a signal of real progress — checking
        // it would auto-save a junk draft for an untouched new wizard. Use the fields the user actually picks.
        var started = !!(m.name || m.subBu || m.service || m.workDriver || (m.fields && m.fields.length));
        if (started && m.status !== 'published') { persist('save_draft'); return; }
        $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_list';
    };
}
]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* Wizard Builder — 5-step config builder */
.nom-app * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.nom-app { font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; background: #eef1f5; color: #20242c; min-height: 100vh; }

/* header */
.nom-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; background: #fff; padding: 6px 26px; border-bottom: 3px solid #C8102E; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06); position: relative; z-index: 30; }
.nom-logo { height: 48px; width: auto; }
.nom-user { margin-left: auto; position: relative; }
.nom-role { font-size: 13px; color: #5b6270; }
.nom-avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #C8102E; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.nom-user-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 8px 4px 6px; border-radius: 9px; transition: background .12s; }
.nom-user-btn:hover { background: #f3f4f7; }
.nom-caret { color: #98a2b3; font-size: 10px; transition: transform .15s; }
.nom-caret.open { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.nom-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 900; background: transparent; }
.nom-menu { position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 8px); z-index: 1000; width: 222px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(20,30,60,.18); overflow: hidden; }
.nom-menu-hd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f2f5; }
.nom-avatar.sm { width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 12px; }
.nom-menu-id .nm-name { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.nom-menu-id .nm-sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: #8a909a; margin-top: 1px; }
.nom-menu-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #fff; border: none; text-align: left; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #C0392B; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
.nom-menu-item:hover { background: #fdf2f2; }

/* layout */
.wb-main { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 30px 48px 60px; }
.wb-titlebar { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.wb-title { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-sub { font-size: 14px; color: #6b7280; margin-top: 6px; }
.wb-clear { margin-left: auto; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e0e3ea; border-radius: 9px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #5b6270; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-clear:hover { background: #f7f8fa; }
.wb-layout { display: block; }

/* summary rail */
.wb-rail { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 14px; padding: 22px 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05); position: sticky; top: 20px; }
.wb-rail-h { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-rail-sub { font-size: 12.5px; color: #8a909a; margin: 4px 0 18px; }
.wb-rail-list { list-style: none; }
.wb-rail-list li { position: relative; padding: 0 0 16px 16px; }
.wb-rail-list li:before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 4px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #cfd6e0; }
.wb-rail-list li:after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 3.5px; top: 12px; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: #eceff3; }
.wb-rail-list li:last-child:after { display: none; }
.wb-rl-k { display: block; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #98a2b3; }
.wb-rl-v { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; color: #1a1a2e; margin-top: 2px; word-break: break-word; }
.wb-rail-div { height: 1px; background: #eceff3; margin: 6px 0 16px; }
.wb-flow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 8px 0 18px; }
.wb-pill { background: #2563eb; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 16px; }
.wb-flow-arrow { color: #98a2b3; }
.wb-rail-mini { margin-bottom: 14px; }

/* stepper */
.wb-stepper { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05); display: flex; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.wb-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: default; flex: 1; }
.wb-step:last-child { flex: 0; }
.wb-step-dot { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e6e9ef; color: #8a909a; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0; }
.wb-step.active .wb-step-dot { background: #E8830C; color: #fff; }
.wb-step.done .wb-step-dot { background: #1E9E57; color: #fff; }
.wb-step-lbl { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #8a909a; white-space: nowrap; }
.wb-step.active .wb-step-lbl { color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-step.done .wb-step-lbl { color: #1E9E57; }
.wb-step-line { flex: 1; height: 2px; background: #e6e9ef; margin: 0 12px; min-width: 24px; }
.wb-step.done .wb-step-line { background: #1E9E57; }

/* panel */
.wb-panel { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 14px; padding: 30px 32px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05); }
.wb-h { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-h-sub { font-size: 14px; color: #6b7280; margin: 6px 0 24px; }
.wb-lbl { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #374151; margin: 18px 0 7px; }

/* Pre-coded steps revealed on the Define screen */
.wb-reveal { margin-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid #eef0f4; padding-top: 18px; }
.wb-reveal-h { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-reveal-sub { font-size: 12.5px; color: #6b7280; margin: 5px 0 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
.wb-steplist { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.wb-steprow { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; background: #f8f9fb; border: 1px solid #eef0f4; border-radius: 9px; padding: 11px 14px; }
.wb-stepnum { flex: none; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; background: #C8102E; color: #fff; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.wb-stepinfo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.wb-stepname { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-stepdesc { font-size: 12px; color: #8a909a; margin-top: 2px; }
.wb-reveal-none { background: #fdf1e3; border: 1px solid #f2d9b8; color: #8a6516; border-radius: 9px; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }
.wb-lbl:first-of-type { margin-top: 0; }
.wb-req { color: #C8102E; }
.wb-hint { font-size: 12.5px; color: #8a909a; margin-bottom: 7px; }
.wb-in { width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid #dfe3ea; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: #1a1a2e; background: #f8f9fb; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-in:focus { outline: none; border-color: #C8102E; background: #fff; }
.wb-ta { resize: vertical; min-height: 84px; }
.wb-ta-sm { resize: vertical; min-height: 54px; background: #fff; }
.wb-row2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; }

/* step 2 — id rules + fields */
.wb-idrules { border-top: 1px solid #eef0f4; margin-top: 26px; padding-top: 18px; }
.wb-idrules-h { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #374151; }
.wb-idrules-note { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: #8a909a; }
.wb-idrules-empty { font-size: 13px; color: #8a909a; margin-top: 10px; }
.wb-label { border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 12px; padding: 22px; margin-top: 14px; }
.wb-label-top { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.wb-label-top .wb-lbl { margin: 0; }
.wb-label-del { margin-left: auto; background: none; border: none; color: #b0b6c0; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; }
.wb-label-del:hover { color: #C0392B; }
.wb-addlabel { background: #f3f4f7; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 9px; padding: 10px 18px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475065; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 14px; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-addlabel:hover { background: #e9ebf0; }
.wb-fields-h { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; border-top: 1px solid #eef0f4; margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 18px; gap: 16px; }
.wb-fields-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.wb-mini { background: #f3f4f7; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 12.5px; color: #475065; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-mini:hover { background: #e9ebf0; }
.wb-selpill { background: #2563eb; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 14px; }
.wb-field { border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-top: 12px; background: #fbfbfc; }
.wb-field.on { background: #fff; border-color: #d7dbe2; box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(20,30,60,.05); }
.wb-field-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; cursor: pointer; }
.wb-field-head input[type=checkbox] { width: 17px; height: 17px; accent-color: #C8102E; }
.wb-field-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; flex: 1; }
.wb-field-del { background: none; border: none; color: #b0b6c0; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; }
.wb-field-del:hover { color: #C0392B; }
.wb-req-badge { font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #8a6516; background: #fdf1e3; border: 1px solid #f2d9b8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; letter-spacing: .3px; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }

/* Write-back sub-page */
.wb-wbtable { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 6px; }
.wb-wbtable th { text-align: left; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #6b7280; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .03em; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e9ef; }
.wb-wbtable td { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f2f5; vertical-align: middle; }
.wb-wbtable .c-wb-out { width: 320px; }
.wb-wb-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px 10px; }
.wb-wb-badge.wb-ok { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1E7E45; }
.wb-wb-badge.wb-warn { background: #fdf1e3; color: #B7791F; }
.wb-wb-badge.wb-bad { background: #fdecec; color: #C0392B; }
.wb-wb-desc { font-size: 11.5px; color: #8a909a; margin-top: 4px; }
.wb-field-def { font-size: 12.5px; color: #8a909a; margin: 6px 0 0 28px; }
.wb-field-edit { margin: 12px 0 2px; }
.wb-field-def-lbl { font-size: 12px; color: #6b7280; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.wb-addfield { border-top: 1px solid #eef0f4; margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 18px; }
.wb-addfield-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.6fr auto; gap: 10px; }
.wb-add { background: #f3f4f7; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475065; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-add:hover { background: #e9ebf0; }

/* --- custom-field prompt enhancer --- */
.wb-enh-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.wb-enh-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #f4eefb; border: 1px solid #e0d3f3; border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 11px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #6B46C1; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-enh-btn:hover:not([disabled]) { background: #ece1fa; border-color: #cdb8ef; }
.wb-enh-btn[disabled] { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }
.wb-enh-msg { font-size: 11.5px; color: #6b7280; }

/* input-fields table (Add field -> Field / AI Prompt / Example / Value / Test) */
.wb-ftable-wrap { overflow-x: auto; margin-top: 14px; }
.wb-ftable { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
.wb-ftable th { text-align: left; color: #6b7280; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: .02em; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f4; }
.wb-ftable td { padding: 12px 10px; vertical-align: top; border-bottom: 1px solid #f5f6f8; }
.wb-ftable .c-field { width: 180px; }
.wb-ftable .c-val { width: 190px; }
.wb-ftable .c-ex { width: 210px; }
.wb-ftable .c-act { width: 96px; white-space: nowrap; text-align: right; }
.wb-ex { margin-bottom: 7px; }
.wb-ex:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.wb-ex-val { width: 100%; font-size: 12.5px; padding: 7px 9px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; box-sizing: border-box; }
.wb-ta-cell { min-height: 62px; resize: vertical; background: #fff; }
.wb-ftable .wb-in[disabled], .wb-ftable select[disabled] { background: #f3f4f7; color: #b0b6c0; }
.wb-testbtn { background: #eef4fb; color: #1F5FA8; border: 1px solid #cfe0f5; border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 15px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-testbtn:hover { background: #e0ecfa; }
.wb-testbtn[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }
.wb-ftable .wb-field-del { margin-left: 6px; vertical-align: middle; }
.wb-fields-empty { font-size: 13px; color: #8a909a; padding: 18px 0; }
.wb-custom-field { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
.wb-revert { flex-shrink: 0; background: #f3f4f7; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 6px; width: 32px; height: 36px; cursor: pointer; color: #5b6270; font-size: 15px; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-revert:hover { background: #e9ebf0; }

/* test modal */
.wb-modal-wrap { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 1100; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.wb-modal-back { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(20,25,40,.45); }
.wb-modal { position: relative; z-index: 2; width: 580px; max-width: 92vw; background: #fff; border-radius: 14px; padding: 26px 26px 24px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(20,30,60,.35); }
.wb-modal-x { position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 16px; background: none; border: none; font-size: 15px; color: #8a909a; cursor: pointer; }
.wb-modal-h { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-modal-sub { font-size: 13px; color: #6b7280; margin: 6px 0 16px; }
.wb-modal-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; margin: 14px 0 6px; }
.wb-testout { background: #f8f9fb; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13.5px; color: #1a1a2e; min-height: 48px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }
.wb-testout.busy { color: #8a909a; }

/* step 3 — targets & mapping */
.wb-addtarget { background: #f3f4f7; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 9px; padding: 11px 18px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475065; cursor: pointer; margin-bottom: 18px; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-addtarget:hover { background: #e9ebf0; }
.wb-addtarget:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }
.wb-derived-line { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; background: #eef4fb; border: 1px solid #d5e3f4; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 4px 0 18px; }
.wb-derived-field { font-weight: 700; color: #1c2b46; font-size: 14px; }
.wb-derived-badge { background: #1F5FA8; color: #fff; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .02em; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 11px; }
.wb-derived-note { color: #6b7280; font-size: 12.5px; }
.wb-target { border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.wb-target-h { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.wb-target-h .wb-lbl { margin: 0; }
.wb-target-del { margin-left: auto; background: none; border: none; color: #b0b6c0; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; }
.wb-target-del:hover { color: #C0392B; }
.wb-target select { margin-top: 8px; }
.wb-map { margin-top: 20px; }
.wb-map-h { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .03em; color: #8a909a; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.wb-map-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background: #f8f9fb; border: 1px solid #eef0f4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.wb-map-field { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-map-x { background: none; border: none; color: #b0b6c0; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; }
.wb-map-x:hover { color: #C0392B; background: #fbe9e7; }
.wb-mapexc { margin-top: 20px; border-top: 1px dashed #e0e3ea; padding-top: 16px; }
.wb-mapexc-h { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .03em; color: #98a2b3; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.wb-mapexc-list { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.wb-mapexc-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; color: #475065; background: #eef0f4; border: 1px solid #e0e3ea; border-radius: 18px; padding: 6px 8px 6px 14px; }
.wb-mapexc-add { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: #1E9E57; color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1; }
.wb-mapexc-add:hover { background: #178048; }
.wb-rv-exc { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 13px; color: #6b7280; }
.wb-map-arrow { color: #98a2b3; }
.wb-map-empty { font-size: 13px; color: #8a909a; padding: 10px 0; }
.wb-map-eve { font-weight: 600; color: #1F5FA8; background: #e7f0fb; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; }

/* step 4 — review */
.wb-review { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px 32px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.wb-rv-wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.wb-rv-k { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #98a2b3; }
.wb-rv-v { font-size: 15px; color: #1a1a2e; margin-top: 4px; }
.wb-rv-map-h { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; border-top: 1px solid #eef0f4; margin-top: 22px; padding-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.wb-rv-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; }
.wb-rv-table th { text-align: left; background: #f3f4f7; color: #6b7280; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: .03em; padding: 10px 14px; }
.wb-rv-table td { padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f2f5; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-arrow-sm { color: #98a2b3; }

/* step 5 — run */
.wb-runnote { font-size: 14px; color: #374151; margin-bottom: 20px; line-height: 1.55; }
.wb-run-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin: 14px 0 22px; }
.wb-run-hint { font-size: 12.5px; color: #8a909a; }
.wb-result { border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; }
.wb-result-h { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; padding: 18px 20px; gap: 16px; }
.wb-result-t { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-result-s { font-size: 12.5px; color: #8a909a; margin-top: 4px; }
.wb-result-pct { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; background: #fbe9e7; color: #C0392B; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 16px; white-space: nowrap; }
.wb-result-pct.good { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1E7E45; }
.wb-result-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
.wb-result-table th { text-align: left; color: #6b7280; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border-top: 1px solid #eef0f4; background: #fafbfc; }
.wb-result-table td { padding: 13px 20px; border-top: 1px solid #f1f2f5; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-result-table tr.bad td { background: #fdf3f2; }
.redv { color: #C0392B; }
.wb-m { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; }
.wb-m.ok { color: #1E7E45; }
.wb-m.bad { color: #C0392B; }
.wb-mockline { font-size: 12px; color: #8a909a; margin-top: 14px; }
.wz-mono { font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; }

/* footer */
.wb-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; margin-top: 20px; padding-top: 20px; }
.wb-foot-right { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 12px; }
.wb-btn { border: none; border-radius: 9px; padding: 12px 22px; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-btn.ghost { background: #eceef2; color: #475065; }
.wb-btn.ghost:hover { background: #e2e5ea; }
.wb-btn.ghost[disabled] { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }
.wb-btn.primary { background: #C8102E; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(200,16,46,.3); }
.wb-btn.primary:hover { background: #a50d26; }
.wb-btn.primary[disabled] { background: #eab7bd; cursor: default; box-shadow: none; }

/* ===== Input Configuration: sub-tab bar ===== */
.wb-subtabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 22px; padding-bottom: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f4; }
.wb-subtab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #f3f4f7; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 20px; padding: 8px 15px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #6b7280; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
.wb-subtab:hover { background: #e9ebf0; }
.wb-subtab-n { width: 19px; height: 19px; border-radius: 50%; background: #d7dbe2; color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.wb-subtab.active { background: #fdeef0; border-color: #f0c8ce; color: #C8102E; }
.wb-subtab.active .wb-subtab-n { background: #C8102E; }
.wb-subtab.done { color: #1E9E57; border-color: #cdeeda; background: #f0faf4; }
.wb-subtab.done .wb-subtab-n { background: #1E9E57; }

.wb-note { background: #f7f8fa; border: 1px solid #eef0f4; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 18px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #475065; margin-top: 14px; }

/* ===== config tables (tagging / writeback) ===== */
.wb-cfg-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; }
.wb-cfg-table th { text-align: left; background: #f3f4f7; color: #6b7280; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: .03em; padding: 10px 14px; }
.wb-cfg-table td { padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f2f5; vertical-align: middle; }
.wb-cfg-table .c-stage { width: 220px; }
.wb-cfg-table .wb-in { margin: 0; }
.wb-stage-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #3F5170; background: #eef0f6; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 16px; }
.wb-wb-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 16px; }
.wb-wb-match { color: #1E7E45; background: #e6f4ea; }
.wb-wb-nomatch { color: #C0392B; background: #f9d7d2; }
.wb-wb-mismatch { color: #B7791F; background: #fdf1e3; }

/* ===== field match rules ===== */
.wb-match { margin-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid #eef0f4; padding-top: 20px; }
.wb-match-h { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .03em; color: #8a909a; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.wb-match-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr auto auto 1.6fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #f8f9fb; border: 1px solid #eef0f4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.wb-match-field { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.wb-match-type, .wb-match-mode { margin: 0; width: auto; min-width: 96px; }
.wb-match-num { width: 74px; margin: 0; display: inline-block; text-align: center; }
.wb-match-val { font-size: 13px; color: #475065; }
.wb-match-note { font-size: 12.5px; color: #98a2b3; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .wb-match-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

/* ===== Compare & Match tolerances (step 5) ===== */
.wb-toltable { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 13px; }
.wb-toltable th { text-align: left; background: #1F2A44; color: #fff; padding: 9px 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: .02em; white-space: nowrap; }
.wb-toltable th:first-child { border-top-left-radius: 8px; }
.wb-toltable th:last-child { border-top-right-radius: 8px; text-align: right; }
.wb-toltable td { padding: 11px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f4; vertical-align: top; }
.wb-toltable .c-tol { width: 46%; }
.wb-toltable .c-tol-tier { width: 74px; }
.wb-toltable .c-tol-in { width: 210px; }
.wb-toltable .c-tol-def { width: 110px; text-align: right; }
.wb-tol-name { font-weight: 600; color: #20242c; }
.wb-tol-hint { font-size: 11.5px; color: #6b7280; margin-top: 3px; line-height: 1.45; }
.wb-tier { display: inline-block; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
.wb-tier.t1 { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1E7E45; }
.wb-tier.t2 { background: #fdf1e3; color: #B7791F; }
.wb-tol-num { max-width: 170px; margin: 0; }
.wb-tol-reset { display: inline-block; margin-top: 7px; background: none; border: none; color: #C8102E; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; }
.wb-tol-reset:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.wb-tol-note { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 12px; color: #5b6270; background: #fafbfc; border: 1px solid #eef0f4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
.wb-tol-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #C8102E; background: #fdeceb; border: 1px solid #f2c3bd; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 10px; margin-left: 4px; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .wb-toltable .c-tol-in, .wb-toltable .c-tol-def { width: auto; } }

/* Write-back — multiple actions per outcome (chips + add) */
.wb-actchips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.wb-actchip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #fdecef; color: #C8102E; border: 1px solid #f5c6cf; border-radius: 14px; padding: 3px 6px 3px 11px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.wb-actchip-x { border: none; background: none; color: #C8102E; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; padding: 0 2px; }
.wb-actchip-x:hover { color: #8f0b20; }
.wb-actchip-none { color: #9aa0a6; font-size: 13px; font-style: italic; }
.wb-actadd { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; max-width: 460px; }
.wb-actadd-sel { flex: 1; }
.wb-actadd-btn { background: #C8102E; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 15px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }
.wb-actadd-btn:disabled { background: #e7e9ee; color: #9aa0a8; cursor: not-allowed; }
</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>true</has_preview><id>nfotcbsm-wizard-builder</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
}]]></link><name>OTC Wizard Builder</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Wizard Builder — 5-step config builder (server).
 * Provides the option catalogs + preconfigured field catalog + target-field lists, loads an
 * existing wizard when ?copy / ?edit is present, and persists on Save-as-draft / Publish.
 * All step state lives on the CLIENT; the only server round-trips are the terminal save/publish
 * (which then navigate back to the list), so the working model is never lost mid-build.
 */
(function () {
    data.logo = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().LOGO;
    data.name = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().titleCase(gs.getUserDisplayName() || 'Analyst');

    // ── ACCESS GUARD (centralised: x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard) ──
    // Wizard authoring (create/edit/publish work-drivers) is a MANAGER surface. SP widget server scripts
    // run server-side and BYPASS the manager-only wizard ACL, so authorisation is enforced HERE. Because
    // this returns first, it guards page load AND every action below (test / run_extract / save_draft /
    // publish). Uses REAL granted roles (not the header 'view-as' label) so a view toggle cannot grant access.
    if (!new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().isManagerOrAdmin()) { data.redirect = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers'; return; }

    // Header role label — the Wizard Builder is the MANAGER authoring surface, so show the user's real
    // functional role (Manager first; a pure platform admin -> Administrator; otherwise Analyst). Never
    // hardcode 'Admin'. Mirrors the Manager Dashboard, incl. the test-user view-as toggle, so the label
    // is consistent across the manager surfaces.
    function hasExplicitRole(roleName) {
        try {
            var roles = gs.getUser().getRoles();
            if (roles) { for (var i = 0; i < roles.length; i++) { if (('' + roles[i]) === roleName) { return true; } } }
        } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
        return false;
    }
    var isTestUser = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().isDemoUser();   // demo operators (x_nose_nfotc_bsm.demo_users)
    var viewAs = isTestUser ? ('' + (gs.getSession().getClientData('nfotc_view_as') || '')) : '';
    var isManager = isTestUser ? (viewAs === 'manager') : hasExplicitRole('x_nose_nfotc_bsm.manager');
    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();
    // Avatar initials from the display name (was hardcoded 'US').
    var _np = ('' + data.name).trim().split(/\s+/);
    data.initials = ((_np[0] || 'U').charAt(0) + (_np.length > 1 ? _np[_np.length - 1].charAt(0) : '')).toUpperCase();

    // ---- option catalogs ----
    // BU -> Sub-BU -> Activity -> Work Driver cascade comes from the shared taxonomy (CompareMatch).
    var _cm = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch();
    data.cat = {
        taxonomy: _cm.taxonomy(),
        inputFormats: ['Email', 'PDF', 'Excel'],
        ingestionTypes: ['Mail', 'API', 'File Drop', 'Manual'],
        mailboxes: ['email1@outlook.com', 'email2@outlook.com', 'settlements@bank.com'],
        frequencies: ['Real-time', 'Hourly', 'Daily'],
        targetSystems: ['System 1', 'System 2', 'PCM'],
        // Write-back actions offered per Compare & Match outcome (unfilled by default in the wizard).
        writebackActions: ['Send to NEWS', 'Reply to Counterparty', 'Reply to Middle Office'],
        // Skill (activity) options on the Define screen — the pipeline the manager picks. Only
        // Compare & Match is wired; Reconcile / Validation are demo placeholders with their own steps.
        activityOptions: ['Compare & Match', 'Reconcile', 'Validation'],
        // Preconfigured input fields — name + the Now Assist prompt (aligned with the production
        // "Extract Settlement Fields" skill) + an example VALUE + data type. Mandatory fields first,
        // optional below. Counterparty is intentionally NOT here — it is derived from the sender, not
        // extracted by the AI.
        fieldCatalog: [
            // ---- CSG mandatory: the RDM id keys the EVE-directory lookup (extract-only; placeholder for now) ----
            {
                name: 'RDM ID', type: 'string', mandatory: true,
                prompt: "Extract the RDM entity identifier for this notification — the reference-data master id used to resolve the entity in the EVE directory. It usually appears at the end of the subject line after the final ' - ', and inside the email body labelled 'ORG_RDM_ID' or 'RDM ID'. It is a 5–7 digit number. Return the digits only. If it is genuinely absent, return an empty string.",
                value: '364469',
                examples: ['364469', '372815', '388104']
            },
            // ---- mandatory (MASTER prompt + 3 worked examples, grounded in the real counterparty mails:
            //      pipe tables, free-form prose, SWIFT MT :32A:/:72:, key/value blocks, "AUD P" shorthand) ----
            {
                name: 'Value Date', type: 'string', mandatory: true,
                prompt: "Extract the settlement / value date for this cashflow. It may appear under a value-date column or label, after the word 'value', in a key/value line, inside a SWIFT date-and-amount field, or — only when the body contains none — in the subject line. The source date may be written in ISO, day-first, or day-month-name form, or as a compact SWIFT date; interpret whichever is present. Always return the date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. If it is genuinely absent, return an empty string.",
                value: '2026-06-13',
                examples: ['2026-06-13', '2026-06-14', '2026-06-05']
            },
            {
                name: 'Amount', type: 'float', mandatory: true,
                prompt: "Extract the settlement amount for this cashflow — the cash amount to settle, not the trade notional. The column may be labelled Amount, Flow Amount or Quantity; that value is the settlement amount. Strip any currency symbol and thousands separators. Where a comma is used as the decimal separator, convert it to a dot. Preserve the sign — negative amounts must stay negative. Return the number only, using a dot as the decimal separator. If it is absent, return an empty string.",
                value: '1497447.18',
                examples: ['1497447.18', '690397.75', '-2309184.24']
            },
            {
                name: 'Currency', type: 'string', mandatory: true,
                prompt: "Extract the settlement currency for this cashflow as a three-letter ISO 4217 code. It may appear under a currency column or label, in a key/value line, embedded inside a SWIFT date-and-amount field, or as the first token of a shorthand amount line. Return the uppercase three-letter code only. If it is absent, return an empty string.",
                value: 'EUR',
                examples: ['EUR', 'SGD', 'AUD']
            },
            {
                name: 'Direction', type: 'string', mandatory: true,
                prompt: "Extract the settlement direction for this cashflow from the counterparty's stated point of view — return exactly 'Pay' or 'Receive'. Normalise single-letter indicators, SWIFT direction tags, and combined Pay/Receive columns to the full word. In shorthand lines the direction indicator follows the currency. If the email states no direction (for example a fund or quantity table with no Pay/Receive column), return an empty string — do not infer it from the amount's sign.",
                value: 'Pay',
                examples: ['Pay', 'Receive', 'Pay']
            },
            // ---- optional ----
            // ---- optional (MASTER-style prompt + 3 grounded examples, from the real counterparty mails) ----
            { name: 'Nomura Entity', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the Nomura booking entity for this cashflow — the internal legal entity / branch on Nomura's side (the recipient side of the correspondence), NOT the counterparty. It may appear after a label such as 'Entity', 'Nomura Entity' or 'Bank', or written as 'BANK <city>' (e.g. 'BANK London', 'BANK Singapore'), or in an 'Entity=' key/value line. Return the entity name only. If the email does not name a Nomura entity, return an empty string — do not guess.",
              value: 'BANK London', examples: ['BANK London', 'BANK Singapore', 'BANK Tokyo'] },
            { name: 'Product', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the product / instrument type for this cashflow. It usually appears on a line labelled 'Product' (sometimes 'Instrument' or 'Product Type'), e.g. 'Equity-Linked Note', 'FX Forward', 'Credit Default Swap', 'NDF', 'Interest Rate Swap'. Return the product name exactly as written. If no product is stated, return an empty string.",
              value: 'Equity-Linked Note', examples: ['Equity-Linked Note', 'FX Forward', 'Credit Default Swap'] },
            { name: 'Trade Reference', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the counterparty's trade / deal reference for THIS cashflow. It typically appears on a line labelled 'Reference' (sometimes 'Trade Ref', 'Deal Ref' or 'Our Ref') and is usually a 9-digit number. When the email lists multiple cash flows, take the reference from the same block as this cashflow. Return the reference token only. If none is present, return an empty string.",
              value: '345927053', examples: ['345927053', '344803556', '352338792'] },
            { name: 'Trade Date', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the trade / execution date for this cashflow — the date the trade was dealt, which is DISTINCT from the settlement / value date. Look for a label such as 'Trade Date', 'Deal Date' or 'Execution Date'. Interpret whatever date format is present and always return ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. Many settlement mails do not state a trade date; if it is genuinely absent, return an empty string — do NOT substitute the value date.",
              value: '2026-06-10', examples: ['2026-06-10', '2026-06-05', ''] },
            { name: 'SSI Bank / BIC', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the settlement agent bank and its BIC from the settlement-instruction (SSI) block. It usually appears on a line labelled 'SSI Bank (BIC)', 'Agent Bank' or 'Correspondent'. Return the bank name together with the BIC in parentheses exactly as written, e.g. 'AGENT BANK 7 (AGGBUS3N)'. If the email carries no SSI block, return an empty string.",
              value: 'AGENT BANK 7 (AGGBUS3N)', examples: ['AGENT BANK 7 (AGGBUS3N)', 'AGENT BANK 5 (AGEBGB22)', 'AGENT BANK 1 (AGABUS33)'] },
            { name: 'SSI Account', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the settlement account number from the SSI block for this cashflow — usually the line labelled 'SSI Account' or 'Account'. It is typically a 10-digit number. Return the digits only. If no SSI account is given, return an empty string.",
              value: '1874730946', examples: ['1874730946', '8052701989', '1500631843'] },
            { name: 'SSI Beneficiary / BIC', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the beneficiary and its BIC from the settlement-instruction block — usually the line labelled 'Beneficiary (BIC)' or 'Beneficiary'. Return the beneficiary name together with the BIC in parentheses exactly as written, e.g. 'Counterparty8 (CPTYCA2L)'. If no beneficiary is stated, return an empty string.",
              value: 'Counterparty8 (CPTYCA2L)', examples: ['Counterparty8 (CPTYCA2L)', 'Counterparty7 (CPTYAU2L)', 'Counterparty (DEMOCP2L)'] },
            { name: 'SSI Intermediary', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the intermediary / correspondent bank and its BIC from the settlement-instruction block, if present — usually labelled 'Intermediary (BIC)', 'Intermediary' or 'Correspondent'. Return the name with the BIC in parentheses exactly as written. Many mails have no intermediary line; if it is genuinely absent, return an empty string.",
              value: '', examples: ['INTERMEDIARY BANK 2 (INTBUS33)', 'CORRESPONDENT BANK (CORRGB22)', ''] }
        ],
        // Target-system column names available for mapping.
        targetFields: {
            'System 1': ['trade_ref', 'cpty', 'notional_amt', 'ccy_pair', 'rate', 'value_dt', 'trade_dt', 'side'],
            'System 2': ['tradeId', 'counterparty', 'notional', 'currencyPair', 'price', 'valueDate', 'tradeDate', 'buySell'],
            'PCM': ['cashflow_id', 'counterparty_entity', 'amount', 'currency', 'rate', 'value_date', 'trade_date', 'direction']
        },
        // CSG target systems + their identifier columns — the RDM id maps to the system's "rdm id" column.
        targetSystemsCsg: ['EVE', 'Target 1', 'Target 2'],
        targetFieldsCsg: {
            'EVE': ['rdm id', 'entity', 'role', 'short_name', 'long_name', 'full_name', 'country', 'status'],
            'Target 1': ['rdm id', 'entity', 'status'],
            'Target 2': ['rdm id', 'entity', 'status']
        }
    };

    function defaultModel() {
        return {
            id: '', name: '', description: '', bu: '', subBu: '', service: '',
            workDriver: '', activity: '',
            inputFormat: 'Email', ingestionType: 'Mail', mailbox: '', frequency: 'Real-time',
            labels: [],                          // [{name, context, keywords, senders, subject, exclusions}]
            fields: [],                          // [{name, type, prompt, example, value, custom, matchMode, fuzzyPct, tolerance}]
            targets: [{ system: '', map: {} }],  // [{system, map: {fieldName: targetField}}]
            // Outlook Tagging — one row per preconfigured stage; manager fills the tag.
            tagging: [
                { stage: 'Default', tag: '' },
                { stage: 'Extraction Confirmed', tag: '' },
                { stage: 'Review Confirmed', tag: '' },
                { stage: 'Resolved', tag: '' },
                { stage: 'Escalated', tag: '' }
            ],
            // Analyst Writeback — the 3 fixed match outcomes; each holds a LIST of configured actions
            // (unfilled by default — the manager adds one or more in the Write-back step).
            writeback: [
                { scenario: 'Matched', actions: [] },
                { scenario: 'Mismatch', actions: [] },
                { scenario: 'No Match', actions: [] }
            ],
            tolerances: {},                      // { rel_tol, abs_tol, vd_tol_days, t2_amt_abs, t2_amt_rel } — blank = inherit system default
            status: 'draft', version: 'v1'
        };
    }

    // ---- activity step-template registry ----
    // The step SEQUENCE for a (work-driver / activity) is PRE-CODED, not composed by the manager. Once
    // an activity is chosen on the Define screen, its steps are revealed (read-only); the manager only
    // configures each step's values below. Adding a new activity's sequence is a DEVELOPER task.
    // (Only "Compare & Match" is defined for now — other activities show "not defined yet".)
    data.cat.stepTemplates = {
        'Compare & Match': [
            { n: 1, name: 'Email Ingestion', desc: 'Pull the email from the configured mailbox / source.' },
            { n: 2, name: 'Email Identification', desc: 'Classify the email and keep only the in-scope ones.' },
            { n: 3, name: 'Extract Counterparty', desc: 'Derive the counterparty from the sender directory.' },
            { n: 4, name: 'Extract Fields', desc: 'Extract the settlement fields using the configured AI prompts.' },
            { n: 5, name: 'Compare & Match', desc: 'Match the extracted fields against the target system.' },
            { n: 6, name: 'Route / Write-back', desc: 'Surface the outcome to the analyst for review & write-back.' }
        ],
        // ---- DEMO PLACEHOLDERS: Reconcile / Validation reveal their own step sequence on Define, but are
        // NOT wired to a runtime pipeline yet (only Compare & Match runs). Different steps per skill. ----
        'Reconcile': [
            { n: 1, name: 'Email Ingestion', desc: 'Pull the email from the configured mailbox / source.' },
            { n: 2, name: 'Email Identification', desc: 'Classify the email and keep only the in-scope ones.' },
            { n: 3, name: 'Extract Positions', desc: 'Extract the positions / balances to reconcile.' },
            { n: 4, name: 'Load Ledger', desc: 'Load the internal ledger records for the value date.' },
            { n: 5, name: 'Reconcile', desc: 'Reconcile the extracted positions against the ledger and flag breaks.' },
            { n: 6, name: 'Route Breaks', desc: 'Route the reconciliation breaks to the analyst.' }
        ],
        'Validation': [
            { n: 1, name: 'Email Ingestion', desc: 'Pull the email from the configured mailbox / source.' },
            { n: 2, name: 'Email Identification', desc: 'Classify the email and keep only the in-scope ones.' },
            { n: 3, name: 'Extract Fields', desc: 'Extract the fields to validate using the configured AI prompts.' },
            { n: 4, name: 'Validate', desc: 'Validate the extracted fields against the business rules.' },
            { n: 5, name: 'Report', desc: 'Report the validation outcome to the analyst.' }
        ]
    };
    // CSG entity-data pipeline — different sequence: extract the RDM id, resolve it in EVE, surface the
    // entity + status. No counterparty derivation, no compare/match, no write-back.
    data.cat.stepTemplatesCsg = [
        { n: 1, name: 'Email Ingestion', desc: 'Pull the entity-data email from the configured mailbox / source.' },
        { n: 2, name: 'Email Identification', desc: 'Classify & route the CSG (NLUX) emails and keep only the in-scope ones.' },
        { n: 3, name: 'Extract RDM ID', desc: 'Extract the RDM id from the email using the configured AI prompt.' },
        { n: 4, name: 'Resolve in EVE', desc: 'Look up the RDM id in the EVE directory (entity, role, names, country, status).' },
        { n: 5, name: 'Review', desc: 'Surface the resolved entity and its status to the analyst.' }
    ];

    // ---- Compare & Match tolerances (step 5) — per-driver overrides + current SYSTEM defaults for placeholders.
    // Written to x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard.config_overrides (match.* keys) and read live by CompareMatch.loadConfig(wizId).
    var _cfg = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.NfotcConfig();
    data.cat.tolerances = [
        // Tier 1 & 3 are EXACT (no tolerance) per FR-MTH-001/020 — only Tier 2 has tunable tolerances.
        { mkey: 'vd_tol_days', ckey: 'match.vd_tol_days', label: 'Value-date window (business days)', tier: 'Tier 2', step: '1', def: _cfg.getNumber('match.vd_tol_days', '', 2), hint: '+/- N BUSINESS days for the fuzzy value-date match (weekends skipped).' },
        { mkey: 't2_amt_abs', ckey: 'match.t2_amt_abs', label: 'Tier 2 amount tolerance', tier: 'Tier 2', step: '0.1', def: _cfg.getNumber('match.t2_amt_abs', '', 50.0), hint: 'Amount tolerance in currency units (FSD: "$50 equivalent" — FX normalization pending).' },
        { mkey: 'name_fuzzy_pct', ckey: 'match.name_fuzzy_pct', label: 'Fuzzy name-match threshold', tier: 'Tier 2', step: '0.01', def: _cfg.getNumber('match.name_fuzzy_pct', '', 0.85), hint: 'Similarity 0-1 for the counterparty name fuzzy match, e.g. 0.85.' }
    ];

    // ---- load existing (copy = clone, edit = same record) ----
    var copyId = $sp.getParameter('copy') || '';
    var editId = $sp.getParameter('edit') || '';
    var loadId = editId || copyId;
    data.mode = editId ? 'edit' : 'new';
    var model = defaultModel();
    if (loadId) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (g.get(loadId)) {
            model.name = editId ? g.getValue('name') : (g.getValue('name') + ' (copy)');
            model.description = g.getValue('description');
            model.bu = g.getValue('bu') || '';
            model.subBu = g.getValue('sub_bu') || '';
            model.service = g.getValue('service') || '';
            model.workDriver = g.getValue('work_driver');
            model.activity = g.getValue('activity') || 'Compare & Match';
            // Back-fill BU/Sub-BU/Service for wizards created before the current taxonomy so the cascade shows them.
            var _rt = _cm.resolveTaxonomy(model.bu, model.subBu, model.service, model.workDriver);
            model.bu = _rt.bu; model.subBu = _rt.subBu; model.service = _rt.service;
            model.inputFormat = g.getValue('input_format') || 'Email';
            model.ingestionType = g.getValue('ingestion_type') || 'Mail';
            model.mailbox = g.getValue('mailbox');
            model.frequency = g.getValue('frequency') || 'Real-time';
            try { model.labels = JSON.parse(g.getValue('id_rules') || '[]'); } catch (el) { model.labels = []; }
            try { model.fields = JSON.parse(g.getValue('input_fields') || '[]'); } catch (e) { model.fields = []; }
            try { var tg = JSON.parse(g.getValue('tagging') || '[]'); if (tg.length) { model.tagging = tg; } } catch (etg) { /* keep defaults */ }
            try { var wb = JSON.parse(g.getValue('writeback') || '[]'); if (wb.length) { model.writeback = wb; } } catch (ewb) { /* keep defaults */ }
            var tmap = {};
            try { tmap = JSON.parse(g.getValue('mapping') || '{}'); } catch (e2) { tmap = {}; }
            model.targets = [{ system: g.getValue('target_system') || '', map: tmap }];
            // Per-driver Compare & Match tolerances (config_overrides JSON, keyed match.* -> model key).
            model.tolerances = {};
            try {
                var _ov = JSON.parse(g.getValue('config_overrides') || '{}') || {};
                for (var _t = 0; _t < data.cat.tolerances.length; _t++) {
                    var _td = data.cat.tolerances[_t];
                    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(_ov, _td.ckey)) { model.tolerances[_td.mkey] = '' + _ov[_td.ckey]; }
                }
            } catch (etol) { model.tolerances = {}; }
            if (editId) { model.id = loadId; model.status = g.getValue('status') || 'draft'; model.version = g.getValue('version') || 'v1'; }
        }
    }
    data.initModel = model;
    data.startStep = parseInt($sp.getParameter('step'), 10) || 1;

    // ---- Test a single field's extraction against sample input, via Now Assist (NASK) ----
    // Prompt-driven: the field's AI Prompt (+ example) becomes the runtime instruction handed to the
    // generic "Extract Field (Generic)" skill — so what the analyst edits in the wizard IS what runs.
    if (input && input.action === 'test') {
        data.testOutput = '';
        data.testStatus = '';
        var fieldName = input.testField || '';
        var sampleText = input.testInput || '';
        try {
            if (!sampleText) {
                data.testOutput = '(enter some input text to test)';
            } else {
                var instruction = 'Extract the field "' + fieldName + '". ' + (input.testPrompt || '');
                // Pair Example + Value into a one-shot worked example so the model learns input -> answer.
                if (input.testExample || input.testValue) {
                    instruction += '\n\nWorked example —';
                    if (input.testExample) { instruction += '\nINPUT: ' + input.testExample; }
                    if (input.testValue) { instruction += '\nVALUE: ' + input.testValue; }
                }
                // Skeleton is format-neutral, so the instruction must set the output format.
                instruction += '\n\nReturn ONLY the extracted value as plain text — no field name, no quotes, no JSON. If it is genuinely absent, return an empty string.';
                var gx = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.GenericFieldExtractor();
                var res = gx.extract(instruction, sampleText);
                data.testStatus = res.status || '';
                data.testOutput = (res.status === 'ok')
                    ? (res.value || '(the model returned an empty value — field not found)')
                    : ('(no value — status: ' + (res.status || 'unknown') + ')');
            }
        } catch (et) {
            data.testOutput = 'error: ' + et;
        }
        return;   // don't fall through to persist; the client keeps its working model
    }

    // ---- Prompt enhancer (custom fields): rewrite the manager's rough AI Prompt via a Now Assist skill.
    if (input && input.action === 'enhance_prompt') {
        data.enhanceStatus = '';
        data.enhanceText = '';
        try {
            var _pe = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.PromptEnhancer().enhance(input.enhanceDraft || '', input.enhanceField || '', input.enhanceMode || '');
            data.enhanceStatus = _pe.status || '';
            data.enhanceText = (_pe.status === 'ok') ? (_pe.text || '') : '';
        } catch (ee) {
            data.enhanceStatus = 'error';
        }
        return;   // don't fall through to persist; the client keeps its working model
    }

    // ---- Record-mode run: extract EVERY trade/row from a sample, using all configured fields ----
    // One skill call, one JSON object per row, so multi-trade emails stay aligned per row.
    if (input && input.action === 'run_extract') {
        data.runRows = [];
        data.runKeys = [];
        data.runStatus = '';
        var fields = input.runFields || [];
        var sample = input.runInput || '';
        function slug(s) { return ('' + (s || '')).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '') || 'field'; }
        try {
            if (!sample) { data.runStatus = 'no_input'; return; }
            if (!fields.length) { data.runStatus = 'no_fields'; return; }
            var keys = [], lines = [], seen = {};
            for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
                var f = fields[i] || {};
                var key = slug(f.name); var base = key, n = 2;
                while (seen[key]) { key = base + '_' + (n++); }
                seen[key] = true;
                keys.push({ key: key, label: f.name || key });
                var line = '- ' + key + ': ' + (f.prompt || f.name || key);
                var exParts = [];
                var fexr = f.examples || [];
                for (var xr = 0; xr < fexr.length; xr++) { var evr = fexr[xr]; if (evr && typeof evr === 'object') { evr = evr.value; } if (evr) { exParts.push('"' + evr + '"'); } }
                if (exParts.length) { line += ' (example values: ' + exParts.join(', ') + ')'; }
                else if (f.value) { line += ' (example value: "' + f.value + '")'; }
                lines.push(line);
            }
            var shape = [];
            for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) { shape.push('"' + keys[j].key + '":""'); }
            var instruction =
                'Extract EVERY trade / row present in the TEXT (there may be one row or many — e.g. each line of a table is a row). ' +
                'For EACH row, extract these fields:\n' + lines.join('\n') +
                '\n\nReturn ONLY a JSON array — one object per row, each object exactly {' + shape.join(',') + '}. ' +
                'No markdown, no code fences, no commentary. If a field is absent for a row, use "".';
            var gx = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.GenericFieldExtractor();
            var res = gx.extractRecords(instruction, sample);
            data.runStatus = res.status;
            data.runKeys = keys;
            data.runRaw = ('' + (res.raw || '')).substring(0, 4000);
            if (res.status === 'ok') {
                var _we = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.WizardExtractor();   // same deterministic guardrail as the runtime extraction
                var rows = [];
                for (var r = 0; r < res.rows.length; r++) {
                    var obj = res.rows[r] || {}, row = {};
                    for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
                        row[keys[k].key] = _we.validateField(keys[k].label, obj[keys[k].key]);
                    }
                    rows.push(row);
                }
                data.runRows = rows;
            }
        } catch (er) {
            data.runStatus = 'error';
            data.runRaw = '' + er;
        }
        return;
    }

    // ---- persist: save-as-draft / publish ----
    if (input && (input.action === 'save_draft' || input.action === 'publish') && input.model) {
        var m = input.model;
        var rec = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        var isUpdate = m.id && rec.get(m.id);
        if (!isUpdate) { rec.initialize(); }
        rec.setValue('name', m.name || 'Untitled wizard');
        rec.setValue('description', m.description || '');
        rec.setValue('bu', m.bu || '');
        rec.setValue('sub_bu', m.subBu || '');
        rec.setValue('service', m.service || '');
        rec.setValue('work_driver', m.workDriver || '');
        rec.setValue('activity', m.activity || '');
        rec.setValue('input_format', m.inputFormat || '');
        rec.setValue('ingestion_type', m.ingestionType || '');
        rec.setValue('mailbox', m.mailbox || '');
        rec.setValue('frequency', m.frequency || '');
        // Store the added field rows (name + type + AI prompt + example + value + per-field match config).
        var sel = [];
        var fs = m.fields || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < fs.length; i++) {
            if (fs[i].name) {
                var exs = [];
