                var fex = fs[i].examples || [];
                for (var xi = 0; xi < fex.length; xi++) {
                    var ev = fex[xi];
                    if (ev && typeof ev === 'object') { ev = ev.value; }   // migrate any old {input,value}
                    if (ev !== null && ev !== undefined && ('' + ev) !== '') { exs.push('' + ev); }
                }
                sel.push({
                    name: fs[i].name, type: fs[i].type || 'string',
                    prompt: fs[i].prompt || '', example: fs[i].example || '', value: fs[i].value || '', custom: !!fs[i].custom,
                    mapExclude: !!fs[i].mapExclude, examples: exs
                });
            }
        }
        rec.setValue('input_fields', JSON.stringify(sel));
        rec.setValue('id_rules', JSON.stringify(m.labels || []));
        rec.setValue('tagging', JSON.stringify(m.tagging || []));
        // Write-back: persist each outcome's ACTION LIST only (drop the transient _add UI field; tolerate legacy {action}).
        var wbOut = [], wbIn = m.writeback || [];
        for (var wbi = 0; wbi < wbIn.length; wbi++) {
            var wbActs = (wbIn[wbi].actions instanceof Array) ? wbIn[wbi].actions : (wbIn[wbi].action ? [wbIn[wbi].action] : []);
            wbOut.push({ scenario: wbIn[wbi].scenario, actions: wbActs });
        }
        rec.setValue('writeback', JSON.stringify(wbOut));
        var t0 = (m.targets && m.targets[0]) || { system: '', map: {} };
        rec.setValue('target_system', t0.system || '');
        rec.setValue('mapping', JSON.stringify(t0.map || {}));
        // Per-driver Compare & Match tolerances -> config_overrides (blank/invalid = inherit system default;
        // preserve any non-tolerance override keys already on the record).
        var _ovOut = {};
        try { _ovOut = JSON.parse(rec.getValue('config_overrides') || '{}') || {}; } catch (eo) { _ovOut = {}; }
        var _mt = m.tolerances || {};
        for (var _ti = 0; _ti < data.cat.tolerances.length; _ti++) {
            var _ck = data.cat.tolerances[_ti].ckey, _mk = data.cat.tolerances[_ti].mkey;
            var _val = ('' + (_mt[_mk] === undefined || _mt[_mk] === null ? '' : _mt[_mk])).trim();
            if (_val === '' || isNaN(parseFloat(_val))) { delete _ovOut[_ck]; } else { _ovOut[_ck] = _val; }
        }
        rec.setValue('config_overrides', JSON.stringify(_ovOut));
        rec.setValue('status', input.action === 'publish' ? 'published' : 'draft');
        rec.setValue('version', m.version || 'v1');
        if (isUpdate) { rec.update(); data.savedId = m.id; } else { data.savedId = '' + rec.insert(); }
        data.saved = true;
        data.savedAction = input.action;
        // (Wizard lifecycle is intentionally NOT written to the cashflow audit trail.)
    }
})();
]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>272098e98d38468bbf58b5aaf351b1a3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>OTC Wizard Builder</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_272098e98d38468bbf58b5aaf351b1a3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:24</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="nom-app">
  <header class="nom-top">
    <img class="nom-logo" ng-src="{{c.data.logo}}" alt="Nomura"/>
    <div class="nom-user">
      <div class="nom-user-btn" ng-click="c.userMenu = !c.userMenu">
        <span class="nom-role">{{c.data.role}}</span>
        <div class="nom-avatar">{{c.data.initials}}</div>
        <span class="nom-caret" ng-class="{open: c.userMenu}">▾</span>
      </div>
      <div class="nom-backdrop" ng-if="c.userMenu" ng-click="c.userMenu = false"></div>
      <div class="nom-menu" ng-if="c.userMenu">
        <div class="nom-menu-hd">
          <div class="nom-avatar sm">{{c.data.initials}}</div>
          <div class="nom-menu-id"><div class="nm-name">{{c.data.name}}</div><div class="nm-sub">{{c.data.role}}</div></div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="nom-menu-item" ng-click="c.signOut()"><span class="nm-ico">⏻</span> Sign out</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="wb-main">
    <div class="wb-titlebar">
      <div>
        <a ng-click="c.exit()" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#C8102E;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:4px;">← Back to Onboarding Wizard</a>
        <h1 class="wb-title">Wizard Builder</h1>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="wb-clear" ng-click="c.clearAll()">Clear</button>
    </div>

    <div class="wb-layout">
      <!-- Steps -->
      <div class="wb-content">
        <div class="wb-stepper">
          <div class="wb-step" ng-repeat="s in c.steps track by s.n" ng-class="{done: c.step > s.n, active: c.step === s.n}">
            <span class="wb-step-dot"><span ng-if="c.step > s.n">✓</span><span ng-if="c.step <= s.n">{{s.n}}</span></span>
            <span class="wb-step-lbl">{{s.label}}</span>
            <span class="wb-step-line" ng-if="!$last"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="wb-panel" ng-switch="c.step">

          <!-- STEP 1 : DEFINE -->
          <div ng-switch-when="1">
            <label class="wb-lbl">Name <span class="wb-req">*</span></label>
            <input class="wb-in" ng-model="c.model.name"/>
            <label class="wb-lbl">Description</label>
            <textarea class="wb-in wb-ta" ng-model="c.model.description" rows="3"></textarea>
            <div class="wb-enh-row">
              <button type="button" class="wb-enh-btn" ng-click="c.enhanceDescription()" ng-disabled="c.enhBusy || c.enhanceRow" title="Improve this description with AI">
                <span ng-if="c.enhBusy !== 'desc'">✨ Enhance description</span>
                <span ng-if="c.enhBusy === 'desc'">Enhancing…</span>
              </button>
              <span class="wb-enh-msg" ng-if="c.descEnhMsg">{{c.descEnhMsg}}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="wb-row2">
              <div>
                <label class="wb-lbl">BU <span class="wb-req">*</span></label>
                <select class="wb-in" ng-model="c.model.bu" ng-change="c.onBu()"><option value="">Choose</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.busList() track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="wb-lbl">Sub BU <span class="wb-req">*</span></label>
                <select class="wb-in" ng-model="c.model.subBu" ng-change="c.onSubBu()" ng-disabled="!c.model.bu"><option value="">{{c.model.bu ? 'Choose' : 'Select a BU first'}}</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.subBusFor() track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="wb-row2">
              <div>
                <label class="wb-lbl">Work driver <span class="wb-req">*</span></label>
                <select class="wb-in" ng-model="c.model.service" ng-change="c.onService()" ng-disabled="!c.model.subBu"><option value="">{{c.model.subBu ? 'Choose' : 'Select a Sub BU first'}}</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.servicesFor() track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="wb-lbl">Activity <span class="wb-req">*</span></label>
                <select class="wb-in" ng-model="c.model.workDriver" ng-change="c.onWorkDriver()" ng-disabled="!c.model.service"><option value="">{{c.model.service ? 'Choose' : 'Select a Work driver first'}}</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.workDriversFor() track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="wb-row2">
              <div>
                <label class="wb-lbl">Skill <span class="wb-req">*</span></label>
                <select class="wb-in" ng-model="c.model.activity" ng-change="c.onActivity()" ng-disabled="!c.model.workDriver"><option value="">{{c.model.workDriver ? 'Choose' : 'Select an Activity first'}}</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.activityOptions() track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
              </div>
              <div></div>
            </div>

            <!-- Pre-coded steps for the chosen work driver (revealed on selection; not editable here) -->
            <div class="wb-reveal" ng-if="c.model.activity">
              <div ng-if="c.hasActivitySteps()">
                <div class="wb-reveal-h">Steps for “{{c.model.activity}}”<span ng-if="c.model.workDriver || c.isCsg()"> — {{c.isCsg() ? 'CSG' : c.model.workDriver}}</span></div>
                <div class="wb-steplist">
                  <div class="wb-steprow" ng-repeat="st in c.activitySteps() track by st.n">
                    <span class="wb-stepnum">{{st.n}}</span>
                    <span class="wb-stepinfo">
                      <span class="wb-stepname">{{st.name}}</span>
                      <span class="wb-stepdesc">{{st.desc}}</span>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div ng-if="!c.hasActivitySteps()" class="wb-reveal-none">
                ⚠ Steps for “{{c.model.activity}}” are not defined yet — a developer needs to configure this activity’s sequence before it can be onboarded.
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- STEP 2 : INPUT CONFIGURATION (nested sub-pages) -->
          <div ng-switch-when="2">
            <div class="wb-subtabs">
              <button type="button" class="wb-subtab" ng-repeat="sb in c.visibleSubs() track by sb.n" ng-class="{done: c.sub > sb.n, active: c.sub === sb.n}" ng-click="c.goSub(sb.n)">
                <span class="wb-subtab-n">{{sb.n}}</span> {{sb.label}}
              </button>
            </div>

            <div ng-switch="c.sub">

              <!-- SUB 1 : INGESTION -->
              <div ng-switch-when="1">
                <h2 class="wb-h">Ingestion</h2>
                <div class="wb-h-sub">Choose how work arrives into this wizard.</div>
                <label class="wb-lbl">Type <span class="wb-req">*</span></label>
                <select class="wb-in" ng-model="c.model.ingestionType"><option ng-repeat="o in c.cat.ingestionTypes track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
                <div class="wb-row2" ng-if="c.model.ingestionType === 'Mail'">
                  <div>
                    <label class="wb-lbl">Mailbox <span class="wb-req">*</span></label>
                    <select class="wb-in" ng-model="c.model.mailbox"><option value="">Choose</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.cat.mailboxes track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label class="wb-lbl">Frequency</label>
                    <select class="wb-in" ng-model="c.model.frequency"><option ng-repeat="o in c.cat.frequencies track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="wb-note" ng-if="c.model.ingestionType !== 'Mail'">Configuration for <strong>{{c.model.ingestionType}}</strong> ingestion will be set up with the integration team.</div>
              </div>

              <!-- SUB 2 : EMAIL IDENTIFICATION -->
              <div ng-switch-when="2">
                <h2 class="wb-h">Email Identification</h2>
                <div class="wb-h-sub">Define the rules that decide which emails this wizard picks up.</div>
                <div class="wb-idrules">
                  <div class="wb-label" ng-repeat="lab in c.model.labels track by $index">
                    <div class="wb-label-top" ng-if="c.model.labels.length > 1">
                      <button type="button" class="wb-label-del" ng-click="c.removeLabel($index)">✕</button>
                    </div>
                    <label class="wb-lbl">Context of the emails to be filtered</label>
                    <textarea class="wb-in wb-ta" ng-model="lab.context" rows="3"></textarea>
                    <div class="wb-enh-row">
                      <button type="button" class="wb-enh-btn" ng-click="c.enhanceContext(lab)" ng-disabled="c.enhBusy || c.enhanceRow" title="Improve this context with AI">
                        <span ng-if="c.enhBusy !== lab">✨ Enhance context</span>
                        <span ng-if="c.enhBusy === lab">Enhancing…</span>
                      </button>
                      <span class="wb-enh-msg" ng-if="lab._enhMsg">{{lab._enhMsg}}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="wb-row2">
                      <div><label class="wb-lbl">Keywords present in the email</label><input class="wb-in" ng-model="lab.keywords"/></div>
                      <div><label class="wb-lbl">Specific sender emails to watch</label><input class="wb-in" ng-model="lab.senders"/></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="wb-row2">
                      <div><label class="wb-lbl">Subject line pattern / keywords</label><input class="wb-in" ng-model="lab.subject"/></div>
                      <div><label class="wb-lbl">Exclusion emails</label><input class="wb-in" ng-model="lab.exclusions"/></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="wb-toggles" style="margin-top:10px;display:flex;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                      <label class="wb-chk" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px;color:#4a5160;cursor:pointer;"><input type="checkbox" ng-model="lab.excludeReplies"/> Exclude replies & forwards (RE: / FW:)</label>
                      <label class="wb-chk" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px;color:#4a5160;cursor:pointer;"><input type="checkbox" ng-model="lab.excludeNoise"/> Exclude internal / noise sender domains</label>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- SUB 3 : FIELD EXTRACTION -->
              <div ng-switch-when="3">
                <h2 class="wb-h">Field Extraction</h2>
                <div class="wb-h-sub" ng-if="!c.isCsg()"><strong>Value Date, Amount, Currency and Direction</strong> are mandatory for Compare & Match and can't be removed. Add any optional fields below.</div>
                <div class="wb-h-sub" ng-if="c.isCsg()"><strong>RDM ID</strong> is the mandatory field for CSG — it is extracted from the email and used to resolve the entity in the EVE directory. Add any optional fields below.</div>

                <div class="wb-derived-line" ng-if="!c.isCsg()">
                  <span class="wb-derived-field">Counterparty</span>
                  <span class="wb-derived-badge">Extracted from EVE</span>
                  <span class="wb-derived-note">— derived automatically from the sender address.</span>
                </div>

                <div class="wb-fields-h">
                  <div class="wb-lbl" style="margin:0">Input fields <span class="wb-req">*</span></div>
                  <button type="button" class="wb-add" ng-click="c.addFieldRow()">+ Add field</button>
                </div>
                <div class="wb-ftable-wrap" ng-if="c.model.fields.length">
                  <table class="wb-ftable">
                    <thead>
                      <tr><th class="c-field">Field</th><th>AI Prompt</th><th class="c-ex">Example Value</th><th class="c-act"></th></tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      <tr ng-repeat="row in c.model.fields track by $index">
                        <td class="c-field">
                          <select ng-if="!row.custom" class="wb-in" ng-model="row.name" ng-change="c.onFieldPick(row)" ng-disabled="row.mandatory">
                            <option value="">Choose</option>
                            <option ng-repeat="fc in c.pickableCatalog() track by $index" value="{{fc.name}}" ng-disabled="c.isFieldTaken(fc.name, row)">{{fc.name}}<span ng-if="fc.mandatory"></span></option>
                            <option value="__custom__">Custom field</option>
                          </select>
                          <div ng-if="row.custom" class="wb-custom-field">
                            <input class="wb-in" ng-model="row.name"/>
                            <button type="button" class="wb-revert" ng-click="c.revertField(row)" title="Use a preconfigured field">↻</button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          <textarea class="wb-in wb-ta-cell" ng-model="row.prompt" rows="5" ng-disabled="!row.name"></textarea>
                          <div ng-if="row.custom" class="wb-enh-row">
                            <button type="button" class="wb-enh-btn" ng-click="c.enhancePrompt(row)" ng-disabled="c.enhanceRow" title="Improve this prompt with AI">
                              <span ng-if="c.enhanceRow !== row">✨ Enhance prompt</span>
                              <span ng-if="c.enhanceRow === row">Enhancing…</span>
                            </button>
                            <span class="wb-enh-msg" ng-if="row._enhanceMsg">{{row._enhanceMsg}}</span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td class="c-ex">
                          <div class="wb-ex" ng-repeat="ex in row.examples track by $index">
                            <input class="wb-in wb-ex-val" ng-model="row.examples[$index]" placeholder="example value" ng-disabled="!row.name"/>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td class="c-act">
                          <span ng-if="row.mandatory" class="wb-req-badge" title="Mandatory for Compare & Match">Required</span>
                          <button type="button" class="wb-field-del" ng-if="!row.mandatory" ng-click="c.removeFieldRow($index)" title="Remove">✕</button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
                <div class="wb-fields-empty" ng-if="!c.model.fields.length">No fields yet. Click <strong>+ Add field</strong> to add one.</div>
              </div>

              <!-- SUB 4 : TARGET MAPPING -->
              <div ng-switch-when="4">
                <h2 class="wb-h">Target Mapping</h2>
                <div class="wb-h-sub" ng-if="!c.isCsg()">Map the fields you want to compare & match to a target column.</div>
                <div class="wb-h-sub" ng-if="c.isCsg()">Choose the target system and map the extracted <strong>RDM ID</strong> to its identifier column.</div>

                <button type="button" class="wb-addtarget" ng-if="!c.model.targets[0].system" ng-click="c.addTarget()" title="Add a target system">+ Add a target system</button>

                <div class="wb-target" ng-repeat="t in c.model.targets track by $index">
                  <div class="wb-target-h">
                    <label class="wb-lbl">Target system {{$index + 1}} <span class="wb-req">*</span></label>
                    <button type="button" class="wb-target-del" ng-if="c.model.targets.length > 1" ng-click="c.removeTarget($index)">✕</button>
                  </div>
                  <select class="wb-in" ng-model="t.system" ng-change="c.onTargetSystem(t)"><option value="">Choose a system...</option><option ng-repeat="o in c.targetSystems() track by $index" value="{{o}}">{{o}}</option></select>

                  <div class="wb-map" ng-if="t.system">
                    <div class="wb-map-h">{{c.isCsg() ? 'MAP' : 'COMPARE & MAP'}} INPUT FIELDS → {{t.system}}</div>
                    <div class="wb-map-row" ng-repeat="f in c.mapFields() track by f.name">
                      <span class="wb-map-field">{{f.name}}</span>
                      <span class="wb-map-arrow">→</span>
                      <select class="wb-in" ng-model="t.map[f.name]"><option value="">Choose...</option><option ng-repeat="tf in c.targetFieldsFor(t.system) track by $index" value="{{tf}}">{{tf}}</option></select>
                      <button type="button" class="wb-map-x" ng-if="!f.mandatory" ng-click="c.excludeFromMap(f)" title="Extract only — don't compare/map this field">✕</button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="wb-map-empty" ng-if="!c.mapFields().length">No fields to map. Add one back from the extract-only list below.</div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="wb-mapexc" ng-if="c.excludedFields().length">
                  <div class="wb-mapexc-h">EXTRACTED ONLY · NOT COMPARED OR MAPPED</div>
                  <div class="wb-mapexc-list">
                    <span class="wb-mapexc-chip" ng-repeat="f in c.excludedFields() track by f.name">{{f.name}} <button type="button" class="wb-mapexc-add" ng-click="c.includeInMap(f)" title="Add back to compare / map">+</button></span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- SUB 5 : COMPARE & MATCH (tolerances) — OTC only, hidden for CSG via the sub-stepper -->
              <div ng-switch-when="5">
                <h2 class="wb-h">Compare & Match</h2>
                <div class="wb-h-sub">Set the matching tolerances for <strong>this work-driver</strong>. Leave a field blank to inherit the system default. These are read live by the matcher (Tier 1 exact → Tier 2 fuzzy → Tier 3 counterparty-less) — no redeploy needed.</div>
                <table class="wb-toltable">
                  <thead><tr><th class="c-tol">Tolerance</th><th class="c-tol-tier">Tier</th><th class="c-tol-in">This work-driver</th><th class="c-tol-def">System default</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>
                    <tr ng-repeat="tol in c.cat.tolerances track by tol.mkey">
                      <td class="c-tol"><div class="wb-tol-name">{{tol.label}}</div><div class="wb-tol-hint">{{tol.hint}}</div></td>
                      <td class="c-tol-tier"><span class="wb-tier" ng-class="{t1: tol.tier==='Tier 1', t2: tol.tier==='Tier 2'}">{{tol.tier}}</span></td>
                      <td class="c-tol-in">
                        <input type="number" step="{{tol.step}}" class="wb-in wb-tol-num" ng-model="c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey]" placeholder="{{tol.def}} (default)"/>
                        <button type="button" class="wb-tol-reset" ng-if="c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey] !== undefined && c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey] !== null && c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey] !== ''" ng-click="c.resetTol(tol.mkey)" title="Clear override — use the system default">↻ default</button>
                      </td>
                      <td class="c-tol-def"><span class="wz-mono">{{tol.def}}</span></td>
                    </tr>
                  </tbody>
                </table>
                <div class="wb-tol-note">Tier 1 amount matches if <span class="wz-mono">|diff| ≤ max(absolute, relative × amount)</span>. Tier 2 widens the value date by the window and the amount by the Tier-2 tolerances. Blank fields fall back to the system default shown on the right.</div>
              </div>

              <!-- SUB 6 : WRITE-BACK (OTC only — hidden for CSG via the sub-stepper) -->
              <div ng-switch-when="6">
                <h2 class="wb-h">Write-back</h2>
                <div class="wb-h-sub">Choose what happens after Compare & Match for each outcome.</div>
                <div class="wb-h-sub" style="margin-top:-6px;">Add one or more actions per outcome. Each action produces its own predetermined mail format the analyst can send.</div>
                <table class="wb-wbtable">
                  <thead><tr><th class="c-wb-out">Outcome</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>
                    <tr ng-repeat="w in c.model.writeback track by $index">
                      <td class="c-wb-out">
                        <span class="wb-wb-badge" ng-class="{'wb-ok': w.scenario === 'Matched', 'wb-warn': w.scenario === 'Mismatch', 'wb-bad': w.scenario === 'No Match'}">{{w.scenario}}</span>
                        <div class="wb-wb-desc">{{c.wbLabel(w.scenario)}}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <div class="wb-actchips">
                          <span class="wb-actchip" ng-repeat="a in w.actions track by $index">{{a}}<button type="button" class="wb-actchip-x" ng-click="c.wbRemoveAction(w, $index)" title="Remove">✕</button></span>
                          <span class="wb-actchip-none" ng-if="!w.actions.length">No action yet</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="wb-actadd" ng-if="c.wbAvailable(w).length">
                          <select class="wb-in wb-actadd-sel" ng-model="w._add">
                            <option value="">+ Add an action…</option>
                            <option ng-repeat="a in c.wbAvailable(w) track by $index" value="{{a}}">{{a}}</option>
                          </select>
                          <button type="button" class="wb-actadd-btn" ng-disabled="!w._add" ng-click="c.wbAddAction(w, w._add); w._add='';">Add</button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- STEP 3 : REVIEW -->
          <div ng-switch-when="3">
            <h2 class="wb-h">Review</h2>
            <div class="wb-h-sub">Review the configuration, then publish it.</div>
            <div class="wb-review">
              <div class="wb-rv"><div class="wb-rv-k">NAME</div><div class="wb-rv-v">{{c.model.name || '—'}}</div></div>
              <div class="wb-rv"><div class="wb-rv-k">BU / SUB-BU</div><div class="wb-rv-v">{{c.model.bu || '—'}}<span ng-if="c.model.subBu"> · {{c.model.subBu}}</span></div></div>
              <div class="wb-rv"><div class="wb-rv-k">WORK DRIVER</div><div class="wb-rv-v">{{c.model.service || '—'}}</div></div>
              <div class="wb-rv"><div class="wb-rv-k">ACTIVITY</div><div class="wb-rv-v">{{c.model.workDriver || '—'}}</div></div>
              <div class="wb-rv"><div class="wb-rv-k">SKILL</div><div class="wb-rv-v">{{c.model.activity || '—'}}</div></div>
              <div class="wb-rv"><div class="wb-rv-k">INGESTION</div><div class="wb-rv-v">{{c.model.ingestionType}}<span ng-if="c.model.ingestionType === 'Mail'"> · {{c.model.mailbox || '—'}} · {{c.model.frequency}}</span></div></div>
              <div class="wb-rv"><div class="wb-rv-k">INPUT FIELDS</div><div class="wb-rv-v">{{c.selectedCount()}} field(s)</div></div>
              <div class="wb-rv"><div class="wb-rv-k">TARGET SYSTEM(S)</div><div class="wb-rv-v">{{c.model.targets[0].system || '—'}}</div></div>
              <div class="wb-rv wb-rv-wide"><div class="wb-rv-k">DESCRIPTION</div><div class="wb-rv-v">{{c.model.description || '—'}}</div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="wb-rv-map-h">{{c.isCsg() ? 'Mapped' : 'Compared & mapped'}} → {{c.model.targets[0].system || '—'}}</div>
            <table class="wb-rv-table">
              <thead><tr><th>INPUT FIELD</th><th>TARGET ({{c.model.targets[0].system || '—'}})</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                <tr ng-repeat="f in c.mapFields() track by f.name">
                  <td>{{f.name}}</td>
                  <td><span class="wb-arrow-sm">→</span> <span class="wz-mono">{{c.model.targets[0].map[f.name] || '—'}}</span></td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
            <div class="wb-rv-exc" ng-if="c.excludedFields().length"><strong>Extracted only (not compared):</strong> <span ng-repeat="f in c.excludedFields() track by f.name">{{f.name}}<span ng-if="!$last">, </span></span></div>

            <div class="wb-rv-map-h" ng-if="!c.isCsg()">Write-back actions</div>
            <table class="wb-rv-table" ng-if="!c.isCsg()">
              <thead><tr><th>OUTCOME</th><th>ACTIONS</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                <tr ng-repeat="w in c.model.writeback track by $index">
                  <td>{{w.scenario}}</td>
                  <td><span ng-if="w.actions.length">{{w.actions.join(', ')}}</span><span ng-if="!w.actions.length" class="wz-mono">— not set —</span></td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>

            <div class="wb-rv-map-h" ng-if="!c.isCsg()">Compare & Match tolerances</div>
            <table class="wb-rv-table" ng-if="!c.isCsg()">
              <thead><tr><th>TOLERANCE</th><th>VALUE (this work-driver)</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                <tr ng-repeat="tol in c.cat.tolerances track by tol.mkey">
                  <td>{{tol.label}}</td>
                  <td>
                    <span ng-if="c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey] !== undefined && c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey] !== null && c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey] !== ''"><span class="wz-mono">{{c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey]}}</span> <span class="wb-tol-badge">override</span></span>
                    <span ng-if="c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey] === undefined || c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey] === null || c.model.tolerances[tol.mkey] === ''" class="wz-mono">{{tol.def}} (default)</span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          <!-- STEP 4 : PUBLISH (sample run + publish) -->
          <div ng-switch-when="4">
            <h2 class="wb-h">Publish</h2>
            <div class="wb-h-sub">Optionally run a sample through the configured fields, then publish. Extraction reads EVERY trade in the input and returns one row per trade.</div>

            <label class="wb-lbl">Sample input</label>
            <textarea class="wb-in wb-ta" ng-model="c.runInput" rows="8"></textarea>
            <div class="wb-run-actions">
              <button type="button" class="wb-btn primary" ng-click="c.runExtract()" ng-disabled="c.runBusy || !c.runInput || !c.selectedCount()">
                <span ng-if="!c.runBusy">Run extraction</span><span ng-if="c.runBusy">Running…</span>
              </button>
              <span class="wb-run-hint" ng-if="!c.selectedCount()">Add at least one field in Field Extraction first.</span>
            </div>

            <div class="wb-result" ng-if="c.runRows !== null && !c.runBusy">
              <div class="wb-result-h">
                <div>
                  <div class="wb-result-t">Extraction result</div>
                  <div class="wb-result-s">Extracted from {{c.model.ingestionType}} · {{c.model.mailbox || 'sample'}} via Now Assist</div>
                </div>
                <span class="wb-result-pct good" ng-if="c.runRows.length">{{c.runRows.length}} trade(s) · {{c.runKeys.length}} fields</span>
                <span class="wb-result-pct" ng-if="!c.runRows.length">{{c.runStatusText}}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="wb-ftable-wrap" ng-if="c.runRows.length">
                <table class="wb-result-table">
                  <thead><tr><th ng-repeat="k in c.runKeys track by $index">{{k.label}}</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>
                    <tr ng-repeat="row in c.runRows track by $index">
                      <td class="wz-mono" ng-repeat="k in c.runKeys track by $index">{{row[k.key] || '—'}}</td>
                    </tr>
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Footer nav -->
        <div class="wb-foot">
          <button type="button" class="wb-btn ghost" ng-click="c.back()" ng-disabled="c.step === 1"><span>←</span> Back</button>
          <div class="wb-foot-right">
            <button type="button" class="wb-btn ghost" ng-if="c.step === 4" ng-click="c.saveDraft()" ng-disabled="c.busy">Save as draft</button>
            <button type="button" class="wb-btn primary" ng-if="!c.isLastStep()" ng-click="c.next()" ng-disabled="!c.canNext()">Next <span>→</span></button>
            <button type="button" class="wb-btn primary" ng-if="c.step === 4" ng-click="c.publish()" ng-disabled="c.busy"><span>➤</span> Publish</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>
</div>
]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function controller($window) {
    var c = this;

    // International-format an amount for DISPLAY only (thousands separators). Leaves the raw value + the
    // numeric sort field untouched; preserves any trailing currency text and a leading sign.
    c.fmtAmt = function (v) {
        var s = ('' + (v == null ? '' : v)).trim();
        if (!s) { return ''; }
        var m = s.match(/^(-?)(\d[\d,]*)(\.\d+)?(.*)$/);
        if (!m) { return s; }
        return m[1] + m[2].replace(/,/g, '').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',') + (m[3] || '') + (m[4] || '');
    };

    // User menu (avatar dropdown) + sign out.
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () {
        $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm');
    };

    c.editing = false;
    c.dirty = false;

    // Cashflow navigator (multi-trade mails): Prev / [X] / Next -> open that cashflow's case.
    c.cfNavInput = (c.data && c.data.cfIndex) || 1;
    c.cfGo = function (n) {
        var total = (c.data && c.data.cfTotal) || 0;
        if (total < 1) { return; }
        n = parseInt(n, 10);
        if (isNaN(n)) { n = c.data.cfIndex; }
        if (n < 1) { n = 1; }
        if (n > total) { n = total; }
        if (n === c.data.cfIndex) { c.cfNavInput = c.data.cfIndex; return; } // no change -> snap input back
        var target = c.data.cfList[n - 1];
        if (target) { $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_nfotc_analyst&cf=' + target; }
    };
    // Numeric-only input: block minus / plus / exponent / decimal; Enter commits.
    c.cfKey = function (ev) {
        if (ev.key === 'Enter') { c.cfGo(c.cfNavInput); return; }
        if (['-', '+', 'e', 'E', '.'].indexOf(ev.key) !== -1) { ev.preventDefault(); }
    };

    // Switch the shown email (resets any in-progress edit).
    c.pick = function (id) {
        if (!id) { return; }
        c.data.id = id;
        c.data.action = '';
        c.editing = false;
        c.dirty = false;
        c.server.update();
    };

    // Enter edit mode — fields become editable.
    c.edit = function () { c.editing = true; };

    // A field changed — light up Save.
    c.markDirty = function () { c.dirty = true; c.data.saved = false; };

    // Save edited fields (only when there are unsaved changes).
    c.save = function () {
        if (!c.dirty) { return; }
        c.data.action = 'save';
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.editing = false; c.dirty = false; c.data.action = ''; });
    };

    // Confirm the extracted fields.
    c.confirm = function () {
        c.data.action = 'confirm';
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; });
    };

    // Analyst review (HITL) — write back the chosen match outcome for this cashflow.
    c.setOutcome = function (o) {
        c.data.action = 'outcome';
        c.data.outcomeChoice = o;
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; c.data.outcomeChoice = ''; });
    };
    c.resetOutcome = function () {
        c.data.action = 'reset_outcome';
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; });
    };
    // Confirm the Step 2 review — locks the outcome, turns step 2 green, reveals step 3.
    c.confirmReview = function () {
        c.data.action = 'confirm_review';
        c.data.outcomeChoice = c.data.effectiveOutcome;
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; c.data.outcomeChoice = ''; });
    };

    // Step 3 — next action (demo: records the decision, no real email is sent).
    c.sendAction = function () {
        c.data.action = 'send';
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; });
    };
    c.resolveAction = function () {
        c.data.action = 'resolve';
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; });
    };
}
]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* OTC Analyst Screen — widget CSS. Faithful copy of the UI Page NOM_CSS. */
.nom-app * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.nom-app { font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; background: #eef1f5; color: #20242c; min-height: 100vh; }
.nom-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; background: #fff; padding: 6px 26px; border-bottom: 3px solid #C8102E; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06); }
.nom-logo { height: 48px; width: auto; }
.nom-user { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.nom-role { font-size: 13px; color: #5b6270; }
.nom-avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #C8102E; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
/* --- user menu (avatar dropdown + sign out) --- */
.nom-top { position: relative; z-index: 30; }
.nom-user { position: relative; }
.nom-user-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 8px 4px 6px; border-radius: 9px; transition: background .12s; }
.nom-user-btn:hover { background: #f3f4f7; }
.nom-caret { color: #98a2b3; font-size: 10px; transition: transform .15s; }
.nom-caret.open { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.nom-backdrop { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 900; background: transparent; }
.nom-menu { position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 8px); z-index: 1000; width: 222px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(20,30,60,.18); overflow: hidden; }
.nom-menu-hd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f2f5; }
.nom-avatar.sm { width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 12px; }
.nom-menu-id .nm-name { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.nom-menu-id .nm-sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: #8a909a; margin-top: 1px; }
.nom-menu-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #fff; border: none; text-align: left; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #C0392B; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
.nom-menu-item:hover { background: #fdf2f2; }
.nom-menu-item .nm-ico { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; }

/* --- left sidebar nav --- */
.nom-side { width: 210px; flex-shrink: 0; background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid #e6e9ef; padding: 16px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.ns-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 11px 13px; border-radius: 9px; color: #5b6270; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background .12s, color .12s; }
.ns-item:hover { background: #f3f4f7; color: #1a1a2e; text-decoration: none; }
.ns-item.active { background: #fdeef0; color: #C8102E; }
.ns-ico { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* --- cashflow navigator (multi-trade mails) --- */
.cf-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05); }
.cf-btn { background: #C8102E; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; white-space: nowrap; }
.cf-btn:hover { background: #a50d26; }
.cf-btn:disabled { background: #e7e9ee; color: #9aa0a8; cursor: not-allowed; }
.cf-mid { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.cf-inp { width: 50px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid #d7dbe2; border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 4px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; font-family: inherit; color: #1a1a2e; }
.cf-inp:focus { outline: none; border-color: #C8102E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(200,16,46,.12); }
.cf-inp::-webkit-inner-spin-button, .cf-inp::-webkit-outer-spin-button { -webkit-appearance: none; margin: 0; }

/* --- stepped flow (1 = extracted, 2 = compare) --- */
.step { display: flex; gap: 18px; }
.step-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 36px; }
.step-badge { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: #C8102E; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(200,16,46,.3); }
.step-badge.done { background: #1E7E45; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(30,126,69,.3); }
.step-line { flex: 1; width: 2px; background: #d7dbe2; margin-top: 8px; min-height: 24px; }
.step-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding-bottom: 26px; }
.step-hd { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; margin: 4px 0 14px; }
.step-sub { font-size: 12.5px; color: #6b7280; margin: -8px 0 16px; }

/* --- step 3: decide next action (derived draft) --- */
.na-card { padding: 24px 28px; }

.na-sub { font-size: 12.5px; color: #6b7280; margin: 4px 0 16px; }

.na-body:focus { outline: none; border-color: #C8102E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(200,16,46,.1); }

/* --- analyst review (HITL writeback) box --- */
.ar-box { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 24px; margin-top: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05); }

.cm-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; }

@media (max-width: 900px) { .cm-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.cm-cand { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 22px; margin-top: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05); }

.cm-cand-tbl td { padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f1f5; color: #20242c; white-space: nowrap; }

.cm-cand-best td { background: #f2f9f4; }

.cm-cand-tag { background: #1E7E45; color: #fff; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 9px; margin-left: 7px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .3px; }
.cm-cand-cpx { color: #C0392B; font-weight: 700; margin-left: 6px; }
.cm-mono { font-family: Consolas, monospace; }
.nom-body { display: flex; min-height: calc(100vh - 55px); }
.nom-main { flex: 1; padding: 26px 30px; overflow: auto; }
.nom-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.nom-head h1 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a2e; margin: 0; line-height: 1.1; }

.nom-back { margin-left: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; line-height: 1; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #C8102E; background: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 18px; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid #f0c8ce; }
.nom-back:hover { background: #fdeef0; text-decoration: none; }

.nom-select { padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid #cfd4dc; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: #1a1a2e; background: #fff; min-width: 230px; cursor: pointer; }

.nom-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 22px; align-items: start; }
.nom-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e9ef; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05); overflow: hidden; }
.nom-card-h { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14.5px; color: #1a1a2e; padding: 14px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f4; }
.nom-pills { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.pill { font-size: 10.5px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-weight: 600; }
.pill-red { background: #fdeef0; color: #C8102E; }
.pill-grey { background: #eef0f4; color: #6b7280; }
.nom-meta { padding: 14px 18px 6px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.9; color: #3a3f4a; }
.nom-meta b { color: #1a1a2e; font-weight: 600; display: inline-block; min-width: 82px; }
.nom-mailbody { padding: 6px 18px 20px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; color: #41474f; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; max-height: 360px; overflow: auto; border-top: 1px solid #f2f3f6; margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 14px; }
.nom-fields { padding: 6px 18px; }
.nom-frow { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 11px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f2f5; font-size: 13px; }
.nom-frow:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.nom-flabel { color: #6b7280; }
.nom-fval { color: #1a1a2e; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; max-width: 60%; word-break: break-word; }
.nom-empty { color: #c2c6cd; font-weight: 400; }
.nom-actbar { padding: 16px 18px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-top: 1px solid #eef0f4; }
.nom-btn { background: #C8102E; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(200,16,46,.3); }
.nom-btn:hover { background: #a50d26; }
.nom-btn.done { background: #1e7a34; box-shadow: none; cursor: default; }
.nom-inp { border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #1a1a2e; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; font-family: inherit; text-align: right; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; width: 58%; max-width: 58%; }
.nom-inp.on { border-color: #d7dbe2; background: #fff; }
.nom-inp.on:focus { outline: none; border-color: #C8102E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(200,16,46,.12); }
.nom-ebtn { margin-left: 8px; background: #eef0f4; color: #3a3f4a; border: none; border-radius: 16px; padding: 5px 13px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
.nom-ebtn:hover { background: #e2e6ec; }
.nom-ebtn.on { background: #fdeef0; color: #C8102E; }
.nom-save:disabled { background: #e7e9ee; color: #9aa0a8; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }
.nom-save:disabled:hover { background: #e7e9ee; }
.nom-saved { color: #1e7a34; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; margin-right: 2px; }

/* Per-trade table */
.tr-wrap { padding: 4px 12px 6px; overflow-x: auto; }
.tr-tbl { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }
.tr-tbl th { text-align: left; color: #6b7280; font-weight: 600; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .3px; padding: 6px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f4; white-space: nowrap; }
.tr-tbl td { padding: 5px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f4f5f7; color: #1a1a2e; white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; }
.tr-tbl tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.tr-num { width: 22px; color: #9aa0a8; font-weight: 600; }
.tr-inp { width: 100%; min-width: 78px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #1a1a2e; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 5px; }
.tr-inp.on { border-color: #d7dbe2; background: #fff; }

.tr-amt { min-width: 100px; }
.tr-ccy { min-width: 46px; }
.tr-badge { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
.m-ok { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1E7E45; }
.m-warn { background: #fdf1e3; color: #B7791F; }
.m-bad { background: #fbe9e7; color: #C0392B; }
