.tr-cmp:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description>Mail contents + extracted settlement fields for a Names and Forms OTC record, with Confirm.</description><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>true</has_preview><id>nfotcbsm-analyst</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
}]]></link><name>OTC Analyst Screen</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * OTC Analyst Screen — Service Portal widget SERVER script.
 * Faithful replica of the classic UI Page (AnalystScreen.server.js): shows one email's
 * mail contents + extracted fields, with a Confirm action and an email picker.
 * Runs server-side (GlideRecord) and reuses the EmlFieldExtractor Script Include for the
 * mail contents. Talks to the client via data / input (c.server.update).
 */
(function () {
    var ex = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.EmlFieldExtractor();
    function setIf(gr, col, v) { if (v !== null && v !== undefined) { gr.setValue(col, '' + v); } }
    // Value date: store ISO (YYYY-MM-DD, needed for matching), show/edit as DD-MM-YYYY.
    function vdDisp(v) { var m = ('' + (v || '')).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/); return m ? (m[3] + '-' + m[2] + '-' + m[1]) : ('' + (v || '')); }
    function vdIso(v) { v = '' + (v || ''); if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) { return v; } var m = v.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{4})$/); return m ? (m[3] + '-' + ('0' + m[1]).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + m[2]).slice(-2)) : v; }
    // RFC2822 Date header ("Mon, 16 Jun 2026 09:23:45 +0000") -> "16-06-2026 09:23:45".
    function fmtReceived(raw) {
        raw = '' + (raw || '');
        var m = raw.match(/(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]{3})[A-Za-z]*\s+(\d{4})\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?/);
        if (!m) { return raw; }
        var mo = { jan: '01', feb: '02', mar: '03', apr: '04', may: '05', jun: '06', jul: '07', aug: '08', sep: '09', oct: '10', nov: '11', dec: '12' }[m[2].toLowerCase()] || '01';
        return ('0' + m[1]).slice(-2) + '-' + mo + '-' + m[3] + ' ' + ('0' + m[4]).slice(-2) + ':' + m[5] + ':' + (m[6] || '00');
    }

    // Step 3 draft — pull the counterparty settlement address out of the From header.
    function extractEmail(s) {
        s = '' + (s || '');
        var m = s.match(/<([^>]+)>/); if (m) { return m[1].trim(); }
        m = s.match(/[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.\w+/); return m ? m[0] : '';
    }
    // Amount -> thousands-separated with 2 decimals.
    function fmtAmt(v) {
        var n = parseFloat(('' + (v || '')).replace(/,/g, ''));
        if (isNaN(n)) { return '' + (v || '-'); }
        var p = n.toFixed(2).split('.');
        p[0] = p[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
        return p.join('.');
    }
    // Flip our-POV direction back to the counterparty's POV for outbound replies.
    function flipDir(d) {
        var s = ('' + (d || '')).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (s === 'pay') { return 'Receive'; }
        if (s === 'receive') { return 'Pay'; }
        return d || '-';
    }
    // A labelled key/value line, values aligned in the monospace draft.
    function drow(label, val) { return '  ' + (label + '                    ').slice(0, 18) + ('' + (val === '' || val == null ? '-' : val)); }
    function detailBlock(ref, ccy, amt, dir, vd) {
        return drow('Trade reference', ref) + '\n' + drow('Currency', ccy) + '\n' +
            drow('Amount', fmtAmt(amt)) + '\n' + drow('Direction', dir) + '\n' + drow('Value date', vd);
    }

    // Step 3 draft, DERIVED from the effective outcome (matched / mismatch / no_match).
    function buildDraft(outcome) {
        var ref = data.reference || '(no reference)';
        var ccy = data.currency || '', amt = data.amount || '', vd = data.value_date || '';
        var cp = data.counterparty || 'Counterparty';
        var cpEmail = extractEmail(data.mail.from) || '(counterparty settlement address)';
        var subj = ref + ' (' + ccy + ', value ' + vd + ')';
        var greet = 'Dear ' + cp + ' Settlements,\n\n';
        var quoted = '\n\n-----  Original message  -----\nFrom: ' + (data.mail.from || '') + '\nSubject: ' + (data.mail.subject || '') + '\n\n' + (data.mail.body || '');

        if (outcome === 'matched') {
            var blkM = detailBlock(ref, ccy, amt, flipDir(data.direction), vd);
            return { title: 'Reply to counterparty — agree the details',
                to: cpEmail, subject: 'RE: Trade confirmation — ' + subj,
                body: greet + 'Thank you for your settlement confirmation. We confirm that we agree the details below, including the settlement instructions.\n\n' + blkM + '\n\nNo further action is required from your side. The payment will settle on the value date shown.\n\nKind regards,\nSettlements' + quoted,
                sendLabel: 'Send to counterparty' };
        }
        if (outcome === 'no_match') {
            var blkN = detailBlock(ref, ccy, amt, flipDir(data.direction), vd);
            return { title: 'Reply to counterparty — no matching booking found',
                to: cpEmail, subject: 'RE: Trade confirmation — ' + subj,
                body: greet + 'Thank you for your settlement confirmation. We are unable to locate a matching booking in our systems for the cash flow below:\n\n' + blkN + '\n\nSo that we can investigate further, please could you share:\n  •  your internal trade reference and any UTI / USI\n  •  the executing desk or trader on your side\n  •  the execution venue and timestamp\n  •  confirmation of the legal entity you booked against\n\nWe will hold the payment pending your response.\n\nKind regards,\nSettlements' + quoted,
                sendLabel: 'Send to counterparty' };
        }
        // mismatch -> refer to Middle Office (internal; both sides shown from our POV so direction agrees).
        var bk = (data.cmp && data.cmp.booking) ? data.cmp.booking : null;
        var diffs = (data.cmp && data.cmp.banner) ? data.cmp.banner.diffs.concat(data.cmp.banner.miss).join(', ') : '';
        var cpBlk = detailBlock(ref, ccy, amt, data.direction, vd);
        var bkBlk = bk ? detailBlock(bk.bank_trade_ref || bk.reference || '-', bk.currency || ccy, bk.amount, bk.direction || data.direction, bk.value_date || vd) : '  (booking details unavailable)';
        return { title: 'Refer to Middle Office',
            to: 'middleoffice@abc.com', subject: 'Referral: Trade confirmation — ' + subj,
            body: 'Referring the following for review. The counterparty’s details and our booking agree in part but differ on the field(s)' + (diffs ? ': ' + diffs : ' noted below') + '.\n\nCounterparty: ' + cp + '\nSource email: ' + data.ref + '\n\nCounterparty submitted:\n' + cpBlk + '\n\nBooked by the bank:\n' + bkBlk + '\n\nPlease advise on the correct economics so we can respond to the counterparty.\n\nRegards,\nSettlements' + quoted,
            sendLabel: 'Send to Middle Office' };
    }

    // Build one trade row for the table.
    function mkTrade(sysId, ref, vd, amt, ccy, dir, prod) {
        return {
            sys_id: sysId, reference: ref || '', value_date: vdDisp(vd), amount: amt || '',
            currency: ccy || '', direction: dir || '', product_type: prod || ''
        };
    }

    // Save action (c.save() -> input.action = 'save'): persist the shared counterparty + every edited
    // trade row back onto its cashflow child, and keep the parent summary in sync with the first trade.
    if (input && input.action === 'save' && input.id) {
        if (input.cfSysId) {
            var cfg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
            if (cfg.get(input.cfSysId)) {
                setIf(cfg, 'reference', input.reference);
                setIf(cfg, 'currency', input.currency);
                setIf(cfg, 'amount', input.amount);
                setIf(cfg, 'direction', input.direction);
                setIf(cfg, 'value_date', vdIso(input.value_date));
                cfg.update();
            }
        }
        var sg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        if (sg.get(input.id)) { setIf(sg, 'counterparty_name', input.counterparty); sg.update(); }
        data.saved = true;
    }

    // Confirm action (c.confirm() -> input.action = 'confirm'): confirm THIS cashflow only, so each
    // cashflow in a multi-trade mail is confirmed independently. Mails with no extracted cashflow
    // fall back to confirming the email record itself.
    if (input && input.action === 'confirm') {
        if (input.cfSysId) {
            var ccg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
            if (ccg.get(input.cfSysId)) { ccg.setValue('confirmed', 'true'); ccg.update(); }
        } else if (input.id) {
            var cg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            if (cg.get(input.id)) { cg.setValue('review_status', 'awaiting_review'); cg.update(); }
        }
    }

    // Analyst outcome writeback (HITL): confirm/override the match outcome for THIS cashflow.
    if (input && input.action === 'outcome' && input.cfSysId && input.outcomeChoice) {
        var og = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        // Changing the outcome un-confirms the review (step 2 back to amber, step 3 hidden until re-confirmed).
        if (og.get(input.cfSysId)) { og.setValue('analyst_outcome', input.outcomeChoice); og.setValue('review_confirmed', ''); og.setValue('resolution', ''); og.update(); }
    }
    if (input && input.action === 'reset_outcome' && input.cfSysId) {
        var rg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (rg.get(input.cfSysId)) { rg.setValue('analyst_outcome', ''); rg.setValue('review_confirmed', ''); rg.setValue('resolution', ''); rg.update(); }
    }
    // Confirm the Step 2 review -> locks the (auto/overridden) outcome and turns step 2 green.
    if (input && input.action === 'confirm_review' && input.cfSysId) {
        var cvg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (cvg.get(input.cfSysId)) {
            if (input.outcomeChoice) { cvg.setValue('analyst_outcome', input.outcomeChoice); }
            cvg.setValue('review_confirmed', 'true');
            cvg.update();
        }
    }
    // Step 3 next-action writeback (demo — records the decision; no real email is sent).
    if (input && input.action === 'send' && input.cfSysId) {
        var sd = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (sd.get(input.cfSysId)) { sd.setValue('resolution', 'sent'); sd.update(); }
    }
    if (input && input.action === 'resolve' && input.cfSysId) {
        var rd = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (rd.get(input.cfSysId)) { rd.setValue('resolution', 'closed'); rd.update(); }
    }

    // Which record to show: a dashboard cashflow (?cf) resolves to its parent email; ?eml opens an
    // email directly; else client pick (input.id); else the latest extracted/partial; else latest any.
    var cfParam = $sp.getParameter('cf') || (input && input.cfParam) || '';
    var emlParam = $sp.getParameter('eml') || (input && input.emlParam) || '';
    var emailFromCf = '';
    if (cfParam) { var cfr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); if (cfr.get(cfParam)) { emailFromCf = cfr.getValue('email'); } }
    var wantId = (input && input.id) || emailFromCf || emlParam || '';
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    var found = wantId ? gr.get(wantId) : false;
    if (!found) {
        var q = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        q.addQuery('extraction_status', 'IN', 'extracted,partial');
        q.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); q.setLimit(1); q.query();
        if (q.next()) {
            gr = q;
        } else {
            var a = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            a.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); a.setLimit(1); a.query();
            if (!a.next()) { data.empty = true; return; }
            gr = a;
        }
    }

    data.empty = false;
    data.id = gr.getUniqueValue();
    // Header title = the email id (file name) without the .eml extension, e.g. "EML-0007".
    data.ref = ('' + (gr.getValue('name') || '')).replace(/\.eml$/i, '') || '(no id)';
    data.counterparty = gr.getValue('counterparty_name');
    // This case screen shows ONE trade's detail: the clicked cashflow (?cf). Fall back to the email's
    // first cashflow, or the email summary when a mail has no extracted cashflow.
    var cfRec = null;
    if (cfParam) { var cfg2 = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); if (cfg2.get(cfParam) && cfg2.getValue('email') === gr.getUniqueValue()) { cfRec = cfg2; } }
    if (!cfRec) { var f1 = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); f1.addQuery('email', gr.getUniqueValue()); f1.orderBy('flow_index'); f1.setLimit(1); f1.query(); if (f1.next()) { cfRec = f1; } }
    data.cfSysId = cfRec ? cfRec.getUniqueValue() : '';
    data.analystOutcome = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('analyst_outcome') || '') : '';
    data.reviewConfirmed = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('review_confirmed') === 'true') : false;
    data.reference = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('reference') : '';
    data.currency = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('currency') : '';
    data.amount = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('amount') : '';
    data.direction = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('direction') : '';
    data.value_date = vdDisp(cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('value_date') : '');
    data.confirmed = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('confirmed') === 'true') : (gr.getValue('review_status') === 'awaiting_review');
    data.cfParam = cfParam;   // round-tripped so ?cf survives c.server.update() (confirm/save reloads)
    data.emlParam = emlParam;

    // Cashflow navigator (multi-trade mails): ordered list of the email's cashflows + current index.
    data.cfList = [];
    var lcf = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
    lcf.addQuery('email', gr.getUniqueValue());
    lcf.orderBy('flow_index');
    lcf.query();
    while (lcf.next()) { data.cfList.push(lcf.getUniqueValue()); }
    data.cfTotal = data.cfList.length;
    data.cfIndex = 0;
    for (var ni = 0; ni < data.cfList.length; ni++) { if (data.cfList[ni] === data.cfSysId) { data.cfIndex = ni + 1; break; } }

    // Mail contents from the raw .eml (NOT the extracted .xlsx). An attachment mail carries two
    // sys_attachments — the .eml and the materialised Cashflows.xlsx — so pick the .eml explicitly
    // (else mailContents would parse the spreadsheet bytes as the email -> garbage). Other files
    // become the "Attachment:" line; the .eml sys_id backs the header Download button.
    data.mail = { to: '', from: '', cc: '', subject: '', body: '', attachment: '', received: '' };
    data.emlAttId = '';
    var attNames = [];
    var ag = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
    ag.addQuery('table_name', 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    ag.addQuery('table_sys_id', gr.getUniqueValue());
    ag.orderBy('sys_created_on');
    ag.query();
    while (ag.next()) {
        var ctype = ag.getValue('content_type') || '';
        var fname = ag.getValue('file_name') || '';
        if (!data.emlAttId && (ctype === 'message/rfc822' || /\.eml$/i.test(fname))) {
            data.emlAttId = ag.getUniqueValue();
        } else {
            attNames.push(fname);
        }
    }
    if (data.emlAttId) {
        var m = ex.mailContents(data.emlAttId) || {};
        data.mail.to = m.to || ''; data.mail.from = m.from || ''; data.mail.cc = m.cc || '';
        data.mail.subject = m.subject || ''; data.mail.body = m.body || '';
        data.mail.received = fmtReceived(m.date);
    }
    data.mail.attachment = attNames.join(', ');

    // Email picker options (all uploaded emails).
    data.emails = [];
    var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    g.orderBy('name'); g.setLimit(500); g.query();
    while (g.next()) {
        var eid = g.getUniqueValue();
        var lbl = g.getValue('name') || eid;
        var st = g.getValue('extraction_status');
        if (st) { lbl += '  ·  ' + st; }
        data.emails.push({ id: eid, label: lbl });
    }

    // Step 2 (Compare & Match): only after the analyst confirms the extracted fields. Compares the
    // clicked cashflow (?cf); without one, the email's first cashflow (or the email as a whole).
    data.dashUrl = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_analystdashboard';
    data.cmp = null;
    if (data.confirmed) {
        var cm = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch();
        data.cmp = data.cfSysId ? cm.buildData(data.cfSysId, '') : cm.buildData('', gr.getUniqueValue());
    }
    // Effective outcome = the analyst's override if set, else the system's computed outcome.
    data.effectiveOutcome = data.analystOutcome || (data.cmp ? data.cmp.systemOutcome : '');
    // Step 3: the derived next-action draft + its resolution state.
    data.resolution = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('resolution') || '') : '';
    data.draft = (data.confirmed && data.cmp && data.effectiveOutcome) ? buildDraft(data.effectiveOutcome) : null;

    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();

    // Nomura logo (same mark used across the app).
    data.logo = 'data:image/png;base64,';
})();
]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>ee6e7955dc764bd6b1f92d8948aa9474</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>OTC Analyst Screen</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_ee6e7955dc764bd6b1f92d8948aa9474</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:24</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div>
  <div ng-if="c.data.empty" style="font-family:Arial;padding:50px;color:#555">
    No Names and Forms OTC records yet. Drop a relevant email first, then reload.
  </div>

  <div class="nom-app" ng-if="!c.data.empty">
    <header class="nom-top">
      <img class="nom-logo" ng-src="{{c.data.logo}}" alt="Nomura"/>
      <div class="nom-user">
        <div class="nom-user-btn" ng-click="c.userMenu = !c.userMenu">
          <span class="nom-role">{{c.data.role}}</span>
          <div class="nom-avatar">US</div>
          <span class="nom-caret" ng-class="{open: c.userMenu}">▾</span>
        </div>
        <div class="nom-backdrop" ng-if="c.userMenu" ng-click="c.userMenu = false"></div>
        <div class="nom-menu" ng-if="c.userMenu">
          <div class="nom-menu-hd">
            <div class="nom-avatar sm">US</div>
            <div class="nom-menu-id"><div class="nm-name">Analyst</div><div class="nm-sub">OTC Settlements</div></div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="nom-menu-item" ng-click="c.signOut()"><span class="nm-ico">⏻</span> Sign out</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <div class="nom-body">
      <main class="nom-main">
        <div class="nom-head">
          <h1>{{c.data.ref}}</h1>
          <a ng-if="c.data.emlAttId" class="nom-dl" ng-href="/sys_attachment.do?sys_id={{c.data.emlAttId}}" title="Download this email (.eml)">Download</a>
          <a class="nom-back" ng-href="{{c.data.dashUrl}}">← Dashboard</a>
        </div>

        <!-- ===== Step 1: Extracted from email ===== -->
        <div class="step">
          <div class="step-rail">
            <div class="step-badge" ng-class="{done: c.data.confirmed}">1</div>
            <div class="step-line" ng-if="c.data.confirmed"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="step-main">
            <div class="step-hd">Extracted from email</div>

            <div class="nom-cols">
              <section class="nom-card">
                <div class="nom-card-h">Mail contents</div>
                <div class="nom-meta">
                  <div><b>To:</b> {{c.data.mail.to}}</div>
                  <div><b>From:</b> {{c.data.mail.from}}</div>
                  <div><b>Subject:</b> {{c.data.mail.subject}}</div>
                  <div ng-if="c.data.mail.received"><b>Received:</b> {{c.data.mail.received}}</div>
                  <div ng-if="c.data.mail.attachment"><b>Attachment:</b> {{c.data.mail.attachment}}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="nom-mailbody">{{c.data.mail.body}}</div>
              </section>

              <div class="nom-col-right">
                <div class="cf-nav" ng-if="c.data.cfTotal > 1">
                  <button class="cf-btn" ng-disabled="c.data.cfIndex <= 1" ng-click="c.cfGo(c.data.cfIndex - 1)">← Prev</button>
                  <div class="cf-mid">Cashflow
                    <input type="number" class="cf-inp" min="1" max="{{c.data.cfTotal}}" ng-model="c.cfNavInput" ng-keydown="c.cfKey($event)" ng-blur="c.cfGo(c.cfNavInput)"/>
                    of {{c.data.cfTotal}}
                  </div>
                  <button class="cf-btn" ng-disabled="c.data.cfIndex >= c.data.cfTotal" ng-click="c.cfGo(c.data.cfIndex + 1)">Next →</button>
                </div>

                <section class="nom-card">
                <div class="nom-card-h">Extracted fields
                  <span class="nom-pills">
                    <span ng-if="c.data.confirmed" class="pill pill-green">✓ Confirmed by analyst</span>
                    <button ng-if="!c.editing" class="nom-ebtn" ng-click="c.edit()">✎ <span ng-if="!c.data.confirmed">Edit</span><span ng-if="c.data.confirmed">Re-confirm fields</span></button>
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div class="nom-fields">
                  <div class="nom-frow">
                    <div class="nom-flabel">Counterparty</div>
                    <input ng-if="!c.data.confirmed || c.editing" class="nom-inp" ng-class="{on: c.editing}" ng-model="c.data.counterparty" ng-readonly="!c.editing" ng-change="c.markDirty()"/>
                    <div ng-if="c.data.confirmed && !c.editing" class="nom-fval"><span ng-if="c.data.counterparty">{{c.data.counterparty}}</span><span ng-if="!c.data.counterparty" class="nom-empty">—</span></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="nom-frow">
                    <div class="nom-flabel">Trade Reference</div>
                    <input ng-if="!c.data.confirmed || c.editing" class="nom-inp" ng-class="{on: c.editing}" ng-model="c.data.reference" ng-readonly="!c.editing" ng-change="c.markDirty()"/>
                    <div ng-if="c.data.confirmed && !c.editing" class="nom-fval"><span ng-if="c.data.reference">{{c.data.reference}}</span><span ng-if="!c.data.reference" class="nom-empty">—</span></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="nom-frow">
                    <div class="nom-flabel">Value Date (DD-MM-YYYY)</div>
                    <input ng-if="!c.data.confirmed || c.editing" class="nom-inp" ng-class="{on: c.editing}" ng-model="c.data.value_date" ng-readonly="!c.editing" ng-change="c.markDirty()"/>
                    <div ng-if="c.data.confirmed && !c.editing" class="nom-fval"><span ng-if="c.data.value_date">{{c.data.value_date}}</span><span ng-if="!c.data.value_date" class="nom-empty">—</span></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="nom-frow">
                    <div class="nom-flabel">Amount</div>
                    <input ng-if="!c.data.confirmed || c.editing" class="nom-inp" ng-class="{on: c.editing}" ng-model="c.data.amount" ng-readonly="!c.editing" ng-change="c.markDirty()"/>
                    <div ng-if="c.data.confirmed && !c.editing" class="nom-fval"><span ng-if="c.data.amount">{{c.fmtAmt(c.data.amount)}}</span><span ng-if="!c.data.amount" class="nom-empty">—</span></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="nom-frow">
                    <div class="nom-flabel">Currency Pair</div>
                    <input ng-if="!c.data.confirmed || c.editing" class="nom-inp" ng-class="{on: c.editing}" ng-model="c.data.currency" ng-readonly="!c.editing" ng-change="c.markDirty()"/>
                    <div ng-if="c.data.confirmed && !c.editing" class="nom-fval"><span ng-if="c.data.currency">{{c.data.currency}}</span><span ng-if="!c.data.currency" class="nom-empty">—</span></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="nom-frow">
                    <div class="nom-flabel">Direction</div>
                    <input ng-if="!c.data.confirmed || c.editing" class="nom-inp" ng-class="{on: c.editing}" ng-model="c.data.direction" ng-readonly="!c.editing" ng-change="c.markDirty()"/>
                    <div ng-if="c.data.confirmed && !c.editing" class="nom-fval"><span ng-if="c.data.direction">{{c.data.direction}}</span><span ng-if="!c.data.direction" class="nom-empty">—</span></div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="nom-actbar" ng-if="!c.data.confirmed || c.editing">
                  <span ng-if="c.data.saved" class="nom-saved">✓ Saved</span>
                  <button class="nom-btn nom-save" ng-disabled="!c.dirty" ng-click="c.save()">Save</button>
                  <button class="nom-btn" ng-click="c.confirm()">✓ Confirm Extracted fields</button>
                </div>
              </section>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- ===== Step 2: Compare & Match (after confirmation) ===== -->
        <div class="step" ng-if="c.data.confirmed && c.data.cmp">
          <div class="step-rail">
            <div class="step-badge" ng-class="{done: c.data.reviewConfirmed}">2</div>
            <div class="step-line" ng-if="c.data.reviewConfirmed"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="step-main">
            <div class="step-hd">Compare & Match</div>

            <div ng-if="c.data.cmp.found">
              <div class="cm-banner" ng-class="'cm-' + c.data.cmp.banner.kind">
                <div class="cm-b-title">{{c.data.cmp.banner.title}}</div>
                <div class="cm-b-msg">
                  {{c.data.cmp.banner.msg}}
                  <span class="chip" ng-repeat="d in c.data.cmp.banner.diffs">{{d}}</span>
                  <span class="chip chip-nf" ng-repeat="mf in c.data.cmp.banner.miss">{{mf}} (not found)</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="cm-grid">
                <div class="cm-panel">
                  <div class="cm-p-title">{{c.data.cmp.left.title}}</div>
                  <div class="cm-p-sub">{{c.data.cmp.left.subtitle || '-'}}</div>
                  <div class="cm-rows">
                    <div class="cm-row" ng-repeat="r in c.data.cmp.left.rows">
                      <div class="cm-lbl">{{r.label}}</div>
                      <div class="cm-val" ng-class="{'cm-val-bad': r.value && r.kind === 'bad'}">
                        <span ng-if="!r.value" class="cm-nf">NOT FOUND</span>
                        <span ng-if="r.value">{{r.value}}</span>
                        <span ng-if="r.value && r.kind === 'bad'" class="cm-x">MISMATCH</span>
                        <span ng-if="r.value && r.kind === 'ok'" class="cm-ck">✓</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="cm-panel">
                  <div class="cm-p-title">{{c.data.cmp.right.title}}</div>
                  <div class="cm-p-sub">{{c.data.cmp.right.subtitle || '-'}}</div>
                  <div ng-if="c.data.cmp.right.notFound" class="cm-notfound">
                    <div class="cm-nf-icon">✕</div>
                    <div class="cm-nf-title">Not found in PCM</div>
                  </div>
                  <div ng-if="!c.data.cmp.right.notFound" class="cm-rows">
                    <div class="cm-row" ng-repeat="r in c.data.cmp.right.rows">
                      <div class="cm-lbl">{{r.label}}</div>
                      <div class="cm-val" ng-class="{'cm-val-bad': r.value && r.kind === 'bad'}">
                        <span ng-if="!r.value" class="cm-nf">NOT FOUND</span>
                        <span ng-if="r.value">{{r.value}}</span>
                        <span ng-if="r.value && r.kind === 'bad'" class="cm-x">MISMATCH</span>
                        <span ng-if="r.value && r.kind === 'ok'" class="cm-ck">✓</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="cm-cand" ng-if="c.data.cmp.candidatesList.length && c.data.cmp.tier !== 1">
                <div class="cm-cand-hd">Ranked candidate bookings <span class="cm-cand-n">{{c.data.cmp.candidatesList.length}}</span></div>
                <div class="cm-cand-sub">Every booking the {{c.data.cmp.tierLabel}} search returned, best match first.</div>
                <div class="cm-cand-scroll">
                  <table class="cm-cand-tbl">
                    <thead><tr>
                      <th>#</th><th>Bank Trade Ref</th><th>Counterparty</th><th>Ccy</th><th>Amount</th><th>Direction</th><th>Value Date</th><th>Δ Amount</th><th>Δ Days</th>
                    </tr></thead>
                    <tbody>
                      <tr ng-repeat="cand in c.data.cmp.candidatesList track by $index" ng-class="{'cm-cand-best': cand.best}">
                        <td class="cm-cand-rank">{{cand.rank}}<span ng-if="cand.best" class="cm-cand-tag">best</span></td>
                        <td class="cm-mono">{{cand.reference || '-'}}</td>
                        <td>{{cand.counterparty || '-'}}<span ng-if="!cand.cpMatch" class="cm-cand-cpx">≠</span></td>
                        <td>{{cand.currency || '-'}}</td>
                        <td class="cm-mono">{{c.fmtAmt(cand.amount) || '-'}}</td>
                        <td>{{cand.direction || '-'}}</td>
                        <td class="cm-mono">{{cand.value_date || '-'}}</td>
                        <td class="cm-mono">{{cand.amtDelta}}</td>
                        <td class="cm-mono">{{cand.dayDelta > 0 ? '+' : ''}}{{cand.dayDelta}}d</td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="ar-box">
                <div class="ar-hd">Analyst review</div>
                <div class="ar-sub">Confirm the outcome for this cashflow.</div>
                <div class="ar-row">
                  <button class="ar-btn" ng-class="{on: c.data.effectiveOutcome === 'no_match'}" ng-click="c.setOutcome('no_match')">No match</button>
                  <button class="ar-btn" ng-class="{on: c.data.effectiveOutcome === 'mismatch'}" ng-click="c.setOutcome('mismatch')">Mismatch<span ng-if="c.data.cmp.diffCount > 0"> with {{c.data.cmp.diffCount}} field<span ng-if="c.data.cmp.diffCount !== 1">s</span></span></button>
                  <button class="ar-btn" ng-class="{on: c.data.effectiveOutcome === 'matched'}" ng-click="c.setOutcome('matched')">Mark matched</button>
                  <button ng-if="!c.data.reviewConfirmed" class="nom-btn ar-confirm" ng-click="c.confirmReview()">Confirm</button>
                  <span ng-if="c.data.reviewConfirmed" class="ar-confirmed">✓ Confirmed</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div ng-if="!c.data.cmp.found" class="cm-card"><div class="cm-empty">No matching cashflow to compare.</div></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- ===== Step 3: Decide next action (derived from the Step 2 outcome) ===== -->
        <div class="step" ng-if="c.data.reviewConfirmed && c.data.draft">
          <div class="step-rail"><div class="step-badge">3</div></div>
          <div class="step-main">
            <div class="step-hd">Decide next action</div>

            <div class="nom-card na-card">
              <div class="na-title">{{c.data.draft.title}}</div>
              <div class="na-head">
                <div class="na-hrow"><span class="na-lbl">To</span><span>{{c.data.draft.to}}</span></div>
                <div class="na-hrow"><span class="na-lbl">Subject</span><span>{{c.data.draft.subject}}</span></div>
              </div>
              <textarea class="na-body" ng-model="c.data.draft.body"></textarea>
              <div class="na-actions">
                <button class="nom-btn" ng-click="c.sendAction()">✉ {{c.data.draft.sendLabel}}</button>
                <button class="nom-btn na-grey" ng-click="c.resolveAction()">✓ Resolved / Closed</button>
                <span ng-if="c.data.resolution === 'sent'" class="na-done">✓ Sent</span>
                <span ng-if="c.data.resolution === 'closed'" class="na-done">✓ Resolved / Closed</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>

11:56:25</sys_updated_on><value>var fails = [];
function check(name, expected, actual) {
  if (String(expected) !== String(actual)) { fails.push(name + ': expected ' + expected + ' got ' + actual); }
}
try {
  var reg = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CapabilityRegistry();

  var ok = reg.validateChain(['ingest', 'classify', 'extract', 'compare_match', 'report_notify']);
  check('valid chain ok', true, ok.ok);
  check('valid chain no issues', 0, ok.issues.length);

  var bad = reg.validateChain(['compare_match', 'ingest']);
  check('broken chain not ok', false, bad.ok);
  check('broken chain has issue', true, bad.issues.length >= 1);
  check('broken chain missing structured', 'structured', bad.issues[0].missing);

  check('registry seeded', true, reg.list().length >= 12);
} catch (e) {
  fails.push('EXCEPTION: ' + e);
}
if (fails.length) { stepResult.setOutputMessage('FAILED — ' + fails.join(' | ')); return false; }
stepResult.setOutputMessage('PASS — chain validation (6 assertions)'); return true;</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

11:56:25</sys_updated_on><value>var fails = [];
var cleanup = [];
function check(name, expected, actual) {
  if (String(expected) !== String(actual)) { fails.push(name + ': expected ' + expected + ' got ' + actual); }
}
function mkWizard(rules) {
  var w = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
  w.initialize();
  w.setValue('name', 'ATF Temp Wizard');
  w.setValue('status', 'draft');
  w.setValue('id_rules', rules);
  var id = w.insert();
  cleanup.push(['x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard', id]);
  return id;
}
function mkEmail(subject, body) {
  var e = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
  e.initialize();
  e.setValue('name', 'ATF-TEST.eml');
  e.setValue('mail_subject', subject);
  e.setValue('mail_body', body);
  e.setValue('mail_from', 'ops@bank.example');
  e.setValue('sender', 'ops@bank.example');
  var id = e.insert();
  cleanup.push(['x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email', id]);
  return id;
}
try {
  var csgWiz = mkWizard(JSON.stringify([{ subject: 'NLUX', excludeReplies: false, excludeNoise: false }]));
  var otcWiz = mkWizard(JSON.stringify([{ keywords: 'settlement instructions', exclusions: 'nlux', excludeReplies: false, excludeNoise: false }]));
  var nluxMail = mkEmail('CSG NLUX entity break RDM 364469', 'entity data reference break');
  var otcMail  = mkEmail('Settlement Instructions FXOPT-2026-00047', 'please find settlement instructions attached');

  var wx = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.WizardExtractor();
  check('CSG claims NLUX', 'relevant',   wx.identify(csgWiz, nluxMail).classification);
  check('CSG skips settlement', 'irrelevant', wx.identify(csgWiz, otcMail).classification);
  check('OTC claims settlement', 'relevant',   wx.identify(otcWiz, otcMail).classification);
  check('OTC excludes NLUX', 'irrelevant', wx.identify(otcWiz, nluxMail).classification);
} catch (e) {
  fails.push('EXCEPTION: ' + e);
} finally {
  for (var i = 0; i < cleanup.length; i++) {
    var g = new GlideRecord(cleanup[i][0]);
    if (cleanup[i][1] && g.get(cleanup[i][1])) { g.deleteRecord(); }
  }
}
if (fails.length) { stepResult.setOutputMessage('FAILED — ' + fails.join(' | ')); return false; }
stepResult.setOutputMessage('PASS — OTC/CSG claim matrix (4 assertions)'); return true;</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

11:56:25</sys_updated_on><value>var fails = [];
var bookingId = '';
function check(name, expected, actual) {
  if (String(expected) !== String(actual)) { fails.push(name + ': expected ' + expected + ' got ' + actual); }
}
try {
  var b = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_booking');
  b.initialize();
  b.setValue('currency', 'TST/TST');
  b.setValue('direction', 'Receive');
  b.setValue('value_date', '2099-03-15');
  b.setValue('amount', '1000000');
  b.setValue('counterparty_org_name', 'ATF Synthetic CP');
  b.setValue('bank_trade_ref', 'ATF-BNK-1');
  b.setValue('status', 'booked');
  bookingId = b.insert();
  check('booking inserted', true, !!bookingId);

  var cm = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch();

  var m1 = cm.match({ currency: 'TST/TST', direction: 'Receive', value_date: '2099-03-15', amount: '1000000', counterparty: 'ATF Synthetic CP' });
  check('T1 tier', 1, m1.tier);
  check('T1 status', 'matched', m1.status);

  var mAmt = cm.match({ currency: 'TST/TST', direction: 'Receive', value_date: '2099-03-15', amount: '5000000', counterparty: 'ATF Synthetic CP' });
  check('AmtMismatch tier', 1, mAmt.tier);
  check('AmtMismatch status', 'amount_mismatch', mAmt.status);

  var m2 = cm.match({ currency: 'TST/TST', direction: 'Receive', value_date: '2099-03-16', amount: '1000000', counterparty: 'ATF Synthetic' });
  check('T2 tier', 2, m2.tier);
  check('T2 status', 'fuzzy', m2.status);

  var mNo = cm.match({ currency: 'NON/EXIST', direction: 'Receive', value_date: '2099-03-15', amount: '1000000', counterparty: 'ATF Synthetic CP' });
  check('NoMatch tier', 0, mNo.tier);
  check('NoMatch status', 'no_match', mNo.status);
} catch (e) {
  fails.push('EXCEPTION: ' + e);
} finally {
  if (bookingId) { var d = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_booking'); if (d.get(bookingId)) { d.deleteRecord(); } }
}
if (fails.length) { stepResult.setOutputMessage('FAILED — ' + fails.join(' | ')); return false; }
stepResult.setOutputMessage('PASS — 9 assertions across Tier 1/amount-mismatch/Tier 2/no-match'); return true;</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_generative_ai_config_1768eaf90c5143b0bd92f157cef4a38b
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_generative_ai_config"><sys_generative_ai_config action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><additional_configurations/><ai_suggested>false</ai_suggested><definition>673ea156c3c94acc81c5a4238f5126b4</definition><definition_table>sys_one_extend_capability_definition</definition_table><documentation/><max_tokens>4096</max_tokens><min_word_count>-1</min_word_count><model>llm_generic_small_v2</model><name>Extract Settlement Fields Prompt</name><parent/><prompt>You are a settlement operations analyst at a bank. You read an incoming counterparty email (an FX or OTC-derivative settlement / payment confirmation) and extract the settlement details for EVERY cashflow it confirms.
For each cashflow return these fields. Use "" when a field is genuinely absent — NEVER invent a value. - counterparty: the counterparty firm that SENT the email (from the From name / domain, e.g. "Counterparty8"). Not our own bank. - nomura_entity: OUR (the recipient bank's) booking entity when the email names it — e.g. "BANK Singapore", or a column/label named "Entity"/"Bank"/"Counterparty" that identifies the RECEIVING bank, or a bank BIC. "" if not stated. - reference: the counterparty's trade / settlement / flow reference for that cashflow (e.g. "345927053", "M19218064181"). "" if none. - product: the product / instrument type (e.g. "FX Forward", "NDF", "IRS", "Equity-Linked Note"; a "Typology"/"Type" of Coupon/Premium/Net Settlement is also acceptable). "" if absent. - currency: the 3-letter ISO SETTLEMENT currency (USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, CHF, SGD, HKD, AUD, CNY). If a notional currency and a fee/settlement currency both appear, use the one actually being settled. - amount: the SETTLEMENT amount exactly as written, keeping the sign. If both a notional and a fee / net / settlement amount appear, use the amount actually being settled (the fee / net / settlement figure), not the notional. - direction: "Pay" or "Receive". Normalise variants (Pay / P / Coun Pay / COU PAY -> Pay; Receive / R / RECV / COU RECEIVE -> Receive). "" if not stated. - trade_date: the trade / deal date as YYYY-MM-DD. A 6-digit date is YYMMDD (e.g. 160226 -> 2026-02-16). "" if absent. - value_date: the settlement / value / payment date as YYYY-MM-DD. - ssi_bank: the SSI beneficiary / agent bank, name and/or BIC (e.g. "AGENT BANK 7 (AGGBUS3N)"). "" if absent. - ssi_account: the SSI account number or IBAN. "" if absent. - ssi_beneficiary: the SSI beneficiary, name and/or BIC (e.g. "Counterparty8 (CPTYCA2L)"). "" if absent. - ssi_intermediary: the intermediary / correspondent bank if present. "" otherwise.
Rules: - One email can contain MANY cashflows (a table or repeated blocks) - return one object per cashflow. - Emails arrive in many formats: "Label : Value" blocks, plain-text pipe tables, HTML tables, SWIFT MT (:20:/:32A:/:72:), forwarded / quoted threads (lines starting with ">"), and prose. Extract regardless of format. - SSI details are often absent from the body (e.g. "As per attached SSI") - then leave every ssi_* field "". - If the email is only a Standing Settlement Instruction (SSI) update with no cashflow to settle, return {"type":"ssi","cashflows":[]}. - If the settlement figures are only inside an image / screenshot or a PDF attachment (not in the text), return {"type":"none","cashflows":[]}. - Otherwise return {"type":"cashflow", ...}.
Return ONLY valid JSON (no commentary, no markdown code fences), exactly this shape: {"type":"cashflow|ssi|none","cashflows":[{"counterparty":"","nomura_entity":"","reference":"","product":"","currency":"","amount":"","direction":"","trade_date":"","value_date":"","ssi_bank":"","ssi_account":"","ssi_beneficiary":"","ssi_intermediary":""}]}
Examples: EMAIL: From: Counterparty10 Settlements <otc.settlements@tulvex.cp10.example> Reference : 345779144 Product : FX Forward Currency : CHF Amount : 3,935,858.32 Direction : Pay Value Date : 2026-06-03 SSI Bank (BIC) : AGENT BANK 3 (AGCBDEFF) SSI Account : 4409838141 Beneficiary (BIC): Counterparty10 (CPTYHK2L) JSON: {"type":"cashflow","cashflows":[{"counterparty":"Counterparty10","nomura_entity":"","reference":"345779144","product":"FX Forward","currency":"CHF","amount":"3,935,858.32","direction":"Pay","trade_date":"","value_date":"2026-06-03","ssi_bank":"AGENT BANK 3 (AGCBDEFF)","ssi_account":"4409838141","ssi_beneficiary":"Counterparty10 (CPTYHK2L)","ssi_intermediary":""}]}
EMAIL: Flow Id | Ccy | Amount | Value Date | Pay/Receive | Typology M19218064181 | JPY | 1,516,768.33 | 08-Jun-2026 | Pay | Coupon JSON: {"type":"cashflow","cashflows":[{"counterparty":"","nomura_entity":"","reference":"M19218064181","product":"Coupon","currency":"JPY","amount":"1,516,768.33","direction":"Pay","trade_date":"","value_date":"2026-06-08","ssi_bank":"","ssi_account":"","ssi_beneficiary":"","ssi_intermediary":""}]}
EMAIL: Please confirm below payment value on 08-Jun-2026. Reference | Trade Date | Maturity Date | Notional Ccy | Notional Amount | Fee Ccy | Upfront Fee Amount | Counterparty 349950493 | 160226 | 260529 | HKD | 10,000,000.00 | SGD | 3,622,285.58 | BANK Singapore JSON: {"type":"cashflow","cashflows":[{"counterparty":"","nomura_entity":"BANK Singapore","reference":"349950493","product":"","currency":"SGD","amount":"3,622,285.58","direction":"","trade_date":"2026-02-16","value_date":"2026-06-08","ssi_bank":"","ssi_account":"","ssi_beneficiary":"","ssi_intermediary":""}]}
EMAIL: {{content}} JSON:</prompt><prompt_template_role/><provider_company/><request_tokens>28422</request_tokens><show_in_prompt_library>true</show_in_prompt_library><state>published</state><structured_output_enabled>false</structured_output_enabled><structured_output_schema/><sys_class_name>sys_generative_ai_config</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:27</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>1768eaf90c5143b0bd92f157cef4a38b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>673ea156c3c94acc81c5a4238f5126b4</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_generative_ai_config_1768eaf90c5143b0bd92f157cef4a38b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:27</sys_updated_on><temperature>0.2</temperature><thinking_tokens/><version>1</version></sys_generative_ai_config></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_generative_ai_config"><sys_generative_ai_config action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><additional_configurations/><ai_suggested>false</ai_suggested><definition>e63f4128a4974d21990c94e5db29cc5e</definition><definition_table>sys_one_extend_capability_definition</definition_table><documentation/><max_tokens>1024</max_tokens><min_word_count>-1</min_word_count><model>anthropic-5-sonnet[Bedrock]</model><name>Enhance Field Prompt Prompt</name><parent/><prompt>You are an expert at writing precise data-extraction instructions for a settlement-operations AI that reads counterparty emails.
Rewrite the DRAFT instruction below into ONE clear, self-contained extraction prompt for the field "{{field}}". Improve it so it: - says WHERE the value typically appears in an email (labels, columns, key/value lines, subject), - states the EXACT output format to return (e.g. ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, digits only, three-letter ISO currency, name with BIC in parentheses), - instructs that if the value is genuinely absent the model must return an empty string, - stays faithful to the analyst's ORIGINAL intent — clarify and structure it; never invent a new meaning for the field, and never add unrelated fields.
Keep it concise (2-4 sentences). Return ONLY the rewritten instruction as plain text — no preamble, no explanation, no markdown, no surrounding quotes.
DRAFT: {{draft}}
REWRITTEN INSTRUCTION:</prompt><prompt_template_role/><provider_company/><request_tokens>6918</request_tokens><show_in_prompt_library>true</show_in_prompt_library><state>published</state><structured_output_enabled>false</structured_output_enabled><structured_output_schema/><sys_class_name>sys_generative_ai_config</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:27</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>6f7100c574a947969fae31f30a770482</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>e63f4128a4974d21990c94e5db29cc5e</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_generative_ai_config_6f7100c574a947969fae31f30a770482</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:27</sys_updated_on><temperature>0.2</temperature><thinking_tokens/><version>1</version></sys_generative_ai_config></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * AccessGuard — ONE source of truth for the app's board/case access rules (previously duplicated inline
 * across wiz-dashboard, ai-extraction and ai-dashboard). Consumers call these instead of copy-pasting the
 * role + assignment checks, so the rule can't drift between pages.
 *
 * Rules (unchanged from the inline versions):
 *   - Managers (explicit x_nose_nfotc_bsm.manager role) and platform admins have full access.
 *   - Otherwise an analyst may view a board only for a wizard ASSIGNED to them (canViewWizard), or any of
 *     the AI surfaces only if they still have at least one published assignment (canViewAny).
 */
var AccessGuard = Class.create();
AccessGuard.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    LANDING: '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers',

    /** Platform admin OR an explicitly-granted app manager OR an approved demo operator. Demo operators
     *  (the x_nose_nfotc_bsm.demo_users allow-list) get manager-level VIEW across the app so they can preview the
     *  manager surfaces without an admin/manager grant. NOTE: this is view/access only — ACTING on a cashflow
     *  (confirm / override / write-back) still requires being the assigned analyst (isAssignedAnalyst), which
     *  is unaffected here. The list is a system property only an admin can edit, so this is not arbitrary
     *  escalation. */
    isManagerOrAdmin: function () {
        return gs.hasRole('admin') || this._hasManagerRole() || this.isDemoUser();
    },

    /** Demo operators who get the Manager/Analyst view-as toggle (and manager-level view). Driven by the
     *  x_nose_nfotc_bsm.demo_users system property (comma-separated user_names) so people can be added/removed in
     *  the instance with NO code deploy; falls back to the original test operator if the property is unset. */
    isDemoUser: function () {
        try {
            var me = '' + gs.getUser().getName();
            if (!me) { return false; }
            var list = ('' + (gs.getProperty('x_nose_nfotc_bsm.demo_users', 'akshit.mahajan') || '')).split(',');
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) { if (('' + list[i]).trim() === me) { return true; } }
        } catch (e) { /* not a demo user */ }
        return false;
    },

    /**
     * Explicitly-granted app-manager role — distinct from a plain platform admin, who "has" every role via
     * gs.hasRole() but was never granted THIS one. Robust on purpose: it scans the granted-role list AND,
     * as a fallback, does a definitive sys_user_has_role lookup (catches group-inherited grants and contexts
     * where getRoles() doesn't surface the scoped role name). Used for both the access gate and the role
     * label so the two can never disagree.
     */
    _hasManagerRole: function () {
        try {
            var roles = gs.getUser().getRoles() || [];
            for (var i = 0; i < roles.length; i++) { if (('' + roles[i]) === 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm.manager') { return true; } }
        } catch (e) { /* fall through to the DB check */ }
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
            gr.addQuery('user', gs.getUserID());
            gr.addQuery('role.name', 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm.manager');
            gr.setLimit(1);
            gr.query();
            return gr.hasNext();
        } catch (e2) { return false; }
    },

    /** Is this an approved demo operator? Only they get the view-as toggle. Alias of isDemoUser so the label
     *  and the toggle share ONE source. */
    _isTestUser: function () { return this.isDemoUser(); },

    /** The test operator's session view-as preference ('manager' | 'analyst' | ''); empty/other = analyst. */
    _viewAs: function () {
        try { return '' + (gs.getSession().getClientData('nfotc_view_as') || ''); } catch (e) { return ''; }
    },

    /**
     * Human-facing role label for the header chip — the ONE place this is decided (previously five
     * inconsistent inline copies plus seven pages hard-coding 'Analyst'). Precedence Manager > Administrator
     * > Analyst, honoring the test operator's view-as toggle so the demo can preview the Analyst experience.
     * Every page reads data.role from this, so a manager/admin viewing any board sees their real role.
     */
    roleLabel: function () {
        if (this._isTestUser()) { return this._viewAs() === 'manager' ? 'Manager' : 'Analyst'; }
        if (this._hasManagerRole()) { return 'Manager'; }
        if (gs.hasRole('admin')) { return 'Administrator'; }
        return 'Analyst';
    },

    _assigned: function (wizGr, uid) {
        var au = [];
        try { au = JSON.parse(wizGr.getValue('assigned_users') || '[]'); } catch (e) { au = []; }
        for (var i = 0; i < au.length; i++) { if (au[i] && au[i].id === uid) { return true; } }
        return false;
    },

    /** Is the CURRENT user an assigned analyst of THIS wizard? (independent of manager/admin role.)
     *  Used to decide the board's READ-ONLY mode: only the assigned analyst may act; a manager/admin who
     *  is not assigned views it read-only (FR-UI-022 — managers can't confirm/override/write-back). */
    isAssignedAnalyst: function (wizId) {
        if (!wizId) { return false; }
        var wg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (!wg.get(wizId)) { return false; }
        return this._assigned(wg, gs.getUserID());
    },

    /** May the current user view the board for THIS wizard? (manager/admin, or assigned to it). */
    canViewWizard: function (wizId) {
        if (this.isManagerOrAdmin()) { return true; }
        if (!wizId) { return false; }
        var wg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (!wg.get(wizId)) { return false; }
        return this._assigned(wg, gs.getUserID());
    },

    /** May the current user view the AI surfaces at all? (manager/admin, or assigned to >=1 published wizard). */
    canViewAny: function () {
        if (this.isManagerOrAdmin()) { return true; }
        var uid = gs.getUserID();
        var wz = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        wz.addQuery('status', 'published');
        wz.query();
        while (wz.next()) { if (this._assigned(wz, uid)) { return true; } }
        return false;
    },

    /**
     * Row-level check for a CASHFLOW record — resolves its owning wizard (via the parent email's
     * wiz_extracted) and delegates to canViewWizard. Used by the cashflow read ACL so an analyst lists
     * only cashflows for a work-driver assigned to them. (Managers/admins see all.)
     */
    canViewCashflow: function (cfGr) {
        if (this.isManagerOrAdmin()) { return true; }
        try {
            var em = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            if (em.get(cfGr.getValue('email'))) { return this.canViewWizard(em.getValue('wiz_extracted')); }
        } catch (e) { /* fail closed */ }
        return false;
    },

    /** May the current user ACT on a cashflow (confirm / override / write-back)? ONLY the assigned analyst
     *  of the owning work-driver — managers/admins can view but not act (FR-UI-022). Resolves the wizard via
     *  the parent email's wiz_extracted. */
    canActOnCashflow: function (cfGr) {
        try {
            var em = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            if (em.get(cfGr.getValue('email'))) { return this.isAssignedAnalyst(em.getValue('wiz_extracted')); }
        } catch (e) { /* fail closed */ }
        return false;
    },

    type: 'AccessGuard',
};
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/AccessGuard.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>e8c95125b97347e29f1b333df0a73d16</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/AccessGuard.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_e8c95125b97347e29f1b333df0a73d16</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * ExtractionConfidence — a per-field confidence for AI-extracted settlement fields, computed by
 * checks on the OUTPUT (not by a second extractor), so it survives when the deterministic path is
 * removed and the flow is AI-only.
 *
 * Two explainable signals per field:
 *   1. GROUNDING — does the extracted value actually appear in the source text the AI read?
 *      (type-aware: amounts matched on the digit string, dates across common formats, etc.).
 *      Not-grounded flags likely hallucination or heavy reformatting.
 *   2. VALIDATION — is the value well-formed for its type? (date parses, amount numeric,
 *      currency an ISO code, account has digits, direction is Pay/Receive).
 *
 * grounded+valid -> High; one of them -> Medium; neither -> Low. Counterparty is DERIVED (PCM
 * directory), not AI, so it is reported separately as 'derived'. Confidence is expressed as a plain
 * High / Medium / Low level (no percentage) — deterministic and fully auditable, every level has a reason.
 */
var ExtractionConfidence = Class.create();
ExtractionConfidence.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    // Machine level -> display word. Kept short so it fits a badge; the reason string carries the detail.
    LABELS: { hi: 'High', mid: 'Medium', lo: 'Low', derived: 'Derived', absent: '—' },
    // The four economic keys that a settlement can't be trusted without — they drive the OVERALL level.
    MANDATORY: ['valueDate', 'amount', 'currency', 'direction'],
    _rank: { lo: 0, mid: 1, hi: 2 },

    // fields: {counterparty, nomuraEntity, product, reference, tradeDate, valueDate, amount, currency,
    //          direction, ssiBank, ssiAccount, ssiBeneficiary, ssiIntermediary}
    // content: the text the AI read (email body + any parsed spreadsheet grid)
    score: function (fields, content) {
        var text = '' + (content || '');
        var ctx = { text: text, lc: text.toLowerCase(), noSep: text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''), noComma: text.replace(/,/g, '') };
        var self = this, out = {}, low = 0, n = 0;

        function put(key, type, value) {
            var r = self._field(type, value, ctx);
            out[key] = r;
            if (r.level !== 'absent' && r.level !== 'derived') { n++; if (r.level === 'lo') { low++; } }
        }

        out.counterparty = { level: 'derived', label: this.LABELS.derived, reason: 'Derived from the sender via the Eve directory — not AI-extracted.' };
        put('valueDate', 'date', fields.valueDate);
        put('amount', 'amount', fields.amount);
        put('currency', 'currency', fields.currency);
        put('direction', 'direction', fields.direction);
        put('nomuraEntity', 'text', fields.nomuraEntity);
        put('product', 'text', fields.product);
        put('reference', 'ref', fields.reference);
        put('tradeDate', 'date', fields.tradeDate);
        put('ssiBank', 'text', fields.ssiBank);
        put('ssiAccount', 'account', fields.ssiAccount);
        put('ssiBeneficiary', 'text', fields.ssiBeneficiary);
        put('ssiIntermediary', 'text', fields.ssiIntermediary);

        // OVERALL = weakest-link across the four economic keys (a cashflow is only as trustworthy as its
        // worst key). Secondary/SSI fields have their own per-field level but don't move the headline.
        var worst = 'hi', missing = false;
        for (var i = 0; i < this.MANDATORY.length; i++) {
            var lv = (out[this.MANDATORY[i]] || {}).level;
            if (lv === 'absent' || !lv) { missing = true; continue; }
            if (this._rank[lv] < this._rank[worst]) { worst = lv; }
        }
        var oLevel, oReason;
        if (missing || worst === 'lo') { oLevel = 'lo'; oReason = 'An economic key is missing or could not be verified against the source — please review.'; }
        else if (worst === 'mid') { oLevel = 'mid'; oReason = 'The economic keys are present, but at least one needs a glance (reformatted or unusual format).'; }
        else { oLevel = 'hi'; oReason = 'All four economic keys are grounded in the source and well-formed.'; }
        out.overall = { level: oLevel, label: this.LABELS[oLevel], reason: oReason, low: low, count: n };
        return out;
    },

    _field: function (type, value, ctx) {
        var v = ('' + (value == null ? '' : value)).trim();
        if (!v) { return { level: 'absent', label: this.LABELS.absent, reason: 'Not present in this cashflow.' }; }
        var grounded = this._grounded(type, v, ctx);
        var valid = this._valid(type, v);
        var level, reason;
        if (grounded && valid) { level = 'hi'; reason = 'Found in the source text and well-formed.'; }
        else if (grounded && !valid) { level = 'mid'; reason = 'Found in the source, but the format looks unusual — worth a glance.'; }
        else if (!grounded && valid) { level = 'mid'; reason = 'Well-formed, but not found verbatim in the source (may be reformatted by the AI).'; }
        else { level = 'lo'; reason = 'Not found in the source and the format looks off — please review.'; }
        return { level: level, label: this.LABELS[level], reason: reason, grounded: grounded, valid: valid };
    },

    _grounded: function (type, v, ctx) {
        var vl = v.toLowerCase();
        if (type === 'amount') {
            var num = v.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '');
            if (num && ctx.noComma.indexOf(num) !== -1) { return true; }
            var intp = num.split('.')[0];
            return !!(intp && intp.length >= 4 && ctx.noComma.replace(/\./g, '').indexOf(intp) !== -1);
        }
        if (type === 'currency') { return ctx.lc.indexOf(vl) !== -1; }
        if (type === 'date') { return this._dateGrounded(v, ctx.lc); }
        if (type === 'direction') { return /\b(pay|receive|buy|sell|payment)\b/i.test(ctx.text); }
        if (type === 'account') { var d = vl.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); return !!(d && d.length >= 4 && ctx.noSep.indexOf(d) !== -1); }
        // ref / free text
        var tok = vl.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
        if (!tok) { return false; }
        if (tok.length <= 3) { return ctx.lc.indexOf(vl) !== -1; }
        return ctx.noSep.indexOf(tok) !== -1;
    },

    _dateGrounded: function (v, lc) {
        var m = v.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
        if (!m) { return lc.indexOf(v.toLowerCase()) !== -1; }
        var y = m[1], mo = m[2], d = m[3];
        var mon = ['jan', 'feb', 'mar', 'apr', 'may', 'jun', 'jul', 'aug', 'sep', 'oct', 'nov', 'dec'][parseInt(mo, 10) - 1];
        var dNo = '' + parseInt(d, 10);
        var cands = [
            y + '-' + mo + '-' + d, d + '-' + mo + '-' + y, d + '/' + mo + '/' + y, mo + '/' + d + '/' + y, y + '/' + mo + '/' + d,
            d + '-' + mon + '-' + y, d + ' ' + mon + ' ' + y, dNo + ' ' + mon, mon + ' ' + dNo, mon + '-' + dNo
        ];
        for (var i = 0; i < cands.length; i++) { if (lc.indexOf(cands[i].toLowerCase()) !== -1) { return true; } }
        return false;
    },

    _valid: function (type, v) {
        if (type === 'amount') { return !isNaN(parseFloat(('' + v).replace(/[, ]/g, ''))); }
        if (type === 'currency') { return /^[A-Za-z]{3}$/.test(v.trim()); }
        if (type === 'date') { return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(v); }
        if (type === 'direction') { return /^(pay|receive)$/i.test(v.trim()); }
        if (type === 'account') { return /[0-9]/.test(v); }
        return v.length > 0;
    },

    type: 'ExtractionConfidence'
};
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/ExtractionConfidence.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>ed93e63d0a824d81b5c06c13a695a9f4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/ExtractionConfidence.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_ed93e63d0a824d81b5c06c13a695a9f4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>
