<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * WizardExtractor — runs AI extraction on the dropped mails using a PUBLISHED wizard's own field
 * config (the manager's per-field AI Prompts), and writes the results onto each cashflow's ai_* fields.
 *
 * Two entry points share one per-email routine (_processEmail):
 *   - syncWizard(wizId)         — batch: the wizard board's "Sync now" (inline, capped at BATCH).
 *   - extractEmail(wizId, id)   — single mail: called by Flow A (Intake) per triggered email, so the
 *                                 pipeline runs as a VISIBLE Flow Designer flow rather than inline code.
 *   - identify(wizId, id)       — Flow A's identification step: apply the wizard's id_rules (else keep
 *                                 the mail's existing classification).
 *
 * It builds a record-mode instruction from the wizard's input_fields (identical shape to the wizard's
 * Publish-step "Run"), runs the generic prompt-driven skill (GenericFieldExtractor.extractRecords) once
 * per email, aligns the returned rows to that email's cashflows by index, and maps each known field onto
 * its ai_* column. Direction is flipped to the bank POV. Counterparty stays DERIVED from the sender.
 */
var WizardExtractor = Class.create();
WizardExtractor.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    BATCH: 10,

    // wizard field NAME (lowercased) -> cashflow ai_* column
    FIELD_MAP: {
        'value date': 'ai_value_date',
        'amount': 'ai_amount',
        'currency': 'ai_currency',
        'direction': 'ai_direction',
        'nomura entity': 'ai_nomura_entity',
        'product': 'ai_product',
        'trade reference': 'ai_reference',
        'trade date': 'ai_trade_date',
        'ssi bank / bic': 'ai_ssi_bank',
        'ssi account': 'ai_ssi_account',
        'ssi beneficiary / bic': 'ai_ssi_beneficiary',
        'ssi intermediary': 'ai_ssi_intermediary'
    },

    _slug: function (s) { return ('' + (s || '')).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '') || 'field'; },
    // Coerce an email ref to a sys_id STRING. The subflow invokes with a GlideRecord (reference input),
    // but setValue('email', ...) / GlideRecord.get() need the sys_id — passing the object silently no-ops.
    _sid: function (v) {
        if (v && typeof v === 'object' && typeof v.getUniqueValue === 'function') { return '' + v.getUniqueValue(); }
        return '' + (v || '');
    },
    _flipDir: function (d) {
        var s = ('' + (d || '')).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (s === 'pay' || s === 'p' || s === 'pays') { return 'Receive'; }
        if (s === 'receive' || s === 'r' || s === 'rec' || s === 'receives') { return 'Pay'; }
        return d || '';
    },

    // Resolve + parse the wizard's field config once (shared by both entry points).
    _wizFields: function (wizId) {
        var wg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (!wizId || !wg.get(wizId)) { return null; }
        var fields = [];
        try { fields = JSON.parse(wg.getValue('input_fields') || '[]'); } catch (e) { fields = []; }
        return fields.length ? fields : null;
    },

    // The engine/model/skill actually used for extraction (for the audit's model_version) — mirrors
    // GenericFieldExtractor's config-driven routing (extraction.engine: 'chinou' | 'nowllm').
    _aiMeta: function (wizId) {
        // Chinou is the default/standard engine (no UI toggle); 'nowllm' is only used if the config key is
        // explicitly set to it. Drives the audit trail's model_version / skill fields.
        var engine = 'chinou';
        try { engine = ('' + new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.NfotcConfig().getString('extraction.engine', wizId || '', 'chinou')).trim().toLowerCase(); } catch (e) { engine = 'chinou'; }
        if (engine === 'nowllm') {
            return { engine: 'nowllm', model: 'llm_generic_small_v2', skill: 'Extract Field Generic' };
        }
        return { engine: 'chinou', model: gs.getProperty('chinou.model.id', 'anthropic-5-sonnet[Bedrock]'), skill: 'Extract Fields Generic Chinou' };
    },

    /**
     * BATCH entry (wizard board "Sync now").
     * @param {string} wizId  sys_id of the published x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard
     * @return {{status:string, processed:number, remaining:number, cashflows:number}}
     */
    syncWizard: function (wizId) {
        var out = { status: 'ok', processed: 0, remaining: 0, cashflows: 0, failed: 0, diag: '' };
        if (!wizId) { out.status = 'no_wizard'; return out; }

        var fields = this._wizFields(wizId);
        if (!fields) { out.status = 'no_fields'; return out; }
        var instruction = this._buildInstruction(fields);

        var dx = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.DemoExtractor();
        var gx = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.GenericFieldExtractor();

        // All relevant emails; skip ones already extracted by THIS wizard in JS (a '!=' addQuery would
        // wrongly drop rows whose wiz_extracted is NULL — i.e. every pre-existing mail).
        var eg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        eg.addQuery('classification', 'relevant');
        eg.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        eg.query();

        while (eg.next()) {
            if (eg.getValue('wiz_extracted') === wizId) { continue; } // already extracted by this wizard
            if (out.processed >= this.BATCH) { out.remaining++; continue; }
            var r = this._processEmail(eg.getUniqueValue(), eg.getValue('name'), eg.getValue('counterparty_name'), wizId, instruction, dx, gx);
            if (r.status === 'skipped') { continue; }
            if (r.status === 'failed') { out.failed++; if (r.diag && !out.diag) { out.diag = r.diag; } continue; }
            out.cashflows += r.cashflows;
            out.processed++;
        }
        if (out.processed === 0 && out.failed > 0) { out.status = 'extraction_failed'; }
        return out;
    },

    /**
     * SINGLE-mail entry (Flow A — Intake). Extract one email with the wizard's field prompts.
     * @return {{status:string, cashflows:number, diag:string}}
     */
    extractEmail: function (wizId, emailId) {
        emailId = this._sid(emailId);
        if (!wizId || !emailId) { return { status: 'failed', cashflows: 0, diag: 'missing_args' }; }
        var fields = this._wizFields(wizId);
        if (!fields) { return { status: 'failed', cashflows: 0, diag: 'no_fields' }; }
        var eg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        if (!eg.get(emailId)) { return { status: 'failed', cashflows: 0, diag: 'no_email' }; }
        if (eg.getValue('classification') === 'irrelevant') { return { status: 'skipped', cashflows: 0, diag: 'irrelevant' }; }
        var instruction = this._buildInstruction(fields);
        var dx = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.DemoExtractor();
        var gx = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.GenericFieldExtractor();
        return this._processEmail(emailId, eg.getValue('name'), eg.getValue('counterparty_name'), wizId, instruction, dx, gx);
    },

    /**
     * Email Identification — decide whether THIS wizard should pick up the mail (relevant/irrelevant),
     * driven entirely by the wizard's id_rules (the Email-Identification builder step). HYBRID:
     *   1. wizard structural toggles (exclude replies/forwards, exclude noise domains) — manager-chosen.
     *   2. deterministic rules per label — keywords / subject pattern / sender watch (+ exclusions).
     *   3. AI context — a plain-language description the LLM matches the mail against (fallback for a label
     *      that has a context but no deterministic hit).
     * A wizard CLAIMS the mail if ANY label matches. No labels configured -> default 'relevant'.
     * Returns { classification, reason }.
     */
    identify: function (wizId, emailId) {
        emailId = this._sid(emailId);
        var out = { classification: 'relevant', reason: 'default' };
        var eg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        if (!eg.get(emailId)) { out.classification = ''; out.reason = 'no_email'; return out; }

        var subject = '' + (eg.getValue('mail_subject') || '');
        var body = '' + (eg.getValue('mail_body') || '');
        var sender = ('' + (eg.getValue('sender') || eg.getValue('mail_from') || '')).toLowerCase();
        var hay = (subject + ' ' + body).toLowerCase();
        var content = 'Subject: ' + subject + '\n\n' + body;

        var labels = [];
        try {
            var wg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
            if (wizId && wg.get(wizId)) { labels = JSON.parse(wg.getValue('id_rules') || '[]'); }
        } catch (e) { labels = []; }
        if (!labels || !labels.length) { out.reason = 'no_rules'; return out; }   // nothing configured -> relevant

        // 1) wizard-level structural toggles (default ON), taken from the first label.
        var t0 = labels[0] || {};
        var exReplies = (t0.excludeReplies === undefined) ? true : !!t0.excludeReplies;
        var exNoise = (t0.excludeNoise === undefined) ? true : !!t0.excludeNoise;
        if (exReplies && /^\s*(re|fwd?|fw)\s*:/i.test(subject)) { out.classification = 'irrelevant'; out.reason = 'reply_forward'; return out; }
        if (exNoise && this._isNoiseDomain(sender)) { out.classification = 'irrelevant'; out.reason = 'noise_domain'; return out; }

        // 2/3) any label match -> relevant.
        var gx = null;
        for (var i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
            var L = labels[i] || {};
            if (this._anyMatch(L.exclusions, hay, sender)) { continue; }               // this label excludes the mail
            var subjKw = this._splitList(L.subject), kw = this._splitList(L.keywords), snd = this._splitList(L.senders);
            var hasDet = subjKw.length || kw.length || snd.length;
            var det = (subjKw.length && this._containsAny(subject.toLowerCase(), subjKw)) ||
                      (kw.length && this._containsAny(hay, kw)) ||
                      (snd.length && this._containsAny(sender, snd));
            if (det) { out.reason = 'rule_match'; return out; }
            if (L.context) {
                if (!gx) { gx = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.GenericFieldExtractor(); }
                var ai = gx.classifyMatch(L.context, content);
                if (ai === true) { out.reason = 'ai_context'; return out; }
                // ai === null -> skill unavailable; ai === false -> this label says no. either way, try next label.
            }
            if (!hasDet && !L.context) { out.reason = 'empty_label'; return out; }      // a label with no criteria matches all
        }
        out.classification = 'irrelevant'; out.reason = 'no_label_match';
        return out;
    },

    /**
     * Ownership gate for the board Sync. Ensures the mail is materialised (parses its .eml into mail_*
     * on-demand, so routing works even on the very first sync — before any subflow has run), then applies
     * THIS wizard's identification rules. The board uses this to process ONLY its own mails and leave
     * every other wizard's mails completely untouched (never stamped, never run). Returns identify()'s
     * { classification, reason }.
     */
    routeForWizard: function (wizId, emailId) {
        emailId = this._sid(emailId);
        this._ensureIngested(emailId);
        var res = this.identify(wizId, emailId);
        this._auditClassification(wizId, emailId, res);   // FR-AUD: record the relevance DECISION + provenance
        return res;
    },

    // Audit the routing/relevance DECISION for a mail this wizard evaluated. Logged ONLY when the wizard
    // CLAIMS the mail ('relevant') — avoids a row for every other driver's / noise mail on each scan.
    // Captures the 5 governance fields: label, model_version, prompt_ref (+hash), input_hash, confidence.
    _auditClassification: function (wizId, emailId, res) {
        try {
            if (!res || res.classification !== 'relevant') { return; }
            var eg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            if (!eg.get(emailId)) { return; }
            var content = 'Subject: ' + (eg.getValue('mail_subject') || '') + '\n\n' + (eg.getValue('mail_body') || '');
            var context = '';
            var wg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
            if (wg.get(wizId)) { context = wg.getValue('id_rules') || ''; }
            var at = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AuditTrail();
            var meta = this._aiMeta(wizId);
            var byAi = (res.reason === 'ai_context');   // AI-context judgment vs a deterministic keyword/sender rule
            at.log('classification.decided', {
                entityType: 'email', entityId: emailId, emailId: emailId, mailId: eg.getValue('name'),
                counterparty: eg.getValue('counterparty_name'), actor: 'system', aiComponent: 'classifier',
                summary: 'Relevance: ' + res.classification + ' (' + res.reason + ')',
                ai: {
                    label: res.classification, reason: res.reason,
                    engine: byAi ? meta.engine : 'rule', model_version: byAi ? meta.model : '',
                    skill: byAi ? meta.skill : '', prompt_ref: 'wizard:' + wizId,
                    prompt_hash: at.hash(context), input_hash: at.hash(content),
                    // Deterministic keyword/sender match = high certainty; AI-context judgment = medium.
                    // (Classification returns a yes/no decision, not a numeric score.)
                    confidence_level: byAi ? 'Medium' : 'High'
                }
            });
        } catch (e) { /* audit best-effort */ }
    },

    // Parse the raw .eml into the record's mail_* fields if not already done (mirrors cap-ingest, idempotent).
    _ensureIngested: function (emailId) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        if (!g.get(emailId)) { return; }
        if (g.getValue('mail_body') || g.getValue('mail_subject')) { return; }   // already materialised
        var attId = '', first = '';
        var ag = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
        ag.addQuery('table_name', 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        ag.addQuery('table_sys_id', emailId);
        ag.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        ag.query();
        while (ag.next()) {
            var fn = ('' + ag.getValue('file_name')).toLowerCase();
            if (!first) { first = ag.getUniqueValue(); }
            if (/\.eml$/.test(fn) || ag.getValue('content_type') === 'message/rfc822') { attId = ag.getUniqueValue(); break; }
        }
        if (!attId) { attId = first; }
        if (!attId) { return; }
        try {
            var m = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.EmlFieldExtractor().mailContents(attId) || {};
            g.setValue('mail_to', m.to || '');
            g.setValue('mail_from', m.from || '');
            g.setValue('mail_cc', m.cc || '');
            g.setValue('mail_subject', m.subject || '');
            g.setValue('mail_body', m.body || '');
            g.update();
        } catch (e) { /* leave unparsed; identify falls back to defaults */ }
    },

    // ---- id_rules helpers ----
    _splitList: function (s) {
        return ('' + (s || '')).split(/[,;\n]+/).map(function (x) { return x.trim().toLowerCase(); }).filter(function (x) { return x; });
    },
    _containsAny: function (hay, list) {
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) { if (('' + hay).indexOf(list[i]) !== -1) { return true; } }
        return false;
    },
    _anyMatch: function (exclusions, hay, sender) {
        var list = this._splitList(exclusions);
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) { if (('' + hay).indexOf(list[i]) !== -1 || ('' + sender).indexOf(list[i]) !== -1) { return true; } }
        return false;
    },
    _isNoiseDomain: function (sender) {
        var m = ('' + sender).match(/@([a-z0-9._-]+)/);
        var domain = m ? m[1] : '';
        if (!domain) { return false; }
        var noise = ('' + gs.getProperty('x_nose_nfotc_bsm.noise_domains', 'nonoutlook.com')).split(',');
        for (var i = 0; i < noise.length; i++) {
            var d = noise[i].trim().toLowerCase();
            if (d && (domain === d || domain.substr(domain.length - d.length - 1) === '.' + d)) { return true; }
        }
        return false;
    },

    // ---- shared per-email routine (used by both batch + single-mail paths) ----------------------
    _processEmail: function (emailId, mailId, cpName, wizId, instruction, dx, gx) {
        emailId = this._sid(emailId);
        var res = { status: 'ok', cashflows: 0, diag: '' };
        var attId = this._emlAtt(emailId);
        if (!attId) { return { status: 'skipped', cashflows: 0, diag: 'no_attachment' }; }

        // content that feeds the AI (body + spreadsheet grid), reusing the standard builder
        var content = '';
        try { content = (dx.run(attId, emailId, false) || {}).aiContent || ''; } catch (ec) { content = ''; }
        if (!content) { return { status: 'skipped', cashflows: 0, diag: 'no_content' }; }

        // AI-governance metadata for the audit trail (FR-AUD-003): the engine/model/skill that ran, a
        // reference to the prompt (the wizard config), and a hash of the EXACT input sent to the model.
        var meta = this._aiMeta(wizId);
        var _at = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AuditTrail();
        var contentHash = _at.hash(content);
        // Hash of the ACTUAL prompt text sent (not just the wizard id) — so an output ties to the EXACT
        // prompt used, even after a manager edits the field prompts. model_version + prompt_hash +
        // input_hash form the reproducibility triple (FR-AUD-003).
        var promptHash = _at.hash((instruction && instruction.text) || '');

        var out = null;
        try { out = gx.extractRecords(instruction.text, content); } catch (er) { out = null; }
        if (!out || out.status !== 'ok' || !(out.rows && out.rows.length)) {
            // extraction failed / returned nothing — do NOT blank the cashflows; leave the mail
            // un-flagged so a later run retries it. diag carries the skill status for the log.
            gs.warn('[WizardExtractor] no rows for email=' + emailId + ' (extractor status=' + (out ? out.status : 'null') + ')');
            return { status: 'failed', cashflows: 0, diag: (out && out.status) ? out.status : 'no_rows' };
        }

        // The subflow is the SOLE extractor now: it CREATES one cashflow per AI row (the split comes from
        // the AI's record-mode output). Idempotent — clear this email's existing rows first so a re-sync
        // never duplicates. Match reads the ai_* fields (CompareMatch._cfValuesAi), which _applyRow writes.
        var rows = out.rows;
        var del = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        del.addQuery('email', emailId);
        del.deleteMultiple();
        for (var ri = 0; ri < rows.length; ri++) {
            var cf = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
            cf.initialize();
            cf.setValue('email', emailId);
            cf.setValue('flow_index', ri + 1);
            this._applyRow(cf, instruction.keys, rows[ri] || {});   // writes only the wizard's configured ai_* fields
            cf.setValue('ai_sources', JSON.stringify(this._buildSources(instruction.keys, rows[ri] || {})));  // highlight provenance
            cf.insert();
            // Overall extraction confidence as a level (High/Medium/Low) — grounding + validation of the
            // economic keys against the source content. The model doesn't return a per-field number, so this
            // deterministic check is what the audit records (input_hash ties it to the exact source read).
            var _confLevel = '';
            try {
                _confLevel = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.ExtractionConfidence().score({
                    valueDate: cf.getValue('ai_value_date'), amount: cf.getValue('ai_amount'),
                    currency: cf.getValue('ai_currency'), direction: cf.getValue('ai_direction')
                }, content).overall.label;
            } catch (ecl) { _confLevel = ''; }
            try {
                new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AuditTrail().log('cashflow.extracted', {
                    entityType: 'cashflow', entityId: cf.getUniqueValue(), emailId: emailId, cashflowId: cf.getUniqueValue(),
                    mailId: mailId, counterparty: cpName, actor: 'system',
                    aiComponent: 'extractor', product: cf.getValue('ai_product'),
                    summary: 'AI extracted the cashflow using the wizard field prompts',
                    ai: {
                        source: 'wizard', wizard: wizId,
                        engine: meta.engine, model_version: meta.model, skill: meta.skill,
                        prompt_ref: 'wizard:' + wizId, prompt_hash: promptHash, input_hash: contentHash,
                        confidence_level: _confLevel,   // High / Medium / Low (per-field number = Phase 2, model doesn't return it)
                        amount: cf.getValue('ai_amount'), currency: cf.getValue('ai_currency'),
                        value_date: cf.getValue('ai_value_date'), direction: cf.getValue('ai_direction')
                    }
                });
            } catch (ea) { /* audit best-effort */ }
            res.cashflows++;
        }

        var eg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        if (eg.get(emailId)) { eg.setValue('wiz_extracted', wizId); eg.update(); }
        return res;
    },

    // Build the highlight-provenance JSON from ONE model row: the verbatim row source + one entry per field
    // that carried a "<key>__src" snippet (standard AND custom fields — custom ones have no ai_* column but
    // still get a snippet + legend chip). `group` selects the case-screen highlight colour. Counterparty is
    // DERIVED (never AI-extracted) so it is never a source. Lengths are capped to keep the JSON column small.
    _buildSources: function (keys, row) {
        function cap(s, n) { s = '' + (s == null ? '' : s); return s.length > n ? s.substring(0, n) : s; }
        var out = { rowsrc: cap(row.__rowsrc, 1200), fields: [] };
        for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
            var key = keys[k].key, name = '' + (keys[k].name || key);
            var snip = ('' + (row[key + '__src'] || '')).trim();
            if (!snip) { continue; }
            var col = this.FIELD_MAP[name.toLowerCase()] || '';
            if (col === 'ai_counterparty') { continue; }   // counterparty is derived — never highlighted
            out.fields.push({ key: key, label: name, group: this._hlGroup(col), snippet: cap(snip, 240) });
        }
        return out;
    },
    // Map an ai_* column to a case-screen highlight colour group; a field with no column is a custom field.
    _hlGroup: function (col) {
        if (col === 'ai_amount') { return 'amount'; }
        if (col === 'ai_value_date' || col === 'ai_trade_date') { return 'date'; }
        if (col === 'ai_currency') { return 'ccy'; }
        if (col === 'ai_direction') { return 'dir'; }
        if (col === 'ai_reference') { return 'ref'; }
        if (col === 'ai_nomura_entity' || col === 'ai_product' || col.indexOf('ai_ssi') === 0) { return 'other'; }
        return col ? 'other' : 'custom';   // no column => custom field
    },

    // Build the record-mode instruction + the ordered key list (same shape as the wizard's Run step).
    _buildInstruction: function (fields) {
        var keys = [], lines = [], seen = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
            var f = fields[i] || {};
            var key = this._slug(f.name), base = key, n = 2;
            while (seen[key]) { key = base + '_' + (n++); }
            seen[key] = true;
            keys.push({ key: key, name: '' + (f.name || '') });
            var line = '- ' + key + ': ' + (f.prompt || f.name || key);
            var exs = [];
            var fex = f.examples || [];
            for (var e = 0; e < fex.length; e++) { var ev = fex[e]; if (ev && typeof ev === 'object') { ev = ev.value; } if (ev) { exs.push('"' + ev + '"'); } }
            if (exs.length) { line += ' (example values: ' + exs.join(', ') + ')'; }
            else if (f.value) { line += ' (example value: "' + f.value + '")'; }
            lines.push(line);
        }
        var shape = ['"__rowsrc":""'];
        for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) { shape.push('"' + keys[j].key + '":"","' + keys[j].key + '__src":""'); }
        var text = 'Extract EVERY trade / row present in the TEXT (there may be one row or many — each ' +
            'line of a table is a row). For EACH row, extract these fields:\n' + lines.join('\n') +
            '\n\nProvenance (for precise UI highlighting) — for EACH row also return:\n' +
            '- "__rowsrc": the EXACT verbatim text of THIS row as it appears in the email (the whole line or ' +
            'block for this one cashflow), copied character-for-character.\n' +
            '- for every field <key> above, a "<key>__src": the EXACT verbatim substring of the email (from ' +
            'THIS row only) that the value was read from — copy it exactly as written, do NOT normalise or ' +
            'convert it (e.g. keep "P", "06-Jun-2026", "1,987,114.00"). If the field is absent for the row, use "".\n' +
            '\nReturn ONLY a JSON array — one object per row, each object exactly {' + shape.join(',') + '}. ' +
            'No markdown, no code fences, no commentary. If a field is absent for a row, use "" for both the value and its __src.';
        return { text: text, keys: keys };
    },

    // Blank every standard ai_* field column so a wizard that configures only a SUBSET of fields leaves
    // the rest empty — the board reflects exactly the wizard's field config, with no leftover values from
    // a prior extraction (by another wizard or the original ingest). Counterparty is derived, not cleared.
    _clearFields: function (cf) {
        for (var k in this.FIELD_MAP) { if (this.FIELD_MAP.hasOwnProperty(k)) { cf.setValue(this.FIELD_MAP[k], ''); } }
    },

    _applyRow: function (cf, keys, row) {
        for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
            var name = '' + keys[k].name;
            var col = this.FIELD_MAP[name.toLowerCase()];
            if (!col) { continue; } // custom field with no ai_* column -> not shown on the standard board
            var v = this.validateField(name, row[keys[k].key]);   // GUARDRAIL: coerce/normalise per field; blank if out-of-spec
            if (col === 'ai_direction') { v = this._flipDir(v); }  // then flip to the bank POV
            cf.setValue(col, v);
        }
    },

    // Deterministic guardrail — the prompt REQUESTS the right format; this ENFORCES it after the model
    // responds. Out-of-spec values are coerced to the canonical form or blanked (never a wrong guess).
    // Applied to the mandatory Compare & Match fields; other fields pass through (trimmed).
    validateField: function (name, v) {
        var raw = (v === null || v === undefined) ? '' : ('' + v).trim();
        if (raw === '') { return ''; }
        var n = ('' + name).toLowerCase();
        if (n.indexOf('value date') > -1) { return this._normDate(raw); }
        if (n === 'amount') { return this._normAmount(raw); }
        if (n === 'currency') { return this._normCcy(raw); }
        if (n === 'direction') { return this._normDirection(raw); }
        return raw;
    },

    _MONTHS: { jan: '01', feb: '02', mar: '03', apr: '04', may: '05', jun: '06', jul: '07', aug: '08', sep: '09', oct: '10', nov: '11', dec: '12' },
    // -> ISO YYYY-MM-DD from ISO / DD-first slash / DD-Mon-YYYY / SWIFT YYMMDD / YYYYMMDD; else '' (never a wrong date).
    _normDate: function (s) {
        s = ('' + s).trim();
        var m = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/); if (m) { return s; }
        m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-.](\d{1,2})[\/\-.](\d{4})$/);
        if (m) { return m[3] + '-' + ('0' + m[2]).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + m[1]).slice(-2); }
        m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\-\s]([A-Za-z]{3,})[\-\s](\d{4})$/);
        if (m) { var mo = this._MONTHS[m[2].substring(0, 3).toLowerCase()]; if (mo) { return m[3] + '-' + mo + '-' + ('0' + m[1]).slice(-2); } }
        m = s.match(/^(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/); if (m) { return '20' + m[1] + '-' + m[2] + '-' + m[3]; }
        m = s.match(/^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/); if (m) { return m[1] + '-' + m[2] + '-' + m[3]; }
        return '';
    },
    // -> uppercase 3-letter code; else ''.
    _normCcy: function (s) { var m = ('' + s).toUpperCase().match(/[A-Z]{3}/); return m ? m[0] : ''; },
    // -> 'Pay' / 'Receive' (counterparty stated POV) from words, single letters, SWIFT tags; else ''.
    _normDirection: function (s) {
        var t = ('' + s).toLowerCase();
        if (/rec|rcv/.test(t)) { return 'Receive'; }
        if (/pay|pmt/.test(t)) { return 'Pay'; }
        var w = t.replace(/[^a-z]/g, '');
        if (w === 'r') { return 'Receive'; }
        if (w === 'p') { return 'Pay'; }
        return '';
    },
    // -> plain number string (dot decimal, sign preserved); handles thousands seps + European comma decimals; else ''.
    _normAmount: function (s) {
        var str = ('' + s).trim();
        if (!str) { return ''; }
        var neg = /-/.test(str) || /^\s*\(.*\)\s*$/.test(str);
        str = str.replace(/[^0-9.,]/g, '');
        if (!str) { return ''; }
        var lastComma = str.lastIndexOf(','), lastDot = str.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (lastComma > -1 && lastDot > -1) {
            if (lastComma > lastDot) { str = str.replace(/\./g, '').replace(/,/g, '.'); }  // comma is decimal
            else { str = str.replace(/,/g, ''); }                                          // dot is decimal
        } else if (lastComma > -1) {
            var commas = (str.match(/,/g) || []).length, after = str.length - lastComma - 1;
            if (commas === 1 && after > 0 && after <= 2) { str = str.replace(/,/g, '.'); } // European decimal
            else { str = str.replace(/,/g, ''); }                                          // thousands
        } else {
            var dots = (str.match(/\./g) || []).length;
            if (dots > 1) { var li = str.lastIndexOf('.'); str = str.substring(0, li).replace(/\./g, '') + '.' + str.substring(li + 1); }
        }
        str = str.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '');
        if (str === '' || str === '.') { return ''; }
        var num = parseFloat(str);
        if (isNaN(num)) { return ''; }
        if (neg) { num = -Math.abs(num); }
        return '' + num;
    },

    // The raw .eml attachment on an email record (prefer *.eml; else the first attachment).
    _emlAtt: function (emailId) {
        var ag = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
        ag.addQuery('table_name', 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        ag.addQuery('table_sys_id', emailId);
        ag.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        ag.query();
        var first = '';
        while (ag.next()) {
            var fn = ('' + ag.getValue('file_name')).toLowerCase();
            if (!first) { first = ag.getUniqueValue(); }
            if (/\.eml$/.test(fn) || ag.getValue('content_type') === 'message/rfc822') { return ag.getUniqueValue(); }
        }
        return first;
    },

    type: 'WizardExtractor'
};
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/WizardExtractor.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>f129109d47744765b973977ad1b167e3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/WizardExtractor.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_f129109d47744765b973977ad1b167e3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * PromptEnhancer — invokes the "Enhance Field Prompt" Now Assist skill (via sn_one_extend.OneExtendUtil)
 * to rewrite a manager's rough AI Prompt for a custom extraction field into a precise, structured
 * instruction. The skill GENERATES improved prompt text (it does not extract). Per the standing policy,
 * ALL LLM generation in the eval instance routes through Chinou (Nomura's governed Claude Sonnet 5) — the
 * skill's provider is Chinou; the enhancer only ever sees the prompt string, never counterparty data.
 *
 * Capability is resolved at runtime by name (no hardcoded platform sys_ids), so it survives redeploys.
 */
var PromptEnhancer = Class.create();
PromptEnhancer.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    SKILL_NAME: 'Enhance Field Prompt',

    _capabilityId: function () {
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_one_extend_capability');
        gr.addQuery('name', this.SKILL_NAME);
        gr.addQuery('type', 'skill');
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        return gr.next() ? gr.getUniqueValue() : '';
    },

    _skillConfigId: function (capId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sn_nowassist_skill_config');
        gr.addQuery('skill_id', capId);
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        return gr.next() ? gr.getUniqueValue() : '';
    },

    /**
     * @param {string} draft      the manager's rough AI Prompt
     * @param {string} fieldName  the field the prompt extracts (context only)
     * @return {{status:string, text:string}}  status 'ok' + the enhanced prompt, else a diagnostic status
     */
    enhance: function (draft, fieldName, mode) {
        var out = { status: 'error', text: '' };
        var d = ('' + (draft == null ? '' : draft)).trim();
        if (!d) { out.status = 'no_draft'; return out; }
        var capId = this._capabilityId();
        if (!capId) { out.status = 'no_capability'; return out; }
        var scId = this._skillConfigId(capId);
        if (!scId) { out.status = 'no_skill_config'; return out; }
        // Steer the SAME skill for the other free-text fields it now enhances. Default (custom-field AI
        // prompt) is unchanged; 'description' and 'classification' prepend an explicit task so the model
        // returns prose / a filter brief rather than an extraction prompt.
        var m = ('' + (mode || '')).toLowerCase();
        var payloadDraft = d;
        if (m === 'description') {
            payloadDraft = 'Rewrite the text below into a clear, professional 2-3 sentence DESCRIPTION of an operations work-driver — plain descriptive prose that explains what this workflow does. Do NOT turn it into an instruction, prompt, or bullet list. Return only the rewritten description.\n\nTEXT:\n' + d;
        } else if (m === 'classification') {
            payloadDraft = 'Rewrite the text below into a precise, well-scoped brief describing which emails this workflow should pick up. State clearly what to INCLUDE and what to EXCLUDE, keep it to 2-4 sentences, and preserve the original intent. Return only the rewritten context.\n\nTEXT:\n' + d;
        }
        try {
            var request = {
                executionRequests: [{
                    payload: { draft: payloadDraft, field: '' + (fieldName || 'this field') },
                    capabilityId: capId,
                    meta: { skillConfigId: scId }
                }],
                mode: 'sync'
            };
            var response = sn_one_extend.OneExtendUtil.execute(request) || {};
            var text = ((response['capabilities'] || {})[capId] || {})['response'];
            if (!text) { out.status = 'empty_response'; return out; }
            // Strip any accidental code-fence / surrounding quotes the model may add.
            out.text = ('' + text).trim().replace(/^```[a-z]*\s*|\s*```$/gi, '').trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, '').trim();
            out.status = out.text ? 'ok' : 'empty_response';
            return out;
        } catch (e) {
            out.status = 'error';
            out.text = '' + e;
            return out;
        }
    },

    type: 'PromptEnhancer'
};
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/PromptEnhancer.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>fb59dd8462ed4951a43e30b012e2aeb9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/PromptEnhancer.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_fb59dd8462ed4951a43e30b012e2aeb9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * AuditTrail — append-only writer for the OTC audit event store (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_audit).
 *
 * Every system action and AI inference is captured as one immutable row (BRD §Audit, FSD §15). This
 * helper only ever INSERTs — it never updates or deletes, so the trail is write-once. Timestamp and
 * base actor come from ServiceNow's sys_created_on / sys_created_by; the explicit `actor` field mirrors
 * it for convenience. AI-specific attributes (model version, prompt ref, confidence, source passage,
 * tier, candidates) go in ai_attributes as JSON.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AuditTrail().log('extraction.overridden', {
 *       entityType:'cashflow', entityId:cfId, emailId:emId, cashflowId:cfId, mailId:'EML-0003.eml',
 *       counterparty:'Counterparty5', summary:'Amount corrected', fieldName:'Amount',
 *       aiValue:'1,497,447.18', analystValue:'1,497,447.00', ai:{ model:'...', confidence:66, source:'...' } });
 */
var AuditTrail = Class.create();
AuditTrail.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    TABLE: 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm_audit',

    log: function (eventType, o) {
        try {
            o = o || {};
            var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
            gr.initialize();
            gr.setValue('event_type', ('' + (eventType || 'event')).substring(0, 40));
            gr.setValue('entity_type', ('' + (o.entityType || '')).substring(0, 20));
            gr.setValue('entity_id', '' + (o.entityId || ''));
            gr.setValue('email_id', '' + (o.emailId || ''));
            gr.setValue('cashflow_id', '' + (o.cashflowId || ''));
            gr.setValue('mail_id', ('' + (o.mailId || '')).substring(0, 120));
            gr.setValue('counterparty', ('' + (o.counterparty || '')).substring(0, 100));
            gr.setValue('actor', ('' + (o.actor || gs.getUserName() || 'system')).substring(0, 100));
            gr.setValue('summary', ('' + (o.summary || '')).substring(0, 500));
            gr.setValue('field_name', ('' + (o.fieldName || '')).substring(0, 60));
            gr.setValue('ai_value', ('' + (o.aiValue == null ? '' : o.aiValue)).substring(0, 1000));
            gr.setValue('analyst_value', ('' + (o.analystValue == null ? '' : o.analystValue)).substring(0, 1000));
            gr.setValue('ai_attributes', this._json(o.ai));
            // Promote the AI-governance fields out of the JSON blob into indexable columns (FR-AUD-003) so
            // they can be queried/reported directly. label = classification label OR match status.
            var _ai = o.ai || {};
            gr.setValue('model_version', ('' + (_ai.model_version || '')).substring(0, 80));
            gr.setValue('prompt_ref', ('' + (_ai.prompt_ref || '')).substring(0, 120));
            gr.setValue('prompt_hash', ('' + (_ai.prompt_hash || '')).substring(0, 40));
            gr.setValue('input_hash', ('' + (_ai.input_hash || '')).substring(0, 40));
            gr.setValue('ai_label', ('' + (_ai.label || _ai.status || '')).substring(0, 40));
            gr.setValue('confidence_level', ('' + (_ai.confidence_level || '')).substring(0, 10));
            gr.setValue('ai_confidence', ('' + (_ai.confidence == null ? '' : _ai.confidence)).substring(0, 6));
            gr.setValue('before_state', this._json(o.before));
            gr.setValue('after_state', this._json(o.after));
            // Structured query dimensions (FR-AUD-009) + config-change fields (FR-AUD-005).
            gr.setValue('ai_component', ('' + (o.aiComponent || '')).substring(0, 30));
            gr.setValue('product', ('' + (o.product || '')).substring(0, 60));
            gr.setValue('config_key', ('' + (o.configKey || '')).substring(0, 100));
            gr.setValue('config_old', ('' + (o.configOld == null ? '' : o.configOld)).substring(0, 1000));
            gr.setValue('config_new', ('' + (o.configNew == null ? '' : o.configNew)).substring(0, 1000));
            gr.setValue('effective_from', ('' + (o.effectiveFrom || '')).substring(0, 40));
            return '' + gr.insert();
        } catch (e) {
            gs.warn('[AuditTrail] ' + e);
            return '';
        }
    },

    // Deterministic fingerprint of the model INPUT (FR-AUD-003 input_hash) — stores a hash + length instead
    // of the full text, so a captured inference is tamper-evident without duplicating the payload.
    hash: function (str) {
        var s = '' + (str == null ? '' : str);
        var h = 5381;
        for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h = (((h << 5) + h) + s.charCodeAt(i)) & 0xffffffff; }
        return 'djb2:' + (h >>> 0).toString(16) + ':' + s.length;
    },

    _json: function (v) {
        if (v == null) { return ''; }
        try { return ('' + JSON.stringify(v)).substring(0, 4000); } catch (e) { return ('' + v).substring(0, 4000); }
    },

    type: 'AuditTrail'
};
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/AuditTrail.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>fd37dd7a9767437288c292797acf1e9e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/AuditTrail.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_fd37dd7a9767437288c292797acf1e9e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * EmlSenderClassifier — reads a dropped .eml attachment, extracts the sender's
 * domain, and decides Relevant vs Irrelevant against a configurable noise-domain
 * list (system property `x_nose_nfotc_bsm.noise_domains`, default "nonoutlook.com").
 *
 * Deterministic, no LLM. This is the ONLY custom code in an otherwise-native
 * pipeline: it exists purely because the sender lives inside the raw .eml
 * attachment and no out-of-the-box flow action reads attachment content into a
 * field. To change what counts as noise, edit the property — no code change.
 */
var EmlSenderClassifier = Class.create();
EmlSenderClassifier.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    /**
     * @param {string} attachmentSysId  sys_id of the .eml sys_attachment record
     * @returns {{sender:string, domain:string, classification:string}}
     *          classification is 'relevant' or 'irrelevant'
     */
    classifyAttachment: function (attachmentSysId) {
        var out = { sender: '', domain: '', classification: 'relevant' };
        if (!attachmentSysId) {
            return out;
        }
        var text = this._readText(attachmentSysId);
        out.sender = this._fromHeader(text);
        out.domain = this._domainOf(out.sender);
        // Fresh emails only: replies (RE:) and forwards (FW:/FWD:) are noise.
        if (this._isReplyOrForward(this._subject(text)) || this._isNoise(out.domain)) {
            out.classification = 'irrelevant';
        }
        return out;
    },

    _subject: function (raw) {
        if (!raw) { return ''; }
        var m = raw.match(/^Subject:[ \t]*(.*)$/im);
        return m ? m[1].trim() : '';
    },

    // Reply / forward prefixes on the subject line, e.g. "RE:", "Re :", "Fwd:", "FW:".
    _isReplyOrForward: function (subject) {
        return /^\s*(re|fwd?|fw)\s*:/i.test(subject || '');
    },

    // Read the .eml attachment as text. Scoped GlideSysAttachment.getContent()
    // takes the attachment GlideRecord (NOT a sys_id) and returns the decoded
    // string directly — no base64 step needed.
    _readText: function (attSysId) {
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
            if (!gr.get(attSysId)) {
                gs.warn('[EmlSenderClassifier] attachment not found: ' + attSysId);
                return '';
            }
            return new GlideSysAttachment().getContent(gr) || '';
        } catch (e) {
            gs.warn('[EmlSenderClassifier] could not read attachment ' + attSysId + ': ' + e);
            return '';
        }
    },

    // First "From:" header value, e.g. 'SWIFT Notices <no-reply@swift.nonoutlook.com>'.
    _fromHeader: function (raw) {
        if (!raw) {
            return '';
        }
        var m = raw.match(/^From:[ \t]*(.*)$/im);
        return m ? m[1].trim() : '';
    },

    // Domain from "Name <user@sub.domain.com>" or "user@domain.com".
    _domainOf: function (fromValue) {
        if (!fromValue) {
            return '';
        }
        var m = fromValue.match(/@([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)/);
        return m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : '';
    },

    // True when the domain equals, or is a subdomain of, any configured noise domain.
    _isNoise: function (domain) {
        if (!domain) {
            return false;
        }
        var list = gs.getProperty('x_nose_nfotc_bsm.noise_domains', 'nonoutlook.com');
        var noise = ('' + list).split(',');
        for (var i = 0; i < noise.length; i++) {
            var d = noise[i].trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!d) {
                continue;
            }
            if (domain === d || domain.substr(domain.length - d.length - 1) === '.' + d) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    },

    type: 'EmlSenderClassifier',
};
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/EmlSenderClassifier.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:39</sys_created_on><sys_id>09395b7000744071a16abbe0436a4fa1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/EmlSenderClassifier.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_09395b7000744071a16abbe0436a4fa1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:39</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_module_09d9ab1145ee431c934ebb7f07d55a5d
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[// #3 Reliability — wizard-churn cleanup. When a work-driver (wizard) is deleted it takes its sys_id with
// it; any email still stamped with that id (wiz_extracted / wiz_assigned / composed_run) would be "claimed
// by a ghost" and vanish from every board. So on wizard delete, clear those stamps — the affected emails
// become unclaimed again and can be re-synced by another driver (no orphaned ownership).
// Runs BEFORE delete on x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard. `current` is the wizard being deleted.
// Uses a per-record update() loop (same scope, no cross-scope updateMultiple privilege) so it runs cleanly
// on the first invocation.
var _wid = current.getUniqueValue();
var _fields = ['wiz_extracted', 'wiz_assigned', 'composed_run'];
for (var _i = 0; _i < _fields.length; _i++) {
    var _e = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    _e.addQuery(_fields[_i], _wid);
    _e.query();
    while (_e.next()) {
        _e.setValue(_fields[_i], '');
        _e.update();
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/br-wizard-delete-cleanup.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:39</sys_created_on><sys_id>09d9ab1145ee431c934ebb7f07d55a5d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/br-wizard-delete-cleanup.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_09d9ab1145ee431c934ebb7f07d55a5d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:39</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[function controller($window) {
    var c = this;

    // International-format an amount for DISPLAY only (thousands separators). Leaves the raw value + the
    // numeric sort field untouched; preserves any trailing currency text and a leading sign.
    c.fmtAmt = function (v) {
        var s = ('' + (v == null ? '' : v)).trim();
        if (!s) { return ''; }
        var m = s.match(/^(-?)(\d[\d,]*)(\.\d+)?(.*)$/);
        if (!m) { return s; }
        return m[1] + m[2].replace(/,/g, '').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',') + (m[3] || '') + (m[4] || '');
    };

    // Access guard: the server sets data.redirect when the current user is no longer permitted here (no
    // published work-driver assigned, and not a manager/admin). Navigate back to the landing page.
    if (c.data && c.data.redirect) { $window.location.href = c.data.redirect; return; }

    // User menu (avatar dropdown) + sign out.
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () {
        $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm');
    };

    c.sortKey = 'mailId';
    c.sortAsc = true;
    // Default: activity table sorted by Mail Id (ascending) on load.
    if (c.data && c.data.rows) {
        c.data.rows.sort(function (a, b) { return ('' + (a.mailId || '')).localeCompare('' + (b.mailId || '')); });
    }

    // Activity-table filters: trade-id search + counterparty + match-status + workflow dropdowns.
    c.q = '';
    c.cpFilter = '';
    c.matchFilter = '';
    c.wfFilter = '';
    c.rowFilter = function (row) {
        var q = ('' + (c.q || '')).toLowerCase();
        if (q && ('' + (row.reference || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1) { return false; }
        if (c.cpFilter && row.counterparty !== c.cpFilter) { return false; }
        if (c.matchFilter && row.matchStatus !== c.matchFilter) { return false; }
        if (c.wfFilter && row.workflowLabel !== c.wfFilter) { return false; }
        return true;
    };

    // Row click -> open the AI Compare & Match case screen for that cashflow.
    c.open = function (href) { if (href) { $window.location.href = href; } };

    // Which value a column sorts on (amount / time-elapsed sort numerically).
    c.sortVal = function (row, key) {
        if (key === 'amount') { return row.amountNum; }
        if (key === 'elapsed') { return row.elapsedMin; }
        if (key === 'tagging') { return row.tagging.label; }
        if (key === 'match') { return row.matchLabel; }
        return row[key];
    };

    // Sort glyph for a column: neutral up-down when inactive, up (asc) / down (desc) when active.
    c.arrow = function (key) {
        if (c.sortKey !== key) { return '⇅'; }
        return c.sortAsc ? '▲' : '▼';
    };

    // Click a header to sort; click again to reverse.
    c.sort = function (key) {
        if (c.sortKey === key) { c.sortAsc = !c.sortAsc; } else { c.sortKey = key; c.sortAsc = true; }
        var asc = c.sortAsc;
        c.data.rows.sort(function (a, b) {
            var xa = c.sortVal(a, key), xb = c.sortVal(b, key), r;
            if (typeof xa === 'number' && typeof xb === 'number') { r = xa - xb; }
            else { r = ('' + xa).localeCompare('' + xb); }
            return asc ? r : -r;
        });
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/ai-dashboard.client.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:39</sys_created_on><sys_id>0d77c423551b4ef98b5bbfd472a3066d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/ai-dashboard.client.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_0d77c423551b4ef98b5bbfd472a3066d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:39</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * NfotcConfig — the single reader over the two-tier configuration store (FSD §17).
 *
 *   per-driver override  (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard.config_overrides JSON)   -- if set for this wizard
 *   else system default  (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config row, by `key`)
 *   else the caller's hardcoded fallback                                -- so nothing ever breaks
 *
 * EVERY Script Include and Flow asks this reader instead of hardcoding a constant, so tuning the
 * matcher/classifier is a data edit (Config admin page or the wizard) — no code change, no re-deploy.
 * That is the "config storage + editability" the platform review asked for.
 *
 * Usage:  var cfg = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.NfotcConfig();
 *         var vdTol = cfg.getNumber('match.vd_tol_days', wizId, 2);
 */
var NfotcConfig = Class.create();
NfotcConfig.prototype = {
    initialize: function () { this._cache = null; },

    // --- system defaults, cached per instance -------------------------------------------------
    _sys: function () {
        if (this._cache) { return this._cache; }
        var m = {};
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config');
        g.query();
        while (g.next()) { m[g.getValue('key')] = g.getValue('value'); }
        this._cache = m;
        return m;
    },

    // --- per-driver override off the wizard record --------------------------------------------
    _wizOverride: function (key, wizId) {
        if (!wizId) { return null; }
        var w = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (!w.get(wizId)) { return null; }
        var raw = w.getValue('config_overrides');
        if (!raw) { return null; }
        try {
            var o = JSON.parse(raw);
            return (o && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o, key)) ? ('' + o[key]) : null;
        } catch (e) { return null; }
    },

    _raw: function (key, wizId) {
        var ov = this._wizOverride(key, wizId);
        if (ov !== null && ov !== '') { return ov; }
        var v = this._sys()[key];
        return (v === undefined) ? null : v;
    },

    // --- typed getters (2nd arg is the wizard sys_id or '' for system-only) --------------------
    getNumber: function (key, wizId, def) {
        var v = this._raw(key, wizId);
        if (v === null || v === '') { return def; }
        var n = parseFloat(v);
        return isNaN(n) ? def : n;
    },
    getString: function (key, wizId, def) {
        var v = this._raw(key, wizId);
        return (v === null) ? (def === undefined ? '' : def) : v;
    },
    getBool: function (key, wizId, def) {
        var v = this._raw(key, wizId);
        if (v === null) { return def; }
        return /^(1|true|yes|y)$/i.test('' + v);
    },

    // --- admin surface: list + edit ------------------------------------------------------------
    all: function () {
        var out = [];
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config');
        g.orderBy('config_group');
        g.orderBy('key');
        g.query();
        while (g.next()) {
            out.push({
                sysId: g.getUniqueValue(),
                key: g.getValue('key'),
                label: g.getValue('label'),
                value: g.getValue('value'),
                type: g.getValue('type'),
                group: g.getValue('config_group'),
                description: g.getValue('description')
            });
        }
        return out;
    },
    set: function (sysId, value) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config');
        if (g.get(sysId)) { g.setValue('value', '' + value); g.update(); return true; }
        return false;
    },

    // --- per-wizard surface: list effective config + edit the override -------------------------
    // Returns the config rows with the EFFECTIVE value for this wizard (its override if set, else the
    // system default) plus the system default and an `overridden` flag. `groupFilter` optional.
    forWizard: function (wizId, groupFilter) {
        var overrides = {};
        if (wizId) {
            var w = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
            if (w.get(wizId)) {
                try { overrides = JSON.parse(w.getValue('config_overrides') || '{}') || {}; } catch (e) { overrides = {}; }
            }
        }
        var out = [];
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_config');
        if (groupFilter) { g.addQuery('config_group', groupFilter); }
        g.orderBy('config_group');
        g.orderBy('key');
        g.query();
        while (g.next()) {
            var key = g.getValue('key');
            var sysVal = g.getValue('value');
            var hasOv = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(overrides, key) && ('' + overrides[key]) !== '';
            out.push({
                sysId: g.getUniqueValue(), key: key, label: g.getValue('label'),
                systemValue: sysVal, value: hasOv ? ('' + overrides[key]) : sysVal, overridden: hasOv,
                type: g.getValue('type'), group: g.getValue('config_group'), description: g.getValue('description')
            });
        }
        return out;
    },
    // Write a per-wizard override into x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard.config_overrides (the field visible on the
    // native wizard record). An empty value CLEARS the override, reverting to the system default.
    setOverride: function (wizId, key, value) {
        if (!wizId || !key) { return false; }
        var w = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (!w.get(wizId)) { return false; }
        var o = {};
        try { o = JSON.parse(w.getValue('config_overrides') || '{}') || {}; } catch (e) { o = {}; }
        var sv = ('' + (value === undefined || value === null ? '' : value)).trim();
        if (sv === '') { delete o[key]; } else { o[key] = sv; }
        w.setValue('config_overrides', JSON.stringify(o));
        w.update();
        return true;
    },

    type: 'NfotcConfig'
};
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/NfotcConfig.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:39</sys_created_on><sys_id>152c137cc4ab405d867eff0f591ebc2a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/NfotcConfig.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_152c137cc4ab405d867eff0f591ebc2a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:39</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * Manager Dashboard (Service Portal) — the manager's landing page.
 *
 * Nomura-styled console with a left nav, the published work-drivers as selectable chips, three KPI
 * cards (Open / Resolved / Critical), and an "Unactioned items by Analyst" table built from REAL
 * workflow assignments (an analyst's pending = open cashflows in the workflows assigned to them).
 * Manager-only: analysts/admins-without-the-manager-role are redirected away (client guard).
 */
(function () {
    // EXPLICIT role check — gs.hasRole('x_nose_nfotc_bsm.manager') is TRUE for every admin (admins pass all
    // role checks), so we inspect the user's actual granted roles instead (admin is NOT expanded here).
    function hasExplicitRole(roleName) {
        try {
            var roles = gs.getUser().getRoles();
            if (!roles) { return false; }
            for (var i = 0; i < roles.length; i++) { if (('' + roles[i]) === roleName) { return true; } }
        } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
        return false;
    }

    data.logo = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().LOGO;
    data.name = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().titleCase(gs.getUserDisplayName() || 'Manager');

    // View-as toggle — for approved demo operators (x_nose_nfotc_bsm.demo_users): switch Manager/Analyst view.
    var isTestUser = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().isDemoUser();
    if (isTestUser && input && input.action === 'set_view') {
        gs.getSession().putClientData('nfotc_view_as', input.viewAs === 'manager' ? 'manager' : 'analyst');
    }
    var viewAs = isTestUser ? ('' + (gs.getSession().getClientData('nfotc_view_as') || '')) : '';

    data.isAdmin = gs.hasRole('admin');
    data.isManager = isTestUser ? (viewAs === 'manager') : hasExplicitRole('x_nose_nfotc_bsm.manager');
    data.isTestUser = isTestUser;
    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();
    var parts = ('' + data.name).trim().split(/\s+/);
    data.initials = ((parts[0] || 'M').charAt(0) + (parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1].charAt(0) : '')).toUpperCase();

    var selWiz = (input && input.wiz) || $sp.getParameter('wiz') || '';
    data.selWiz = selWiz;
    data.selName = 'All work drivers';

    // Published work-drivers (chips) + the analyst assignments per workflow.
    data.drivers = [];
    var analystMap = {};    // userSysId -> { name, wiz: { wizId: true } }
    var assignedWiz = {};   // wizId -> true  (published wizards that have >=1 assigned analyst)
    var wz = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
    wz.addQuery('status', 'published');
    wz.orderBy('name');
    wz.query();
    while (wz.next()) {
        var id = wz.getUniqueValue(), nm = wz.getValue('name') || 'Untitled';
        data.drivers.push({ id: id, name: nm });
        if (id === selWiz) { data.selName = nm; }
        var au = [];
        try { au = JSON.parse(wz.getValue('assigned_users') || '[]'); } catch (e) { au = []; }
        if (au.length) { assignedWiz[id] = true; }   // an item only "awaits analyst action" once the workflow is assigned
        if (selWiz && id !== selWiz) { continue; }   // scope the analyst table to the selected driver
        for (var a = 0; a < au.length; a++) {
            var aid = au[a].id;
            if (!aid) { continue; }
            if (!analystMap[aid]) { analystMap[aid] = { name: au[a].name, wiz: {} }; }
            analystMap[aid].wiz[id] = true;
        }
    }

    // email -> owning wizard (wiz_extracted), so each cashflow can be attributed to a workflow.
    var emailWiz = {};
    var eg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    eg.query();
    while (eg.next()) { emailWiz[eg.getUniqueValue()] = eg.getValue('wiz_extracted') || ''; }

    var nowMs = new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue();
    function elapsed(created) {
        if (!created) { return '-'; }
        var t = new GlideDateTime(created).getNumericValue();
        var mins = Math.max(0, Math.floor((nowMs - t) / 60000));
        if (mins < 60) { return mins + 'm'; }
        var hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
        if (hrs < 24) { return hrs + 'h'; }
        return Math.floor(hrs / 24) + 'd ' + (hrs % 24) + 'h';
    }

    // KPI counts (Open / Resolved / Critical) + per-analyst pending (attributed via workflow assignment).
    var open = 0, resolved = 0, critical = 0;
    var pend = {};   // userSysId -> { pending, oldest:{ref,created} }
    var cf = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
    cf.orderBy('sys_created_on');   // oldest first
    cf.query();
    while (cf.next()) {
        var eid = cf.getValue('email');
        if (!emailWiz.hasOwnProperty(eid)) { continue; } // skip ORPHANS — cashflow whose parent email no longer exists
        var wid = emailWiz[eid] || '';
        // Only count items owned by a currently-published, ASSIGNED workflow. This excludes items tagged to
        // a deleted wizard, items never processed by a wizard, and published-but-unassigned workflows — so
        // with no assignment the KPIs read 0, matching the analyst table.
        if (!wid || !assignedWiz[wid]) { continue; }
        if (selWiz && wid !== selWiz) { continue; }
        var res = cf.getValue('ai_resolution');
        var mo = cf.getValue('ai_mo_sent');
        var ms = cf.getValue('ai_match_status');
        if ((res && res !== '') || mo === 'true') { resolved++; continue; }
        open++;
        if (ms === 'no_match' || ms === 'mismatch' || ms === 'amount_mismatch') { critical++; }
        var ref = cf.getValue('ai_reference') || cf.getValue('reference') || '';
        var created = cf.getValue('sys_created_on');
        for (var uid in analystMap) {
            if (analystMap[uid].wiz[wid]) {
                if (!pend[uid]) { pend[uid] = { pending: 0, oldest: null }; }
                pend[uid].pending++;
                if (!pend[uid].oldest) { pend[uid].oldest = { ref: ref, created: created }; }  // oldest-first
            }
        }
    }
    data.kpis = { open: open, resolved: resolved, critical: critical };

    // wizId -> name, so each analyst row can link to the work-driver board(s) they own (read-only).
    var driverName = {};
    for (var di = 0; di < data.drivers.length; di++) { driverName[data.drivers[di].id] = data.drivers[di].name; }

    // Real analyst rows — only analysts assigned to a workflow, with at least one open item.
    data.analysts = [];
    for (var uid2 in analystMap) {
        var p = pend[uid2];
        if (!p || !p.pending) { continue; }
        // The work-driver board(s) this analyst is assigned to — opened by the manager in READ-ONLY (ro=1).
        var drv = [];
        for (var wzid in analystMap[uid2].wiz) {
            drv.push({ id: wzid, name: driverName[wzid] || wzid, url: '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_nfotc_wiz_dash&wiz=' + wzid + '&ro=1' });
        }
        data.analysts.push({
            name: analystMap[uid2].name,
            pending: p.pending,
            oldestRef: p.oldest ? (p.oldest.ref || '-') : '-',
            elapsed: p.oldest ? elapsed(p.oldest.created) : '-',
            drivers: drv
        });
    }
    data.analysts.sort(function (x, y) { return y.pending - x.pending; });
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/manager-dashboard.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>17f91bf63b54484899017db566eef6d4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/manager-dashboard.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_17f91bf63b54484899017db566eef6d4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * AmountDirection — the ONE source of truth for the "never show / store a negative amount" presentation
 * rule. A negative AI-extracted amount is itself a direction inversion, so we display (and, on an analyst
 * action, persist) |amount| with the direction normalised and flipped once more. Previously this rule was
 * re-implemented inline in ai-extraction.server.js and TaggingDashboard.server.js and had diverged
 * (free-text directions weren't flipped; an empty direction produced a '-' sentinel). Centralised here so
 * both the board and the case screen agree.
 */
var AmountDirection = Class.create();
AmountDirection.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    _num: function (a) { return parseFloat(('' + (a == null ? '' : a)).replace(/[, ]/g, '')); },

    /** Is the amount negative? */
    isNeg: function (a) { var n = this._num(a); return !isNaN(n) && n < 0; },

    /** Display amount: |n| when negative; otherwise the ORIGINAL string (preserve formatting, no re-parse). */
    absAmt: function (a) {
        var s = '' + (a == null ? '' : a);
        var n = this._num(s);
        return (!isNaN(n) && n < 0) ? ('' + Math.abs(n)) : s;
    },

    /** Normalise a free-text direction ("COU RECEIVE", "RECV", "PMT", ...) to Pay / Receive. Unknown/blank
     *  values are returned trimmed, never a placeholder. */
    normDir: function (raw) {
        var s = ('' + (raw || '')).toLowerCase();
        if (/rec|rcv/.test(s)) { return 'Receive'; }
        if (/pay|pmt/.test(s)) { return 'Pay'; }
        return ('' + (raw || '')).trim();
    },

    /** Flip a Pay/Receive. Anything else is returned unchanged (NOT a '-' sentinel). */
    flip: function (d) {
        var s = ('' + (d || '')).trim().toLowerCase();
        return s === 'pay' ? 'Receive' : (s === 'receive' ? 'Pay' : ('' + (d || '')));
    },

    /** Display/normalised direction for a given (amount, direction): normalise, then flip once more when the
     *  amount is negative (the double-flip). Empty stays empty. */
    dispDir: function (amt, dir) {
        var nd = this.normDir(dir);
        return this.isNeg(amt) ? this.flip(nd) : nd;
    },

    type: 'AmountDirection'
};
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/AmountDirection.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>1a2a9a679a474054b15ba9e3abaed6ce</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/AmountDirection.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_1a2a9a679a474054b15ba9e3abaed6ce</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * SSO-aware gate for the OTC console login widget (BSM handover build).
 *
 * The BSM instance (nomurabsmdev) authenticates users via SSO at the instance layer, so by the
 * time this Service Portal home/login page renders, a real user is already signed in. In that
 * case we skip the custom sign-in form entirely and forward straight to the landing. Only a
 * genuinely unauthenticated ("guest") visitor is shown the branded sign-in form, as a fallback.
 *
 * This keeps the app portable with no code change between environments:
 *   SSO instance (bsmdev)      -> user already authenticated -> form skipped, straight to landing
 *   non-SSO instance / logged-out -> guest session          -> branded sign-in form is shown
 */
(function () {
    data.redirect = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers';
    data.authed = false;

    // In Service Portal an unauthenticated visitor runs as the built-in "guest" user.
    var userName = gs.getUser().getUserName();
    var isGuest = !userName || userName === 'guest';

    if (gs.isLoggedIn() && !isGuest) {
        data.authed = true; // real (SSO / platform) user -> skip the sign-in form
    }
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/login.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>33400dbbe3ce4f8e8b5e35d8e0e1850f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/login.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_33400dbbe3ce4f8e8b5e35d8e0e1850f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[// #3 Reliability — cascade delete. When an email record is deleted, remove its child cashflows so none
// are left orphaned (orphan cashflows previously inflated the board counts). The .eml / PDF attachments
// are auto-removed by the platform when the parent record is deleted, so only cashflows need cleaning.
// Runs BEFORE delete on x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email. `current` is the email being deleted.
var _cf = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
_cf.addQuery('email', current.getUniqueValue());
_cf.deleteMultiple();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/br-email-cascade-delete.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>363316fdf76d4f21abcce2ab1e80af5a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/br-email-cascade-delete.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_363316fdf76d4f21abcce2ab1e80af5a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>
