<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * Wizard Builder — 5-step config builder (server).
 * Provides the option catalogs + preconfigured field catalog + target-field lists, loads an
 * existing wizard when ?copy / ?edit is present, and persists on Save-as-draft / Publish.
 * All step state lives on the CLIENT; the only server round-trips are the terminal save/publish
 * (which then navigate back to the list), so the working model is never lost mid-build.
 */
(function () {
    data.logo = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().LOGO;
    data.name = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().titleCase(gs.getUserDisplayName() || 'Analyst');

    // ── ACCESS GUARD (centralised: x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard) ──
    // Wizard authoring (create/edit/publish work-drivers) is a MANAGER surface. SP widget server scripts
    // run server-side and BYPASS the manager-only wizard ACL, so authorisation is enforced HERE. Because
    // this returns first, it guards page load AND every action below (test / run_extract / save_draft /
    // publish). Uses REAL granted roles (not the header 'view-as' label) so a view toggle cannot grant access.
    if (!new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().isManagerOrAdmin()) { data.redirect = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers'; return; }

    // Header role label — the Wizard Builder is the MANAGER authoring surface, so show the user's real
    // functional role (Manager first; a pure platform admin -> Administrator; otherwise Analyst). Never
    // hardcode 'Admin'. Mirrors the Manager Dashboard, incl. the test-user view-as toggle, so the label
    // is consistent across the manager surfaces.
    function hasExplicitRole(roleName) {
        try {
            var roles = gs.getUser().getRoles();
            if (roles) { for (var i = 0; i < roles.length; i++) { if (('' + roles[i]) === roleName) { return true; } } }
        } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
        return false;
    }
    var isTestUser = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().isDemoUser();   // demo operators (x_nose_nfotc_bsm.demo_users)
    var viewAs = isTestUser ? ('' + (gs.getSession().getClientData('nfotc_view_as') || '')) : '';
    var isManager = isTestUser ? (viewAs === 'manager') : hasExplicitRole('x_nose_nfotc_bsm.manager');
    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();
    // Avatar initials from the display name (was hardcoded 'US').
    var _np = ('' + data.name).trim().split(/\s+/);
    data.initials = ((_np[0] || 'U').charAt(0) + (_np.length > 1 ? _np[_np.length - 1].charAt(0) : '')).toUpperCase();

    // ---- option catalogs ----
    // BU -> Sub-BU -> Activity -> Work Driver cascade comes from the shared taxonomy (CompareMatch).
    var _cm = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch();
    data.cat = {
        taxonomy: _cm.taxonomy(),
        inputFormats: ['Email', 'PDF', 'Excel'],
        ingestionTypes: ['Mail', 'API', 'File Drop', 'Manual'],
        mailboxes: ['email1@outlook.com', 'email2@outlook.com', 'settlements@bank.com'],
        frequencies: ['Real-time', 'Hourly', 'Daily'],
        targetSystems: ['System 1', 'System 2', 'PCM'],
        // Write-back actions offered per Compare & Match outcome (unfilled by default in the wizard).
        writebackActions: ['Send to NEWS', 'Reply to Counterparty', 'Reply to Middle Office'],
        // Skill (activity) options on the Define screen — the pipeline the manager picks. Only
        // Compare & Match is wired; Reconcile / Validation are demo placeholders with their own steps.
        activityOptions: ['Compare & Match', 'Reconcile', 'Validation'],
        // Preconfigured input fields — name + the Now Assist prompt (aligned with the production
        // "Extract Settlement Fields" skill) + an example VALUE + data type. Mandatory fields first,
        // optional below. Counterparty is intentionally NOT here — it is derived from the sender, not
        // extracted by the AI.
        fieldCatalog: [
            // ---- CSG mandatory: the RDM id keys the EVE-directory lookup (extract-only; placeholder for now) ----
            {
                name: 'RDM ID', type: 'string', mandatory: true,
                prompt: "Extract the RDM entity identifier for this notification — the reference-data master id used to resolve the entity in the EVE directory. It usually appears at the end of the subject line after the final ' - ', and inside the email body labelled 'ORG_RDM_ID' or 'RDM ID'. It is a 5–7 digit number. Return the digits only. If it is genuinely absent, return an empty string.",
                value: '364469',
                examples: ['364469', '372815', '388104']
            },
            // ---- mandatory (MASTER prompt + 3 worked examples, grounded in the real counterparty mails:
            //      pipe tables, free-form prose, SWIFT MT :32A:/:72:, key/value blocks, "AUD P" shorthand) ----
            {
                name: 'Value Date', type: 'string', mandatory: true,
                prompt: "Extract the settlement / value date for this cashflow. It may appear under a value-date column or label, after the word 'value', in a key/value line, inside a SWIFT date-and-amount field, or — only when the body contains none — in the subject line. The source date may be written in ISO, day-first, or day-month-name form, or as a compact SWIFT date; interpret whichever is present. Always return the date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. If it is genuinely absent, return an empty string.",
                value: '2026-06-13',
                examples: ['2026-06-13', '2026-06-14', '2026-06-05']
            },
            {
                name: 'Amount', type: 'float', mandatory: true,
                prompt: "Extract the settlement amount for this cashflow — the cash amount to settle, not the trade notional. The column may be labelled Amount, Flow Amount or Quantity; that value is the settlement amount. Strip any currency symbol and thousands separators. Where a comma is used as the decimal separator, convert it to a dot. Preserve the sign — negative amounts must stay negative. Return the number only, using a dot as the decimal separator. If it is absent, return an empty string.",
                value: '1497447.18',
                examples: ['1497447.18', '690397.75', '-2309184.24']
            },
            {
                name: 'Currency', type: 'string', mandatory: true,
                prompt: "Extract the settlement currency for this cashflow as a three-letter ISO 4217 code. It may appear under a currency column or label, in a key/value line, embedded inside a SWIFT date-and-amount field, or as the first token of a shorthand amount line. Return the uppercase three-letter code only. If it is absent, return an empty string.",
                value: 'EUR',
                examples: ['EUR', 'SGD', 'AUD']
            },
            {
                name: 'Direction', type: 'string', mandatory: true,
                prompt: "Extract the settlement direction for this cashflow from the counterparty's stated point of view — return exactly 'Pay' or 'Receive'. Normalise single-letter indicators, SWIFT direction tags, and combined Pay/Receive columns to the full word. In shorthand lines the direction indicator follows the currency. If the email states no direction (for example a fund or quantity table with no Pay/Receive column), return an empty string — do not infer it from the amount's sign.",
                value: 'Pay',
                examples: ['Pay', 'Receive', 'Pay']
            },
            // ---- optional ----
            // ---- optional (MASTER-style prompt + 3 grounded examples, from the real counterparty mails) ----
            { name: 'Nomura Entity', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the Nomura booking entity for this cashflow — the internal legal entity / branch on Nomura's side (the recipient side of the correspondence), NOT the counterparty. It may appear after a label such as 'Entity', 'Nomura Entity' or 'Bank', or written as 'BANK <city>' (e.g. 'BANK London', 'BANK Singapore'), or in an 'Entity=' key/value line. Return the entity name only. If the email does not name a Nomura entity, return an empty string — do not guess.",
              value: 'BANK London', examples: ['BANK London', 'BANK Singapore', 'BANK Tokyo'] },
            { name: 'Product', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the product / instrument type for this cashflow. It usually appears on a line labelled 'Product' (sometimes 'Instrument' or 'Product Type'), e.g. 'Equity-Linked Note', 'FX Forward', 'Credit Default Swap', 'NDF', 'Interest Rate Swap'. Return the product name exactly as written. If no product is stated, return an empty string.",
              value: 'Equity-Linked Note', examples: ['Equity-Linked Note', 'FX Forward', 'Credit Default Swap'] },
            { name: 'Trade Reference', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the counterparty's trade / deal reference for THIS cashflow. It typically appears on a line labelled 'Reference' (sometimes 'Trade Ref', 'Deal Ref' or 'Our Ref') and is usually a 9-digit number. When the email lists multiple cash flows, take the reference from the same block as this cashflow. Return the reference token only. If none is present, return an empty string.",
              value: '345927053', examples: ['345927053', '344803556', '352338792'] },
            { name: 'Trade Date', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the trade / execution date for this cashflow — the date the trade was dealt, which is DISTINCT from the settlement / value date. Look for a label such as 'Trade Date', 'Deal Date' or 'Execution Date'. Interpret whatever date format is present and always return ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. Many settlement mails do not state a trade date; if it is genuinely absent, return an empty string — do NOT substitute the value date.",
              value: '2026-06-10', examples: ['2026-06-10', '2026-06-05', ''] },
            { name: 'SSI Bank / BIC', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the settlement agent bank and its BIC from the settlement-instruction (SSI) block. It usually appears on a line labelled 'SSI Bank (BIC)', 'Agent Bank' or 'Correspondent'. Return the bank name together with the BIC in parentheses exactly as written, e.g. 'AGENT BANK 7 (AGGBUS3N)'. If the email carries no SSI block, return an empty string.",
              value: 'AGENT BANK 7 (AGGBUS3N)', examples: ['AGENT BANK 7 (AGGBUS3N)', 'AGENT BANK 5 (AGEBGB22)', 'AGENT BANK 1 (AGABUS33)'] },
            { name: 'SSI Account', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the settlement account number from the SSI block for this cashflow — usually the line labelled 'SSI Account' or 'Account'. It is typically a 10-digit number. Return the digits only. If no SSI account is given, return an empty string.",
              value: '1874730946', examples: ['1874730946', '8052701989', '1500631843'] },
            { name: 'SSI Beneficiary / BIC', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the beneficiary and its BIC from the settlement-instruction block — usually the line labelled 'Beneficiary (BIC)' or 'Beneficiary'. Return the beneficiary name together with the BIC in parentheses exactly as written, e.g. 'Counterparty8 (CPTYCA2L)'. If no beneficiary is stated, return an empty string.",
              value: 'Counterparty8 (CPTYCA2L)', examples: ['Counterparty8 (CPTYCA2L)', 'Counterparty7 (CPTYAU2L)', 'Counterparty (DEMOCP2L)'] },
            { name: 'SSI Intermediary', type: 'string', mandatory: false,
              prompt: "Extract the intermediary / correspondent bank and its BIC from the settlement-instruction block, if present — usually labelled 'Intermediary (BIC)', 'Intermediary' or 'Correspondent'. Return the name with the BIC in parentheses exactly as written. Many mails have no intermediary line; if it is genuinely absent, return an empty string.",
              value: '', examples: ['INTERMEDIARY BANK 2 (INTBUS33)', 'CORRESPONDENT BANK (CORRGB22)', ''] }
        ],
        // Target-system column names available for mapping.
        targetFields: {
            'System 1': ['trade_ref', 'cpty', 'notional_amt', 'ccy_pair', 'rate', 'value_dt', 'trade_dt', 'side'],
            'System 2': ['tradeId', 'counterparty', 'notional', 'currencyPair', 'price', 'valueDate', 'tradeDate', 'buySell'],
            'PCM': ['cashflow_id', 'counterparty_entity', 'amount', 'currency', 'rate', 'value_date', 'trade_date', 'direction']
        },
        // CSG target systems + their identifier columns — the RDM id maps to the system's "rdm id" column.
        targetSystemsCsg: ['EVE', 'Target 1', 'Target 2'],
        targetFieldsCsg: {
            'EVE': ['rdm id', 'entity', 'role', 'short_name', 'long_name', 'full_name', 'country', 'status'],
            'Target 1': ['rdm id', 'entity', 'status'],
            'Target 2': ['rdm id', 'entity', 'status']
        }
    };

    function defaultModel() {
        return {
            id: '', name: '', description: '', bu: '', subBu: '', service: '',
            workDriver: '', activity: '',
            inputFormat: 'Email', ingestionType: 'Mail', mailbox: '', frequency: 'Real-time',
            labels: [],                          // [{name, context, keywords, senders, subject, exclusions}]
            fields: [],                          // [{name, type, prompt, example, value, custom, matchMode, fuzzyPct, tolerance}]
            targets: [{ system: '', map: {} }],  // [{system, map: {fieldName: targetField}}]
            // Outlook Tagging — one row per preconfigured stage; manager fills the tag.
            tagging: [
                { stage: 'Default', tag: '' },
                { stage: 'Extraction Confirmed', tag: '' },
                { stage: 'Review Confirmed', tag: '' },
                { stage: 'Resolved', tag: '' },
                { stage: 'Escalated', tag: '' }
            ],
            // Analyst Writeback — the 3 fixed match outcomes; each holds a LIST of configured actions
            // (unfilled by default — the manager adds one or more in the Write-back step).
            writeback: [
                { scenario: 'Matched', actions: [] },
                { scenario: 'Mismatch', actions: [] },
                { scenario: 'No Match', actions: [] }
            ],
            tolerances: {},                      // { rel_tol, abs_tol, vd_tol_days, t2_amt_abs, t2_amt_rel } — blank = inherit system default
            status: 'draft', version: 'v1'
        };
    }

    // ---- activity step-template registry ----
    // The step SEQUENCE for a (work-driver / activity) is PRE-CODED, not composed by the manager. Once
    // an activity is chosen on the Define screen, its steps are revealed (read-only); the manager only
    // configures each step's values below. Adding a new activity's sequence is a DEVELOPER task.
    // (Only "Compare & Match" is defined for now — other activities show "not defined yet".)
    data.cat.stepTemplates = {
        'Compare & Match': [
            { n: 1, name: 'Email Ingestion', desc: 'Pull the email from the configured mailbox / source.' },
            { n: 2, name: 'Email Identification', desc: 'Classify the email and keep only the in-scope ones.' },
            { n: 3, name: 'Extract Counterparty', desc: 'Derive the counterparty from the sender directory.' },
            { n: 4, name: 'Extract Fields', desc: 'Extract the settlement fields using the configured AI prompts.' },
            { n: 5, name: 'Compare & Match', desc: 'Match the extracted fields against the target system.' },
            { n: 6, name: 'Route / Write-back', desc: 'Surface the outcome to the analyst for review & write-back.' }
        ],
        // ---- DEMO PLACEHOLDERS: Reconcile / Validation reveal their own step sequence on Define, but are
        // NOT wired to a runtime pipeline yet (only Compare & Match runs). Different steps per skill. ----
        'Reconcile': [
            { n: 1, name: 'Email Ingestion', desc: 'Pull the email from the configured mailbox / source.' },
            { n: 2, name: 'Email Identification', desc: 'Classify the email and keep only the in-scope ones.' },
            { n: 3, name: 'Extract Positions', desc: 'Extract the positions / balances to reconcile.' },
            { n: 4, name: 'Load Ledger', desc: 'Load the internal ledger records for the value date.' },
            { n: 5, name: 'Reconcile', desc: 'Reconcile the extracted positions against the ledger and flag breaks.' },
            { n: 6, name: 'Route Breaks', desc: 'Route the reconciliation breaks to the analyst.' }
        ],
        'Validation': [
            { n: 1, name: 'Email Ingestion', desc: 'Pull the email from the configured mailbox / source.' },
            { n: 2, name: 'Email Identification', desc: 'Classify the email and keep only the in-scope ones.' },
            { n: 3, name: 'Extract Fields', desc: 'Extract the fields to validate using the configured AI prompts.' },
            { n: 4, name: 'Validate', desc: 'Validate the extracted fields against the business rules.' },
            { n: 5, name: 'Report', desc: 'Report the validation outcome to the analyst.' }
        ]
    };
    // CSG entity-data pipeline — different sequence: extract the RDM id, resolve it in EVE, surface the
    // entity + status. No counterparty derivation, no compare/match, no write-back.
    data.cat.stepTemplatesCsg = [
        { n: 1, name: 'Email Ingestion', desc: 'Pull the entity-data email from the configured mailbox / source.' },
        { n: 2, name: 'Email Identification', desc: 'Classify & route the CSG (NLUX) emails and keep only the in-scope ones.' },
        { n: 3, name: 'Extract RDM ID', desc: 'Extract the RDM id from the email using the configured AI prompt.' },
        { n: 4, name: 'Resolve in EVE', desc: 'Look up the RDM id in the EVE directory (entity, role, names, country, status).' },
        { n: 5, name: 'Review', desc: 'Surface the resolved entity and its status to the analyst.' }
    ];

    // ---- Compare & Match tolerances (step 5) — per-driver overrides + current SYSTEM defaults for placeholders.
    // Written to x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard.config_overrides (match.* keys) and read live by CompareMatch.loadConfig(wizId).
    var _cfg = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.NfotcConfig();
    data.cat.tolerances = [
        // Tier 1 & 3 are EXACT (no tolerance) per FR-MTH-001/020 — only Tier 2 has tunable tolerances.
        { mkey: 'vd_tol_days', ckey: 'match.vd_tol_days', label: 'Value-date window (business days)', tier: 'Tier 2', step: '1', def: _cfg.getNumber('match.vd_tol_days', '', 2), hint: '+/- N BUSINESS days for the fuzzy value-date match (weekends skipped).' },
        { mkey: 't2_amt_abs', ckey: 'match.t2_amt_abs', label: 'Tier 2 amount tolerance', tier: 'Tier 2', step: '0.1', def: _cfg.getNumber('match.t2_amt_abs', '', 50.0), hint: 'Amount tolerance in currency units (FSD: "$50 equivalent" — FX normalization pending).' },
        { mkey: 'name_fuzzy_pct', ckey: 'match.name_fuzzy_pct', label: 'Fuzzy name-match threshold', tier: 'Tier 2', step: '0.01', def: _cfg.getNumber('match.name_fuzzy_pct', '', 0.85), hint: 'Similarity 0-1 for the counterparty name fuzzy match, e.g. 0.85.' }
    ];

    // ---- load existing (copy = clone, edit = same record) ----
    var copyId = $sp.getParameter('copy') || '';
    var editId = $sp.getParameter('edit') || '';
    var loadId = editId || copyId;
    data.mode = editId ? 'edit' : 'new';
    var model = defaultModel();
    if (loadId) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (g.get(loadId)) {
            model.name = editId ? g.getValue('name') : (g.getValue('name') + ' (copy)');
            model.description = g.getValue('description');
            model.bu = g.getValue('bu') || '';
            model.subBu = g.getValue('sub_bu') || '';
            model.service = g.getValue('service') || '';
            model.workDriver = g.getValue('work_driver');
            model.activity = g.getValue('activity') || 'Compare & Match';
            // Back-fill BU/Sub-BU/Service for wizards created before the current taxonomy so the cascade shows them.
            var _rt = _cm.resolveTaxonomy(model.bu, model.subBu, model.service, model.workDriver);
            model.bu = _rt.bu; model.subBu = _rt.subBu; model.service = _rt.service;
            model.inputFormat = g.getValue('input_format') || 'Email';
            model.ingestionType = g.getValue('ingestion_type') || 'Mail';
            model.mailbox = g.getValue('mailbox');
            model.frequency = g.getValue('frequency') || 'Real-time';
            try { model.labels = JSON.parse(g.getValue('id_rules') || '[]'); } catch (el) { model.labels = []; }
            try { model.fields = JSON.parse(g.getValue('input_fields') || '[]'); } catch (e) { model.fields = []; }
            try { var tg = JSON.parse(g.getValue('tagging') || '[]'); if (tg.length) { model.tagging = tg; } } catch (etg) { /* keep defaults */ }
            try { var wb = JSON.parse(g.getValue('writeback') || '[]'); if (wb.length) { model.writeback = wb; } } catch (ewb) { /* keep defaults */ }
            var tmap = {};
            try { tmap = JSON.parse(g.getValue('mapping') || '{}'); } catch (e2) { tmap = {}; }
            model.targets = [{ system: g.getValue('target_system') || '', map: tmap }];
            // Per-driver Compare & Match tolerances (config_overrides JSON, keyed match.* -> model key).
            model.tolerances = {};
            try {
                var _ov = JSON.parse(g.getValue('config_overrides') || '{}') || {};
                for (var _t = 0; _t < data.cat.tolerances.length; _t++) {
                    var _td = data.cat.tolerances[_t];
                    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(_ov, _td.ckey)) { model.tolerances[_td.mkey] = '' + _ov[_td.ckey]; }
                }
            } catch (etol) { model.tolerances = {}; }
            if (editId) { model.id = loadId; model.status = g.getValue('status') || 'draft'; model.version = g.getValue('version') || 'v1'; }
        }
    }
    data.initModel = model;
    data.startStep = parseInt($sp.getParameter('step'), 10) || 1;

    // ---- Test a single field's extraction against sample input, via Now Assist (NASK) ----
    // Prompt-driven: the field's AI Prompt (+ example) becomes the runtime instruction handed to the
    // generic "Extract Field (Generic)" skill — so what the analyst edits in the wizard IS what runs.
    if (input && input.action === 'test') {
        data.testOutput = '';
        data.testStatus = '';
        var fieldName = input.testField || '';
        var sampleText = input.testInput || '';
        try {
            if (!sampleText) {
                data.testOutput = '(enter some input text to test)';
            } else {
                var instruction = 'Extract the field "' + fieldName + '". ' + (input.testPrompt || '');
                // Pair Example + Value into a one-shot worked example so the model learns input -> answer.
                if (input.testExample || input.testValue) {
                    instruction += '\n\nWorked example —';
                    if (input.testExample) { instruction += '\nINPUT: ' + input.testExample; }
                    if (input.testValue) { instruction += '\nVALUE: ' + input.testValue; }
                }
                // Skeleton is format-neutral, so the instruction must set the output format.
                instruction += '\n\nReturn ONLY the extracted value as plain text — no field name, no quotes, no JSON. If it is genuinely absent, return an empty string.';
                var gx = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.GenericFieldExtractor();
                var res = gx.extract(instruction, sampleText);
                data.testStatus = res.status || '';
                data.testOutput = (res.status === 'ok')
                    ? (res.value || '(the model returned an empty value — field not found)')
                    : ('(no value — status: ' + (res.status || 'unknown') + ')');
            }
        } catch (et) {
            data.testOutput = 'error: ' + et;
        }
        return;   // don't fall through to persist; the client keeps its working model
    }

    // ---- Prompt enhancer (custom fields): rewrite the manager's rough AI Prompt via a Now Assist skill.
    if (input && input.action === 'enhance_prompt') {
        data.enhanceStatus = '';
        data.enhanceText = '';
        try {
            var _pe = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.PromptEnhancer().enhance(input.enhanceDraft || '', input.enhanceField || '', input.enhanceMode || '');
            data.enhanceStatus = _pe.status || '';
            data.enhanceText = (_pe.status === 'ok') ? (_pe.text || '') : '';
        } catch (ee) {
            data.enhanceStatus = 'error';
        }
        return;   // don't fall through to persist; the client keeps its working model
    }

    // ---- Record-mode run: extract EVERY trade/row from a sample, using all configured fields ----
    // One skill call, one JSON object per row, so multi-trade emails stay aligned per row.
    if (input && input.action === 'run_extract') {
        data.runRows = [];
        data.runKeys = [];
        data.runStatus = '';
        var fields = input.runFields || [];
        var sample = input.runInput || '';
        function slug(s) { return ('' + (s || '')).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '') || 'field'; }
        try {
            if (!sample) { data.runStatus = 'no_input'; return; }
            if (!fields.length) { data.runStatus = 'no_fields'; return; }
            var keys = [], lines = [], seen = {};
            for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
                var f = fields[i] || {};
                var key = slug(f.name); var base = key, n = 2;
                while (seen[key]) { key = base + '_' + (n++); }
                seen[key] = true;
                keys.push({ key: key, label: f.name || key });
                var line = '- ' + key + ': ' + (f.prompt || f.name || key);
                var exParts = [];
                var fexr = f.examples || [];
                for (var xr = 0; xr < fexr.length; xr++) { var evr = fexr[xr]; if (evr && typeof evr === 'object') { evr = evr.value; } if (evr) { exParts.push('"' + evr + '"'); } }
                if (exParts.length) { line += ' (example values: ' + exParts.join(', ') + ')'; }
                else if (f.value) { line += ' (example value: "' + f.value + '")'; }
                lines.push(line);
            }
            var shape = [];
            for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) { shape.push('"' + keys[j].key + '":""'); }
            var instruction =
                'Extract EVERY trade / row present in the TEXT (there may be one row or many — e.g. each line of a table is a row). ' +
                'For EACH row, extract these fields:\n' + lines.join('\n') +
                '\n\nReturn ONLY a JSON array — one object per row, each object exactly {' + shape.join(',') + '}. ' +
                'No markdown, no code fences, no commentary. If a field is absent for a row, use "".';
            var gx = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.GenericFieldExtractor();
            var res = gx.extractRecords(instruction, sample);
            data.runStatus = res.status;
            data.runKeys = keys;
            data.runRaw = ('' + (res.raw || '')).substring(0, 4000);
            if (res.status === 'ok') {
                var _we = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.WizardExtractor();   // same deterministic guardrail as the runtime extraction
                var rows = [];
                for (var r = 0; r < res.rows.length; r++) {
                    var obj = res.rows[r] || {}, row = {};
                    for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
                        row[keys[k].key] = _we.validateField(keys[k].label, obj[keys[k].key]);
                    }
                    rows.push(row);
                }
                data.runRows = rows;
            }
        } catch (er) {
            data.runStatus = 'error';
            data.runRaw = '' + er;
        }
        return;
    }

    // ---- persist: save-as-draft / publish ----
    if (input && (input.action === 'save_draft' || input.action === 'publish') && input.model) {
        var m = input.model;
        var rec = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        var isUpdate = m.id && rec.get(m.id);
        if (!isUpdate) { rec.initialize(); }
        rec.setValue('name', m.name || 'Untitled wizard');
        rec.setValue('description', m.description || '');
        rec.setValue('bu', m.bu || '');
        rec.setValue('sub_bu', m.subBu || '');
        rec.setValue('service', m.service || '');
        rec.setValue('work_driver', m.workDriver || '');
        rec.setValue('activity', m.activity || '');
        rec.setValue('input_format', m.inputFormat || '');
        rec.setValue('ingestion_type', m.ingestionType || '');
        rec.setValue('mailbox', m.mailbox || '');
        rec.setValue('frequency', m.frequency || '');
        // Store the added field rows (name + type + AI prompt + example + value + per-field match config).
        var sel = [];
        var fs = m.fields || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < fs.length; i++) {
            if (fs[i].name) {
                var exs = [];
                var fex = fs[i].examples || [];
                for (var xi = 0; xi < fex.length; xi++) {
                    var ev = fex[xi];
                    if (ev && typeof ev === 'object') { ev = ev.value; }   // migrate any old {input,value}
                    if (ev !== null && ev !== undefined && ('' + ev) !== '') { exs.push('' + ev); }
                }
                sel.push({
                    name: fs[i].name, type: fs[i].type || 'string',
                    prompt: fs[i].prompt || '', example: fs[i].example || '', value: fs[i].value || '', custom: !!fs[i].custom,
                    mapExclude: !!fs[i].mapExclude, examples: exs
                });
            }
        }
        rec.setValue('input_fields', JSON.stringify(sel));
        rec.setValue('id_rules', JSON.stringify(m.labels || []));
        rec.setValue('tagging', JSON.stringify(m.tagging || []));
        // Write-back: persist each outcome's ACTION LIST only (drop the transient _add UI field; tolerate legacy {action}).
        var wbOut = [], wbIn = m.writeback || [];
        for (var wbi = 0; wbi < wbIn.length; wbi++) {
            var wbActs = (wbIn[wbi].actions instanceof Array) ? wbIn[wbi].actions : (wbIn[wbi].action ? [wbIn[wbi].action] : []);
            wbOut.push({ scenario: wbIn[wbi].scenario, actions: wbActs });
        }
        rec.setValue('writeback', JSON.stringify(wbOut));
        var t0 = (m.targets && m.targets[0]) || { system: '', map: {} };
        rec.setValue('target_system', t0.system || '');
        rec.setValue('mapping', JSON.stringify(t0.map || {}));
        // Per-driver Compare & Match tolerances -> config_overrides (blank/invalid = inherit system default;
        // preserve any non-tolerance override keys already on the record).
        var _ovOut = {};
        try { _ovOut = JSON.parse(rec.getValue('config_overrides') || '{}') || {}; } catch (eo) { _ovOut = {}; }
        var _mt = m.tolerances || {};
        for (var _ti = 0; _ti < data.cat.tolerances.length; _ti++) {
            var _ck = data.cat.tolerances[_ti].ckey, _mk = data.cat.tolerances[_ti].mkey;
            var _val = ('' + (_mt[_mk] === undefined || _mt[_mk] === null ? '' : _mt[_mk])).trim();
            if (_val === '' || isNaN(parseFloat(_val))) { delete _ovOut[_ck]; } else { _ovOut[_ck] = _val; }
        }
        rec.setValue('config_overrides', JSON.stringify(_ovOut));
        rec.setValue('status', input.action === 'publish' ? 'published' : 'draft');
        rec.setValue('version', m.version || 'v1');
        if (isUpdate) { rec.update(); data.savedId = m.id; } else { data.savedId = '' + rec.insert(); }
        data.saved = true;
        data.savedAction = input.action;
        // (Wizard lifecycle is intentionally NOT written to the cashflow audit trail.)
    }
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/wizard-builder.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>4ac6698861124e668874a821335dbeb8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/wizard-builder.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_4ac6698861124e668874a821335dbeb8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[function controller($window) {
    var c = this;
    // Manager-only surface — analysts (and admins without the manager role) go to their work drivers.
    if (c.data && !c.data.isManager) { $window.location.replace('/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers'); return; }
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () { $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm'); };
    // View-as toggle (test user only): set the session view, then land on that view.
    c.switchView = function (view) {
        c.data.action = 'set_view';
        c.data.viewAs = view;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.data.action = '';
            $window.location.href = (view === 'manager') ? '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_manager_dashboard' : '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers';
        });
    };

    // Select a work-driver chip -> reload scoped to it (empty = all).
    c.selectDriver = function (id) {
        var base = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_manager_dashboard';
        $window.location.href = id ? (base + '&wiz=' + id) : base;
    };

    // Remind an analyst (placeholder until assignment/notifications are wired).
    c.reminded = {};
    c.remind = function (name) { c.reminded[name] = true; };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/manager-dashboard.client.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>4b2eb63bc513444ab56d7cb3832fca66</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/manager-dashboard.client.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_4b2eb63bc513444ab56d7cb3832fca66</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[function controller($window) {
    var c = this;
    // Managers (and admins) land on the Manager Dashboard, not the analyst card grid.
    if (c.data && c.data.isManager) { $window.location.replace('/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_manager_dashboard'); return; }
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () {
        $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm');
    };
    // View-as toggle (test user only): set the session view, then land on that view.
    c.switchView = function (view) {
        c.data.action = 'set_view';
        c.data.viewAs = view;
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.data.action = '';
            $window.location.href = (view === 'manager') ? '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_manager_dashboard' : '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers';
        });
    };
}

export function showStateUpdate(current, previous) {
    const currentState = current.getValue('state');

    gs.addInfoMessage(`state updated from "${previousState}" to "${currentState}"`);
}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[function controller($window) {
    var c = this;

    // Header user menu + sign out.
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () {
        $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm');
    };

    // Filters.
    c.q = '';
    c.wdFilter = '';
    c.actFilter = '';
    c.setWd = function (v) { c.wdFilter = v; };
    c.setAct = function (v) { c.actFilter = v; };
    c.rowFilter = function (card) {
        var q = ('' + (c.q || '')).toLowerCase();
        if (q && ('' + card.name).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1) { return false; }
        if (c.wdFilter && card.workDriver !== c.wdFilter) { return false; }
        if (c.actFilter && card.activity !== c.actFilter) { return false; }
        return true;
    };

    // Create modal.
    c.showModal = false;
    c.copyId = '';
    c.openModal = function () { c.showModal = true; c.copyId = ''; };
    c.closeModal = function () { c.showModal = false; };
    c.createNew = function () { $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_builder'; };
    c.copyEdit = function () {
        if (!c.copyId) { return; }
        $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_builder&copy=' + c.copyId;
    };

    // Card actions.
    c.open = function (id) { $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_builder&edit=' + id; };
    c.publishDraft = function (id) { $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_wizard_builder&edit=' + id + '&step=5'; };

    // Assign to real people.
    c.showAssign = false;
    c.assignWiz = null;
    c.assignSel = {};
    c.assignQ = '';
    c.openAssign = function (w) {
        c.assignWiz = w;
        c.assignSel = {};
        var ids = w.assignedIds || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) { c.assignSel[ids[i]] = true; }
        c.assignQ = '';
        c.showAssign = true;
    };
    c.closeAssign = function () { c.showAssign = false; c.assignWiz = null; };
    c.assignCount = function () { var n = 0; for (var k in c.assignSel) { if (c.assignSel[k]) { n++; } } return n; };
    c.userFilter = function (u) {
        var q = ('' + (c.assignQ || '')).toLowerCase();
        if (!q) { return true; }
        return ('' + u.name).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) > -1 || ('' + u.email).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) > -1;
    };
    c.saveAssign = function () {
        var ids = [];
        for (var k in c.assignSel) { if (c.assignSel[k]) { ids.push(k); } }
        c.data.action = 'assign';
        c.data.wizardId = c.assignWiz.id;
        c.data.userIds = ids.join(',');
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.data.action = ''; c.data.wizardId = ''; c.data.userIds = '';
            c.closeAssign();
        });
    };

    c.remove = function (id, name) {
        if (!$window.confirm('Delete "' + name + '"? This cannot be undone.')) { return; }
        c.data.action = 'delete';
        c.data.wizardId = id;
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; c.data.wizardId = ''; });
    };

    // ---- Settings (gear on a card): edit the wizard record's config fields inline ----
    var scat = (c.data && c.data.cat) || {};
    var STAX = scat.taxonomy || {};
    c.showSettings = false;
    c.settingsWiz = null;
    c.settings = null;
    c.savingSettings = false;
    c.openSettings = function (w) {
        c.settingsWiz = w;
        c.settings = {
            description: w.description || '', bu: w.bu || '', subBu: w.subBu || '', service: w.service || '',
            activity: w.activity || 'Compare & Match', workDriver: w.workDriver || '',
            mailbox: w.mailbox || '', inputFormat: w.inputFormat || 'Email',
            ingestionType: w.ingestionType || 'Mail', frequency: w.frequency || 'Real-time',
            target: w.target || '', version: w.version || 'v1'
        };
        c.showSettings = true;
    };
    c.closeSettings = function () { c.showSettings = false; c.settingsWiz = null; c.settings = null; };
    // cascade: BU -> Sub-BU -> Service -> Work Driver (Activity is fixed to "Compare & Match")
    c.sBusList = function () { return Object.keys(STAX); };
    c.sSubBusFor = function () { var s = c.settings; return (s && s.bu && STAX[s.bu]) ? Object.keys(STAX[s.bu]) : []; };
    c.sServicesFor = function () { var s = c.settings; return (s && s.bu && s.subBu && STAX[s.bu] && STAX[s.bu][s.subBu]) ? Object.keys(STAX[s.bu][s.subBu]) : []; };
    c.sWorkDriversFor = function () { var s = c.settings; return (s && s.bu && s.subBu && s.service && STAX[s.bu] && STAX[s.bu][s.subBu] && STAX[s.bu][s.subBu][s.service]) ? STAX[s.bu][s.subBu][s.service] : []; };
    c.sOnBu = function () { c.settings.subBu = ''; c.settings.service = ''; c.settings.workDriver = ''; c.settings.activity = 'Compare & Match'; };
    c.sOnSubBu = function () { c.settings.service = ''; c.settings.workDriver = ''; c.settings.activity = 'Compare & Match'; };
    c.sOnService = function () { c.settings.workDriver = ''; c.settings.activity = 'Compare & Match'; };
    c.sOnWorkDriver = function () { c.settings.activity = 'Compare & Match'; };
    c.saveSettings = function () {
        if (c.savingSettings || !c.settingsWiz) { return; }
        c.savingSettings = true;
        c.data.action = 'save_config';
        c.data.wizardId = c.settingsWiz.id;
        c.data.cfg = JSON.stringify(c.settings);
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            c.savingSettings = false;
            c.data.action = ''; c.data.wizardId = ''; c.data.cfg = '';
            c.closeSettings();
        });
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/wizard-list.client.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>637819981529418184f404c6605c131f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/wizard-list.client.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_637819981529418184f404c6605c131f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * OTC console login — custom branded sign-in for the /nfotcbsm Service Portal.
 * Authenticates through the same endpoint the OOTB Service Portal login widget uses
 * (view_form.login), so it is a real, working login (not a mock). On success it
 * redirects straight to the dashboard (/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_analystdashboard).
 */
function controller($scope, $http, $window, spUtil) {
    var c = this;
    c.username = '';
    c.password = '';
    c.message = '';
    c.busy = false;

    var HOME = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers';

    // SSO short-circuit: if the platform already authenticated this visitor (e.g. SSO on
    // bsmdev), skip the branded sign-in form and go straight to the landing. The server
    // (login.server.js) sets c.data.authed for a real, non-guest session.
    if (c.data && c.data.authed) {
        $window.location = c.data.redirect || HOME;
        return;
    }

    c.login = function (username, password) {
        if (!username || !password) {
            c.message = 'Please enter your username and password.';
            return;
        }
        c.busy = true;
        c.message = '';

        var url = spUtil.getURL({ sysparm_type: 'view_form.login' });
        var body = {
            sysparm_type: 'login',
            'ni.nolog.user_password': true,
            remember_me: true,
            user_name: username,
            user_password: password,
            get_redirect_url: true,
            is_direct_redirect: true,
            sysparm_goto_url: HOME,
            cert_login: false
        };
        var enc = Object.keys(body).map(function (k) {
            return encodeURIComponent(k) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(body[k]);
        }).join('&');

        $http({
            method: 'post',
            url: url,
            data: enc,
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
        }).then(function (res) {
            c.busy = false;
            var d = res.data || {};
            if (d.status === 'success') {
                $window.location = d.redirect_url || HOME;
            } else if (d.status === 'mfa_code_required') {
                $window.location = '/validate_multifactor_auth_code.do';
            } else {
                c.message = d.message || 'Invalid username or password.';
                c.password = '';
            }
        }, function () {
            c.busy = false;
            c.message = 'Sign-in failed. Please try again.';
        });
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/login.client.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>691cd49ae50c4eb3a0539e4e302e7b92</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/login.client.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_691cd49ae50c4eb3a0539e4e302e7b92</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

Stays IN edit mode so the analyst can // then Confirm (or keep editing) — only Confirm leaves edit mode. `dirty` is cleared synchronously // (within this click's digest) so the Save button disables immediately. c.saveError = ''; c.save = function () { if (!c.dirty) { return; } c.dirty = false; c.saveError = ''; c.data.action = 'save'; c.server.update().then( function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; rebuildFeedback(); }, function () { c.dirty = true; c.data.saved = false; c.saveError = 'Save failed — please try again.'; c.data.action = ''; } ); }; // Confirm the AI extracted fields. Leave edit mode so the card returns to the clean read-only view // (plain fields, no action bar, Re-confirm available). CRITICAL: set editing=false SYNCHRONOUSLY here // (not in the server .then) — in Service Portal the .then can run outside Angular's digest, so a // deferred assignment wouldn't re-render, leaving the inputs/action bar stuck on screen. c.confirm = function () { if (c.dirty) { return; } // guarded in the UI too (Confirm disabled while dirty) — never confirm unsaved edits c.editing = false; c.saveError = ''; c.data.action = 'confirm'; c.server.update().then( function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; rebuildFeedback(); }, function () { c.editing = true; c.saveError = 'Confirm failed — please try again.'; c.data.action = ''; } ); }; // Analyst review (HITL) — write back the chosen match outcome for this cashflow (ai_* fields). c.setOutcome = function (o) { c.data.action = 'outcome'; c.data.outcomeChoice = o; c.server.update().then(function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; c.data.outcomeChoice = ''; }); }; c.resetOutcome = function () { c.data.action = 'reset_outcome'; c.server.update().then(function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; }); }; c.confirmReview = function () { c.data.action = 'confirm_review'; c.server.update().then(function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; }); }; // Step 2 — analyst manually SELECTS which candidate booking to compare against (drives the outcome), // or declares that none of them match. Nothing is auto-selected. c.selectCandidate = function (key) { c.data.action = 'select_candidate'; c.data.candKey = key; c.server.update().then(function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; c.data.candKey = ''; }); }; c.markNoMatch = function () { c.data.action = 'mark_no_match'; c.server.update().then(function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; }); }; // Step 3 — final resolution (this is what the dashboard Workflow Status reflects). c.resolveMatched = function () { c.data.action = 'resolve_matched'; c.server.update().then(function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; }); }; c.resolveUnmatched = function () { c.data.action = 'resolve_unmatched'; c.server.update().then(function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; }); }; // Analyst switches which configured write-back action's draft to view/send (>1 action for the outcome). c.pickDraft = function (d) { if (d) { c.data.draft = d; } }; // Optional — perform the configured write-back "send". Does NOT change the workflow status. c.sendMO = function () { c.data.action = 'send_mo'; c.data.sendLabel = (c.data.draft && c.data.draft.sendLabel) || 'Send to Middle Office'; c.server.update().then(function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; c.data.sendLabel = ''; c.data.moSent = true; }); }; } ]]>falsex_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/ai-extraction.client.jssys_moduleakshit.mahajan2026-09-03 11:56:40726720b282b74a548702d0b5a1378fda0x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/ai-extraction.client.jseff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712sys_module_726720b282b74a548702d0b5a1378fdaakshit.mahajan2026-09-03 11:56:40

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * Intake — the ONE reusable front door that turns any source into an NFOTC Work Item
 * (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_work_item). Creating a Work Item is what kicks off the reference pipeline flow (which
 * triggers on Work Item created), so this is the seam every channel shares: the Create Work Item flow
 * action, the inbound-email action, a future Outlook/Graph poll flow, or a manual/API call all land here.
 *
 * Source-agnostic on purpose: the pipeline downstream never cares whether the item came from Outlook, a
 * PDF drop, or an API — only Intake changes when a new channel is added. ADDITIVE — OTC/CSG untouched.
 */
var Intake = Class.create();
Intake.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    T: 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm_work_item',

    /** Set the canonical source fields on a Work Item GlideRecord (does NOT insert — the caller owns that). */
    populate: function (gr, sourceType, sourceRef, rawContent, workDriver) {
        gr.setValue('source_type', '' + (sourceType || ''));
        gr.setValue('source_ref', '' + (sourceRef || ''));
        gr.setValue('raw_content', ('' + (rawContent || '')).substring(0, 8000));
        if (workDriver) { gr.setValue('work_driver', '' + workDriver); }
        if (!gr.getValue('wi_status')) { gr.setValue('wi_status', 'new'); }
        if (!gr.getValue('wi_number')) { gr.setValue('wi_number', this._number()); }
        return gr;
    },

    /**
     * Create a Work Item from a source. Deduplicates on source_ref (a stable per-item id, e.g. an email
     * message-id) so the same item is never ingested twice. Returns the sys_id of the new (or existing)
     * Work Item.
     */
    createWorkItem: function (sourceType, sourceRef, rawContent, workDriver) {
        if (sourceRef) {
            var dup = new GlideRecord(this.T);
            dup.addQuery('source_ref', '' + sourceRef);
            dup.setLimit(1); dup.query();
            if (dup.next()) { return dup.getUniqueValue(); }
        }
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.T);
        gr.initialize();
        this.populate(gr, sourceType, sourceRef, rawContent, workDriver);
        return gr.insert();
    },

    _number: function () { return 'WI-' + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue(); },

    type: 'Intake',
};
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/Intake.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>76a3c340e9044e04b650f2ee3b2bd0e4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/Intake.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_76a3c340e9044e04b650f2ee3b2bd0e4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * OTC Dashboard — Service Portal widget SERVER script.
 * Faithful replica of the classic Outlook Tagging dashboard (TaggingDashboard.server.js).
 * Delegates all data prep to the same Script Include (TaggingDashboard.data()) so the two
 * dashboards can never drift; renders it in Angular (see dashboard.html/.scss/.client.js).
 */
(function () {
    var d = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.TaggingDashboard().data();
    data.logo = d.logo;
    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();
    data.stats = d.stats;
    data.rows = d.rows;
    data.counterparties = d.counterparties;
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/dashboard.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>79a8364f4f224243a608bbec1e5acbaf</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/dashboard.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_79a8364f4f224243a608bbec1e5acbaf</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[function controller($window, $timeout, $interval) {
    var c = this;

    // Board pagination survives the cashflow round-trip (opening a cashflow is a FULL page nav that resets
    // Angular state): c.open saves the current page + page-size to sessionStorage, and the restore block
    // (below the pager helpers) reads it on load so we return to the same page instead of page 1. Keyed by
    // wizard id so each board remembers its own page (order-independent — survives ?wiz=/?id= param order).
    c._pageKey = 'nfotcBoardPage:' + ((c.data && c.data.wizId) || 'default');   // server-recovered wiz id — stable even when the URL drops ?wiz= on the way back from a case screen

    // International-format an amount for DISPLAY only (thousands separators). Leaves the raw value + the
    // numeric sort field untouched; preserves any trailing currency text and a leading sign.
    c.fmtAmt = function (v) {
        var s = ('' + (v == null ? '' : v)).trim();
        if (!s) { return ''; }
        var m = s.match(/^(-?)(\d[\d,]*)(\.\d+)?(.*)$/);
        if (!m) { return s; }
        return m[1] + m[2].replace(/,/g, '').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',') + (m[3] || '') + (m[4] || '');
    };
    // Board-level access guard: the server sets data.redirect when the current user isn't permitted to
    // view this wizard's board (not assigned, and not a manager/admin). Navigate back to the landing page.
    if (c.data && c.data.redirect) { $window.location.href = c.data.redirect; return; }
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () { $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm'); };

    c.synced = !!(c.data && c.data.synced);
    c.syncing = false;

    // ---- live async progress state ----
    // CSG scans the whole mailbox and routes its own mails; OTC runs its settlement pipeline. Stage copy
    // differs so the loading card matches what's actually happening.
    var STAGES = (c.data && c.data.isCsg)
        ? ['Scanning the shared mailbox…', 'Routing CSG entity-data (NLUX) mails…', 'Extracting RDM ids…', 'Resolving entities in the EVE directory…']
        : ['Ingesting mails from the mailbox…', 'Classifying the in-scope mails…', 'Deriving counterparties from EVE…', 'Extracting settlement fields with AI…'];
    c.syncProgress = 0;      // real % = done / target
    c.syncDone = 0;
    c.syncTarget = 0;
    c.syncMatched = 0;       // mails routed to THIS wizard (of the whole mailbox scanned)
    c.syncElapsed = 0;
    c.syncMsg = '';
    c._tick = null;          // 1s elapsed/stage ticker
    c._poll = null;          // status poller
    c.elapsedFmt = function () { var m = Math.floor(c.syncElapsed / 60), s = c.syncElapsed % 60; return m + ':' + ('0' + s).slice(-2); };

    function startTicker() {
        var i = 0; c.syncElapsed = 0; c.syncMsg = STAGES[0];
        c._tick = $interval(function () { c.syncElapsed += 1; if (c.syncElapsed % 3 === 0) { i = (i + 1) % STAGES.length; c.syncMsg = STAGES[i]; } }, 1000);
    }
    function stopTicker() { if (c._tick) { $interval.cancel(c._tick); c._tick = null; } }
    function stopPoll() { if (c._poll) { $interval.cancel(c._poll); c._poll = null; } }

    // Access can be REVOKED while the board is already open (manager deletes the work-driver or unassigns
    // the analyst). The server re-runs the access guard on EVERY request and sets data.redirect; check it
    // after every round-trip so an in-page refresh / Sync / poll bounces the analyst out immediately — not
    // only on the initial page load.
    function checkRedirect() {
        if (c.data && c.data.redirect) {
            stopPoll(); stopTicker(); c.syncing = false;
            $window.location.href = c.data.redirect;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // Read the REAL progress the server returns and drive the bar/count.
    function applyProgress() {
        var p = (c.data && c.data.progress) || {};
        c.syncDone = (p.done || 0) + (p.errored || 0);
        c.syncTarget = p.target || 0;
        c.syncMatched = p.matched || 0;
        c.syncProgress = c.syncTarget > 0 ? Math.max(4, Math.round(c.syncDone / c.syncTarget * 100)) : (c.syncDone ? 100 : 8);
        return p;
    }
    function finishSync() {
        stopPoll(); stopTicker();
        c.syncProgress = 100;
        $timeout(function () { c.syncing = false; c.data.action = ''; c.synced = !!c.data.synced; sortRows(); }, 500);
    }

    function sortRows() {
        if (c.data.rows && c.data.rows.length) {
            c.data.rows.sort(function (a, b) { return ('' + (a.mailId || '')).localeCompare('' + (b.mailId || '')); });
        }
    }
    sortRows();

    // Sync now: fire the Workflow-Studio subflow per mail in the BACKGROUND (non-blocking), then poll real
    // progress every ~2.5s — the bar + "X of N" reflect actual completions, and rows stream in live.
    var _lastDone = -1, _noChange = 0, _polls = 0;
    function poll() {
        c.data.action = 'sync_status';
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            if (checkRedirect()) { return; }
            c.data.action = ''; _polls += 1;
            var p = applyProgress();
            sortRows();
            if (p.complete || (p.running || 0) <= 0) { finishSync(); return; }
            if (c.syncDone === _lastDone) { _noChange += 1; } else { _noChange = 0; _lastDone = c.syncDone; }
            if (_polls > 120 || _noChange > 16) { finishSync(); }   // safety: reveal what we have if it stalls
        });
    }
    c.sync = function () {
        if (c.syncing) { return; }
        c.syncing = true; _lastDone = -1; _noChange = 0; _polls = 0;
        c.syncProgress = 6; c.syncDone = 0; c.syncTarget = 0;
        startTicker();
        c.data.action = 'sync';
        c.server.update().then(function () {
            if (checkRedirect()) { return; }
            c.data.action = '';
            var p = applyProgress(); sortRows();
            if (!p.complete && (p.running || 0) > 0) { c._poll = $interval(poll, 2500); }
            else { finishSync(); }
        });
    };
    c.resync = function () {
        c.data.action = 'reset_sync';
        c.server.update().then(function () { if (checkRedirect()) { return; } c.data.action = ''; c.synced = false; c.data.rows = []; });
    };

    // ---- filters + sort (same behaviour as the OTC Settlements dashboard) ----
    c.sortKey = 'mailId'; c.sortAsc = true;
    c.q = ''; c.cpFilter = ''; c.matchFilter = '';
    // Outlook Tagging is a MULTI-SELECT (toggle buttons): c.wfSel holds the chosen tags; empty = show all.
    c.wfTags = ['Awaiting Confirmation', 'Awaiting Review', 'Resolved — Matched', 'Resolved — Unmatched'];
    c.wfSel = {};
    c.toggleWf = function (t) { if (c.wfSel[t]) { delete c.wfSel[t]; } else { c.wfSel[t] = true; } c.onFilterChange(); };
    c.wfActive = function () { for (var k in c.wfSel) { if (c.wfSel.hasOwnProperty(k)) { return true; } } return false; };
    c.clearWf = function () { c.wfSel = {}; c.onFilterChange(); };
    c.rowFilter = function (row) {
        var q = ('' + (c.q || '')).toLowerCase().trim();
        if (q) {
            // Global search across every visible column — mail id, counterparty, amount (raw + formatted),
            // currency, direction, value date, classification, match status and outlook tagging. Every typed
            // word must appear somewhere in the row (AND match).
            var hay = [
                row.mailId, row.cfLabel, row.counterparty, row.amount, c.fmtAmt(row.amount),
                row.currency, row.direction, row.value_date_disp, row.value_date,
                (row.tagging && row.tagging.label), row.matchLabel, row.workflowLabel, row.reference
            ].join(' ').toLowerCase();
            var terms = q.split(/\s+/);
            for (var ti = 0; ti < terms.length; ti++) { if (terms[ti] && hay.indexOf(terms[ti]) === -1) { return false; } }
        }
        if (c.cpFilter && row.counterparty !== c.cpFilter) { return false; }
        if (c.matchFilter && row.matchStatus !== c.matchFilter) { return false; }
        if (c.wfActive() && !c.wfSel[row.workflowLabel]) { return false; }   // multi-select: keep rows whose tag is selected
        return true;
    };
    c.open = function (href) {
        if (!href) { return; }
        // Remember which board page this cashflow was opened from, so returning lands back here.
        try { $window.sessionStorage.setItem(c._pageKey, JSON.stringify({ page: c.page, pageSize: c.pageSize })); } catch (e) { /* sessionStorage unavailable (private mode) */ }
        $window.location.href = href;
    };

    // ---- CSG entity-break board filters + detail panel ----
    c.csgQ = ''; c.csgStatusFilter = '';
    c.csgDetail = null;
    c.openCsg = function (row) { c.csgDetail = row; if ($window.scrollTo) { $window.scrollTo(0, 0); } };
    c.closeCsg = function () { c.csgDetail = null; };
    c.csgRowFilter = function (row) {
        var q = ('' + (c.csgQ || '')).toLowerCase();
        if (q && ('' + (row.rdm || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1 &&
                 ('' + (row.entity || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1 &&
                 ('' + (row.fullName || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1) { return false; }
        if (c.csgStatusFilter && row.status !== c.csgStatusFilter) { return false; }
        return true;
    };
    c.sortVal = function (row, key) {
        if (key === 'amount') { return row.amountNum; }
        if (key === 'elapsed') { return row.elapsedMin; }
        if (key === 'tagging') { return row.tagging.label; }
        if (key === 'match') { return row.matchLabel; }
        return row[key];
    };
    c.arrow = function (key) { if (c.sortKey !== key) { return '⇅'; } return c.sortAsc ? '▲' : '▼'; };
    c.sort = function (key) {
        if (c.sortKey === key) { c.sortAsc = !c.sortAsc; } else { c.sortKey = key; c.sortAsc = true; }
        var asc = c.sortAsc;
        c.data.rows.sort(function (a, b) {
            var xa = c.sortVal(a, key), xb = c.sortVal(b, key), r;
            if (typeof xa === 'number' && typeof xb === 'number') { r = xa - xb; }
            else { r = ('' + xa).localeCompare('' + xb); }
            return asc ? r : -r;
        });
    };

    // ---- pagination (shared by the OTC cashflow board + the CSG entity-break board) ----
    // Client-side only: the rows are already loaded, so this slices the CURRENT filtered set. The user
    // picks how many rows per page from a standard set; "All" shows everything. Available to managers and
    // analysts alike (the read-only mode only hides ACTIONS, not the paging controls).
    c.pageSizes = [10, 25, 50, 100];
    c.pageSize = 25;                 // sensible default
    c.page = 1;
    c.ALL = 1000000;                 // limitTo cap used for the "All" option
    c._ps = function () { return c.pageSize === 'All' ? c.ALL : c.pageSize; };
    c.pageOffset = function () { return (c.page - 1) * (c.pageSize === 'All' ? 0 : c.pageSize); };
    c.pageLimit = function () { return c._ps(); };
    c.pageCount = function (total) { return Math.max(1, Math.ceil((total || 0) / c._ps())); };
    c.prevPage = function () { if (c.page > 1) { c.page -= 1; } };
    c.nextPage = function (total) { if (c.page < c.pageCount(total)) { c.page += 1; } };
    c.lastPage = function (total) { c.page = c.pageCount(total); };
    c.rangeStart = function (total) { return total ? (c.pageOffset() + 1) : 0; };
    c.rangeEnd = function (total) { return Math.min(c.pageOffset() + c._ps(), total || 0); };
    // Reset to page 1 whenever the row set changes shape (search / filter / page-size) so we never land on
    // a now-empty page. Sorting keeps the count, so it does NOT reset the page.
    c.onPageSize = function () { c.page = 1; };
    c.onFilterChange = function () { c.page = 1; };

    // Restore the page/size saved when a cashflow was opened from this board (c.open), so a "← Dashboard"
    // return lands on the same page. Clamp to the current row count so we never overshoot a shorter list.
    (function () {
        try {
            var saved = JSON.parse($window.sessionStorage.getItem(c._pageKey) || 'null');
            if (!saved) { return; }
            if (saved.pageSize === 'All' || c.pageSizes.indexOf(saved.pageSize) !== -1) { c.pageSize = saved.pageSize; }
            var n = parseInt(saved.page, 10);
            if (n > 0) {
                c.page = n;   // restore even if rows haven't rendered yet (board is sync-gated) — never force page 1 prematurely
                var rc = (c.data && c.data.rows) ? c.data.rows.length : 0;
                if (rc > 0 && c.pageSize !== 'All') {
                    var maxPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rc / c.pageSize));   // clamp DOWN only when the count is actually known
                    if (c.page > maxPage) { c.page = maxPage; }
                }
            }
        } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    })();
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/wiz-dashboard.client.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>9072287717404d13bf87e70106759888</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/wiz-dashboard.client.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_9072287717404d13bf87e70106759888</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * Work Driver Onboarding Wizard — LIST page (server).
 * Lists configured wizards split into Published / Drafts, with filter option lists and the
 * "copy an existing wizard" source list for the create modal. Delete happens here too.
 *
 * Access is gated by ROLE on the landing page (manager/admin only), so there is no separate
 * password gate on this page.
 */
(function () {
    function hasExplicitRole(roleName) {
        try {
            var roles = gs.getUser().getRoles();
            if (!roles) { return false; }
            for (var i = 0; i < roles.length; i++) { if (('' + roles[i]) === roleName) { return true; } }
        } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
        return false;
    }
    var cm = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch();
    data.logo = cm.LOGO;
    data.name = cm.titleCase(gs.getUserDisplayName() || 'Analyst');
    data.isAdmin = gs.hasRole('admin');

    // Option catalogs for the per-card Settings panel (edit the wizard record's config fields inline).
    data.cat = {
        taxonomy: cm.taxonomy(),
        inputFormats: ['Email', 'PDF', 'Excel'],
        ingestionTypes: ['Mail', 'API', 'File Drop', 'Manual'],
        frequencies: ['Real-time', 'Hourly', 'Daily'],
        targetSystems: ['System 1', 'System 2', 'PCM']
    };
    data.isManager = hasExplicitRole('x_nose_nfotc_bsm.manager');
    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();
    var wlp = ('' + data.name).trim().split(/\s+/);
    data.initials = ((wlp[0] || 'U').charAt(0) + (wlp.length > 1 ? wlp[wlp.length - 1].charAt(0) : '')).toUpperCase();

    // Delete a wizard (trash icon on a card).
    if (input && input.action === 'delete' && input.wizardId) {
        var dg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (dg.get(input.wizardId)) { dg.deleteRecord(); }
    }

    // Settings (gear icon on a card): edit the wizard record's configuration fields inline and write them
    // straight back to x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard — the same fields shown on the native record form.
    if (input && input.action === 'save_config' && input.wizardId && input.cfg) {
        var cfgIn = {};
        try { cfgIn = JSON.parse(input.cfg); } catch (ec) { cfgIn = {}; }
        var cg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (cg.get(input.wizardId)) {
            var FMAP = {
                description: 'description', bu: 'bu', subBu: 'sub_bu', service: 'service', activity: 'activity',
                workDriver: 'work_driver', mailbox: 'mailbox', inputFormat: 'input_format',
                ingestionType: 'ingestion_type', frequency: 'frequency', target: 'target_system', version: 'version'
            };
            for (var mk in FMAP) {
                if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cfgIn, mk)) { cg.setValue(FMAP[mk], '' + (cfgIn[mk] == null ? '' : cfgIn[mk])); }
            }
            cg.update();
            data.configSaved = input.wizardId;
            // (Wizard configuration is intentionally NOT written to the cashflow audit trail.)
        }
    }

    // Assign a published workflow to real people: store the list on the wizard AND grant them the
    // analyst role (best-effort) so they can actually run it.
    if (input && input.action === 'assign' && input.wizardId) {
        var wg2 = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
        if (wg2.get(input.wizardId)) {
            var ids = ('' + (input.userIds || '')).split(',');
            var analystRoleId = '';
            var rr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_role');
            if (rr.get('name', 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm.analyst')) { analystRoleId = rr.getUniqueValue(); }
            var list = [];
            for (var ai = 0; ai < ids.length; ai++) {
                var uid = ids[ai];
                if (!uid) { continue; }
                var ug2 = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
                if (!ug2.get(uid)) { continue; }
                list.push({ id: uid, name: ug2.getValue('name') });
                if (analystRoleId) {
                    try {
                        var chk = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
                        chk.addQuery('user', uid);
                        chk.addQuery('role', analystRoleId);
                        chk.query();
                        if (!chk.hasNext()) {
                            var ins = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
                            ins.initialize();
                            ins.setValue('user', uid);
                            ins.setValue('role', analystRoleId);
                            ins.insert();
                        }
                    } catch (e) { /* role grant best-effort (may be restricted) */ }
                }
            }
            wg2.setValue('assigned_users', JSON.stringify(list));
            wg2.setValue('assigned_count', list.length);
            wg2.update();
        }
    }

    // Assignable people (real, active users with an email), for the Assign modal.
    data.users = [];
    var ug = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
    ug.addActiveQuery();
    ug.addNotNullQuery('email');
    ug.addQuery('email', 'NOT LIKE', 'example.com');   // query-level exclude of OOB demo users (…@example.com)
    ug.addQuery('email', 'NOT LIKE', 'email.com');     // …and the …@email.com demo users
    ug.orderBy('name');
    ug.setLimit(2000);                                 // high cap so real analysts past 'R' are actually fetched (not truncated by demo users)
    ug.query();
    while (ug.next()) {
        var unm = ug.getValue('name');
        if (!unm) { continue; }
        var uem = ug.getValue('email') || '';
        var lem = uem.toLowerCase();
        if (lem.indexOf('example.com') !== -1 || lem.indexOf('email.com') !== -1) { continue; }   // JS backup: always drop demo domains even if the query operator doesn't
        data.users.push({ id: ug.getUniqueValue(), name: unm, email: uem });
    }

    function fieldCount(json) {
        try { var a = JSON.parse(json || '[]'); return a.length; } catch (e) { return 0; }
    }
    function assignedList(json) {
        try { return JSON.parse(json || '[]'); } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    data.published = [];
    data.drafts = [];
    data.allWizards = [];
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard');
    gr.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
    gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) {
        var cardActivity = gr.getValue('activity') || 'Compare & Match';
        var cardWd = gr.getValue('work_driver') || '';
        var rtc = cm.resolveTaxonomy(gr.getValue('bu') || '', gr.getValue('sub_bu') || '', gr.getValue('service') || '', cardWd);
        var card = {
            id: gr.getUniqueValue(),
            name: gr.getValue('name') || 'Untitled wizard',
            description: gr.getValue('description') || '',
            bu: rtc.bu, subBu: rtc.subBu, service: rtc.service,
            workDriver: cardWd,
            activity: cardActivity,
            inputFormat: gr.getValue('input_format') || 'Email',
            ingestionType: gr.getValue('ingestion_type') || 'Mail',
            frequency: gr.getValue('frequency') || 'Real-time',
            source: gr.getValue('mailbox') || '',
            mailbox: gr.getValue('mailbox') || '',
            target: gr.getValue('target_system') || '',
            version: gr.getValue('version') || 'v1',
            fieldCount: fieldCount(gr.getValue('input_fields')),
            status: gr.getValue('status') || 'draft'
        };
        var au = assignedList(gr.getValue('assigned_users'));
        card.assigned = au.length;
        card.assignedIds = au.map(function (u) { return u.id; });
        data.allWizards.push({ id: card.id, name: card.name });
        if (card.status === 'published') { data.published.push(card); } else { data.drafts.push(card); }
    }

    // Filter option lists (chips).
    data.workDrivers = ['Non Pari-ff Prematching', 'OTC Settlements', 'Position Management / Depot Transfer'];
    data.activities = ['Compare & Match', 'Reconcile', 'Validate'];
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/wizard-list.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>94fbf57279734e04a0372921f3a097b1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/wizard-list.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_94fbf57279734e04a0372921f3a097b1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:40</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>
