<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * EmlFieldExtractor — deterministic (no-LLM) extraction of settlement fields from a
 * relevant email's BODY. Handles every shape seen in the corpus:
 *   - SWIFT MT blocks (:20:/:32A:/:72:)
 *   - plain-text pipe tables (preferred over their HTML mirror, which often renames /
 *     adds columns) with a wide column-synonym map
 *   - HTML tables (fallback)
 *   - "Label : Value" text (incl. quoted ">" forwards)
 *   - inline prose ("GBP 692,043.41 (Receive, value 2026-06-04, ref 344163511)")
 *   - compact code lists ("AUD P 3,411,420.02")
 * plus base64-encoded parts, direction-value normalisation (Coun Pay / COU RECEIVE / RECV /
 * R|P -> Pay|Receive), dd/MM/yyyy + d-MMM-yyyy date normalisation, and subject/prose
 * fallbacks for value_date and reference when the table doesn't carry them.
 *
 * Best-effort by design: no LLM. Only runs on RELEVANT emails; skips emails that carry a
 * real file attachment (those need attachment parsing, out of scope for now). Standing
 * settlement-instruction notices (SSI) have no cashflow and are marked status 'ssi_only'.
 * The raw .eml is still preserved as an attachment.
 *
 * Fields: counterparty_name (from sender), reference, currency, amount, direction, value_date.
 */
var EmlFieldExtractor = Class.create();
EmlFieldExtractor.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    /**
     * @param {string} attachmentSysId  .eml sys_attachment sys_id
     * @param {string} classification   'relevant' | 'irrelevant'
     */
    extract: function (attachmentSysId, classification) {
        if (!attachmentSysId) {
            return this._empty('no_attachment');
        }
        var raw = this._readText(attachmentSysId);
        var out = this.extractFromText(raw, classification);
        // Counterparty = org name from the EVE directory, looked up by sender email.
        // Falls back to the sender display name (set in extractFromText) if not found.
        if (out.status !== 'skipped_irrelevant') {
            var org = this._counterpartyOrg(this._fromEmail(raw));
            if (org) { out.counterparty_name = org; }
        }
        return out;
    },

    // The From email ADDRESS (not the display name), lowercased.
    _fromEmail: function (raw) {
        var from = this._headerVal(raw, 'From');
        if (!from) { return ''; }
        var m = from.match(/<([^>]+)>/);
        var addr = m ? m[1] : (from.match(/[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+/) || [''])[0];
        return ('' + addr).trim().toLowerCase();
    },

    // Look up the counterparty org name in the EVE directory by sender email.
    _counterpartyOrg: function (email) {
        if (!email) { return ''; }
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_counterparty');
        gr.addQuery('email_address', email);
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        return gr.next() ? gr.getValue('org_name') : '';
    },

    // Read the .eml and extract EVERY cashflow (multi-trade mails). Returns the same flat
    // summary fields as extract() PLUS `flows` (an array, one entry per trade) and
    // `flow_count`. The summary fields describe the first flow, for the parent record.
    extractAll: function (attachmentSysId, classification) {
        if (!attachmentSysId) { return this._emptyAll('no_attachment'); }
        var raw = this._readText(attachmentSysId);
        var res = this._analyze(raw, classification);
        var out = this._emptyAll(res.status);
        out.counterparty_name = res.counterparty_name;
        this._copyRow(out, res.summary);
        out.flows = res.flows;
        out.flow_count = res.flows.length;
        if (res.status !== 'skipped_irrelevant') {
            var org = this._counterpartyOrg(this._fromEmail(raw));
            if (org) { out.counterparty_name = org; }
        }
        return out;
    },

    // Pure logic (no ServiceNow attachment read) — unit-testable with raw .eml text.
    // Single-flow view: summary fields + `flows` as a COUNT (kept for backward compat).
    extractFromText: function (raw, classification) {
        var res = this._analyze(raw, classification);
        var out = this._empty(res.status);
        out.counterparty_name = res.counterparty_name;
        this._copyRow(out, res.summary);
        out.flows = res.flows.length || (this._filledCount(res.summary) > 0 ? 1 : 0);
        return out;
    },

    // Core: parse the mail into a list of cashflow rows + a summary + a status. Pure.
    _analyze: function (raw, classification) {
        var res = { counterparty_name: '', status: 'no_match', flows: [], summary: this._emptyRow() };
        if (classification && classification !== 'relevant') { res.status = 'skipped_irrelevant'; return res; }
        if (!raw) { res.status = 'no_attachment'; return res; }

        res.counterparty_name = this._counterparty(raw);
        var hasAttachment = /Content-Disposition:[ \t]*attachment/i.test(raw);

        var subject = this._headerVal(raw, 'Subject');
        var text = this._decodeParts(raw);

        // Parsers ordered by signature specificity; each returns an ARRAY of raw rows (one per
        // trade) or null. For multipart/alternative mails the HTML table is the authoritative,
        // richer rendering (the plain-text copy drops columns — e.g. the 9-digit Trn Id), so
        // HTML wins when present and cleanly falls through to the pipe parser for text-only mails.
        //
        // When the mail ALSO carries a real attachment, restrict to the STRUCTURED table parsers
        // (SWIFT / HTML / pipe). Cashflows genuinely in the body (BodyTablePlusAttachment mails) are
        // still captured, but the loose colon/prose/compact parsers — which can misread an SSI cover
        // note as a phantom cashflow — are held back so they don't pollute the body+attachment merge.
        var rawRows = hasAttachment
            ? (this._parseSwift(text) || this._parseHtml(text) || this._parsePipe(text) || [])
            : (this._parseSwift(text) || this._parseHtml(text) || this._parsePipe(text) ||
               this._parseColon(text) || this._parseProse(text) || this._parseCompact(text) || []);

        // Mail-level fallbacks (one value date / reference for the whole mail), applied to any
        // row that didn't carry its own — many counterparties put the VD only in the subject.
        var fbVd = this._normDate(this._findDate(subject) || this._findDate(text));
        var fbRef = this._clean(this._refFromSubject(subject));

        for (var i = 0; i < rawRows.length; i++) {
            var rr = rawRows[i];
            res.flows.push({
                reference: this._clean(rr.reference) || fbRef,
                currency: this._clean(rr.currency),
                amount: this._clean(rr.amount),
                direction: this._clean(this._normDir(rr.direction)),
                value_date: this._normDate(rr.value_date) || fbVd
            });
        }

        // Summary = first real flow, or a fallback-only row (preserves single-flow "partial").
        res.summary = res.flows.length ? res.flows[0]
            : { reference: fbRef, currency: '', amount: '', direction: '', value_date: fbVd };

        var filled = this._filledCount(res.summary);

        // SSI notices carry no cashflow — a distinct type, not a failed extraction. Gated on
        // filled<=1 so real cashflow mails that merely mention "SSI attached" aren't mislabelled.
        if (filled <= 1 && this._isSsiOnly(subject, text)) {
            res.summary.currency = res.summary.currency || this._ssiCurrency(subject);
            res.flows = [];
            res.status = 'ssi_only';
            return res;
        }

        // Body carries no cashflow but a file is attached -> the cashflows live in the attachment;
        // signal the caller to parse the spreadsheet (which it then merges with any body cashflows).
        if (res.flows.length === 0 && hasAttachment) { res.status = 'skipped_attachment'; return res; }

        res.status = filled >= 4 ? 'extracted' : (filled > 0 ? 'partial' : 'no_match');
        return res;
    },

    _emptyRow: function () {
        return { reference: '', currency: '', amount: '', direction: '', value_date: '' };
    },

    _copyRow: function (dst, row) {
        dst.reference = row.reference; dst.currency = row.currency; dst.amount = row.amount;
        dst.direction = row.direction; dst.value_date = row.value_date;
    },

    _filledCount: function (row) {
        return [row.reference, row.currency, row.amount, row.direction, row.value_date]
            .filter(function (v) { return v; }).length;
    },

    _empty: function (status) {
        return { counterparty_name: '', reference: '', currency: '', amount: '', direction: '', value_date: '', flows: 0, status: status };
    },

    _emptyAll: function (status) {
        return { counterparty_name: '', reference: '', currency: '', amount: '', direction: '', value_date: '', flows: [], flow_count: 0, status: status };
    },

    _readText: function (attSysId) {
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
            if (!gr.get(attSysId)) { return ''; }
            return new GlideSysAttachment().getContent(gr) || '';
        } catch (e) {
            gs.warn('[EmlFieldExtractor] read fail: ' + e);
            return '';
        }
    },

    // --- counterparty from the From display name ---
    _counterparty: function (raw) {
        var m = raw.match(/^From:[ \t]*(.*)$/im);
        if (!m) { return ''; }
        var v = m[1].trim();
        var lt = v.indexOf('<');
        if (lt > 0) { v = v.substring(0, lt).trim(); }
        return v.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '').trim();
    },

    // --- concatenate decoded text of all non-attachment MIME parts (handles base64) ---
    _decodeParts: function (raw) {
        var bnd = raw.match(/boundary="?([^";\r\n]+)"?/i);
        if (!bnd) {
            var body = this._afterHeaders(raw);
            return /Content-Transfer-Encoding:[ \t]*base64/i.test(raw) ? this._b64(body) : body;
        }
        var chunks = raw.split('--' + bnd[1]);
        var text = '';
        for (var i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) {
            var c = chunks[i];
            if (!c || /Content-Disposition:[ \t]*attachment/i.test(c)) { continue; }
            var pb = this._afterHeaders(c);
            if (/Content-Transfer-Encoding:[ \t]*base64/i.test(c)) { pb = this._b64(pb); }
            text += '\n' + pb;
        }
        return text || raw;
    },

    _afterHeaders: function (s) {
        var i = s.indexOf('\r\n\r\n'), d = 4;
        if (i === -1) { i = s.indexOf('\n\n'); d = 2; }
        return i === -1 ? s : s.substring(i + d);
    },

    // Pure-JS base64 decode — scoped ServiceNow has no GlideStringUtil.base64Decode.
    // Fields are ASCII, so byte→char mapping is sufficient.
    _b64: function (s) {
        s = ('' + s).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]/g, '');
        var chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';
        var out = '', i = 0;
        while (i < s.length) {
            var e1 = chars.indexOf(s.charAt(i++));
            var e2 = chars.indexOf(s.charAt(i++));
            var e3 = chars.indexOf(s.charAt(i++));
            var e4 = chars.indexOf(s.charAt(i++));
            if (e1 < 0 || e2 < 0) { break; }
            out += String.fromCharCode((e1 << 2) | (e2 >> 4));
            if (e3 >= 0 && e3 !== 64) { out += String.fromCharCode(((e2 & 15) << 4) | (e3 >> 2)); }
            if (e4 >= 0 && e4 !== 64) { out += String.fromCharCode(((e3 & 3) << 6) | e4); }
        }
        return out;
    },

    // --- parsers: each returns an ARRAY of raw rows {reference,currency,amount,direction,value_date}
    //     (one per trade), or null. Field values are raw here; normalisation happens in _analyze. ---

    // HTML tables — accumulates every data row across every data table (some mails split one
    // logical table into several single-row <table> blocks, e.g. CP13 London).
    _parseHtml: function (text) {
        if (!/<table/i.test(text)) { return null; }
        var tables = text.match(/<table[\s\S]*?<\/table>/gi) || [], out = [];
        for (var ti = 0; ti < tables.length; ti++) {
            var block = tables[ti], headers = [], m, thRe = /<th[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/th>/gi;
            while ((m = thRe.exec(block))) { headers.push(this._field(this._stripTags(m[1]))); }
            // Only a table with an amount/reference column is a data table (skips layout/summary tables).
            if (headers.indexOf('amount') === -1 && headers.indexOf('reference') === -1) { continue; }
            var trs = block.match(/<tr[\s\S]*?<\/tr>/gi) || [];
            for (var r = 0; r < trs.length; r++) {
                var tds = [], t, tdRe = /<td[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/td>/gi;
                while ((t = tdRe.exec(trs[r]))) { tds.push(this._stripTags(t[1])); }
                if (!tds.length) { continue; } // header row (only <th>) or empty
                var rec = {};
                for (var i = 0; i < headers.length && i < tds.length; i++) { if (headers[i]) { rec[headers[i]] = tds[i]; } }
                out.push(rec);
            }
        }
        return out.length ? out : null;
    },

    // Plain-text pipe tables — every data row, across one or more header blocks in the mail.
    _parsePipe: function (text) {
        var lines = text.split(/\r?\n/), out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            if (lines[i].indexOf('|') === -1) { continue; }
            var hdr = this._splitPipe(lines[i]);
            for (var h = 0; h < hdr.length; h++) { hdr[h] = this._field(hdr[h]); }
            if (hdr.indexOf('amount') === -1 && hdr.indexOf('reference') === -1) { continue; }
            var got = 0;
            for (var j = i + 1; j < lines.length; j++) {
                if (lines[j].indexOf('|') === -1) {
                    if (got > 0) { break; }   // blank line ends this table
                    continue;
                }
                if (!/\d/.test(lines[j]) || /^[\s|:_+.\-]+$/.test(lines[j])) { continue; } // separator row
                var data = this._splitPipe(lines[j]), rec = {};
                for (var k = 0; k < hdr.length && k < data.length; k++) { if (hdr[k]) { rec[hdr[k]] = data[k]; } }
                out.push(rec);
                got++;
            }
            i = (got > 0) ? j : i; // resume after this table so later blocks are found too
        }
        return out.length ? out : null;
    },

    // "Label : Value" text. Splits into per-trade blocks when the mail enumerates "Cash flow N:".
    _parseColon: function (text) {
        var blocks = /cash\s*flow\s*\d+/i.test(text) ? text.split(/cash\s*flow\s*\d+\s*:?/i) : [text];
        var out = [];
        for (var b = 0; b < blocks.length; b++) {
            var lines = blocks[b].split(/\r?\n/), rec = {}, any = false;
            for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                var ln = lines[i].replace(/^[>\s]+/, '');
                var m = ln.match(/^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z \/]+?)\s*:\s*(.+?)\s*$/);
                if (!m) { continue; }
                var f = this._field(m[1]);
                if (f && !rec[f]) { rec[f] = m[2].trim(); any = true; }
            }
            if (any) { out.push(rec); }
        }
        return out.length ? out : null;
    },

    // Inline prose, e.g. "GBP 692,043.41 (Receive, value 2026-06-04, ref 344163511)" — every flow.
    _parseProse: function (text) {
        var re = /\b([A-Z]{3})\s+(-?[\d,]+\.\d+)\s*\(\s*(Pay|Receive)\b[^)]*?value\s+([0-9A-Za-z\/-]+)[^)]*?ref\s+([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/gi;
        var out = [], m;
        while ((m = re.exec(text))) { out.push({ currency: m[1], amount: m[2], direction: m[3], value_date: m[4], reference: m[5] }); }
        return out.length ? out : null;
    },

    // SWIFT MT — one flow per message block (":20:<ref>", ":32A:<YYMMDD><CCY><amount>", ":72:/PAY|RECEIVE/").
    _parseSwift: function (text) {
        if (!/:32A:/.test(text)) { return null; }
        var blocks = text.split(/(?=:20:)/), out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
            var b = blocks[i];
            if (!/:32A:/.test(b)) { continue; }
            var rec = {};
            var mRef = b.match(/:20:\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)/);
            if (mRef) { rec.reference = mRef[1]; }
            var m32 = b.match(/:32A:\s*(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})([A-Z]{3})([\d.,]+)/);
            if (m32) {
                rec.value_date = '20' + m32[1] + '-' + m32[2] + '-' + m32[3];
                rec.currency = m32[4];
                rec.amount = m32[5].replace(/,(\d{2})$/, '.$1'); // European decimal comma -> dot
            }
            var mDir = b.match(/:72:\s*\/(PAY|RECEIVE)\b/i);
            if (mDir) { rec.direction = mDir[1]; }
            if (rec.reference || rec.amount) { out.push(rec); }
        }
        return out.length ? out : null;
    },

    // Compact code list, e.g. "SGD R 4,727,217.92 USD P 4,960,547.21" (R=Receive, P=Pay) — every flow.
    // No reference/date in this shape -> the mail-level subject fallbacks fill those in.
    _parseCompact: function (text) {
        var re = /\b([A-Z]{3})\s+([RP])\s+(-?[\d,]+\.\d{2})\b/g;
        var out = [], m;
        while ((m = re.exec(text))) { out.push({ currency: m[1], direction: m[2], amount: m[3] }); }
        return out.length ? out : null;
    },

    // --- helpers ---
    _splitPipe: function (line) {
        var parts = ('' + line).split('|'), out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { out.push(parts[i].trim()); }
        while (out.length && out[0] === '') { out.shift(); }
        while (out.length && out[out.length - 1] === '') { out.pop(); }
        return out;
    },

    _stripTags: function (s) {
        return ('' + s).replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/ /g, ' ')
            .replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    },

    _clean: function (s) { return ('' + (s || '')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); },

    _norm: function (label) { return ('' + label).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); },

    // Map a (possibly renamed) column header to a canonical field, or null.
    // Note on multi-candidate rows: parsers assign left-to-right, so when a table has
    // several reference-like columns the RIGHTMOST wins — which in this corpus is
    // consistently the settlement/cashflow reference (e.g. CP12 TradeId then Client Ref No,
    // CP17 Prod. Ref then Trade reference, SHS then C.P REFERENCE).
    _field: function (label) {
        var n = this._norm(label);
        var map = this._fieldMap || (this._fieldMap = {
            reference: ['reference', 'ref', 'refno', 'refnum', 'trnid', 'tradereference', 'transactionid',
                'groupid', 'dealid', 'deal', 'nettingid', 'clientrefno', 'cpreference', 'shsreference',
                'prodref', 'flowid', 'tradeid'],
            currency: ['currency', 'ccy', 'cur', 'curr', 'ccy1', 'notionalccy', 'settlementcurrency'],
            amount: ['amount', 'notionalamount', 'notional', 'settlementamount', 'settlementamt',
                'totalsettlementamount', 'flowamount', 'quantity'],
            direction: ['direction', 'payreceive', 'payrec', 'pr', 'rp', 'buysell', 'paymentdirection', 'r'],
            value_date: ['valuedate', 'valuedt', 'valdate', 'paymentdate', 'settlementdate',
                'originalvaluedate', 'vd']
        });
        for (var field in map) {
            if (map.hasOwnProperty(field) && map[field].indexOf(n) !== -1) { return field; }
        }
        return null;
    },

    // Normalise a direction cell to Pay / Receive (leaves anything unrecognised untouched).
    // Handles Pay, Receive, RECV, Coun Pay, COU RECEIVE, and lone R / P flags.
    _normDir: function (v) {
        var s = ('' + (v || '')).trim();
        if (!s) { return ''; }
        if (/receiv|recv|\brcv\b/i.test(s)) { return 'Receive'; }
        if (/\bpay\b|\bpaid\b/i.test(s)) { return 'Pay'; }
        if (/^r$/i.test(s)) { return 'Receive'; }
        if (/^p$/i.test(s)) { return 'Pay'; }
        return s;
    },

    // First date-like token in a string, in any of the corpus formats.
    _findDate: function (s) {
        s = '' + (s || '');
        var m = s.match(/\b(\d{1,2}[-\/][A-Za-z]{3}[-\/]\d{4})\b/); // 06-Jun-2026
        if (m) { return m[1]; }
        m = s.match(/\b(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\b/);                     // 2026-06-06
        if (m) { return m[1]; }
        m = s.match(/\b(\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}\/\d{4})\b/);               // 05/06/2026
        if (m) { return m[1]; }
        return '';
    },

    // Pull a reference out of the subject when the body table has none
    // (e.g. "... Ref Num 348307611", "OPT Premium ... Interbank-6805596").
    _refFromSubject: function (subj) {
        subj = '' + (subj || '');
        var m = subj.match(/\bref(?:erence|\.?\s*(?:num|no)\.?)?\s*[:#-]?\s*([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]{4,})/i);
        if (m) { return m[1]; }
        m = subj.match(/Interbank-(\d+)/i);
        if (m) { return m[1]; }
        return '';
    },

    // Standing-settlement-instruction notice (no cashflow to extract).
    _isSsiOnly: function (subject, text) {
        return /standing settlement instruction/i.test('' + (text || '')) || /\bSSI\b/.test('' + (subject || ''));
    },

    _ssiCurrency: function (subject) {
        subject = '' + (subject || '');
        var m = subject.match(/\bSSI\s+([A-Z]{3})\b/) || subject.match(/\b([A-Z]{3})\b\s*-?\s*settlement instructions/i);
        return m ? m[1] : '';
    },

    _normDate: function (d) {
        d = ('' + (d || '')).trim();
        if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d)) { return d; }
        var m = d.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-\/]([A-Za-z]{3})[-\/](\d{4})$/); // 06-Jun-2026 / 06/Jun/2026
        if (m) {
            var mon = { jan: '01', feb: '02', mar: '03', apr: '04', may: '05', jun: '06', jul: '07', aug: '08', sep: '09', oct: '10', nov: '11', dec: '12' }[m[2].toLowerCase()];
            if (mon) { return m[3] + '-' + mon + '-' + ('0' + m[1]).slice(-2); }
        }
        m = d.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/); // 05/06/2026 -> day-first (European) -> ISO
        if (m) { return m[3] + '-' + ('0' + m[2]).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + m[1]).slice(-2); }
        return d;
    },

    // ------- mail contents (for the analyst UI): from / to / cc / subject / body -------
    mailContents: function (attachmentSysId) {
        var raw = this._readText(attachmentSysId);
        return {
            from: this._decodeMime(this._headerVal(raw, 'From')),
            to: this._decodeMime(this._headerVal(raw, 'To')),
            cc: this._decodeMime(this._headerVal(raw, 'Cc')),
            subject: this._decodeMime(this._headerVal(raw, 'Subject')),
            date: this._headerVal(raw, 'Date'),
            body: this._bodyText(raw),
        };
    },

    // Decode RFC2047 encoded-words in a header value, e.g. "=?utf-8?B?...?=" -> plain text.
    _decodeMime: function (s) {
        s = ('' + (s || '')).replace(/\?=\s+=\?/g, '?==?'); // join adjacent encoded-words (drop ws)
        var self = this;
        return s.replace(/=\?[^?]+\?([BbQq])\?([^?]*)\?=/g, function (whole, enc, dat) {
            try {
                if (enc.toUpperCase() === 'B') { return self._b64(dat); }
                return dat.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/=([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})/g, function (m2, h) { return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h, 16)); });
            } catch (e) { return dat; }
        });
    },

    _headerVal: function (raw, name) {
        if (!raw) { return ''; }
        var re = new RegExp('^' + name + ':[ \\t]*(.*(?:\\r?\\n[ \\t].*)*)', 'im');
        var m = raw.match(re);
        return m ? m[1].replace(/\r?\n[ \t]+/g, ' ').trim() : '';
    },

    // The email's Date header (RFC 2822 string), e.g. "Sun, 14 Jun 2026 17:12:23 -0000".
    emailDate: function (attachmentSysId) {
        return this._headerVal(this._readText(attachmentSysId), 'Date');
    },

    // Prefer the text/plain part; else strip the HTML part to readable text.
    _bodyText: function (raw) {
        if (!raw) { return ''; }
        return this._findBodyPart(raw);
    },

    // Recursively find the readable body: descend into nested multipart (e.g. related > alternative),
    // prefer text/plain, else strip text/html. Base64 is decoded using ONLY the leaf part's OWN
    // headers, so a nested multipart's inner base64 parts are never mistaken for the whole block
    // (the old bug that emitted the raw attachment bytes as "body").
    _findBodyPart: function (part, depth) {
        depth = depth || 0;
        var hb = part.substring(0, this._headerEnd(part));
        var bm = hb.match(/boundary="?([^";\r\n]+)"?/i);
        if (depth < 8 && /multipart\//i.test(hb) && bm) {
            var chunks = part.split('--' + bm[1]);
            var html = '';
            // Start at 1: chunks[0] is the container's own headers/preamble (before the first
            // boundary) and carries the multipart Content-Type — descending into it would recurse
            // forever. The trailing "--" close marker is skipped by the checks below.
            for (var i = 1; i < chunks.length; i++) {
                var c = chunks[i];
                if (!c || !c.replace(/\s/g, '') || /^--/.test(c)) { continue; }
                if (/Content-Disposition:[ \t]*attachment/i.test(c)) { continue; }
                var chb = c.substring(0, this._headerEnd(c));
                if (/Content-Type:\s*multipart\//i.test(chb)) {
                    var nested = this._findBodyPart(c, depth + 1);
                    if (nested) { return nested; }
                    continue;
                }
                var ct = (chb.match(/Content-Type:\s*([^;\r\n]+)/i) || [])[1] || '';
                var enc = (chb.match(/Content-Transfer-Encoding:\s*(\S+)/i) || [])[1] || '';
                var pb = this._afterHeaders(c);
                if (/base64/i.test(enc)) { pb = this._b64(pb); }
                if (/text\/plain/i.test(ct)) { return this._cleanText(pb); }
                if (/text\/html/i.test(ct) && !html) { html = pb; }
            }
            if (html) { return this._cleanText(this._htmlToText(html)); }
            return '';
        }
        // Single/leaf part: decode based on THIS part's own headers only.
        var body = this._afterHeaders(part);
        if (/Content-Transfer-Encoding:[ \t]*base64/i.test(hb)) { body = this._b64(body); }
        var isHtml = /Content-Type:\s*text\/html/i.test(hb);
        return this._cleanText(isHtml ? this._htmlToText(body) : body);
    },

    // Index of the blank line that separates a MIME part's headers from its body.
    _headerEnd: function (s) {
        s = '' + s;
        var i = s.indexOf('\r\n\r\n');
        if (i !== -1) { return i; }
        i = s.indexOf('\n\n');
        return i === -1 ? s.length : i;
    },

    // HTML -> readable text that PRESERVES line breaks (block/break tags -> newlines).
    _htmlToText: function (s) {
        return ('' + s)
            .replace(/<\s*br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n')
            .replace(/<\/(p|div|tr|li|h[1-6]|table|thead|tbody)>/gi, '\n')
            .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')
            .replace(/ /gi, ' ').replace(/&/gi, '&').replace(/</gi, '<').replace(/>/gi, '>')
            .replace(/[ \t]{2,}/g, ' ');
    },

    _cleanText: function (s) {
        return ('' + (s || '')).replace(/\r/g, '').replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, '\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
    },

    type: 'EmlFieldExtractor'
};
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/EmlFieldExtractor.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>cd677481d3b5402e90a7ed6f777f8f40</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/EmlFieldExtractor.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_cd677481d3b5402e90a7ed6f777f8f40</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[function controller($window) {
    var c = this;

    // International-format an amount for DISPLAY only (thousands separators). Leaves the raw value + the
    // numeric sort field untouched; preserves any trailing currency text and a leading sign.
    c.fmtAmt = function (v) {
        var s = ('' + (v == null ? '' : v)).trim();
        if (!s) { return ''; }
        var m = s.match(/^(-?)(\d[\d,]*)(\.\d+)?(.*)$/);
        if (!m) { return s; }
        return m[1] + m[2].replace(/,/g, '').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',') + (m[3] || '') + (m[4] || '');
    };

    // User menu (avatar dropdown) + sign out.
    c.userMenu = false;
    c.signOut = function () {
        $window.location.href = '/logout.do?sysparm_goto_url=' + encodeURIComponent('/nfotcbsm');
    };

    c.editing = false;
    c.dirty = false;

    // Cashflow navigator (multi-trade mails): Prev / [X] / Next -> open that cashflow's case.
    c.cfNavInput = (c.data && c.data.cfIndex) || 1;
    c.cfGo = function (n) {
        var total = (c.data && c.data.cfTotal) || 0;
        if (total < 1) { return; }
        n = parseInt(n, 10);
        if (isNaN(n)) { n = c.data.cfIndex; }
        if (n < 1) { n = 1; }
        if (n > total) { n = total; }
        if (n === c.data.cfIndex) { c.cfNavInput = c.data.cfIndex; return; } // no change -> snap input back
        var target = c.data.cfList[n - 1];
        if (target) { $window.location.href = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_nfotc_analyst&cf=' + target; }
    };
    // Numeric-only input: block minus / plus / exponent / decimal; Enter commits.
    c.cfKey = function (ev) {
        if (ev.key === 'Enter') { c.cfGo(c.cfNavInput); return; }
        if (['-', '+', 'e', 'E', '.'].indexOf(ev.key) !== -1) { ev.preventDefault(); }
    };

    // Switch the shown email (resets any in-progress edit).
    c.pick = function (id) {
        if (!id) { return; }
        c.data.id = id;
        c.data.action = '';
        c.editing = false;
        c.dirty = false;
        c.server.update();
    };

    // Enter edit mode — fields become editable.
    c.edit = function () { c.editing = true; };

    // A field changed — light up Save.
    c.markDirty = function () { c.dirty = true; c.data.saved = false; };

    // Save edited fields (only when there are unsaved changes).
    c.save = function () {
        if (!c.dirty) { return; }
        c.data.action = 'save';
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.editing = false; c.dirty = false; c.data.action = ''; });
    };

    // Confirm the extracted fields.
    c.confirm = function () {
        c.data.action = 'confirm';
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; });
    };

    // Analyst review (HITL) — write back the chosen match outcome for this cashflow.
    c.setOutcome = function (o) {
        c.data.action = 'outcome';
        c.data.outcomeChoice = o;
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; c.data.outcomeChoice = ''; });
    };
    c.resetOutcome = function () {
        c.data.action = 'reset_outcome';
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; });
    };
    // Confirm the Step 2 review — locks the outcome, turns step 2 green, reveals step 3.
    c.confirmReview = function () {
        c.data.action = 'confirm_review';
        c.data.outcomeChoice = c.data.effectiveOutcome;
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; c.data.outcomeChoice = ''; });
    };

    // Step 3 — next action (demo: records the decision, no real email is sent).
    c.sendAction = function () {
        c.data.action = 'send';
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; });
    };
    c.resolveAction = function () {
        c.data.action = 'resolve';
        c.server.update().then(function () { c.data.action = ''; });
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/analyst.client.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>d398555614dd4e78aaa2b6dbddbf4f7e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/analyst.client.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_d398555614dd4e78aaa2b6dbddbf4f7e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_one_extend_capability"><sys_one_extend_capability action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>Chinou-backed twin of "Extract Field Generic". Extracts data from arbitrary text following a runtime-supplied instruction. The instruction sets both WHAT to extract and the OUTPUT FORMAT, so one published skill serves both a single field (plain value) and a full record set (JSON array, one object per row/trade) — driven entirely by the Onboarding Wizard config. Routes generation through Nomura's governed Chinou gateway (Claude Sonnet 5) instead of the in-platform Now LLM Service.</description><external>false</external><metadata/><name>Extract Fields Generic Chinou</name><offglide_enabled>false</offglide_enabled><short_description>Prompt-driven extraction from text — one field or a full record set (Chinou / Claude Sonnet 5).</short_description><sys_class_name>sys_one_extend_capability</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>d6613c21f9274c4ca82cf215cf9954b7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Extract Fields Generic Chinou</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_one_extend_capability_d6613c21f9274c4ca82cf215cf9954b7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on><type>skill</type></sys_one_extend_capability><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=d6613c21f9274c4ca82cf215cf9954b7"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * OTC Analyst Screen — Service Portal widget SERVER script.
 * Faithful replica of the classic UI Page (AnalystScreen.server.js): shows one email's
 * mail contents + extracted fields, with a Confirm action and an email picker.
 * Runs server-side (GlideRecord) and reuses the EmlFieldExtractor Script Include for the
 * mail contents. Talks to the client via data / input (c.server.update).
 */
(function () {
    var ex = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.EmlFieldExtractor();
    function setIf(gr, col, v) { if (v !== null && v !== undefined) { gr.setValue(col, '' + v); } }
    // Value date: store ISO (YYYY-MM-DD, needed for matching), show/edit as DD-MM-YYYY.
    function vdDisp(v) { var m = ('' + (v || '')).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/); return m ? (m[3] + '-' + m[2] + '-' + m[1]) : ('' + (v || '')); }
    function vdIso(v) { v = '' + (v || ''); if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) { return v; } var m = v.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{4})$/); return m ? (m[3] + '-' + ('0' + m[1]).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + m[2]).slice(-2)) : v; }
    // RFC2822 Date header ("Mon, 16 Jun 2026 09:23:45 +0000") -> "16-06-2026 09:23:45".
    function fmtReceived(raw) {
        raw = '' + (raw || '');
        var m = raw.match(/(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]{3})[A-Za-z]*\s+(\d{4})\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?/);
        if (!m) { return raw; }
        var mo = { jan: '01', feb: '02', mar: '03', apr: '04', may: '05', jun: '06', jul: '07', aug: '08', sep: '09', oct: '10', nov: '11', dec: '12' }[m[2].toLowerCase()] || '01';
        return ('0' + m[1]).slice(-2) + '-' + mo + '-' + m[3] + ' ' + ('0' + m[4]).slice(-2) + ':' + m[5] + ':' + (m[6] || '00');
    }

    // Step 3 draft — pull the counterparty settlement address out of the From header.
    function extractEmail(s) {
        s = '' + (s || '');
        var m = s.match(/<([^>]+)>/); if (m) { return m[1].trim(); }
        m = s.match(/[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.\w+/); return m ? m[0] : '';
    }
    // Amount -> thousands-separated with 2 decimals.
    function fmtAmt(v) {
        var n = parseFloat(('' + (v || '')).replace(/,/g, ''));
        if (isNaN(n)) { return '' + (v || '-'); }
        var p = n.toFixed(2).split('.');
        p[0] = p[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
        return p.join('.');
    }
    // Flip our-POV direction back to the counterparty's POV for outbound replies.
    function flipDir(d) {
        var s = ('' + (d || '')).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (s === 'pay') { return 'Receive'; }
        if (s === 'receive') { return 'Pay'; }
        return d || '-';
    }
    // A labelled key/value line, values aligned in the monospace draft.
    function drow(label, val) { return '  ' + (label + '                    ').slice(0, 18) + ('' + (val === '' || val == null ? '-' : val)); }
    function detailBlock(ref, ccy, amt, dir, vd) {
        return drow('Trade reference', ref) + '\n' + drow('Currency', ccy) + '\n' +
            drow('Amount', fmtAmt(amt)) + '\n' + drow('Direction', dir) + '\n' + drow('Value date', vd);
    }

    // Step 3 draft, DERIVED from the effective outcome (matched / mismatch / no_match).
    function buildDraft(outcome) {
        var ref = data.reference || '(no reference)';
        var ccy = data.currency || '', amt = data.amount || '', vd = data.value_date || '';
        var cp = data.counterparty || 'Counterparty';
        var cpEmail = extractEmail(data.mail.from) || '(counterparty settlement address)';
        var subj = ref + ' (' + ccy + ', value ' + vd + ')';
        var greet = 'Dear ' + cp + ' Settlements,\n\n';
        var quoted = '\n\n-----  Original message  -----\nFrom: ' + (data.mail.from || '') + '\nSubject: ' + (data.mail.subject || '') + '\n\n' + (data.mail.body || '');

        if (outcome === 'matched') {
            var blkM = detailBlock(ref, ccy, amt, flipDir(data.direction), vd);
            return { title: 'Reply to counterparty — agree the details',
                to: cpEmail, subject: 'RE: Trade confirmation — ' + subj,
                body: greet + 'Thank you for your settlement confirmation. We confirm that we agree the details below, including the settlement instructions.\n\n' + blkM + '\n\nNo further action is required from your side. The payment will settle on the value date shown.\n\nKind regards,\nSettlements' + quoted,
                sendLabel: 'Send to counterparty' };
        }
        if (outcome === 'no_match') {
            var blkN = detailBlock(ref, ccy, amt, flipDir(data.direction), vd);
            return { title: 'Reply to counterparty — no matching booking found',
                to: cpEmail, subject: 'RE: Trade confirmation — ' + subj,
                body: greet + 'Thank you for your settlement confirmation. We are unable to locate a matching booking in our systems for the cash flow below:\n\n' + blkN + '\n\nSo that we can investigate further, please could you share:\n  •  your internal trade reference and any UTI / USI\n  •  the executing desk or trader on your side\n  •  the execution venue and timestamp\n  •  confirmation of the legal entity you booked against\n\nWe will hold the payment pending your response.\n\nKind regards,\nSettlements' + quoted,
                sendLabel: 'Send to counterparty' };
        }
        // mismatch -> refer to Middle Office (internal; both sides shown from our POV so direction agrees).
        var bk = (data.cmp && data.cmp.booking) ? data.cmp.booking : null;
        var diffs = (data.cmp && data.cmp.banner) ? data.cmp.banner.diffs.concat(data.cmp.banner.miss).join(', ') : '';
        var cpBlk = detailBlock(ref, ccy, amt, data.direction, vd);
        var bkBlk = bk ? detailBlock(bk.bank_trade_ref || bk.reference || '-', bk.currency || ccy, bk.amount, bk.direction || data.direction, bk.value_date || vd) : '  (booking details unavailable)';
        return { title: 'Refer to Middle Office',
            to: 'middleoffice@abc.com', subject: 'Referral: Trade confirmation — ' + subj,
            body: 'Referring the following for review. The counterparty’s details and our booking agree in part but differ on the field(s)' + (diffs ? ': ' + diffs : ' noted below') + '.\n\nCounterparty: ' + cp + '\nSource email: ' + data.ref + '\n\nCounterparty submitted:\n' + cpBlk + '\n\nBooked by the bank:\n' + bkBlk + '\n\nPlease advise on the correct economics so we can respond to the counterparty.\n\nRegards,\nSettlements' + quoted,
            sendLabel: 'Send to Middle Office' };
    }

    // Build one trade row for the table.
    function mkTrade(sysId, ref, vd, amt, ccy, dir, prod) {
        return {
            sys_id: sysId, reference: ref || '', value_date: vdDisp(vd), amount: amt || '',
            currency: ccy || '', direction: dir || '', product_type: prod || ''
        };
    }

    // Save action (c.save() -> input.action = 'save'): persist the shared counterparty + every edited
    // trade row back onto its cashflow child, and keep the parent summary in sync with the first trade.
    if (input && input.action === 'save' && input.id) {
        if (input.cfSysId) {
            var cfg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
            if (cfg.get(input.cfSysId)) {
                setIf(cfg, 'reference', input.reference);
                setIf(cfg, 'currency', input.currency);
                setIf(cfg, 'amount', input.amount);
                setIf(cfg, 'direction', input.direction);
                setIf(cfg, 'value_date', vdIso(input.value_date));
                cfg.update();
            }
        }
        var sg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        if (sg.get(input.id)) { setIf(sg, 'counterparty_name', input.counterparty); sg.update(); }
        data.saved = true;
    }

    // Confirm action (c.confirm() -> input.action = 'confirm'): confirm THIS cashflow only, so each
    // cashflow in a multi-trade mail is confirmed independently. Mails with no extracted cashflow
    // fall back to confirming the email record itself.
    if (input && input.action === 'confirm') {
        if (input.cfSysId) {
            var ccg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
            if (ccg.get(input.cfSysId)) { ccg.setValue('confirmed', 'true'); ccg.update(); }
        } else if (input.id) {
            var cg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            if (cg.get(input.id)) { cg.setValue('review_status', 'awaiting_review'); cg.update(); }
        }
    }

    // Analyst outcome writeback (HITL): confirm/override the match outcome for THIS cashflow.
    if (input && input.action === 'outcome' && input.cfSysId && input.outcomeChoice) {
        var og = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        // Changing the outcome un-confirms the review (step 2 back to amber, step 3 hidden until re-confirmed).
        if (og.get(input.cfSysId)) { og.setValue('analyst_outcome', input.outcomeChoice); og.setValue('review_confirmed', ''); og.setValue('resolution', ''); og.update(); }
    }
    if (input && input.action === 'reset_outcome' && input.cfSysId) {
        var rg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (rg.get(input.cfSysId)) { rg.setValue('analyst_outcome', ''); rg.setValue('review_confirmed', ''); rg.setValue('resolution', ''); rg.update(); }
    }
    // Confirm the Step 2 review -> locks the (auto/overridden) outcome and turns step 2 green.
    if (input && input.action === 'confirm_review' && input.cfSysId) {
        var cvg = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (cvg.get(input.cfSysId)) {
            if (input.outcomeChoice) { cvg.setValue('analyst_outcome', input.outcomeChoice); }
            cvg.setValue('review_confirmed', 'true');
            cvg.update();
        }
    }
    // Step 3 next-action writeback (demo — records the decision; no real email is sent).
    if (input && input.action === 'send' && input.cfSysId) {
        var sd = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (sd.get(input.cfSysId)) { sd.setValue('resolution', 'sent'); sd.update(); }
    }
    if (input && input.action === 'resolve' && input.cfSysId) {
        var rd = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (rd.get(input.cfSysId)) { rd.setValue('resolution', 'closed'); rd.update(); }
    }

    // Which record to show: a dashboard cashflow (?cf) resolves to its parent email; ?eml opens an
    // email directly; else client pick (input.id); else the latest extracted/partial; else latest any.
    var cfParam = $sp.getParameter('cf') || (input && input.cfParam) || '';
    var emlParam = $sp.getParameter('eml') || (input && input.emlParam) || '';
    var emailFromCf = '';
    if (cfParam) { var cfr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); if (cfr.get(cfParam)) { emailFromCf = cfr.getValue('email'); } }
    var wantId = (input && input.id) || emailFromCf || emlParam || '';
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    var found = wantId ? gr.get(wantId) : false;
    if (!found) {
        var q = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        q.addQuery('extraction_status', 'IN', 'extracted,partial');
        q.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); q.setLimit(1); q.query();
        if (q.next()) {
            gr = q;
        } else {
            var a = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            a.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); a.setLimit(1); a.query();
            if (!a.next()) { data.empty = true; return; }
            gr = a;
        }
    }

    data.empty = false;
    data.id = gr.getUniqueValue();
    // Header title = the email id (file name) without the .eml extension, e.g. "EML-0007".
    data.ref = ('' + (gr.getValue('name') || '')).replace(/\.eml$/i, '') || '(no id)';
    data.counterparty = gr.getValue('counterparty_name');
    // This case screen shows ONE trade's detail: the clicked cashflow (?cf). Fall back to the email's
    // first cashflow, or the email summary when a mail has no extracted cashflow.
    var cfRec = null;
    if (cfParam) { var cfg2 = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); if (cfg2.get(cfParam) && cfg2.getValue('email') === gr.getUniqueValue()) { cfRec = cfg2; } }
    if (!cfRec) { var f1 = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); f1.addQuery('email', gr.getUniqueValue()); f1.orderBy('flow_index'); f1.setLimit(1); f1.query(); if (f1.next()) { cfRec = f1; } }
    data.cfSysId = cfRec ? cfRec.getUniqueValue() : '';
    data.analystOutcome = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('analyst_outcome') || '') : '';
    data.reviewConfirmed = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('review_confirmed') === 'true') : false;
    data.reference = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('reference') : '';
    data.currency = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('currency') : '';
    data.amount = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('amount') : '';
    data.direction = cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('direction') : '';
    data.value_date = vdDisp(cfRec ? cfRec.getValue('value_date') : '');
    data.confirmed = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('confirmed') === 'true') : (gr.getValue('review_status') === 'awaiting_review');
    data.cfParam = cfParam;   // round-tripped so ?cf survives c.server.update() (confirm/save reloads)
    data.emlParam = emlParam;

    // Cashflow navigator (multi-trade mails): ordered list of the email's cashflows + current index.
    data.cfList = [];
    var lcf = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
    lcf.addQuery('email', gr.getUniqueValue());
    lcf.orderBy('flow_index');
    lcf.query();
    while (lcf.next()) { data.cfList.push(lcf.getUniqueValue()); }
    data.cfTotal = data.cfList.length;
    data.cfIndex = 0;
    for (var ni = 0; ni < data.cfList.length; ni++) { if (data.cfList[ni] === data.cfSysId) { data.cfIndex = ni + 1; break; } }

    // Mail contents from the raw .eml (NOT the extracted .xlsx). An attachment mail carries two
    // sys_attachments — the .eml and the materialised Cashflows.xlsx — so pick the .eml explicitly
    // (else mailContents would parse the spreadsheet bytes as the email -> garbage). Other files
    // become the "Attachment:" line; the .eml sys_id backs the header Download button.
    data.mail = { to: '', from: '', cc: '', subject: '', body: '', attachment: '', received: '' };
    data.emlAttId = '';
    var attNames = [];
    var ag = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
    ag.addQuery('table_name', 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    ag.addQuery('table_sys_id', gr.getUniqueValue());
    ag.orderBy('sys_created_on');
    ag.query();
    while (ag.next()) {
        var ctype = ag.getValue('content_type') || '';
        var fname = ag.getValue('file_name') || '';
        if (!data.emlAttId && (ctype === 'message/rfc822' || /\.eml$/i.test(fname))) {
            data.emlAttId = ag.getUniqueValue();
        } else {
            attNames.push(fname);
        }
    }
    if (data.emlAttId) {
        var m = ex.mailContents(data.emlAttId) || {};
        data.mail.to = m.to || ''; data.mail.from = m.from || ''; data.mail.cc = m.cc || '';
        data.mail.subject = m.subject || ''; data.mail.body = m.body || '';
        data.mail.received = fmtReceived(m.date);
    }
    data.mail.attachment = attNames.join(', ');

    // Email picker options (all uploaded emails).
    data.emails = [];
    var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    g.orderBy('name'); g.setLimit(500); g.query();
    while (g.next()) {
        var eid = g.getUniqueValue();
        var lbl = g.getValue('name') || eid;
        var st = g.getValue('extraction_status');
        if (st) { lbl += '  ·  ' + st; }
        data.emails.push({ id: eid, label: lbl });
    }

    // Step 2 (Compare & Match): only after the analyst confirms the extracted fields. Compares the
    // clicked cashflow (?cf); without one, the email's first cashflow (or the email as a whole).
    data.dashUrl = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_analystdashboard';
    data.cmp = null;
    if (data.confirmed) {
        var cm = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch();
        data.cmp = data.cfSysId ? cm.buildData(data.cfSysId, '') : cm.buildData('', gr.getUniqueValue());
    }
    // Effective outcome = the analyst's override if set, else the system's computed outcome.
    data.effectiveOutcome = data.analystOutcome || (data.cmp ? data.cmp.systemOutcome : '');
    // Step 3: the derived next-action draft + its resolution state.
    data.resolution = cfRec ? (cfRec.getValue('resolution') || '') : '';
    data.draft = (data.confirmed && data.cmp && data.effectiveOutcome) ? buildDraft(data.effectiveOutcome) : null;

    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();

    // Nomura logo (same mark used across the app).
    data.logo = 'data:image/png;base64,';
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/analyst.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>d7697203edb24890816b896f0bee4930</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/analyst.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_d7697203edb24890816b896f0bee4930</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * OTC Compare & Match — Service Portal widget server.
 * Reads the target from the URL (?cf=<cashflow sys_id> preferred, else ?email=<email sys_id>) and
 * delegates to the CompareMatch Script Include's buildData() so the match + per-field logic stays in
 * one place (shared with the dashboard's classify()). Returns structured data; the Angular template
 * renders it. Opened from a dashboard row: /nfotcbsm?id=bsm_comparematch&cf=<sys_id>.
 */
(function () {
    var cm = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch();
    data.logo = cm.LOGO;
    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();
    data.dashUrl = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_analystdashboard';

    var cfId = $sp.getParameter('cf') || '';
    var emId = $sp.getParameter('email') || '';
    data.hasTarget = !!(cfId || emId);
    data.cmp = data.hasTarget ? cm.buildData(cfId, emId) : { found: false };
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/compare.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>db1af79b721340ee9ed7e51b023277c3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/compare.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_db1af79b721340ee9ed7e51b023277c3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[/**
 * OTC AI Dashboard — RETIRED.
 * This page was a GLOBAL console showing every work-driver's mails (OTC + CSG) via TaggingDashboard.dataAi()
 * with no wizard scope. It is superseded by the per-wizard boards (nfotc_wiz_dash), which are correctly
 * scoped. Nothing links here anymore; any direct hit on /nfotcbsm?id=bsm_ai_dashboard now bounces to the landing
 * page (the client navigates on data.redirect). Kept as a redirect stub so the URL resolves cleanly.
 */
(function () {
    data.logo = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().LOGO;
    data.role = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AccessGuard().roleLabel();
    data.redirect = '/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_work_drivers';
    data.stats = []; data.rows = []; data.counterparties = []; data.empty = true;
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/ai-dashboard.server.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>e2911d44b0414f4daa82cc57c38084c3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm/names-forms-otc/0.0.1/src/server/sp/ai-dashboard.server.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_e2911d44b0414f4daa82cc57c38084c3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:41</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm.DemoExtractor</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>One-shot email extraction (EmlFieldExtractor + XlsxCashflowExtractor + AiFieldExtractor) for the Demo page; returns results in-memory without persisting cashflows.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>DemoExtractor</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * DemoExtractor — one-shot email extraction for the business "Demo" page.
 *
 * Given a raw .eml already stored as a sys_attachment on a throwaway email record, it runs the SAME
 * pipeline the live OTC AI Settlements flow uses — EmlFieldExtractor (body) + XlsxCashflowExtractor
 * (spreadsheet), merged — and, when asked, the "Extract Settlement Fields" Now Assist skill
 * (AiFieldExtractor). It NEVER writes cashflow rows; everything is returned in-memory for display, so
 * the demo shows the unstructured-email -> structured-fields journey without touching the dashboards.
 *
 * Direction convention mirrors the live path: the email states the counterparty's POV; the AI 13-field
 * view is stored/shown from the bank POV (Pay <-> Receive flipped).
 */
var DemoExtractor = Class.create();
DemoExtractor.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    _flipDir: function (d) {
        var s = ('' + (d || '')).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (s === 'pay' || s === 'p' || s === 'pays') { return 'Receive'; }
        if (s === 'receive' || s === 'r' || s === 'rec' || s === 'receives') { return 'Pay'; }
        return d || '';
    },
    _refKey: function (s) { return ('' + (s || '')).toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ''); },

    /**
     * @param {string} attSysId    sys_id of the raw .eml sys_attachment
     * @param {string} emailSysId  sys_id of the (throwaway) parent x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email record
     * @param {boolean} withAi     also run the Now Assist extraction + align per cashflow
     */
    run: function (attSysId, emailSysId, withAi) {
        var out = {
            counterparty: '', mail: { to: '', from: '', cc: '', subject: '', body: '', date: '', attachment: '' },
            flows: [], cashflows: [], aiContent: '', aiStatus: '', aiFlowCount: 0
        };
        if (!attSysId) { return out; }
        var self = this;
        var ex = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.EmlFieldExtractor();

        // 1. deterministic body extraction + counterparty derived from the sender
        var r = ex.extractAll(attSysId, 'relevant');
        out.counterparty = r.counterparty_name || '';
        var bodyFlows = (r.flows && r.flows.length) ? r.flows.slice() : [];

        // 2. spreadsheet extraction (multi-tab), merged with the body flows (dedupe by reference)
        var attachmentText = '', attFlows = [];
        try {
            var xr = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.XlsxCashflowExtractor().extract(attSysId, emailSysId);
            if (xr && xr.flow_count) { attFlows = xr.flows; attachmentText = xr.sheet_text || ''; }
        } catch (e) { gs.warn('[DemoExtractor] xlsx: ' + e); }

        var merged = [], seen = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < bodyFlows.length; i++) { merged.push(bodyFlows[i]); var kb = self._refKey(bodyFlows[i].reference); if (kb) { seen[kb] = true; } }
        for (var j = 0; j < attFlows.length; j++) { var ka = self._refKey(attFlows[j].reference); if (ka && seen[ka]) { continue; } merged.push(attFlows[j]); if (ka) { seen[ka] = true; } }

        // 3. mail contents (headers + body) — as-shown to the analyst
        var m = ex.mailContents(attSysId) || {};
        out.mail.to = m.to || ''; out.mail.from = m.from || ''; out.mail.cc = m.cc || '';
        out.mail.subject = m.subject || ''; out.mail.body = m.body || ''; out.mail.date = m.date || '';

        // deterministic preview (direction shown AS STATED in the email — pre-AI, pre-flip)
        for (var p = 0; p < merged.length; p++) {
            var f = merged[p];
            out.flows.push({ reference: f.reference || '', currency: f.currency || '', amount: f.amount || '', direction: f.direction || '', value_date: f.value_date || '' });
        }

        // 4. the exact content that will be fed to the AI (body + parsed spreadsheet grid)
        var content = 'From: ' + (m.from || '') + '\nSubject: ' + (m.subject || '') + '\n\n';
        var segs = [];
        if (m.body) { segs.push(m.body); }
        if (attachmentText) {
            segs.push('The counterparty is the firm that SENT this email (the From address/domain above), ' +
                'NOT any "Counterparty Legal Name" column (which names the recipient bank). Additional ' +
                'settlement cashflows from the attached spreadsheet:\n' + attachmentText);
        }
        content += segs.join('\n\n');
        out.aiContent = content;

        if (withAi) {
            var ai = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AiFieldExtractor().extract(content);
            var aiFlows = ai.flows || [];
            out.aiStatus = ai.status || '';
            out.aiFlowCount = ai.flow_count || 0;
            var aiByRef = {};
            for (var q = 0; q < aiFlows.length; q++) { var qk = self._refKey(aiFlows[q].reference); if (qk && !(qk in aiByRef)) { aiByRef[qk] = aiFlows[q]; } }
            for (var c = 0; c < merged.length; c++) {
                var fm = merged[c];
                var af = aiByRef[self._refKey(fm.reference)] || aiFlows[c] || {};
                out.cashflows.push({
                    counterparty: out.counterparty,
                    nomuraEntity: af.nomura_entity || '',
                    product: af.product || '',
                    reference: af.reference || fm.reference || '',
                    tradeDate: af.trade_date || '',
                    valueDate: af.value_date || fm.value_date || '',
                    amount: af.amount || fm.amount || '',
                    currency: af.currency || fm.currency || '',
                    direction: af.direction ? self._flipDir(af.direction) : self._flipDir(fm.direction),
                    ssiBank: af.ssi_bank || '',
                    ssiAccount: af.ssi_account || '',
                    ssiBeneficiary: af.ssi_beneficiary || '',
                    ssiIntermediary: af.ssi_intermediary || ''
                });
            }
        }
        return out;
    },

    type: 'DemoExtractor'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>026f2974670e449c8a9a9acc304dee68</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>DemoExtractor</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_026f2974670e449c8a9a9acc304dee68</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:42</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_0f64407a0db34d02ba2be012b8583bc5
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>NFOTC: clear wizard ownership stamps on </name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[// #3 Reliability — wizard-churn cleanup. When a work-driver (wizard) is deleted it takes its sys_id with
// it; any email still stamped with that id (wiz_extracted / wiz_assigned / composed_run) would be "claimed
// by a ghost" and vanish from every board. So on wizard delete, clear those stamps — the affected emails
// become unclaimed again and can be re-synced by another driver (no orphaned ownership).
// Runs BEFORE delete on x_nose_nfotc_bsm_wizard. `current` is the wizard being deleted.
// Uses a per-record update() loop (same scope, no cross-scope updateMultiple privilege) so it runs cleanly
// on the first invocation.
var _wid = current.getUniqueValue();
var _fields = ['wiz_extracted', 'wiz_assigned', 'composed_run'];
for (var _i = 0; _i < _fields.length; _i++) {
    var _e = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
    _e.addQuery(_fields[_i], _wid);

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>NFOTC: cascade delete cashflows on email</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[// #3 Reliability — cascade delete. When an email record is deleted, remove its child cashflows so none
// are left orphaned (orphan cashflows previously inflated the board counts). The .eml / PDF attachments
// are auto-removed by the platform when the parent record is deleted, so only cashflows need cleaning.
// Runs BEFORE delete on x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email. `current` is the email being deleted.
var _cf = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
_cf.addQuery('email', current.getUniqueValue());
_cf.deleteMultiple();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:42</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>31a2dcc6c33c487dbb891c38f85fdeb8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>NFOTC: cascade delete cashflows on email</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_31a2dcc6c33c487dbb891c38f85fdeb8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:42</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=31a2dcc6c33c487dbb891c38f85fdeb8"/></record_update>
