<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Compare & Match: match email cashflows to bank bookings on currency/direction/value_date (+ amount tolerance) and render the two-panel screen.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CompareMatch</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * CompareMatch -" Compare & Match screen (UI Page x_nose_nfotc_bsm_compare.do).
 *
 * Matches an extracted email cashflow (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow) against the bank booking
 * golden source (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_booking, loaded from PCM.xlsx). The "bible" method:
 *   - Tier 1 EXACT: currency + direction + value_date + counterparty + AMOUNT all equal (FR-MTH-001).
 *   - Tier 2 FUZZY: amount within T2_AMT_ABS; value_date +/- business days; counterparty name fuzzy.
 *   - Tier 3 CPTY-LESS: amount + value_date EXACT, counterparty filter dropped (FR-MTH-020).
 *   - reference (trade ref): DISPLAYED, never compared.
 * Outcome per cashflow: matched / fuzzy / counterparty_less / no_match.
 *
 * render('')          -> list of all cashflows with live match status.
 * render(<cf sys_id>) -> two-panel compare (Counterparty Submitted vs Bank Booked).
 */
var CompareMatch = Class.create();
CompareMatch.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this._emailCache = {};
    },

    // Title-case a display name — capitalise the first letter of each word, leave the rest as-is:
    // "john smith" -> "John Smith". Used for the user name shown in every console header.
    titleCase: function (s) { return ('' + (s || '')).replace(/\b\w/g, function (m) { return m.toUpperCase(); }); },

    // Org taxonomy for the onboarding wizard's cascading Define selects (BRD FR-3.1): the wizard is scoped
    // BU -> Sub-BU -> Service -> Work Driver, and the Activity is always "Compare & Match" (the one built
    // pipeline). Mirrors Nomura's Settlements Operations org sheet: two BUs (OPS Shared / Client Services),
    // their Sub-BUs, and for the in-scope Sub-BUs the Service -> Work Driver breakdown. Sub-BUs with no
    // Service map yet are `{}` (shown in the dropdown, no work drivers) — extend here (data, no code change).
    taxonomy: function () {
        return {
            'OPS Shared Services': {
                'Listed Derivatives': {},
                'Asset Servicing': {},
                'Securities Settlements': {},
                'OTC Settlements': {
                    'Pre Settlement': ['Cash flow & SSI confirmation (Int \\ Ext)', 'Netting', 'Discrepancy & Query Management', 'SSI Management', 'Static Data Management', 'Reporting', 'Bespoke Activities', 'Cross Product Netting', 'System & Comment Update'],
                    'Settlement': ['Cash flow Release', 'Inter Entity Flow', 'Cleared derivatives - CF Validation', 'Credit \\ Comp Block Client', 'Cancellation'],
                    'Post Settlement': ['Fails', 'Nostro', 'DCC', 'Client Money investigation', 'Client Money Checker', 'Account Verification preparation', 'Account Verification approval'],
                    'NSC Pre Settlement': ['NSC - Cash flow & SSI confirmation (Int \\ Ext)', 'NSC - Netting With CP', 'NSC - SSI Management'],
                    'NSC Settlement': ['NSC - Cancellation', 'NSC - Cleared derivatives - cash flow validation', 'NSC - Reporting']
                },
                'Cash Management': {}
            },
            'OPS Client Services': {
                'KYC': {},
                'Client Sales Support': {},
                'Client Entity Data': {
                    'CSG': ['ASAM', 'NSC - Reporting', 'Reference Data & Entity Data Creation and Maintenance', 'Screening', 'Netting (Internal & External)']
                },
                'Client On-Boarding': {}
            }
        };
    },

    // Resolve a valid {bu, subBu, service} for a wizard that may predate the current taxonomy (blank or
    // legacy values) so the Define cascade shows sensible selections. Keeps existing values if already
    // valid; otherwise remaps the two legacy pilots (OTC / CSG) and finally searches the tree by work driver.
    resolveTaxonomy: function (bu, subBu, service, workDriver) {
        var t = this.taxonomy();
        if (bu && t[bu] && subBu && t[bu][subBu] && service && t[bu][subBu][service]) { return { bu: bu, subBu: subBu, service: service }; }
        var sig = (('' + (subBu || '')) + ' ' + ('' + (workDriver || ''))).toUpperCase();
        // Legacy CSG pilot (subBu/workDriver carried "CSG") -> Client Entity Data / CSG service.
        if (sig.indexOf('CSG') > -1) { return { bu: 'OPS Client Services', subBu: 'Client Entity Data', service: 'CSG' }; }
        // Legacy OTC pilot (subBu 'SSG'/'RegOps', workDriver 'OTC Settlements'/'OTC Allege') -> OTC Settlements / Pre Settlement.
        if (/OTC/i.test(sig) || (subBu && /SSG|RegOps/i.test('' + subBu))) { return { bu: 'OPS Shared Services', subBu: 'OTC Settlements', service: 'Pre Settlement' }; }
        // Otherwise locate the branch whose Service lists this work driver.
        var b, s;
        for (b in t) { for (s in t[b]) { for (var sv in t[b][s]) { if (workDriver && t[b][s][sv].indexOf(workDriver) > -1) { return { bu: b, subBu: s, service: sv }; } } } }
        return { bu: bu || '', subBu: subBu || '', service: service || '' };
    },

    // FSD-aligned matching (FR-MTH-001/010/020):
    //   Tier 1 (exact)   — amount is EXACT-filtered in the query (no tolerance). Currency/direction/value
    //                      date/counterparty exact.
    //   Tier 2 (fuzzy)   — the ONLY tier with tolerances: amount within T2_AMT_ABS; value date +/- VD_TOL_DAYS
    //                      BUSINESS days (weekends skipped); counterparty NAME fuzzy (>= NAME_FUZZY_PCT).
    //   Tier 3 (cpty-less) — amount + value date EXACT, counterparty filter dropped.
    // KNOWN FSD GAPS (data not available): value-date business days skip weekends only, NOT currency/bank
    // holidays (no holiday calendar); T2_AMT_ABS is in the RAW currency, not the FSD's "$50 equivalent" (no
    // FX rates). Both are upgradeable via config + a rate/calendar source with no rewrite.
    CENTS_EPS: 0.005,    // float-safety only, so "exact to the cent" isn't broken by parsing artefacts
    VD_TOL_DAYS: 2,      // Tier 2 value-date window, in BUSINESS days
    T2_AMT_ABS: 50.0,    // Tier 2 amount tolerance (raw currency units)
    NAME_FUZZY_PCT: 0.85, // Tier 2 fuzzy counterparty-name threshold (0..1 similarity)

    // Overlay the tolerances from the editable config store (system default, or the wizard's per-driver
    // override) onto THIS instance. Call before match()/classify() when a wizard context is known.
    loadConfig: function (wizId) {
        try {
            var c = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.NfotcConfig();
            this.VD_TOL_DAYS = c.getNumber('match.vd_tol_days', wizId, this.VD_TOL_DAYS);
            this.T2_AMT_ABS = c.getNumber('match.t2_amt_abs', wizId, this.T2_AMT_ABS);
            this.NAME_FUZZY_PCT = c.getNumber('match.name_fuzzy_pct', wizId, this.NAME_FUZZY_PCT);
        } catch (e) { /* config store unavailable -> keep the hardcoded fallbacks */ }
        return this;
    },

    // Flow B (Match & Write-back) entry point. Runs the tiered cascade for ONE AI cashflow using the
    // owning wizard's config, then PERSISTS the system's best-candidate outcome (status, producing
    // tier, bank ref, confidence, candidate count) onto the cashflow so the result is a stored fact.
    // Returns the same summary for the flow/audit. Nothing here auto-resolves — the analyst still
    // selects the match and writes back; this just computes + records what the system found.
    matchAndStore: function (cfSysId) {
        var out = { status: 'no_cashflow', tier: 0, bankRef: '', confidence: 0, candidates: 0 };
        var cfGr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        if (!cfSysId || !cfGr.get(cfSysId)) { return out; }

        var wizId = '';
        var em = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        if (em.get(cfGr.getValue('email'))) { wizId = em.getValue('wiz_extracted') || em.getValue('wiz_assigned') || ''; }
        this.loadConfig(wizId);

        var cf = this._cfValuesAi(cfGr);
        var m = this.match(cf);
        out.status = 'no_match'; out.tier = 0; out.candidates = m.candidates || 0;
        if (m.status !== 'no_match' && m.booking) {
            var one = this._compareOne(cf, m.booking, m.tier);
            var cands = this._candList(cf, m.list, m.tier);
            out.status = one.systemOutcome;                 // matched | mismatch
            out.tier = m.tier || 0;
            out.bankRef = m.booking.bank_trade_ref || '';
            out.confidence = (cands && cands.length) ? cands[0].confidence : 0;   // already a 0-100 integer % (from _confidence)
            out.candidates = m.candidates || cands.length || 0;
        }

        cfGr.setValue('ai_match_status', out.status);
        cfGr.setValue('ai_match_tier', '' + (out.tier || 0));
        cfGr.setValue('ai_match_booking', out.bankRef);
        cfGr.setValue('ai_match_confidence', '' + Math.round(out.confidence || 0));   // out.confidence is already a 0-100 % — do NOT re-scale
        cfGr.setValue('ai_candidate_count', '' + (out.candidates || 0));
        cfGr.setValue('ai_match_computed', 'true');
        cfGr.update();

        // Audit the match stage (FR-AUD-001: every system action; FR-MTH: tier + candidates + outcome).
        try {
            new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AuditTrail().log('match.computed', {
                entityType: 'cashflow', entityId: cfSysId, cashflowId: cfSysId,
                emailId: cfGr.getValue('email'), mailId: em.getValue('name'), counterparty: em.getValue('counterparty_name'),
                actor: 'system', aiComponent: 'matcher', product: cfGr.getValue('ai_product'),
                summary: 'Compare & Match: ' + out.status + ' (tier ' + (out.tier || 0) + ', ' + (out.candidates || 0) + ' candidate(s))',
                ai: { tier: out.tier, status: out.status, confidence: Math.round(out.confidence || 0), confidence_level: this._confWord(Math.round(out.confidence || 0)), candidates: out.candidates, booking: out.bankRef },
                after: { ai_match_status: out.status, ai_match_tier: out.tier, ai_match_booking: out.bankRef, ai_match_confidence: Math.round(out.confidence || 0) }
            });
        } catch (ea) { /* audit best-effort */ }

        return out;
    },

    // Run Compare & Match for every cashflow of an email (used by the composed "Compare & Match" spoke).
    // Returns a tally of the stored outcomes. Reuses matchAndStore (per-cashflow persist + audit).
    matchEmail: function (emailId) {
        var out = { matched: 0, mismatch: 0, no_match: 0 };
        if (!emailId) { return out; }
        var cf = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
        cf.addQuery('email', emailId);
        cf.query();
        while (cf.next()) {
            var r = this.matchAndStore(cf.getUniqueValue());
            if (r.status === 'matched') { out.matched++; }
            else if (r.status === 'mismatch') { out.mismatch++; }
            else { out.no_match++; }
        }
        return out;
    },

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- tiered match cascade
    // Each tier fires only when the previous one returns nothing:
    //   Tier 1 (exact):     currency + direction + value date (exact) + counterparty (exact).
    //   Tier 2 (fuzzy):     currency + direction exact; counterparty FUZZY; value date +/- N calendar
    //                       days; amount within the wider (T2) tolerance.
    //   Tier 3 (cpty-less): currency + direction + value date (exact), counterparty filter dropped.
    // Returns the best-ranked booking + the producing tier. Amount agreement is computed for display.
    match: function (cf) {
        var out = { status: 'no_match', tier: 0, booking: null, candidates: 0, amountAgrees: false, delta: null };
        if (!cf.currency) { return out; }
        var amt = this._num(cf.amount);

        var t1 = this._search(cf, 'exact', 'exact', 0);   // Tier 1: amount EXACT (FR-MTH-001)
        if (t1.best) { return this._finish(cf, t1, 1, amt); }

        var t2 = this._search(cf, 'window', 'fuzzy', this.T2_AMT_ABS);   // Tier 2: ±T2_AMT_ABS, business-day VD, fuzzy names
        if (t2.best) { return this._finish(cf, t2, 2, amt); }

        var t3 = this._search(cf, 'exact', 'none', 0);   // Tier 3: amount + VD EXACT, counterparty dropped (FR-MTH-020)
        if (t3.best) { return this._finish(cf, t3, 3, amt); }

        return out;
    },

    // Query bookings for one tier; return { best, count, delta }.
    //   vdMode: 'exact' | 'window'    cpMode: 'exact' | 'fuzzy' | 'none'
    //   amtTol: null (no amount filter) | number (candidate amount must be within tol)
    _search: function (cf, vdMode, cpMode, amtTol) {
        var res = { best: null, count: 0, delta: null, list: [] };
        var amt = this._num(cf.amount);
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_booking');
        gr.addQuery('currency', cf.currency);
        if (cf.direction) { gr.addQuery('direction', cf.direction); }
        if (vdMode === 'window' && cf.value_date) {
            var lo = this._addBusinessDays(cf.value_date, -this.VD_TOL_DAYS);
            var hi = this._addBusinessDays(cf.value_date, this.VD_TOL_DAYS);
            if (lo && hi) { gr.addQuery('value_date', '>=', lo); gr.addQuery('value_date', '<=', hi); }
            else { gr.addQuery('value_date', cf.value_date); }
        } else {
            gr.addQuery('value_date', cf.value_date);
        }
        gr.query();
        var cands = [];
        while (gr.next()) {
            var bCp = gr.getValue('counterparty_org_name');
            if (cpMode === 'exact' && cf.counterparty && !this._cpEq(cf.counterparty, bCp)) { continue; }
            if (cpMode === 'fuzzy' && cf.counterparty && !this._cpFuzzy(cf.counterparty, bCp)) { continue; }
            var bAmt = this._num(gr.getValue('amount'));
            var dAmt = (isNaN(amt) || isNaN(bAmt)) ? 0 : Math.abs(bAmt - amt);
            // amtTol=0 => EXACT to the cent (Tier 1 & 3); a positive tol => within-tolerance (Tier 2).
            if (amtTol !== null && !isNaN(amt) && !isNaN(bAmt) && dAmt > (amtTol + this.CENTS_EPS)) { continue; }
            var dVd = this._dateDiffDays(cf.value_date, gr.getValue('value_date'));
            var cpExact = this._cpEq(cf.counterparty, bCp) ? 0 : 1;
            // rank: counterparty-exact first, then smallest |amount delta|, then smallest |date delta|,
            // then positive date difference before negative (per BRD ranking).
            cands.push({ obj: this._bookingObj(gr), dAmt: dAmt, dVd: dVd, rank: [cpExact, dAmt, Math.abs(dVd), (dVd >= 0 ? 0 : 1)] });
        }
        var self = this;
        cands.sort(function (a, b) { return self._rankLess(a.rank, b.rank) ? -1 : (self._rankLess(b.rank, a.rank) ? 1 : 0); });
        res.count = cands.length;
        res.list = cands;
        if (cands.length) { res.best = cands[0].obj; res.delta = cands[0].dAmt; }
        return res;
    },
    _rankLess: function (a, b) {
        for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { if (a[i] < b[i]) { return true; } if (a[i] > b[i]) { return false; } }
        return false;
    },
    _finish: function (cf, s, tier, amt) {
        var out = { status: 'no_match', tier: tier, booking: s.best, candidates: s.count, amountAgrees: false, delta: s.delta, list: s.list || [] };
        var bAmt = this._num(s.best.amount);
        out.delta = (isNaN(amt) || isNaN(bAmt)) ? 0 : Math.abs(bAmt - amt);
        // Amount was filtered by the query per tier (exact for T1/T3; within T2_AMT_ABS for T2), so the
        // best candidate already agrees within the tier's rule.
        out.amountAgrees = isNaN(amt) || out.delta <= (this._amtTol(tier) + this.CENTS_EPS);
        if (tier === 1) { out.status = 'matched'; }
        else if (tier === 2) { out.status = 'fuzzy'; }
        else { out.status = 'counterparty_less'; }
        return out;
    },
    // Amount tolerance for a tier: exact (0) for Tier 1 & 3, T2_AMT_ABS for Tier 2. Single source for the
    // query filter, the status check and the candidate-compare highlight.
    _amtTol: function (tier) { return tier === 2 ? this.T2_AMT_ABS : 0; },

    // ---- helpers: plain-calendar dates, counterparty match, tier label ----
    _addDays: function (iso, n) {
        var m = ('' + (iso || '')).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
        if (!m) { return ''; }
        var d = new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]));
        d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + n);
        return d.getUTCFullYear() + '-' + ('0' + (d.getUTCMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + d.getUTCDate()).slice(-2);
    },
    // Add N BUSINESS days (skip Sat/Sun). FSD FR-MTH-011 also excludes currency + bank holidays, but no
    // holiday calendar is available — so weekends only for now (upgradeable when a calendar source exists).
    _addBusinessDays: function (iso, n) {
        var m = ('' + (iso || '')).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
        if (!m) { return ''; }
        var d = new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]));
        var step = n < 0 ? -1 : 1, left = Math.abs(n);
        while (left > 0) {
            d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + step);
            var dow = d.getUTCDay();   // 0=Sun, 6=Sat
            if (dow !== 0 && dow !== 6) { left--; }
        }
        return d.getUTCFullYear() + '-' + ('0' + (d.getUTCMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0' + d.getUTCDate()).slice(-2);
    },
    _dateDiffDays: function (a, b) {
        var ma = ('' + (a || '')).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/), mb = ('' + (b || '')).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
        if (!ma || !mb) { return 0; }
        return Math.round((Date.UTC(+mb[1], +mb[2] - 1, +mb[3]) - Date.UTC(+ma[1], +ma[2] - 1, +ma[3])) / 86400000);
    },
    _cpNorm: function (s) { return ('' + (s == null ? '' : s)).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); },
    _cpEq: function (a, b) { var x = this._cpNorm(a); return x !== '' && x === this._cpNorm(b); },
    // Tier 2 fuzzy name match (FR-MTH-010): equal / containment, else a normalized Levenshtein similarity
    // above the configurable threshold (NAME_FUZZY_PCT). Handles minor spelling/alias drift.
    _cpFuzzy: function (a, b) {
        var x = this._cpNorm(a), y = this._cpNorm(b);
        if (!x || !y) { return false; }
        if (x === y || x.indexOf(y) !== -1 || y.indexOf(x) !== -1) { return true; }
        return this._nameSim(x, y) >= (this.NAME_FUZZY_PCT || 0.85);
    },
    _nameSim: function (a, b) {   // 0..1 similarity = 1 - normalized Levenshtein distance
        var la = a.length, lb = b.length;
        if (!la || !lb) { return 0; }
        return 1 - (this._lev(a, b) / Math.max(la, lb));
    },
    _lev: function (a, b) {   // Levenshtein edit distance
        var m = a.length, n = b.length, i, j, prev = [], cur = [];
        for (j = 0; j <= n; j++) { prev[j] = j; }
        for (i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            cur[0] = i;
            for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                var cost = a.charAt(i - 1) === b.charAt(j - 1) ? 0 : 1;
                cur[j] = Math.min(cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j] + 1, prev[j - 1] + cost);
            }
            for (j = 0; j <= n; j++) { prev[j] = cur[j]; }
        }
        return prev[n];
    },
    _tierLabel: function (t) {
        if (t === 1) { return 'Tier 1 · exact'; }
        if (t === 2) { return 'Tier 2 · fuzzy'; }
        if (t === 3) { return 'Tier 3 · counterparty-less'; }
        return '';
    },

    // Bucket a cashflow for the dashboard, using the SAME per-field logic as the compare screen so
    // the card numbers match exactly what the analyst sees:
    //   'matched'  -> a booking was found AND every field agrees (amount within tolerance),
    //   'mismatch' -> a booking was found but >=1 field differs or is missing (not just amount),
    //   'no_match' -> no booking shares the currency + direction + value date.
    classify: function (cf) {
        var m = this.match(cf);
        if (m.status === 'no_match' || !m.booking) { return 'no_match'; }
        var b = m.booking;
        var pairs = [
            [cf.counterparty, b.counterparty, false],
            [cf.value_date, b.value_date, false],
            [cf.amount, b.amount, true],
            [cf.currency, b.currency, false],
            [cf.direction, b.direction, false]
        ];
        for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
            var l = this._norm(pairs[i][0]), r = this._norm(pairs[i][1]);
            if (!l || !r) { return 'mismatch'; }                 // missing on one side
            if (pairs[i][2]) { if (!m.amountAgrees) { return 'mismatch'; } } // amount beyond tolerance
            else if (l !== r) { return 'mismatch'; }              // fields differ
        }
        return 'matched';
    },

    _num: function (s) { return parseFloat(('' + (s || '')).replace(/,/g, '')); },

    _bookingObj: function (gr) {
        return {
            cashflow_id: gr.getValue('cashflow_id'),
            counterparty: gr.getValue('counterparty_org_name'),
            reference: gr.getValue('counterparty_trade_ref'),
            currency: gr.getValue('currency'),
            amount: gr.getValue('amount'),
            direction: gr.getValue('direction'),
            value_date: gr.getValue('value_date'),
            product_type: gr.getValue('product_type'),
            trade_system: gr.getValue('trade_system'),
            cashflow_type: gr.getValue('cashflow_type'),
            bank_trade_ref: gr.getValue('bank_trade_ref'),
            status: gr.getValue('status')
        };
    },

    // Build the email-side cashflow object (fields + parent counterparty / mail id).
    _cfValues: function (cfGr) {
        var em = this._email(cfGr.getValue('email'));
        return {
            sys_id: cfGr.getUniqueValue(),
            reference: cfGr.getValue('reference'),
            currency: cfGr.getValue('currency'),
            amount: cfGr.getValue('amount'),
            direction: cfGr.getValue('direction'),
            value_date: cfGr.getValue('value_date'),
            flow_index: cfGr.getValue('flow_index'),
            counterparty: em.counterparty,
            mail_id: em.mail_id
        };
    },

    // Same shape as _cfValues, but sourced from the AI-extracted fields (OTC AI variant). The match
    // logic is identical; only the input values differ. Counterparty is the per-cashflow AI value,
    // falling back to the parent email's counterparty.
    _cfValuesAi: function (cfGr) {
        var em = this._email(cfGr.getValue('email'));
        return {
            sys_id: cfGr.getUniqueValue(),
            reference: cfGr.getValue('ai_reference'),
            currency: cfGr.getValue('ai_currency'),
            amount: cfGr.getValue('ai_amount'),
            direction: cfGr.getValue('ai_direction'),
            value_date: cfGr.getValue('ai_value_date'),
            flow_index: cfGr.getValue('flow_index'),
            counterparty: em.counterparty,   // DERIVED (directory lookup), not AI
            mail_id: em.mail_id
        };
    },
    _cfFromEmailAi: function (eGr) {
        return {
            sys_id: '', flow_index: '',
            reference: eGr.getValue('ai_reference'),
            currency: eGr.getValue('ai_currency'),
            amount: eGr.getValue('ai_amount'),
            direction: eGr.getValue('ai_direction'),
            value_date: eGr.getValue('ai_value_date'),
            counterparty: eGr.getValue('counterparty_name'),   // DERIVED, not AI
            mail_id: eGr.getValue('name')
        };
    },

    _email: function (sysId) {
        if (!sysId) { return { counterparty: '', mail_id: '' }; }
        if (this._emailCache[sysId]) { return this._emailCache[sysId]; }
        var e = { counterparty: '', mail_id: '' };
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
        if (gr.get(sysId)) { e.counterparty = gr.getValue('counterparty_name') || ''; e.mail_id = gr.getValue('name') || ''; }
        this._emailCache[sysId] = e;
        return e;
    },

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- entry point (LEGACY UI Page)
    // LEGACY / DELISTED (review #14): the classic Compare UI Page (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_compare.do) is superseded
    // by the Service-Portal compare widget (buildData / buildDataAi below). No navigation points here.
    // Opens from a Dashboard line item: ?id=<cashflow sys_id> (an extracted flow) OR
    // ?email=<email sys_id> (a mail with no extracted flow — image/PDF/partial/SSI).
    render: function (cfSysId, emailSysId) {
        if (cfSysId) {
            var cfGr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
            if (cfGr.get(cfSysId)) { return this._renderCompare(this._cfValues(cfGr)); }
        }
        if (emailSysId) {
            var eGr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            if (eGr.get(emailSysId)) { return this._renderCompare(this._cfFromEmail(eGr)); }
        }
        return this._page(
            '<div class="cm-head"><h1>Compare & Match</h1></div>' +
            '<div class="card"><div class="empty">Open a cashflow from the ' +
            '<a href="/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_analystdashboard">Dashboard</a> to compare it against the bank booking.</div></div>');
    },

    // Email-side object for a mail with no extracted cashflow row (image/PDF/partial/SSI). Deterministic
    // settlement fields no longer live on the email — only the derived counterparty + mail id remain.
    _cfFromEmail: function (eGr) {
        return {
            sys_id: '', flow_index: '',
            reference: '', currency: '', amount: '', direction: '', value_date: '',
            counterparty: eGr.getValue('counterparty_name'),
            mail_id: eGr.getValue('name')
        };
    },

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Service Portal data
    // Structured version of _renderCompare for the Service Portal widget (Angular renders it, so this
    // returns DATA not HTML). Same match + per-field logic as the classic screen. cf sys_id preferred;
    // email sys_id for mails with no extracted flow.
    buildData: function (cfSysId, emailSysId) {
        var cf = null;
        if (cfSysId) {
            var cfGr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
            if (cfGr.get(cfSysId)) { cf = this._cfValues(cfGr); }
        }
        if (!cf && emailSysId) {
            var eGr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            if (eGr.get(emailSysId)) { cf = this._cfFromEmail(eGr); }
        }
        if (!cf) { return { found: false }; }
        var outD = this._buildDataFromCf(cf);
        delete outD._bookings;
        return outD;
    },

    // OTC AI variant: identical compare, but the counterparty-submitted side is the AI-extracted values.
    // selectedRef (a candidate's bank_trade_ref) is the analyst's chosen booking — NOTHING is auto-matched;
    // the selection drives the compare + outcome. '' = not yet chosen, 'none' = marked as no match.
    buildDataAi: function (cfSysId, emailSysId, selectedRef) {
        var cf = null;
        if (cfSysId) {
            var cfGr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow');
            if (cfGr.get(cfSysId)) {
                var em = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
                if (em.get(cfGr.getValue('email'))) { this.loadConfig(em.getValue('wiz_extracted') || em.getValue('wiz_assigned') || ''); }
                cf = this._cfValuesAi(cfGr);
            }
        }
        if (!cf && emailSysId) {
            var eGr = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email');
            if (eGr.get(emailSysId)) { cf = this._cfFromEmailAi(eGr); }
        }
        if (!cf) { return { found: false }; }
        var out = this._buildDataFromCf(cf);
        this._applySelection(out, cf, selectedRef || '');
        delete out._bookings;
        return out;
    },

    // Given a resolved counterparty-side cashflow object, run the match + per-field compare and return
    // the Service-Portal data payload. Shared by buildData (deterministic) and buildDataAi (AI).
    _buildDataFromCf: function (cf) {
        var m = this.match(cf);
        var out = {
            found: true,
            mailId: cf.mail_id || '',
            flowIndex: cf.flow_index || '',
            candidates: m.candidates || 0,
            status: m.status,
            tier: m.tier || 0,
            tierLabel: this._tierLabel(m.tier),
            noMatch: (m.status === 'no_match'),
            submitted: this._submitted(cf),
            _bookings: []
        };

        if (m.status === 'no_match') {
            out.banner = { kind: 'bad', title: 'Allege',
                msg: 'No candidate found across Tier 1–3 (exact, then fuzzy, then counterparty-less).', diffs: [], miss: [] };
            out.left = { title: 'Counterparty Submitted Details', subtitle: cf.counterparty || '', rows: [
                this._drow('Counterparty', cf.counterparty, 'plain'),
                this._drow('Trade Reference', cf.reference, 'plain'),
                this._drow('Value Date (DD-MM-YYYY)', this._toDisp(cf.value_date), 'plain'),
                this._drow('Amount', this._amtPlain(cf.amount, cf.currency), 'plain'),
                this._drow('Currency Pair', cf.currency, 'plain'),
                this._drow('Direction', cf.direction, 'plain')
            ] };
            out.right = { title: 'Bank Booked Details', subtitle: 'No matching trade in books', notFound: true, rows: [] };
            out.systemOutcome = 'no_match';
            out.diffCount = 0;
            out.candidatesList = [];
            return out;
        }

        var one = this._compareOne(cf, m.booking, m.tier);
        out.banner = one.banner;
        out.left = one.left;
        out.right = one.right;
        out.booking = one.booking;
        out.diffCount = one.diffCount;
        out.systemOutcome = one.systemOutcome;
        out.candidatesList = this._candList(cf, m.list, m.tier);
        for (var i = 0; i < (m.list || []).length; i++) { out._bookings.push(m.list[i].obj); }
        return out;
    },

    // Detailed two-panel compare (banner + counterparty/bank rows + diff count) for ONE booking.
    _compareOne: function (cf, b, tier) {
        var cfAmt = this._num(cf.amount), bAmt = this._num(b.amount);
        var tol = this._amtTol(tier) + this.CENTS_EPS;   // tier-aware: exact for T1/T3, T2_AMT_ABS for T2
        var amtOk = (isNaN(cfAmt) || isNaN(bAmt)) ? false : Math.abs(bAmt - cfAmt) <= tol;
        var kCp = this._cmp(cf.counterparty, b.counterparty);
        var kVd = this._cmp(cf.value_date, b.value_date);
        var kAmt = this._amtCmp(cf.amount, b.amount, amtOk);
        var kCcy = this._cmp(cf.currency, b.currency);
        var kDir = this._cmp(cf.direction, b.direction);
        var diffs = [], miss = [];
        // Trade reference is DISPLAYED on the extracted-fields card but never part of compare/match.
        var checks = [
            ['Counterparty', kCp, cf.counterparty, b.counterparty],
            ['Value Date', kVd, cf.value_date, b.value_date],
            ['Amount', kAmt, cf.amount, b.amount],
            ['Currency Pair', kCcy, cf.currency, b.currency],
            ['Direction', kDir, cf.direction, b.direction]
        ];
        for (var i = 0; i < checks.length; i++) {
            if (checks[i][1] === 'bad') { diffs.push(checks[i][0]); }
            else if (!this._norm(checks[i][2]) || !this._norm(checks[i][3])) { miss.push(checks[i][0]); }
        }
        var banner = this._dbanner(diffs, miss);
        banner.msg = 'Found at ' + this._tierLabel(tier) + '. ' + banner.msg;
        var diffCount = diffs.length + miss.length;
        return {
            banner: banner,
            left: { title: 'Counterparty Submitted Details', subtitle: cf.counterparty || '', rows: [
                this._drow('Counterparty', cf.counterparty, kCp),
                this._drow('Value Date (DD-MM-YYYY)', this._toDisp(cf.value_date), kVd),
                this._drow('Amount', this._amtPlain(cf.amount, cf.currency), kAmt),
                this._drow('Currency Pair', cf.currency, kCcy),
                this._drow('Direction', cf.direction, kDir)
            ] },
            right: { title: 'Bank Booked Details — ' + this._tierLabel(tier) + (b.trade_system ? ' (' + b.trade_system + ')' : ''), subtitle: b.counterparty || '', notFound: false, rows: [
                this._drow('Counterparty', b.counterparty, kCp),
                this._drow('Value Date (DD-MM-YYYY)', this._toDisp(b.value_date), kVd),
                this._drow('Amount', this._amtPlain(b.amount, b.currency), kAmt),
                this._drow('Currency Pair', b.currency, kCcy),
                this._drow('Direction', b.direction, kDir)
            ] },
            booking: { reference: b.reference || '', bank_trade_ref: b.bank_trade_ref || '', currency: b.currency || '', amount: b.amount || '', direction: b.direction || '', value_date: this._toDisp(b.value_date), trade_system: b.trade_system || '' },
            diffCount: diffCount,
            systemOutcome: diffCount === 0 ? 'matched' : 'mismatch'
        };
    },

    // Counterparty-submitted values, for the top row of the AI candidate-selection table.
    _submitted: function (cf) {
        return {
            counterparty: this._clean(cf.counterparty),
            reference: this._clean(cf.reference),
            currency: this._clean(cf.currency),
            amount: this._amtPlain(cf.amount, cf.currency),
            direction: this._clean(cf.direction),
            value_date: this._toDisp(cf.value_date)
        };
    },

    // AI screen: overlay the analyst's manual selection. Nothing is auto-matched — a chosen candidate
    // (by bank_trade_ref) drives the compare/outcome; 'none' = mark no match; '' = not yet chosen.
    _applySelection: function (out, cf, selectedRef) {
        out.selectedRef = '';
        out.markedNoMatch = false;
        if (out.status === 'no_match') {
            out.selectable = false;
            if (selectedRef === 'none') { out.markedNoMatch = true; out.selectedRef = 'none'; out.systemOutcome = 'no_match'; }
            return out;
        }
        out.selectable = true;
        for (var i = 0; i < out.candidatesList.length; i++) { out.candidatesList[i].selected = false; }
        if (selectedRef === 'none') {
            out.markedNoMatch = true; out.selectedRef = 'none';
            out.systemOutcome = 'no_match'; out.diffCount = 0; out.booking = null;
            out.banner = { kind: 'bad', title: 'Marked as no match', msg: 'None of the candidate bookings match this cashflow.', diffs: [], miss: [] };
            return out;
        }
        if (selectedRef) {
            var chosen = this._findBooking(out._bookings, selectedRef);
            if (chosen) {
                for (var j = 0; j < out.candidatesList.length; j++) {
                    var isSel = (out.candidatesList[j].key === selectedRef);
                    out.candidatesList[j].selected = isSel;
                    if (isSel) { out.selectedConfidence = out.candidatesList[j].confidence; out.selectedConfLabel = out.candidatesList[j].confLabel; out.selectedConfLevel = out.candidatesList[j].confLevel; }
                }
                var one = this._compareOne(cf, chosen, out.tier);
                out.banner = one.banner; out.left = one.left; out.right = one.right;
                out.booking = one.booking; out.diffCount = one.diffCount; out.systemOutcome = one.systemOutcome;
                out.selectedRef = selectedRef;
                return out;
            }
        }
        // not yet chosen — do NOT auto-select a booking
        out.systemOutcome = 'pending'; out.diffCount = 0; out.booking = null;
        return out;
    },

    _findBooking: function (bookings, ref) {
        for (var i = 0; i < (bookings || []).length; i++) {
            if ((bookings[i].bank_trade_ref || ('CAND-' + (i + 1))) === ref) { return bookings[i]; }
        }
        return null;
    },

    // Ranked list of every candidate booking the producing tier returned (best first), each with its
    // amount/date deltas from the counterparty cashflow — this is what the analyst sees as "the ranking".
    _candList: function (cf, list, tier) {
        var out = [];
        if (!list) { return out; }
        var cfAmt = this._num(cf.amount);
        var tol = this._amtTol(tier) + this.CENTS_EPS;   // tier-aware: exact for T1/T3, T2_AMT_ABS for T2
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            var c = list[i], b = c.obj;
            var bAmt = this._num(b.amount);
            var amtOk = (isNaN(cfAmt) || isNaN(bAmt)) ? false : Math.abs(bAmt - cfAmt) <= tol;
            // per-field agreement vs the counterparty-submitted values ('bad' => highlight red).
            // Trade reference is NOT compared here (it is display-only on the extracted-fields card).
            var flags = {
                cp: this._cmp(cf.counterparty, b.counterparty),
                ccy: this._cmp(cf.currency, b.currency),
                amt: this._amtCmp(cf.amount, b.amount, amtOk),
                dir: this._cmp(cf.direction, b.direction),
                vd: this._cmp(cf.value_date, b.value_date)
            };
            var mis = 0, kk;
            for (kk in flags) { if (flags[kk] === 'bad') { mis++; } }
            var _cpct = this._confidence(tier, flags, c.dAmt, c.dVd, cfAmt, i + 1);
            out.push({
                key: b.bank_trade_ref || ('CAND-' + (i + 1)),
                rank: i + 1,
                best: (i === 0),
                selected: false,
                system: b.trade_system || '',
                bankRef: b.bank_trade_ref || '',
                counterparty: b.counterparty || '',
                currency: b.currency || '',
                amount: this._amtPlain(b.amount, b.currency),
                direction: b.direction || '',
                value_date: this._toDisp(b.value_date),
                flags: flags,
                mismatchCount: mis,
                confidence: _cpct,
                confLevel: this._confBucket(_cpct),
                confLabel: this._confWord(_cpct),
                // back-compat fields for the deterministic (OTC analyst) ranked list
                reference: b.bank_trade_ref || b.reference || '',
                trade_system: b.trade_system || '',
                cpMatch: this._cpEq(cf.counterparty, b.counterparty),
                amtDelta: this._fmtDelta(c.dAmt),
                dayDelta: (c.dVd == null ? 0 : c.dVd)
            });
        }
        return out;
    },
    _fmtDelta: function (n) {
        if (n == null || isNaN(n) || n === 0) { return '0'; }
        var s = Math.abs(n).toFixed(2).replace(/\.00$/, '');
        return s.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
    },

    // Match-confidence (%) for one candidate. Base by producing tier (exact > fuzzy > counterparty-less),
    // penalised by value-date distance, relative amount distance, a differing counterparty NAME (Tier 1/2
    // only — Tier 3's base already reflects the dropped counterparty), and any other differing field. A
    // tiny rank decay keeps the % monotonically non-increasing down the already-ranked list. Deterministic.
    // Match confidence expressed as a plain level (no percentage shown to the analyst). The raw % is kept
    // internally for the audit trail; the UI shows High / Medium / Low only. Buckets: >=85 High, >=65 Medium.
    _confBucket: function (pct) { return pct >= 85 ? 'hi' : (pct >= 65 ? 'mid' : 'lo'); },
    _confWord: function (pct) { return pct >= 85 ? 'High' : (pct >= 65 ? 'Medium' : 'Low'); },

    _confidence: function (tier, flags, dAmt, dVd, cfAmt, rank) {
        var base = (tier === 1) ? 0.98 : (tier === 2) ? 0.88 : 0.68;
        var pen = 0.03 * Math.abs(dVd || 0);
        var ca = Math.abs(cfAmt || 0);
        if (dAmt != null && !isNaN(dAmt) && ca > 0) { pen += Math.min(0.18, 0.06 * (Math.abs(dAmt) / ca * 100)); }
        if (tier !== 3 && flags && flags.cp === 'bad') { pen += 0.18; }
        var other = 0;
        if (flags && flags.ccy === 'bad') { other++; }
        if (flags && flags.dir === 'bad') { other++; }
        pen += 0.05 * other;
        pen += 0.004 * ((rank || 1) - 1);
        var conf = base - pen;
        if (conf < 0.30) { conf = 0.30; }
        if (conf > 0.99) { conf = 0.99; }
        return Math.round(conf * 100);
    },

    _drow: function (label, value, kind) { return { label: label, value: this._clean(value), kind: kind }; },
    _amtPlain: function (v, ccy) { v = this._clean(v); return v ? (v + (ccy ? ' ' + this._clean(ccy) : '')) : ''; },
    // Value date for display only: ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) -> DD-MM-YYYY. Comparison still uses the raw value.
    _toDisp: function (v) { var m = ('' + (v || '')).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/); return m ? (m[3] + '-' + m[2] + '-' + m[1]) : ('' + (v || '')); },
    _dbanner: function (diffs, miss) {
        if (!diffs.length && !miss.length) {
            return { kind: 'ok', title: 'All fields agree', msg: 'Every field matches the bank booking.', diffs: [], miss: [] };
        }
        var n = diffs.length + miss.length;
        var title = n + (n === 1 ? ' field needs attention' : ' fields need attention');
        var msg = 'Matched on the core key (currency, direction, value date). ' +
            (diffs.length ? diffs.length + (diffs.length === 1 ? ' differs. ' : ' differ. ') : '') +
            (miss.length ? miss.length + ' not found.' : '');
        return { kind: 'warn', title: title, msg: msg, diffs: diffs, miss: miss };
    },

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- detail view
    _renderCompare: function (cf) {
        var m = this.match(cf);

        if (m.status === 'no_match') {
            var bannerNM = this._banner('bad', 'Allege',
                'No bank booking shares this cashflow’s currency, direction and value date.');
            // Submitted side still shows a NOT FOUND tag for any field the mail didn't carry.
            var leftNM = this._panel('Counterparty Submitted Details', cf.counterparty, [
                this._row('Counterparty', cf.counterparty, 'plain'),
                this._row('Trade Reference', cf.reference, 'plain'),
                this._row('Value Date (YYYY-MM-DD)',cf.value_date, 'plain'),
                this._row('Amount', this._amt(cf.amount, cf.currency), 'plain'),
                this._row('Currency Pair', cf.currency, 'plain'),
                this._row('Direction', cf.direction, 'plain')
            ]);
            var rightNM = '<div class="cm-panel"><div class="cm-p-title">Bank Booked Details</div>' +
                '<div class="cm-p-sub">No matching trade in books</div>' +
                '<div class="cm-notfound"><div class="cm-nf-icon">✕</div>' +
                '<div class="cm-nf-title">Not found in PCM</div></div></div>';
            return this._comparePage(cf, m, bannerNM, leftNM, rightNM);
        }

        var b = m.booking, amtOk = m.amountAgrees;

        // Compare EVERY field between the two sides (not just the core match key). Amount uses the
        // tolerance result; the rest are exact (normalised). 'ok' = agree, 'bad' = both present but
        // differ, 'plain' = one side missing (that side renders a NOT FOUND tag via _row).
        var kCp = this._cmp(cf.counterparty, b.counterparty);
        var kRef = this._cmp(cf.reference, b.reference);
        var kVd = this._cmp(cf.value_date, b.value_date);
        var kAmt = this._amtCmp(cf.amount, b.amount, amtOk);
        var kCcy = this._cmp(cf.currency, b.currency);
        var kDir = this._cmp(cf.direction, b.direction);

        // Banner: summarise field-level discrepancies (differ) and missing fields.
        var diffs = [], miss = [];
        var checks = [
            ['Counterparty', kCp, cf.counterparty, b.counterparty],
            ['Trade Reference', kRef, cf.reference, b.reference],
            ['Value Date', kVd, cf.value_date, b.value_date],
            ['Amount', kAmt, cf.amount, b.amount],
            ['Currency Pair', kCcy, cf.currency, b.currency],
            ['Direction', kDir, cf.direction, b.direction]
        ];
        for (var i = 0; i < checks.length; i++) {
            if (checks[i][1] === 'bad') { diffs.push(checks[i][0]); }
            else if (!this._norm(checks[i][2]) || !this._norm(checks[i][3])) { miss.push(checks[i][0]); }
        }
        var banner = this._discBanner(diffs, miss);

        var left = this._panel('Counterparty Submitted Details', cf.counterparty, [
            this._row('Counterparty', cf.counterparty, kCp),
            this._row('Trade Reference', cf.reference, kRef),
            this._row('Value Date (YYYY-MM-DD)',cf.value_date, kVd),
            this._row('Amount', this._amt(cf.amount, cf.currency), kAmt),
            this._row('Currency Pair', cf.currency, kCcy),
            this._row('Direction', cf.direction, kDir)
        ]);
        var right = this._panel('Bank Booked Details (Matched in ' + this._esc(b.trade_system) + ')', b.counterparty, [
            this._row('Counterparty', b.counterparty, kCp),
            this._row('Trade Reference', b.reference, kRef),
            this._row('Value Date (YYYY-MM-DD)',b.value_date, kVd),
            this._row('Amount', this._amt(b.amount, b.currency), kAmt),
            this._row('Currency Pair', b.currency, kCcy),
            this._row('Direction', b.direction, kDir)
        ]);
        return this._comparePage(cf, m, banner, left, right);
    },

    // Exact (normalised) comparison for display highlighting: 'ok' agree, 'bad' differ,
    // 'plain' when one side is missing (that side then shows NOT FOUND via _row).
    _cmp: function (a, b2) {
        var x = this._norm(a), y = this._norm(b2);
        if (!x || !y) { return 'plain'; }
        return (x === y) ? 'ok' : 'bad';
    },
    // Amount comparison rides on the tolerance result already computed by match().
    _amtCmp: function (a, b2, amtOk) {
        if (!this._norm(a) || !this._norm(b2)) { return 'plain'; }
        return amtOk ? 'ok' : 'bad';
    },
    _norm: function (v) { return ('' + (v == null ? '' : v)).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().toLowerCase(); },

    // Discrepancy banner: green when everything agrees; amber listing fields that differ (red
    // chips) and fields not found on one side (grey chips).
    _discBanner: function (diffs, miss) {
        if (!diffs.length && !miss.length) {
            return this._banner('ok', 'All fields agree', 'Every field matches the bank booking.');
        }
        var chips = '';
        for (var i = 0; i < diffs.length; i++) { chips += ' <span class="chip">' + this._esc(diffs[i]) + '</span>'; }
        for (var j = 0; j < miss.length; j++) { chips += ' <span class="chip chip-nf">' + this._esc(miss[j]) + ' (not found)</span>'; }
        var n = diffs.length + miss.length;
        var title = n + (n === 1 ? ' field needs attention' : ' fields need attention');
        var msg = 'Matched on the core key (currency, direction, value date). ' +
            (diffs.length ? diffs.length + (diffs.length === 1 ? ' differs. ' : ' differ. ') : '') +
            (miss.length ? miss.length + ' not found. ' : '') + chips;
        return this._banner('warn', title, msg);
    },

    _comparePage: function (cf, m, banner, left, right) {
        var sub = 'Mail ' + this._esc(cf.mail_id) +
            (m.candidates > 1 ? ' · ' + m.candidates + ' candidate bookings shared the core key' : '');
        var body =
            '<div class="cm-head"><h1>Compare & Match</h1>' +
            '<a class="cm-back" href="/nfotcbsm?id=bsm_analystdashboard">← Dashboard</a></div>' +
            '<div class="cm-sub">' + sub + '</div>' +
            banner +
            '<div class="cm-grid">' + left + right + '</div>';
        return this._page(body);
    },

    _panel: function (title, subtitle, rowsHtml) {
        return '<div class="cm-panel"><div class="cm-p-title">' + this._esc(title) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="cm-p-sub">' + this._v(subtitle) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="cm-rows">' + rowsHtml.join('') + '</div></div>';
    },

    // kind: 'plain' (display only), 'ok' (agree, green), 'bad' (mismatch, red)
    // A field row. Empty value -> NOT FOUND tag (the field is missing on this side); otherwise the
    // value plus an agree tick (ok) or MISMATCH tag (bad).
    _row: function (label, value, kind) {
        var v = ('' + (value == null ? '' : value)).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        var cell, vcls = 'cm-val';
        if (!v) {
            cell = '<span class="cm-nf">NOT FOUND</span>';
            vcls += ' cm-val-nf';
        } else if (kind === 'bad') {
            cell = this._esc(v) + ' <span class="cm-x">MISMATCH</span>';
            vcls += ' cm-val-bad';
        } else if (kind === 'ok') {
            cell = this._esc(v) + ' <span class="cm-ck">✓</span>';
        } else {
            cell = this._esc(v);
        }
        return '<div class="cm-row"><div class="cm-lbl">' + this._esc(label) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="' + vcls + '">' + cell + '</div></div>';
    },

    _banner: function (kind, title, msg) {
        return '<div class="cm-banner cm-' + kind + '"><div class="cm-b-title">' + this._esc(title) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="cm-b-msg">' + msg + '</div></div>';
    },

    _amt: function (v, ccy) { v = this._clean(v); return v ? (v + (ccy ? ' ' + this._esc(ccy) : '')) : ''; },
    _clean: function (v) { return ('' + (v || '')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); },
    _v: function (val) { return val ? this._esc(val) : '<span class="dash">-</span>'; },
    _esc: function (s) { return ('' + (s || '')).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"'); },

    _page: function (body) {
        return '<style>' + this.CSS + '</style>' +
            '<div class="nom-app"><header class="nom-top">' +
            '<img class="nom-logo" src="' + this.LOGO + '" alt="Nomura"/>' +
            '<div class="nom-user"><span class="nom-role">Analyst</span><div class="nom-avatar">US</div></div>' +
            '</header><main class="cm-main">' + body + '</main></div>';
    },

    LOGO: 'data:image/png;base64,',


    CSS:
        '*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}' +
        '.nom-app{font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;background:#eef1f5;color:#20242c;min-height:100vh}' +
        '.nom-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;background:#fff;padding:12px 26px;border-bottom:3px solid #C8102E;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}' +
        '.nom-logo{height:34px;width:auto}' +
        '.nom-user{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}' +
        '.nom-role{font-size:13px;color:#5b6270}' +
        '.nom-avatar{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#C8102E;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}' +
        '.cm-main{padding:24px 40px;width:100%}' +
        '.cm-head{display:flex;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px}' +
        '.cm-head h1{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#1a1a2e}' +
        '.cm-back{margin-left:auto;font-size:13px;color:#C8102E;text-decoration:none}' +
        '.cm-back:hover{text-decoration:underline}' +
        '.cm-sub{font-size:12.5px;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:14px}' +
        '.cm-stats{display:flex;gap:12px;margin:14px 0 18px}' +
        '.cm-stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e6e9ef;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 22px;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(20,30,60,.05)}' +
        '.cm-stat-n{font-size:24px;font-weight:700}' +
        '.cm-stat-l{font-size:11.5px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:2px}' +
        '.cm-stat.cm-ok .cm-stat-n{color:#1E7E45}.cm-stat.cm-warn .cm-stat-n{color:#B7791F}.cm-stat.cm-bad .cm-stat-n{color:#C0392B}' +
        '.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e6e9ef;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(20,30,60,.05);overflow:hidden}' +
        '.card-h{font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:#1a1a2e;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f4}' +
        '.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px}' +
        '.tbl th{text-align:left;background:#1F2A44;color:#fff;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}' +
        '.tbl td{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f2f5;color:#2a2f39;white-space:nowrap}' +
        '.tbl tbody tr:hover{background:#f5f7fb}' +
        '.mono{font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-size:12px}.num{text-align:right;font-family:Consolas,monospace}' +
        '.dash{color:#c2c6cd}.empty{text-align:center;color:#6b7280;padding:26px}' +
        '.tg{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;white-space:nowrap}' +
        '.tg-ok{background:#e6f4ea;color:#1E7E45}.tg-warn{background:#fdf1e3;color:#B7791F}.tg-bad{background:#fbe9e7;color:#C0392B}' +
        '.cm-banner{border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:16px;border:1px solid}' +
        '.cm-banner.cm-ok{background:#eef8f1;border-color:#bfe3ca}.cm-banner.cm-warn{background:#fdf6e8;border-color:#f0dcae}.cm-banner.cm-bad{background:#fdeceb;border-color:#f2c3bd}' +
        '.cm-b-title{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:3px}' +
        '.cm-banner.cm-ok .cm-b-title{color:#1E7E45}.cm-banner.cm-warn .cm-b-title{color:#B7791F}.cm-banner.cm-bad .cm-b-title{color:#C0392B}' +
        '.cm-b-msg{font-size:12.5px;color:#5b6270}' +
        '.chip{display:inline-block;background:#fbe0dd;color:#C0392B;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:12px;margin-left:6px}' +
        '.cm-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}' +
        '.cm-panel{background:#fbfaf3;border:1px solid #e8e6d6;border-radius:12px;padding:22px 26px}' +
        '.cm-notfound{background:#fbe9e7;border:1px solid #f2c3bd;border-radius:12px;padding:38px 30px;text-align:center;margin-top:6px}' +
        '.cm-nf-icon{width:48px;height:48px;line-height:44px;margin:0 auto 14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #C0392B;color:#C0392B;font-size:22px;font-weight:700}' +
        '.cm-nf-title{color:#C0392B;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:8px}' +
        '.cm-nf-msg{color:#6b7280;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;max-width:440px;margin:0 auto}' +
        '.cm-p-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#1a1a2e}' +
        '.cm-p-sub{font-size:13px;color:#6b7280;margin:2px 0 16px}' +
        '.cm-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}' +
        '.cm-row{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #efeee2}' +
        '.cm-lbl{width:150px;font-size:12.5px;color:#6b7280}' +
        '.cm-val{flex:1;text-align:right;font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-size:13px;color:#20242c}' +
        '.cm-val-bad{color:#C0392B}' +
        '.cm-ck{color:#1E7E45;font-weight:700;margin-left:8px}' +
        '.cm-x{background:#f9d7d2;color:#C0392B;font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:10px;margin-left:8px}' +
        '.cm-nf{background:#eef0f4;color:#6b7280;font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:10px;letter-spacing:.3px}' +
        '.cm-val-nf .dash{display:none}' +
        '.chip-nf{background:#eef0f4;color:#6b7280}' +
        '@media(max-width:900px){.cm-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}',

    type: 'CompareMatch'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>a0999b1fd30a42628d5c158080d039e6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CompareMatch</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_a0999b1fd30a42628d5c158080d039e6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:44</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CapabilityRegistry</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Read/validate the capability marketplace: list, get(key), validateChain(keys).</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CapabilityRegistry</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * CapabilityRegistry — read/validate API over the capability marketplace (x_nose_nfotc_bsm_capability).
 * -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * This is the seam every consumer uses (the wizard/composer, the runner, a catalog view) so nothing
 * hardcodes the capability list. It:
 *   - list()/listByType()      enumerate the marketplace (active, ordered)
 *   - get(key)                 one capability with its JSON contract fields parsed
 *   - validateChain(keys)      check a proposed pipeline composes: every capability's `consumes` must
 *                              be `produced` by an earlier capability (or be present on a fresh Work Item)
 *
 * Purely additive + read-only against the registry — does not touch any OTC/CSG code.
 */
var CapabilityRegistry = Class.create();
CapabilityRegistry.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    TABLE: 'x_nose_nfotc_bsm_capability',
    // Fields a brand-new Work Item already carries, so a leading capability that consumes them is valid.
    SEED_FIELDS: ['source_type', 'source_ref', 'raw_content', 'work_driver'],

    _json: function (s, dflt) { try { return JSON.parse('' + (s || '')); } catch (e) { return dflt; } },

    // Shape one registry GlideRecord into a plain, contract-parsed object.
    _shape: function (gr) {
        return {
            key: gr.getValue('key'),
            name: gr.getValue('capability_name'),
            version: gr.getValue('version'),
            type: gr.getValue('cap_type'),
            category: gr.getValue('category'),
            owner: gr.getValue('owner'),
            description: gr.getValue('description'),
            consumes: this._json(gr.getValue('consumes'), []),
            produces: this._json(gr.getValue('produces'), []),
            config_schema: this._json(gr.getValue('config_schema'), {}),
            impl: gr.getValue('impl'),
            flags: this._json(gr.getValue('flags'), {}),
            seq: parseInt(gr.getValue('seq'), 10) || 0,
            active: gr.getValue('active') !== 'false',
        };
    },

    /** All active capabilities, ordered by seq. */
    list: function () {
        var out = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
        gr.addQuery('active', '!=', 'false');
        gr.orderBy('seq');
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) { out.push(this._shape(gr)); }
        return out;
    },

    /** Active capabilities of one type ('pipeline' | 'gate' | 'cross_cutting'). */
    listByType: function (type) {
        var all = this.list(), out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) { if (all[i].type === type) { out.push(all[i]); } }
        return out;
    },

    /** One capability by key, or null. */
    get: function (key) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
        gr.addQuery('key', key);
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        return gr.next() ? this._shape(gr) : null;
    },

    /**
     * Validate that an ordered list of capability keys composes into a runnable pipeline: each step's
     * `consumes` must already be `produced` by an earlier step (or be a seed field on a fresh Work Item).
     * @return {{ ok:boolean, issues:Array<{step:number,key:string,missing:string}>, produced:Array<string> }}
     */
    validateChain: function (keys) {
        var produced = this.SEED_FIELDS.slice();
        var issues = [];
        keys = keys || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
            var cap = this.get(keys[i]);
            if (!cap) { issues.push({ step: i + 1, key: keys[i], missing: '(unknown capability)' }); continue; }
            // Gates / cross-cutting consume '*' (the whole item) — never a chaining constraint.
            var needs = cap.consumes || [];
            for (var n = 0; n < needs.length; n++) {
                if (needs[n] === '*') { continue; }
                if (produced.indexOf(needs[n]) === -1) {
                    issues.push({ step: i + 1, key: cap.key, missing: needs[n] });
                }
            }
            for (var p = 0; p < (cap.produces || []).length; p++) {
                if (produced.indexOf(cap.produces[p]) === -1) { produced.push(cap.produces[p]); }
            }
        }
        return { ok: issues.length === 0, issues: issues, produced: produced };
    },

    type: 'CapabilityRegistry',
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>e5776079fcc64ca3ace78c9b4558dd5b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CapabilityRegistry</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_e5776079fcc64ca3ace78c9b4558dd5b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:44</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

Counterparty is DERIVED from the sender via the * x_nose_nfotc_bsm_counterparty directory (not AI-extracted). Stamps it on the mail. */ (function execute(inputs, outputs) { var cp = ''; var g = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email'); if (g.get(inputs.email_record)) { cp = g.getValue('counterparty_name') || ''; if (!cp) { // Find the sender's email ADDRESS across BOTH sender and mail_from. Some mails fold the From // header across two lines, so `sender` (captured single-line) holds only the display name while // `mail_from` carries the address — search both so the EVE lookup always sees the address. var hay = ('' + (g.getValue('sender') || '') + ' ' + (g.getValue('mail_from') || '')).toLowerCase(); var m = hay.match(/[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+/); var addr = m ? m[0] : ''; if (addr) { var d = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_counterparty'); d.addQuery('email_address', addr); d.query(); if (d.next()) { cp = d.getValue('org_name'); g.setValue('counterparty_name', cp); g.update(); } } } } outputs.counterparty = cp; })(inputs, outputs); 71aa7f6647032200b4fad7527c9a719bemail_record7473cd1692b34c8fb545bc4bc37083b0akshit.mahajan2026-09-03 11:56:30b1949556c8bc4f7aaae235ea4151ca6e0akshit.mahajan2026-09-03 11:56:30var__m_sys_hub_step_ext_input_7473cd1692b34c8fb545bc4bc37083b0

Runs the tiered cascade under the owning wizard's config, persists the outcome * onto the cashflow (status / tier / bank ref / confidence / candidate count), and audits it. * * inputs.cashflow_record = sys_id of the x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow just confirmed * outputs.status/tier/bank_ref/confidence/candidates = the computed result (for the flow log) */ (function execute(inputs, outputs) { var r = new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.CompareMatch().matchAndStore(inputs.cashflow_record); outputs.status = r.status || ''; outputs.tier = '' + (r.tier || 0); outputs.bank_ref = r.bankRef || ''; outputs.confidence = '' + Math.round(r.confidence || 0); // r.confidence is already a 0-100 integer % — do NOT re-scale outputs.candidates = '' + (r.candidates || 0); // Audit the automated match (BRD §Audit / FSD §15) — the flow ran this, not the analyst. try { var cf = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_cashflow'); if (cf.get(inputs.cashflow_record)) { var mailId = '', cp = ''; var em = new GlideRecord('x_nose_nfotc_bsm_email'); if (em.get(cf.getValue('email'))) { mailId = em.getValue('name'); cp = em.getValue('counterparty_name'); } new x_nose_nfotc_bsm.AuditTrail().log('match.computed', { entityType: 'cashflow', entityId: inputs.cashflow_record, cashflowId: inputs.cashflow_record, emailId: cf.getValue('email'), mailId: mailId, counterparty: cp, actor: 'system (Flow B)', summary: 'Flow ran Compare & Match after extraction confirmation: ' + (r.status || 'no_match') + (r.tier ? sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_67b2607108274eb3a5fe9a4e6baa52c2
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl>cf9d01d3e73003009d6247e603f6a990</enforce_acl><http_method>POST</http_method><name>invoke</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {
    // Write RAW JSON (stream writer) so ServiceNow does NOT wrap it in {"result":...} — the response
    // transformer expects LLMDocuResponse / LLMError at the TOP level.
    function raw(obj) {
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        response.getStreamWriter().writeString(JSON.stringify(obj));
    }
    function deny() {
        response.setStatus(401);
        response.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        response.getStreamWriter().writeString(JSON.stringify({ LLMError: { message: 'unauthorized', code: 'AUTH' } }));
    }
    try {
        // Shared-secret gate. Enforced ONLY when the property is set (so the flow never breaks before it is
        // configured). Accept the key from the '?k=' query param OR an 'x-bridge-key' header — whichever the
        // outbound hop reliably carries. HARDENING for prod: also restrict source IP at the network layer.
        var secret = gs.getProperty('x_nose_nfotc_bsm.chinou_bridge_key', '');
        if (secret) {
            var qp = request.queryParams || {};
            var qk = qp.k ? ('' + (qp.k.length ? qp.k[0] : qp.k)) : '';
            var hk = '';
            try { hk = request.getHeader('x-bridge-key') || ''; } catch (eh) { hk = ''; }
            if (qk !== secret && ('' + hk) !== secret) { deny(); return; }
        }

        // Read the body robustly: request.body.data is the parsed object for application/json;
        // fall back to dataString (both can throw on an empty body, so guard each).
        var body = null;
        try { body = (request && request.body) ? request.body.data : null; } catch (e1) { body = null; }
        if (!body) {
            try {
                var ds = (request && request.body) ? request.body.dataString : '';
                if (ds) { body = JSON.parse(ds); }
            } catch (e2) { body = null; }
        }
        if (!body) { raw({ LLMError: { message: 'no request body', code: 'UNDEFINED' } }); return; }

        var req = body.LLMRequest || {};
        var prompt = (req.body != null) ? ('' + req.body) : '';
        var model = (req.LLMDescriptor && req.LLMDescriptor.model) ? ('' + req.LLMDescriptor.model) : '';
        if (!prompt) { raw({ LLMError: { message: 'empty prompt', code: 'UNDEFINED' } }); return; }

        // ChinouClient is a global-scope Script Include accessible from all scopes; it carries the MID route
        // + Basic/svcnewsd auth on the 'Chinou API' REST Message, so this works in ANY context.
        var r = new global.ChinouClient().invoke(prompt, model);

        if (!r || !r.success) {
            raw({ LLMError: { message: (r && r.error) ? ('' + r.error) : 'chinou_failed', code: (r && r.blocked) ? 'GUARDRAIL' : 'UNDEFINED' } });
            return;
        }
        raw({
            LLMDocuResponse: {
                body: '' + (r.response || ''),
                ComplianceChecks: { Decision: { decision: 'RESPOND' } },
                metrics: { cost: r.costUsd, execution_time_ms: r.responseTimeMs }
            }
        });
    } catch (e) {
        raw({ LLMError: { message: 'bridge error: ' + e, code: 'UNDEFINED' } });
    }
})(request, response)]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_nose_nfotc_bsm/chinou_bridge/invoke</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/invoke</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>false</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Loopback: chinou-json:1 in -> ChinouClient (MID) -> chinou-json:1 out.</short_description><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 11:56:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>67b2607108274eb3a5fe9a4e6baa52c2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>invoke</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM" source="x_nose_nfotc_bsm">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Names and Forms OTC BSM">eff39d2ab73de50d8051b95090f30712</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_67b2607108274eb3a5fe9a4e6baa52c2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>akshit.mahajan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:56:49</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Chinou Bridge">294421223a584a1895eef5191871b6d8</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
